The hotel's exclusive leisure facilities include a gym with the latest equipment and an indoor swimming pool and sauna where guests can rest and relax. At the on-site bar and restaurant, visitors can enjoy informal dining and something for every taste as they take in iconic views of Edinburgh's famous Grassmarket and Edinburgh Castle.

7530.description: Perfectly placed in the city's fashionable West End this elegant hotel boasts a great location in combination with fantastic modern interiors that offer a very warm welcome. Within a short walk from Botanic Gardens 1. 9m and only a few minutes' drive from Kelvingrove Art Gallery and Museum and the city centre of Glasgow, this family-friendly establishment is a great base for those wanting to explore all that Glasgow has to offer. From guided excursions to cafes and bars on tap, there is something for everyone. Whether staying for business or leisure the hotel is the perfect choice to make sure it will be a memorable one. Guest rooms are modern and stylish with digital TV, welcome tray and 24 hour room service. The Brasserie serves up wonderful food all day every day and guests may also enjoy a drink from the welcoming bar. There are 3 functional meeting rooms and free parking for guests' added convenience.

7531.description: The Glasgow Grosvenor Hotel is the perfect place to stay when visiting Scotland's biggest city. Set in the bustling West End of Glasgow, just minutes from the city center via subway, walking distance from Glasgow University and overlooking the Botanic Gardens, our hotel is in the ideal location. Excellent transport links are available to the SECC and the Hydro and Glasgow International Airport is just a 20 minute drive from the hotel. Hold a wedding, graduation ball, conference or special event in one of six meeting and function suites for 2-450 guests or dine in our award winning outlets. Bo'Vine Meats & Wines, our steak restaurant specializing in seasonal, locally sourced ingredients and fine wines. Visit beGIN, our cocktail lounge where you'll find over 100 gins from around the world along with a choice of cocktails, craft beers, wines and spirits.

7533.description: 'The centrally located Hilton Glasgow hotel, a city landmark, is the perfect starting point for exploring Glasgow's attractions, surrounding golf courses, the Highlands, and even Edinburgh, just 40 minutes away! Glasgow Central Station, the King's Theatre, the shopping district, the OVO Hydro, numerous restaurants and bars, and many other local attractions are within walking distance. Enjoy stunning views from your guest room, savor seasonal dishes or a whisky cocktail at the Whisky Mist Bar & Kitchen, or indulge in the famous Dilmah Afternoon Tea in the Tea Lounge by Dilmah. Unwind after a long day in the Health Club's indoor pool and gym. For business travelers, the hotel offers meeting and event space for up to 1, 000 delegates. Children under 5 eat free from the children's menu, while those aged 6-16 enjoy breakfast for £10 and can also order from the children's menu. These children's dining rates apply regardless of the package booked. '

7535.description: The 4-star Novotel Glasgow Centre is conveniently located in the heart of the vibrant city. This family-friendly hotel is set amongst the hustle and bustle of Glasgow, making getting around town easy. Guests can rejuvenate after busy city days in the state-of-the-art fitness centre, or relax completely in the sauna and stream room. The hotel offers a choice of Standard, Superior and Executive rooms, all of which are furnished to a high standard with style and comfort in mind.

7536.description: Situated on Jamaica Street, our four star hotel in Glasgow is within a ten minute walk of three major stations- Glasgow Central, Queen Street and Argyle Street making it the ideal hotel for transport links within the city centre. With an easy three minute train ride (or 20 minute walk) to the Scottish Exhibition and Conference Centre and The Hydro Entertainment Arena, Leonardo Royal Hotel Glasgow is perfectly placed for both business and pleasure guests. Our Leonardo Royal Hotel in Glasgow offers 321 comfortable, stylish and affordable hotel rooms able accommodate up to three adults or a family of four (two children, two adults). All our Glasgow hotel rooms are en-suite and come with complimentary toiletries, a flat screen TV, free WiFi, air conditioning and room service available 24 hours. *It is mandatory to provide a full name per room in case of 2 or more rooms are booked.

7537.address: March Burn Drive, Glasgow Airport Business Park, 1
7537.description: Enjoy convenient amenities at the Courtyard by Marriott Glasgow Airport, including a 24-hour fitness center and a relaxing garden. This hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, a banquet hall, and a vending machine. Dine at the on-site restaurant for lunch or dinner, or enjoy 24-hour room service. Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available on weekdays from 6:00 AM to 10:00 AM and on weekends from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM (for a fee). Business services, express check-out, and dry cleaning/laundry services are also available. Self-parking is offered (subject to charges). The hotel's 170 air-conditioned rooms feature refrigerators, minibars, and pillowtop beds with Egyptian cotton sheets. Each room also includes complimentary Wi-Fi and a bathroom with a bathtub or shower, complimentary toiletries, and a hair dryer. Located near Glasgow International Airport (GLA), the hotel is also convenient to St. Mirren Park, Paisley Campus of the University of the West of Scotland, and various other attractions.

7540.description: Located in the heart of London, St. Ermin's Hotel, Autograph Collection, is within a 10-minute walk of Buckingham Palace and Westminster Abbey. This upscale hotel offers 331 air-conditioned rooms, each featuring a refrigerator, minibar, and a 50-inch LED TV with satellite programming. Complimentary wired and wireless internet access is provided. Bathrooms include showers, designer toiletries, and hair dryers. Guests can enjoy the fitness center, terrace, and garden, or dine at the Caxton Grill, which offers alfresco dining and a bar/lounge. A full breakfast is available for a fee. Additional amenities include 24-hour room service, concierge and wedding services, a business center, and limo/town car service. Self-parking is available (subject to charges).

name.content: The May Fair Hotel, Mayfair, London

7541.description: The May Fair Hotel, Mayfair London is an iconic hotel with a rich history, set in one of London’s most sought-after locations. Buckingham Palace, Bond Street’s exclusive shops. Green Park station is nearby, ensuring seamless travel across the city. Since opening in 1927, The May Fair Hotel, Mayfair London has blended modern design with its glamorous heritage. Rooms feature luxury Vispring beds with down pillows, 400 thread count, sateen finish, 100% cotton, high-speed WiFi for unlimited devices, Samsung TVs with 300+ international channels, Italian marble bathrooms, and sustainable Noble Isle skincare products. Guests can savour an intimate Japanese izakaya and Italian menu at May Fair Kitchen, while May Fair Bar offers global cuisine and signature cocktails. The hotel also boasts stunning event spaces, including a Crystal Ballroom, screening room, tranquil spa, and gym.

7542.description: A modern hotel near central London's attractions, with free Wi-Fi and smart event facilities. Holiday Inn® London - Regent's Park hotel offers easy access to central London's major attractions, with Great Portland Street and Regent's Park Tube stations just a few minutes away. The hotel is near A501 and a 45-minute drive from Heathrow Airport. You can head to the leafy grounds of Regent's Park or hit the shops on buzzy Oxford Street, both an easy walk from the hotel. Family-friendly attractions like Madame Tussauds, the Sherlock Holmes Museum & London Zoo are all a stone's throw from the hotel. You can discover ancient treasures and learn about cultures from around the world at the British Museum, less than a mile away, or see an exhibition at the British Library. Theatre lovers can reach the West End in 15 minutes on foot, along with the bars & restaurants of vibrant Soho. Planning your next training day or conference? The Academy is a modern events centre fitted with the latest technology and high-speed Wi-Fi. There's a dedicated reception and banquet kitchen, plus an operations team to help plan your event. Training packages are available. Unwind and choose from our extensive rate of wine, beers and spirits on our comfortable range of seating. Chill or catch up on the day’s emails with complimentary WiFi. Afterwards, tuck into hearty meals in the newly renovated open lobby. Kids Stay and Eat Free.

7543.description:
Opened in 1955, The Hotel is primely located on Bond Street, in the heart of Mayfair's fashion and arts district. The only hotel to occupy such a prized address, it shares its illustrious position with prestigious boutiques, arts institutions and city landmarks, offering an ideal base from which to explore the individuality and authentic personality of the neighbourhood.Built in an era when American glamour prevailed, the hotel is styled from white Portland stone, dark marble and architectural brass detailing that renders it both notable and distinctive in character. Classic styling permeates throughout the property which has been indelibly influenced by its proximity to the high-end world of design, tailoring and the arts. The story of fashion through the decades is showcased in black and white photographic detail on each floor, while intriguing and evolving snapshots of British design are routinely placed throughout the lobby.
With an ample inventory of suites, The Westbury Mayfair, offers an enriching choice of distinctively styled spaces, with a variety of inter-connecting options, where warm, discreet and personalised service is a given. Guests staying in select suites also benefit from the unrivalled Butler service that is tailored to individual wishes and needs. The distinguished Berkeley and Hanover Suites, located on the 7th floor and the distinctive top floor St George's Penthouse, boast spacious outside terraces that overlook the Mayfair skyline.Awarded one Michelin star, Alyn Williams at The Westbury brings inspired dining to Mayfair with a creative culinary menu that extends to lunch, dinner and a tasting menu. Gastronomes can choose to dine in the main restaurant or in the privacy of the Wine Room, flanked with 600 bottles of wine, or the larger, Aspen Room, with its hand-blown glass fixtures, that seats 20 guests. Sushi devotees will find crafted Japanese cuisine in Tsukiji Sushi, an intimate space with a refined ambience, where traditional recipes

7544.description: The Tower Hotel sits adjacent to the iconic Tower Bridge, offering excellent connections to Canary Wharf, the Excel Centre, the O2 Arena, and central London, all within a 5-minute walk. For meetings and events, the hotel's dedicated 12th-floor conference level provides a fantastic view of the city. Guests can enjoy delicious dishes and cocktails at Vicinity or escape the bustling streets below at VU from the Tower, savoring expertly crafted cocktails in a sophisticated atmosphere. London City Airport is just 45 minutes away. The hotel also holds the Greenage ECOSmart 2023 Gold Accreditation.

7545.description: Hyatt Regency London Churchill is an international five-star business hotel nestled on the picturesque gardens of Portman Square, London W1, just 100 metres north of Marble Arch. The hotel is ideally situated in London's West End, close to many of London's main attractions and exclusive shopping areas, plus Hyatt Regency London - The Churchill is perfectly placed for easy access to the City. The hotel is also just minutes from Paddington Station where the Heathrow Express train takes a mere 15 minutes directly from London's Heathrow Airport. Hyatt Regency London - The Churchill's 440 well-appointed hotel guest rooms and suites offer complete comfort and luxury. Regency Club, Hyatt's 'hotel within a hotel' concept, is designed for hotel guests looking for a higher level of personalised service and a more intimate atmosphere. Hyatt Regency London - The Churchill offers guests a dining experiences at The Montagu where British and European comfort foods are prepared in a striking open kitchen, and hotel guests can also enjoy a large selection of cocktails and whiskies in The Churchill Bar.

7546.description: Whether you choose our 4-star hotel for business or leisure, Novotel London West is the perfect place to stay for comfort and location. Situated in the bustling heart of Hammersmith, West London, discover the amazing sights the capital has to offer thanks to the nearby tube station. Whatever your reason for visiting—a weekend city break, family holiday, or business trip—you can be confident we have the perfect room or event space for you.

7547.description:
Situated on the prestigious Grosvenor Square in Mayfair, The Biltmore Mayfair offers a refined London stay surrounded by some of the city’s most iconic landmarks, including Hyde Park, Buckingham Palace, Bond Street, and the West End. With its central location, the hotel provides convenient access to London’s leading shopping, cultural, and business destinations. 

The hotel features beautifully designed rooms and suites with contemporary interiors, calming colour palettes, and thoughtful amenities. Guests can enjoy spacious accommodation with marble bathrooms, premium toiletries, and views overlooking Grosvenor Square or the hotel’s landscaped courtyard. The property also offers a fully equipped fitness centre, concierge services, and Free WiFi throughout the hotel. 

Guests can experience a variety of dining options, including Café Biltmore Restaurant & Terrace, serving all-day dining with globally inspired cuisine in a relaxed setting. The Foliage Lounge offers a traditional Afternoon Tea experience, while The Pine Bar provides a welcoming space for cocktails, and Grill 88 offers a refined dining experience featuring premium steaks and seafood, ideal for intimate dinner, and special occasions. 

Combining elegant accommodation, exceptional service, and a sought-after Mayfair location, The Biltmore Mayfair provides a comfortable and convenient base for discovering London.

7548.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. You can take advantage of recreational amenities such as an indoor pool, a sauna, and a 24-hour fitness center. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Enjoy Japanese cuisine at The Aubrey, one of the hotel's 3 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Need to unwind? Take a break with a tasty beverage at one of the 2 bars/lounges. English breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include limo/town car service, a computer station, and express check-in. Make yourself at home in one of the 181 guestrooms featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions. Satellite programming and DVD players are provided for your entertainment, while complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected.

7549.description: An icon of British hospitality since 1963, London Hilton on Park Lane was the first Hilton hotel to open in the UK — and we’ve been purveyors of excellence ever since. Located in the heart of Mayfair, our hotel is the perfect getaway to explore London by foot or bike. You can walk to West End in 25 minutes, go shopping at Harrods in under 20 minutes or explore the Royal Parks and Buckingham Palace only a 15 minute walk away from the hotel. Hire a Santander Cycle, in front of the hotel, and cycle along the Thames to the Tower of London and the famous Tower Bridge all in just 25 minutes. Step inside the hotel and find elegant rooms with magnificent views, world-class dining, and modern facilities for business and relaxation — everything you need for a memorable stay in the capital. London's magnificent city and park views await you from a Guest Room or Suite. Our Deluxe Rooms offer more space while Executive Rooms provide Executive Lounge access. For something extra special, select a spacious Suite with sweeping views of Hyde Park, Mayfair or the city. Guests are also invited to sample our Chocoholic Afternoon Tea designed and created by our winners of The Bake Off: The Professionals 2018. Or discover London's pre-eminent sky bar, 10 Degrees, for signature cocktails, whilst enjoying stunning views across London and indulge into a culinary experience at our award-winning restaurant, Galvin at Windows with 360-degree views on the 28th floor. For a tropical escape, taste a little bit of paradise in the home of Mai Tai’s and luscious dishes in the midst of authentic artefacts at our Polynesian restaurant Trader Vic’s.

7550.description:
Wake up in the centre of the action, Thistle Trafalgar Square is steps away from London’s iconic Trafalgar Square – home of history, culture, and family fun. Situated in the middle of the West End and the famous Theatreland area, the hotel is only a 2-minute stroll to the famous Chinatown, 10 minutes to Covent Garden and just a 5-minute walk to Piccadilly Circus. The perfect base to explore London, less than 10 minutes from Charing Cross train station, Leicester Square and Piccadilly Tube stops, enabling guests to easily access all that London has to offer.  
Thistle Trafalgar Square offers a welcoming retreat in the centre of it all, with everything you need to explore the city’s landmarks, theatres, and vibrant dining scene.

7552.description: Flemings Mayfair is one of the few remaining independent privately owned hotels in London that has been in the same family for over 40 years. It is also one of the capital’s oldest established, having opened its doors in 1851. Part of Small Luxury Hotels of the World, the award-winning hotel offers unrivalled luxury accommodation in the heart of Mayfair just moments from Green Park, Piccadilly, and a short walk from Buckingham Palace. Comprising thirteen townhouses that date from 1734, Flemings’ interiors are a chic blend of modern Art Deco style and Georgian elegance with an intimacy that belies the hotel’s 129 sumptuous guest rooms and luxury suites, including ten fully serviced apartments of either one, two or three bedrooms. It is the perfect base for a leisure escape with the very best that London has to offer literally right on its doorstep. Home to highly acclaimed One-Michelin-starred restaurant Ormer Mayfair by Executive chef Sofian Msetfi and consistently ranked as one of the finest dining experiences in London. Sofian and his team offer a simpler and yet inspired dining experience with cooking suffused with creativity and originality. The dining experience is for you to take your time to savour a sublime food journey in an atmosphere that is as polished and sophisticated as it is relaxed. And the intimate Manetta’s Bar that offers an ambiance redolent of the glamorous 1930's.

7553.description: The hotel is conveniently situated in the heart of London's Royal Borough of Kensington and Chelsea, overlooking Kensington Palace, in the west part of the metropolis. Just a short drive from the M40, M4 and M25 motorways, the hotel is also just minutes from Earls Court and the Olympia Exhibition Halls, and is within a short drive of London's financial district. The hotel offers contemporary accommodation with a choice of 3 bars and two restaurants. The Tenth is the fine-dining, award-winning restaurant, which has stunning views of the London skyline. This combines with conference and banqueting facilities, and a business centre open 24 hours a day. There are 396 guest rooms in total. All of the spacious guest rooms offer a work area with a desk, a comfy chair and a coffee table, in which to either work or relax. A private en suite bathroom, personal safe, minibar and many additional comforts are included in the room. A large proportion of bedrooms are designated non-smoking. Single occupancy rooms feature a double bed and have views of either Kensington Palace and Gardens and the Royal Household Mews, or look out over a buzzing Kensington High Street and the neighbourhood's quaint 'Mary Poppins' rooftops. Other rooms, which are for double occupancy, feature either a twin or king-size bed. Like the single rooms, views include the green vistas of Kensington Gardens, or the city's rooftops. North-facing rooms overlook the quiet Royal Household Mews. To help guests relax after a busy day, the hotel provides a health spa, featuring state-of-the-art exercise equipment, a sauna and a steam room. Other services provided at an additional charge include massage and physiotherapy treatments. An exquisite, extensive breakfast buffet is on offer to guests on a daily basis. In addition to this, it is possible to pay a visit to the excellent hotel restaurants where the finest wines and dishes are available.

7555.description: A landmark itself, Charing Cross opened in 1865 and remains one of the most well-places hotels. A few steps to Trafalgar Square. A minute's stroll to London's West End, A stone's throw away from The National Gallery and so much more. And when exploring more of the city, Charing Cross station is right next door. Our rooms, along with some handy extras, are all set up to send you soundly off to sleep. The Clermont Restaurant & Bar serves an all-day menu of fresh, seasonal British cuisine. The menu in our Charing Cross restaurant is inspired by the classics with a modern twist, created from fresh, locally sourced produce wherever possible. So, whether it's a breakfast to set you up for the day, a three-course meal, or an evening of cocktails, our restaurant and bar have you covered. Hotel residents receive complimentary use of the hotel's fitness centre which features a full range of cardiovascular fitness equipment and weights.

7556.description:
Situated at one of London’s most prestigious addresses, InterContinental London Park Lane embodies the epitome of refined luxury and timeless elegance. Overlooking the iconic Royal Parks and set in the heart of Mayfair, our hotel seamlessly blends classic heritage with contemporary sophistication. From award-winning seasonal cuisine to our tranquil spa, every detail is crafted to deliver an unparalleled experience. 

Dear guest, from early October 2026, we will be undertaking a thoughtfully planned enhancement of selected guest rooms on the 5th and 6th floors, alongside the rolling refurbishment of our guest lifts. Both programmes reflect our commitment to excellence and are carefully managed to minimise disruption and ensure seamless guest experience. Works are expected to be completed by June 2027.

7557.description: ibis London Earls Court is a 12-storey three-star hotel with breathtaking views of the London skyline. With 226 guestrooms, including suites, family, triple and accessible rooms, a business centre, bespoke Food and Beverage outlets and on-site parking, it offers an ideal base for both business and leisure travellers. We offer a 24-hour reception and information desk and 24-hour snack service.

7558.description: Holiday Inn London Bloomsbury offers a prime central London location with dining, excellent meeting facilities, and complimentary Wi Fi. Located just steps from Russell Square Tube station on the Piccadilly Line, the hotel provides quick access to major transport hubs King's Cross St. Pancras and Euston stations are both under a mile away and accessible within five minutes by bus or taxi. Heathrow Airport 'LHR' is a convenient 40 minute drive. Guests are close to popular attractions, with Oxford Street's bustling shops just a 10 minute taxi ride away, and the British Museum's world class collections only half a mile from the hotel. Leicester Square and the West End's nightlife are just an 11 minute tube ride, while family fun at London Zoo is a quick 10 minute cab ride. The hotel's Academy Conference and Training Suites are ideal for conferences, weddings, or celebrations, accommodating up to 300 guests. A dedicated host, video conferencing capabilities, and included refreshments make planning smooth and stress free. Guests can dine at the Junction Restaurant for breakfast, lunch, or dinner and unwind with a Starbucks coffee or a drink at the Junction Bar. Callaghan's Bar offers live sports viewing, a hearty pub menu, and an outdoor terrace. Plus, kids stay and eat for free.

7559.description: There's more to Hampstead than its world-famous heath. You'll find shops, bars and restaurants galore, lovely parks, and amazing views across the city skyline. And, while Hampstead has that laid-back village feel, it's all just minutes from central London. Go bargain hunting at nearby Camden Town Market. Watch wickets tumble at Lords Cricket Ground. Or catch the big match or must-see show at Wembley. Then return to some well-earned R&R - your chance to enjoy the friendliest service, tasty food, and extra-comfy beds. All reservations placed at this hotel are subject to Premier Inn’s standard Terms and Conditions, which can be found at premierinn. com

7560.description: The Mayfair Townhouse, comprised of seven listed Georgian buildings, offers a discreet address in the heart of Mayfair. Steps from Green Park tube station and upscale shopping, this hotel, opened in December 2020, features 172 rooms and suites, the Dandy Bar, a private gym, and event spaces. Inspired by a whimsical past, this stylish hotel overlooks Green Park and delivers high-end service in a warm setting.

7562.description: Convenient & Comfortable Hotel Near Wembley StadiumA contemporary London hotel located steps away from the electric atmosphere of Wembley Park, with both the iconic Wembley Stadium and The SSE Arena on our doorstep. With 336 guest rooms and 7 flexible meeting and events spaces accommodating up to 700 guests, Holiday Inn London - Wembley hotel is perfect for both business and leisure guests alike. Next door you’ll find London Designer Outlet, Cineworld and the latest addition to the area, Troubadour Wembley Park Theatre. With both Wembley Park and Wembley Central Station’s a short walk away, you can be transported into central London with ease or conjure up some magic at Warner Bros. Studio Tour, the home of Harry Potter, a 40-minute drive away. As well as a fantastic location, our Wembley Stadium hotel provides all the amenities you need to ensure a relaxing and comfortable stay. Free Wi-Fi, power showers, satellite TV and a choice of pillows to ensure a great night’s sleep come as standard. Suites come with extra living space and our family rooms with sofa beds means children under 13 stay and dine for free. Breakfast and all-day dining are served in The Arch Restaurant or grab a coffee to go from our 24/7 coffee shop.

7563.description: Welcome to the a&o London Docklands Riverside, located along the River Thames with stunning views of Canary Wharf – perfect for travelers looking to make the most out of London. This former 17th century Wharf Building boasts exposed brickwork and London’s last dry dock for shipbuilding. The hotel’s complimentary ferry provides access to Canary Wharf and a connection to the Thames Clippers for an unforgettable voyage into central London. The nearby Underground station and Docklands Light Railway also offer links to the city. Your memorable stay at our Docklands hotel begins with a warm chocolate chip cookie at check-in. Guest rooms feature a flat-screen LCD TV, opening windows and tea/coffee facilities. Most guest rooms also boast city and river views. Business travelers will appreciate the laptop-sized safe, large desk and 24-hour room service. Choose a suite for a separate living area with sofa bed – perfect for families. WiFi is complimentary in all guest rooms and public areas. Discover our Columbia Restaurant, and savor seasonal produce and individual barbecues on the outdoor terrace. For private dining, visit The Library or The Snug – exceptional places to celebrate special occasions. With 9, 286 sq. ft. of event space, our Riverside hotel is ideal for your next function. Host a conference for up to 350 guests in one of 15 meeting rooms. Wedding receptions are stylish in the Millennium Suite, which opens to the terrace for spectacular London views.

7564.description: Thistle Bloomsbury Park is an Edwardian hotel, set right in the heart of the West End. A prime location in London, whether you want to do a spot of shopping on Oxford Street, visit cultural locations including St Paul’s Cathedral and the British Museum, or experience the vibrant atmosphere of Covent Garden and Soho. Plus, in close proximity to great transport links with Euston and Holborn tube stations just a short walk away. No matter if you’re here for business or a bit of fun, the 95 en-suite rooms have what you need to make your trip easy and enjoyable. There are a range of rooms to choose from, take your pick from twin to family rooms. The rooms include fast, free and unlimited Wi-Fi, a flat screen LCD TV with Freeview, tea/coffee facilities and a private bathroom with a hairdryer. Kick-start your day with some seriously tasty treats. Our breakfast is filled with modern spins on that classic British cuisine we all love. Visit our self-service counter in the reception area for a selection of alcoholic beverages, soft drinks, and snacks. Simply pick your favourites and pay at the reception—quick and easy!Please note this property does not have air conditioning, portable fans are available.

7565.description: This elegant hotel enjoys a delightful setting at the heart of London, lying between Piccadilly Circus and Leicester Square. The hotel is situated within easy access to a host of attractions in the city, as well as delightful shopping, entertainment and dining venues. Convenient links to the public transport network are available nearby. This charming hotel dates back to the early 20th century, welcoming guests into the elegant surroundings of the lobby. The guest rooms offer a haven of peace and serenity, in which to completely relax and unwind at the end of the day. The rooms are well equipped with modern amenities, for the utmost in comfort and convenience.

7566.description: Children up to 18 stay free (with existing bedding) when sharing a room with a paying adult on a room-only rate. Children 12 and under enjoy complimentary breakfast from the buffet. The purpose-built Coburg Court Hotel, first opened in 1907 and later renamed the Coburg Hotel in the early 1960s, was created by D. Joseph, the architect behind several London Underground stations. Now occupying this iconic, Grade II listed Edwardian townhouse, the Hilton London Hyde Park boasts a prime location overlooking Hyde Park and Kensington Palace. Guest rooms are elegantly designed with the modern traveler in mind, blending classic style with contemporary amenities. Whether you're visiting London for shopping, sightseeing, or business, the hotel offers a warm and welcoming atmosphere. Conveniently located in Bayswater on Queensway, the hotel is adjacent to two Underground stations—Queensway and Bayswater—servicing the Central, Circle, and District lines, placing all of London's key destinations within 20 minutes. With Hyde Park right at your doorstep, enjoy a jog or a relaxing stroll. Explore nearby Kensington Palace, Serpentine Lake, and the Diana Memorial Fountain. The shopping district of Oxford Street is within easy reach, and the hotel is within walking distance of Portobello Road Market and Harrods. Enjoy relaxed dining in the hotel's Library Lounge. The bustling Bayswater district, bordered by Edgware Road, Kensington, and Notting Hill, is known for its diverse culinary scene.

7567.description:
Feel at home in Fulham, one of London’s most vibrant neighbourhoods. Located at Stamford Bridge on Fulham Road, lyf Chelsea London is ideal for city explorers, football fans, families, and business travellers. Choose from cosy double rooms or spacious family rooms for up to 2 adults and 2 children. 

Enjoy easy access to London’s top attractions, from the West End and South Kensington to Oxford Street. With excellent transport links nearby, explore the city at your own pace. From matchday excitement at Stamford Bridge to shopping and dining on King’s Road, London is right on your doorstep. 

Start your day with breakfast at 55 Bar & Dining, then relax in our vibrant bar-lounge, perfect for meeting friends, socialising, or enjoying lunch, dinner, and drinks.

7568.description: The Hilton London Angel Islington, situated in the heart of fashionable Islington in North London, offers convenient access to Kings Cross and Central London. A short walk from Angel Tube Station, the hotel is also next door to the British Design Center. The area boasts a wide selection of restaurants and bars, perfect for both business and leisure travelers. The hotel features elegantly designed rooms and suites, with upgrades to Executive Rooms and Suites providing Executive Lounge access. Following a recent renovation, the hotel offers a modern lobby, a grab-and-go facility, and the stylish Halo Bar and Restaurant, serving breakfast and an all-day menu featuring international dishes and signature cocktails. The hotel also provides a 24-hour fitness room and a small meeting space, the Angel Suite, equipped with state-of-the-art technology. Complimentary Wi-Fi is available for Hilton Honors members.

7570.description: Centrally located in London, Park Avenue Bayswater Inn Hyde Park is within a 10-minute walk of Kensington Gardens and Portobello Road Market. This hotel offers 148 guestrooms with flat-screen TVs, complimentary Wi-Fi, and digital programming. Enjoy on-site dining at the restaurant, or take advantage of room service (limited hours). A buffet breakfast is available daily (fee applies). Amenities include a 24-hour front desk, multilingual staff, and luggage storage. Hyde Park is 1 mi (1. 7 km) and Kensington Palace is 1. 3 mi (2. 1 km) away.

7571.description: This comfortable Art Deco hotel overlooks Tavistock Square Gardens, a perfect location for exploring London. Offering stunning views and remarkable value, this historic Bloomsbury hotel is a short stroll from attractions like the British Museum, Covent Garden, Theatreland, Regent's Park, Tottenham Court Road, and Oxford Street's elegant shops. Russell Square and Euston stations provide easy access to the city, and Heathrow Airport is less than 25km away. The hotel features a spacious 24-hour reception and a bar for enjoying a beverage. The contemporary rooms are classically decorated, each bright and boasting a private bathroom with complimentary toiletries.

7572.description: The Pullman London St Pancras hotel is ideally located just a few minutes' walk from three of the city's major railway stations: King's Cross, Euston and St Pancras International. Guests arriving on business will find this the perfect destination, with 17 contemporary meeting rooms capable of holding conferences and functions. The hotel is one of the city's premier upscale destinations, with a host of luxury amenities and offerings such as tranquil rain showers and more.

name.content: Doubletree By Hilton Angel Kings Cross

7573.description: The DoubleTree by Hilton London Angel Kings Cross offers convenient access to key London destinations. A short walk from Angel tube station, it's just 15 minutes from King's Cross and St. Pancras International rail stations. Explore nearby attractions like Sadler's Wells Theatre, the West End Theatre District, the British Museum, and Camden Market. This hotel features 381 newly refurbished guest rooms and suites, each equipped with complimentary Wi-Fi, a 40-inch LCD TV, a spacious bathroom with complimentary toiletries, and a well-lit work desk. Guests can enjoy 24-hour room service and complimentary gym access. Upgrade to an executive room for Executive Lounge access with complimentary breakfast, drinks, and snacks, or select a suite with a separate living area. For a unique experience, try a Five Feet to Fitness room, featuring over 11 different fitness equipment and accessory options for private in-room workouts. The hotel also offers six modern meeting rooms with natural daylight and state-of-the-art AV equipment, suitable for various events. Dining options include the Marco Pierre White Steakhouse & Grill and Bar 60, specializing in London gins. Please note that some services, including the Business Center, breakfast, and room service, may have reduced availability, while the Executive Lounge, Fitness Center, and on-site restaurants are currently unavailable.

7576.description: Explore the best of London from Holiday Inn Express London – Hammersmith, a modern and comfortable hotel located in the vibrant district of Hammersmith, West London. Parking is available for £45 per day. Hammersmith tube station is just a few minutes' walk away, providing access to the District, Piccadilly, Hammersmith &City, and Circle lines, which can take you to all the major attractions in London. Heathrow Airport is a 30-minute drive away and London Euston Station is seven miles away. The Lyric Theatre and Eventim Apollo are both within walking distance, and are popular venues for live music, comedy shows and plays. Ravenscourt Park, a beautiful green space with tennis courts, a children's playground, is also nearby, providing a peaceful escape from the hustle and bustle of the city. For shopping, head to Westfield London, Knightsbridge or Oxford Street. For sports fans, Craven Cottage, the home ground of Fulham Football Club, is just a short distance away, and is a great place to catch a game. Kew Palace, a historic royal palace and gardens, is also nearby, offering a glimpse into the lives of British monarchs throughout history. Exhibitions and events at Olympia London are less than 10 minutes’ drive away. After busy days sightseeing, relax in your room with free Wi-Fi and bedside charging. Pizzas are available 24/7 if you fancy a late-night snack. Before you head out for the day, tuck into an Express Start buffet breakfast, always included.

7578.description: With a stay at Sofitel London St James in London (London City Centre), you'll be steps from Regent Street and 3 minutes by foot from Piccadilly Circus. This luxury hotel is 0. 2 mi (0. 3 km) from Trafalgar Square and 0. 2 mi (0. 4 km) from Leicester Square. Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and wedding services. Make yourself at home in one of the 183 guestrooms featuring iPod docking stations and minibars. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Bathrooms have designer toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as laptop-compatible safes and desks. For lunch or dinner, stop by Wild Honey St James, a restaurant that specializes in French cuisine. Dining is also available at the coffee shop/cafe, and 24-hour room service is provided. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. English breakfasts are served on weekdays for a fee. Featured amenities include wired internet access (surcharge), a 24-hour business center, and limo/town car service. Planning an event in London? This hotel has 6501 square feet (604 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 12 meeting rooms. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer.

7580.description: The Crowne Plaza London - Ealing offers stylish accommodation in West London, with excellent transport links. Located adjacent to Hanger Lane Tube station, Central London is just a 25-minute ride away. Heathrow Airport is easily accessible by car via the nearby A40. The hotel features five meeting rooms, a business center, and a 24-hour gym. Guests can enjoy the sophisticated West 5 Brasserie and Bar, along with the convenience of room service and the Sleep Advantage® program for a restful night. Its location makes it an ideal choice for attending events at Wembley Stadium and the SSE Arena.

7586.description: Novotel Newcastle Airport is just 10 minutes' walk from Kingston Park Metro Station, providing easy access to the city centre. On-site parking is available (payable), and Eldon Square Shopping Centre is a 10-minute drive away. The spacious rooms each have an LCD TV with Freeview channels. Rooms also feature a work desk and a private modern bathroom.

7587.description: This hotel enjoys an ideal setting in Newcastle, lying just 350 metres away from the international airport. The hotel offers a great option for business and leisure travellers alike, as well as those seeking a relaxing setting in which to relax and unwind before or after a long flight. The nearby metro offers ease of access to the lively city centre. This charming hotel welcomes guests with warm hospitality and excellent service. The guest rooms are tastefully designed, and come complete with modern amenities. Guests are invited to enjoy a delightful breakfast in the mornings, for a great start to the day. Free Wi-Fi in public areas. Bedroom Wi-Fi available at an additional charge.

name.content: The Randolph Hotel Oxford, a Graduate Hotel

7588.description: The Randolph Hotel by Graduate Hotels, set in the heart of Oxford, is a historic retreat that blends the city’s rich traditions with academic heritage. Just steps from the University of Oxford, it’s the perfect base for exploring the city. Our guest rooms feature bespoke designs that celebrate Oxford's distinguished legacy, with touches of Oxford Blue throughout.

name.content: Linton Lodge Hotel, BW Signature Collection

7589.description: Discover Linton Lodge, a BW Signature Collection Hotel, a hidden gem just minutes from Oxford's vibrant heart. This charming hotel, nestled in a peaceful residential street, is a mere 10-minute walk from Oxford University and combines three renovated Edwardian houses, offering spacious, comfortable rooms with original features. Unwind in our tranquil garden after a day exploring the city. Our hotel is just a mile from the city centre, with easy access to major roads and transport links. Enjoy stylish rooms with modern amenities like flat-screen TVs, iPod docks, and complimentary toiletries. Upgrade to an Executive Room for added luxury. Stay connected with free Wi-Fi and kick-start your day with our Healthy Option Buffet Breakfast. For a quick bite, grab a takeaway Continental Breakfast. Indulge in our new menu featuring mouth-watering dishes crafted from fresh ingredients. Linton Lodge is perfect for hosting weddings or group events, offering a serene setting and group discounts. Experience the best of Oxford where history meets modern comfort, just a stone's throw from the prestigious university.

7590.description: Situated in the heart of the historic university city of Oxford, this beautiful 17th-century coaching-inn looks over the Examination Halls and Magdalen Tower. The convenient central location allows guests to easily discover Oxford most iconic landmarks. City sightseeing tours are available in the area, making this a great base for guests who want to explore. The hotel offers modern, comfortable rooms which are perfectly equipped to accommodate individuals, couples and families.

7602.description: Thistle Heathrow situated at Terminal 5, is the perfect choice if you need a hotel near London Heathrow Airport or before heading off on your holidays. We’ve got everything you need to make you feel at home, including a comfortable lounge and bar, 266 en-suite rooms, and 450 on-site parking spaces. Get in the holiday spirit and relax in our brand-new Aviator Sports Bar & Restaurant. Watch live Sports with an ice cold beer and a top flight burger. The Heathrow Pods next to us can take you directly from the hotel across to Terminal 5 in just 5 minutes, which run from 04:00am to 12:15 am, making your pre-flight experience a relaxed one! If you have some time to kill before jetting off, why not visit some local attractions? You can do some sightseeing around Heathrow and easily reach Wimbledon, Windsor, Ascot and the Warner Bros Harry Potter Studio Tour for a day out from Thistle Heathrow. If you require parking while you're away, contact the hotel Reservations team directly to check availability. Please be aware that this hotel does not have a lift, therefore the rooms and restaurants on the upper floors need to be accessed by the stairs.

7603.description: The Holiday Inn London - Heathrow M4, Jct. 4 offers a welcoming stay near Heathrow Airport. Our newly refurbished hotel provide comfortable spaces to sleep, dine, work, or relax. The Hotel Hoppa service facilitates quick airport transfers, and Park, Stay & Go packages are available. Central London is easily accessible via the nearby M4 or the Elizabeth Line and Heathrow Express, making day trips convenient. The hotel features 14 well-equipped meeting rooms suitable for various events, free WiFi, and a fitness center. Families will appreciate the spacious guest rooms with comfortable bedding, and kids stay and eat free. Enjoy Sky Sports at the T6 Restaurant & Bar.

8881.description: This hotel is situated at the heart of the wonderful city of Dublin. The hotel is located just a short distance away from the many attractions that this historical city has to offer. The city centre is located just a 15 minutes' walking distance away. The bustling shopping areas of St. Stephen's Green and Grafton Street are situated just a short distance away. Links to the public transport network are within easy access of this hotel. This wonderful hotel enjoys a charming architectural design, blending effortlessly with its culturally-rich surroundings. The guest rooms are beautifully designed, offering a cocoon in which to escape the bustle of the city which lies just outside. The hotel features 2 wonderful restaurants, where delectable dining is just waiting to be enjoyed. Hotel has implemented a full range of enhanced sanitisation procedures and new practices which have been rigorously reviewed by Bureau Veritas, a trusted, independent global leader in tested, inspections and certification. Hotel has been accredited by Green Tourism, a certification program that provides a framework to achieve a sustainable business in the tourism industry.

8882.description: Indulge in a visit to the spa, offering massages, body treatments, and facials. Take advantage of recreational amenities such as a health club, indoor pool, and sauna. This Dublin hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and gift shops/newsstands. Enjoy international cuisine at The Saddle Room, one of the hotel's four restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of room service. Unwind with a drink at one of the two bars/lounges. Full breakfasts are served on weekdays from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM and on weekends from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, limo/town car service, and express check-out. Planning an event? The hotel offers 4, 977 square feet (462 square meters) of space, including conference space and ten meeting rooms. A roundtrip airport shuttle is available for a surcharge (24 hours). Make yourself at home in one of the 265 guestrooms featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions. Your bed comes with down comforters and Egyptian cotton sheets. Complimentary wired internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms include complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Located near St. Stephen's Green, the hotel is a short distance from attractions such as the Little Museum of Dublin and The Mansion House.

8895.description: Set amongst 1, 000 acres of beautiful parkland with two 18-hole golf courses, this elegant country hotel offers luxurious spa and leisure facilities and an award-winning restaurant. All of the spacious rooms at the Dalmahoy Hotel & Country Club offer 32-inch flat-screen TVs and private en suite bathrooms. Rooms also include luxury bedding, tea/coffee facilities, and a mini-fridge. As well as an impressive 18-hole golf course, Dalmahoy also includes both a championship golf-course and a PGA-approved golf academy within its expansive and scenic grounds. Freshly prepared cuisine can be enjoyed at The Pentland, the hotel's award-winning restaurant, alongside panoramic views of Dalmahoy's green parkland. The Zest Restaurant and James Braid Bar also offer informal dining. The Dalmahoy Hotel & Country Club also boasts a leisure club, featuring modern gym equipment and complimentary fitness classes. Guests can make use of the indoor swimming pool, sauna, whirlpool, and tennis facilities.

8896.description: 'Indulge in a spa treatment at our Edinburgh hotel, featuring massages, body treatments, and facials. Maintain your routine at our health club, indoor pool, and sauna. Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and event planning in our conference and meeting spaces. Savor local cuisine at Surf & Turf or 24-hour room service. Unwind at our bar/lounge. The 157 air-conditioned guestrooms offer cable TV, private bathrooms with complimentary toiletries, and conveniences such as safes and coffee/tea makers. Nearby attractions include Dynamic Earth, the Museum of Edinburgh, and the Scottish Parliament. '

8897.description: A refined Glasgow business hotel with conference space for 800 delegates and a spaThe Crowne Plaza Glasgow is situated along the River Clyde, in a central yet quieter area of Glasgow, west of the heart of Glasgow City Centre, making it close enough but not within the immediate hustle and bustle. The hotel is particularly convenient for those attending events at the SEC Centre, OVO Hydro, or the SEC, all of which are right next door. You’ll find us in a striking, glass tower with Glasgow Airport only a 15-minute drive away, we offer convenient parking on site. Direct trains from the nearby Exhibition Centre station take 5 minutes to reach Central Station in the city centre. Alternatively, it is a 30-minute walk to the city centre or a 10-minute taxi ride. Entertain your clients in flexible meeting spaces ranging from chic private boardrooms to impressive event suites. Our Meetings Director is on hand to help with all the details, and there’s a Conference Café where guests can take a break. Elegant bedrooms have breathtaking city and river views. Book a Club Room or Suite for access to the Club Lounge. After work, savour a juicy steak while gazing out of the floor-to-ceiling windows in the Mariner Restaurant, or join colleagues for a glass of wine in the Mariner Lounge. Please note: The hotel is located outside the Low Emission Zone (LEZ).

name.content: Radisson Blu Edwardian Mercer Street Hotel London

8898.description: The Radisson Blu Edwardian Mercer Street, nestled in London's vibrant Covent Garden district, offers a stylish boutique experience. Surrounded by charming shops, cafes, and restaurants, the hotel reflects the area's unique village atmosphere. Its classic and contemporary artwork celebrates the rich cultural heritage of Seven Dials. Guests enjoy easy access to Covent Garden's Piazza and the bustling streets of Bond Street, Oxford Street, and Soho. The hotel features 137 comfortable rooms and suites, decorated in calming, muted shades with tactile fabrics and original artwork. Amenities include premium REN toiletries and complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi. Deluxe rooms offer additional workspace and a spacious seating area. The hotel also provides four meeting rooms equipped with cutting-edge technology, accommodating 2 to 60 guests. For dining, Monmouth Kitchen offers a sophisticated setting with exposed brickwork and contemporary furnishings. The menu features Peruvian and Italian sharing plates, including signature smoked lamb cutlets and fresh sea bass ceviche. The hotel is a TripAdvisor Hall of Fame recipient (2015-2017). A valid credit card is required upon arrival.

8899.description: Nestled in London's fashionable Belgravia village, the Lowndes London Hotel offers a stylish retreat amidst exclusive boutiques and charming cobbled streets. Moments from Harrods, Harvey Nichols, and the embassies of Belgrave Square, the hotel provides easy access to London's airports, the City, and its finest attractions. Each contemporary room and suite is beautifully appointed and features amenities such as a Nespresso coffee machine, complimentary internet access, and Temple Spa products. Some rooms overlook the tranquil Lowndes Square. The vibrant Lowndes Restaurant and Bar serves breakfast and all-day dining. Guests typically enjoy access to The Peak Health Club & Spa at our sister hotel, Jumeirah Carlton Tower.

name.content: The Welbeck Hotel London, an IHG Hotel

8900.description: The Welbeck Hotel is a stunning Edwardian gem offering contemporary luxury in the heart of Marylebone. Located on iconic Welbeck Street, rich in medical history, the hotel blends historic charm with modern elegance. Our motto is Stay Well, Be Well, Travel Well, providing a seamless, refined experience in one of London’s most fashionable neighbourhoods. Start your day at The Welbecker Bar and Lounge, with coffee and pastries, and enjoy free breakfast for children under 12. The hotel also features a restaurant, bar, new meeting rooms, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Guests can enjoy a mini-gym with complimentary water to stay refreshed during their workout. The Welbeck Hotel is a 5-minute walk from Bond Street tube station, with easy access to Oxford Street, West End theatres, and London Paddington Station, offering fast rail service to Heathrow. Gatwick is easily reachable via the Gatwick Express from Victoria Station. Nearby, you’ll find attractions like Wigmore Hall, The Wallace Collection, and Selfridges, as well as the British Museum, West End theatres, and Madame Tussauds. Hyde Park is just under a mile away. The hotel features six new, air-conditioned conference rooms, accommodating up to 35 guests. With the US Embassy, BBC headquarters, and the University of London all within a 20-minute walk, The Welbeck Hotel is ideal for both business and leisure.

name.content: The Chelsea Harbour Hotel & Spa London

8901.description: The Chelsea Harbour Hotel, a five-star all-suite hotel, offers a tranquil harborside haven within easy reach of London's city center. Overlooking Chelsea Harbour, it's one of the few hotels in London with a river view. Located near the Saatchi Gallery, home to contemporary artworks from Charles Saatchi's private collection, and a short walk from the shops of King's Road, the hotel combines urban convenience with a peaceful retreat. Imperial Wharf Station, a two-minute walk away, provides direct access to Kensington Olympia in just five minutes.

8903.description: Enjoy amenities like a sauna and fitness center at the London Marriott Hotel Maida Vale. Stay connected with complimentary Wi-Fi, or make use of the concierge and babysitting services (surcharge). Dine at Carluccio's, the hotel's restaurant, for lunch or dinner, or enjoy 24-hour room service. Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfast is available weekdays from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM and weekends from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM (surcharge). The hotel offers a business center, express check-in/check-out, and four meeting rooms. Self-parking is available (surcharge). Each of the 239 guestrooms features a flat-screen TV, pillowtop bed with premium bedding, Wi-Fi (surcharge), and satellite programming. Private bathrooms include shower/tub combinations, designer toiletries, and hair dryers. The hotel is conveniently located near Lord's Cricket Ground, Regent's Park, and Paddington Central, with easy access to Heathrow Airport.

8906.description: This pretty hotel with Spanish and Mediterranean architecture offers comfort, value and first class facilities. The fabulous courtyard with a fountain and landscaped gardens are the perfect place to sit and relax. The warm and inviting reception is spacious and has a mezzanine floor where the restaurant is situated. The on-site bar is cosy, with a feature fireplace and houses a modern snack menu, and leads out onto the courtyard. All 211 traditional styled bedrooms are en-suite. There is a health and leisure club where visitors can make the most of their stay. The 13 conference rooms have first-class facilities and can hold up to 132 people. WIFI is free to all guests and available in all public areas around the hotel.

8907.description: Less than a 10-minute drive from the airport, Best Western London Heathrow Ariel Hotel provides the ideal stopover for holidaymakers and business travelers alike. This unique ring-shaped hotel – the first to be built at Heathrow – was opened by the Her Majesty The Queen in December 1960. There's short and long-stay onsite parking available with Park, Stay and Go options, and you can catch the Hoppa Bus airport shuttle service from outside the hotel. All our 184 modern air-conditioned rooms come with double glazing and blackout curtains to help you get a good night's sleep before your flight or meeting. They also have invigorating power showers, free Wi-Fi and flat-screen TVs with satellite channels and on-demand movies. Some rooms also come with runway views and our executive rooms have bathrobes, slippers and Bluetooth sound systems. We have spaces for meetings and training sessions, and you can relax in the contemporary bar and restaurant while watching the spectacular sight of planes coming in to land. If you have some spare time for sightseeing or entertainment, there's plenty to see and do in the area within a 30-minute drive. Thorpe Park and Legoland Windsor are brilliant fun for families, while at Windsor Castle you can have a nosy around the state apartments. At Twickenham Stadium, just 5 miles away, revel in the atmosphere of an international rugby match or take a stadium tour. If you're heading into Central London, hop on the Heathrow Express.

8908.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as a 24-hour fitness center, or other amenities including complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. This hotel also features shopping on site, wedding services, and a television in a common area. Enjoy Indian cuisine at Madhus Heathrow, one of the hotel's 2 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Snacks are also available at the coffee shop/cafe. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Full breakfasts are available daily from 6 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, limo/town car service, and express check-in. Planning an event in Hayes? This hotel has 18148 square feet (1686 square meters) of space consisting of a conference center and 17 meeting rooms. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 350 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions.

8933.description: A comfortable Birmingham hotel with a conference centre, a gym, and an indoor pool. Set in a pretty garden, Holiday Inn® Birmingham M6, Jct. 7 hotel is only six miles from Birmingham city centre. Close to the M6 motorway, our hotel is a great jumping-off point for family holidays to the Midlands and the South West via the M5 and M42. You can drive to Birmingham Airpor (BHX) in 20 minutes. Nearby Birmingham New Street station has regular direct trains to Leeds, Manchester, and London. Big-name gigs at the Arena Birmingham are within easy reach. You can go underwater without getting wet at the National SEA LIFE Centre or indulge your sweet tooth at the Cadbury World chocolate factory, a short drive away. If you’re planning a conference or a wedding, you can host up to 340 guests in our 16 air-conditioned, naturally lit meeting rooms. At this hotel you can enjoy: Free Wi-Fi, free parking, 24-hour room service and Kids Stay and Eat Free!Our smart rooms and suites all have high-quality bedding and a choice of pillows for your comfort. Tuck into a buffet breakfast or international dishes for dinner at Traders Restaurant, work out or swim laps at our You Fit Health & Fitness Club, or wind down in the sauna. Enjoy a pint with friends in the Open Lobby Bar & Lounge, or sip a latte in the garden.

8937.description: A stylish Edinburgh hotel next to Edinburgh Zoo, with an indoor pool and a fitness centreNear the M8 motorway, Holiday Inn® Edinburgh hotel is handy for the city centre and all its attractions. You can take a tour of the 16th-century, antique-furnished rooms at Holyrood Palace, official Scottish residence of the Queen, just a 20-minute bus ride from the hotel, or cheer on a game at Murrayfield Stadium, which hosts Scotland's rugby union home matches. The high street shops of the modern Gyle Shopping Centre are 10 minutes away by bus, from the stop just outside the hotel. Haymarket train station, also a short bus ride away, is served by trains across Scotland and the north of England. Here for work? You're a 10-minute drive from Edinburgh Park–based companies, or you can host meetings at the hotel in 14 flexible conference spaces with panoramic views. At this hotel you can enjoy:- Free WiFi- Limited free on-site parking- 24-hour room service- Kids stay and eat freeEach welcoming room has a flat-screen TV and a pillow menu. Look forward to an invigorating power shower in the morning, or get energised with a visit to the well-equipped fitness room or indoor pool. Relax at day's end in the spa or sauna, then dine on European cuisine in the hotel's casual restaurant and chat over drinks in the relaxed lounge bar.

8938.description: voco™ Edinburgh - Royal Terrace is nestled within historic gardens at the edge of Edinburgh's New Town. The voco™ Edinburgh - Royal Terrace is a 10-minute walk from Edinburgh Waverly station, and a 25-minute taxi ride from Edinburgh Airport. You'll be just a 20-minute walk from Edinburgh Castle. The National Museum of Scotland, the Palace of Holyrood house and the city's main shopping streets are on our doorstep, along with the new St. James Quarter. Captivating exteriors & stylish interiors, our warm and genuine hosts offer true Scottish hospitality; making our hotel your ‘home away from home’ with unique spaces to share and connect. The hotel is home to the Terrace Restaurant and Garden, where guests can take in a piece of nature in the city. Additionally, showing off Scotland's whisky scene, The Nook, showcases boutique cocktails and an extensive whisky menu.

8941.description: This hotel enjoys a great setting in London. The hotel is situated close to the British Museum, lying between the West End and Covent Garden. Guests will find themselves surrounded by a wealth of attractions, as well as shopping opportunities, dining options and entertainment venues. Links to the public transport network are available nearby, offering ease of access to other areas of the city. This charming hotel enjoys a delightful architectural design, blending effortlessly with its historical surroundings. The guest rooms are elegantly designed and offer a peaceful setting in which to work and rest in comfort. Guests can enjoy traditional dishes in the relaxing surroundings of the restaurant. This hotel offers a wide range of facilities, for guests' comfort and convenience.

name.content: The County Hotel and County Aparthotel

8942.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as a fitness center, or other amenities including complimentary wireless Internet access and concierge services. This hotel also features wedding services and a banquet hall. Enjoy British cuisine at The Hudson Bar & Restaurant, a restaurant which features a bar/lounge, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Full breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 10 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include express check-out, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. This hotel has 6 meeting rooms available for events. Self-parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 114 guestrooms featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless Internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Bathrooms feature shower/tub combinations, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers.

8943.description: At the heart of Newcastle's Quayside, this hotel is an ideal base from which to explore the city of Newcastle, as well as the heritage of Northumberland. A central hub for trade in North England, Newcastle and the surrounding areas host a vibrant business community. With the Northumbrian coastline and Hadrian's Wall both within easy reach, the city is also a perfect destination to visit for leisure and relaxation.

8951.description: Enjoy terrace views and amenities like complimentary Wi-Fi and wedding services. This hotel also features a common area television, discounted access to a nearby fitness center, and a banquet hall. Dine at the hotel's RBG Bar and Grill or enjoy room service (limited hours). Relax with a drink at the bar/lounge. Continental breakfast is served weekdays from 6:30 to 9:30 AM and weekends from 7:00 to 10:30 AM (for a fee). The hotel offers 146 guest rooms with flat-screen TVs, complimentary Wi-Fi, and satellite programming. Private bathrooms include shower/tub combinations, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Safes and desks are provided, and housekeeping is daily. Located near Cardiff International Arena, the hotel is also a short distance from the University of South Wales and various city center attractions. The nearest airports are Cardiff International (CWL) and Bristol International (BRS).

9007.description: Located in the heart of Dublin, The Westbury Hotel is steps from Grafton Street and the Phil Lynott Statue. This luxury Art Deco hotel offers 201 air-conditioned rooms with minibars, espresso makers, and pillowtop beds with premium bedding. Enjoy on-site amenities such as a fitness center, terrace, two restaurants including WILDE serving Irish cuisine, a bar/lounge, and 24-hour room service. Complimentary Wi-Fi and cable TV are provided. For business travelers, the hotel features a 24-hour business center and meeting facilities. Self-parking is available (charges apply).

9008.description: The Clarence is Dublin's original rock n' roll hotel situated right in the heart of Dublin. This boutique hotel offers rooms with super king-size, wrought-iron beds and velvet drapes. Located right in Dublin's centre, the hotel boast River Liffey views. Each individually designed room features custom-designed and hand-crafted furnishings, and stained glass bedside lamps. There is free Wi-Fi in all rooms, along with American White Oak floors and a private bathroom with limestone flooring. The hotel's Therapy area offers a range of relaxing massages and aromatherapy treatments. The Octagon Bar serves award-winning drinks and cocktails in Art Deco surroundings. Dublin's lively Temple Bar District is just a 2-minute walk from The Clarence, while O'Connell Street and Grafton Street are both 10 minutes' walk away.

9009.description: Take in the views from a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access and wedding services. Additional amenities at this hotel include tour/ticket assistance, barbecue grills, and complimentary use of a nearby fitness facility. Enjoy Irish cuisine at T3 Bar & Restaurant, a restaurant which features a bar/lounge, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Full breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-in, and express check-out. Event facilities at this hotel consist of a conference center and meeting rooms. A roundtrip airport shuttle is complimentary (available 24 hours). Make yourself at home in one of the 229 guestrooms. Complimentary wireless internet access is available to keep you connected. Private bathrooms with bathtubs or showers feature designer toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks.

name.content: The College Green Hotel Dublin, Autograph

9010.description: Located in the heart of Dublin, The College Green Hotel, Autograph Collection, is just a five-minute walk from Grafton Street and Trinity College. This luxury hotel offers a fitness center, complimentary Wi-Fi, and concierge services. Each of the 191 air-conditioned rooms features a minibar, LCD television, and a pillowtop bed. Private bathrooms include complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Enjoy a meal at one of the hotel's two restaurants, including The Mint Bar, or take advantage of the 24-hour room service. A full breakfast is available for a fee. Additional amenities include babysitting services, wedding services, a fireplace in the lobby, a business center, limo/town car service, express check-in, conference space, meeting rooms, and self-parking (subject to charges). Nearby attractions include EPIC The Irish Emigration Museum (1 km) and Jameson Distillery Bow St. (1. 7 km).

9013.description: On school or national holidays, this hotel offers a bespoke Family Experience for travellers below the age of 12. Children enjoy a Kids Welcome and a dedicated Kids Breakfast experience. Enjoy your family meals by selecting dishes from the Kids Menu. The hotel has kids amenities available on requestExplore London's West End from the iconic Waldorf Hilton hotel in Theatreland, five minutes' walk from fantastic shopping in Covent Garden. Savor modern European cuisine in stylish surroundings at the Homage Grand Salon restaurant, enjoy afternoon tea in Homage Private Bar, or sip a cocktail in Good Godfrey's bar. Visit top London attractions within a mile radius of this central London hotel, including the London Eye and Trafalgar Square, or enjoy a play or musical at the theater. Situated 2 miles from London's financial centre, The Waldorf Hilton hotel has an Executive Lounge, a 24-hour business centre and 7 meeting rooms for up to 400 with wireless internet access. All guest rooms have high-speed internet access. Upgrade to a Deluxe Room or choose an Executive Room for Executive Lounge access.

9014.description: Located close to the West End, this upscale hotel sits proudly in London, surrounded by stylish shopping districts, leafy Royal parks and thriving business centres. The city's wealth of intriguing attractions can be found close by. This elegant hotel greets visitors with the promise of a comfortable, enjoyable stay. Rich in grandeur and timeless elegance, the guest rooms come complete with first-class amenities. Guests are invited to dine in style in the restaurant, or enjoy the property's renowned afternoon tea. Guests can indulge in the ultimate relaxation in the health centre and spa. This luxurious hotel also offers the perfect setting for conferences and events.

9015.description: Indulge in a relaxing experience at the full-service spa, offering a variety of massages. Take advantage of the hotel's recreational amenities, including an indoor pool, sauna, and fitness center. This hotel also provides complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and wedding services. Enjoy lunch or dinner at Carluccio's, the hotel's restaurant, or take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Unwind with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are served on weekdays from 6:30 AM to 11 AM and on weekends from 7 AM to 11 AM (for a fee). Featured amenities include a business center, express check-in, and express check-out. Planning an event in London? This hotel offers 5, 231 square feet (486 square meters) of space, including conference space and meeting rooms. Self-parking is available onsite (subject to charges). Make yourself comfortable in one of the 311 guest rooms, each featuring a minibar and a flat-screen television. Your pillowtop bed includes premium bedding, and rooms have private balconies or patios. Wireless internet access is available (surcharge), along with satellite programming. Private bathrooms with shower/tub combinations feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. The hotel is conveniently located near Primrose Hill, Regent's Park, and ZSL London Zoo. The nearest airport is London City Airport (LCY).

name.content: Radisson Blu Edwardian Hampshire Hotel London

9016.description: The Radisson Blu Edwardian Hampshire Hotel, part of Edwardian Hotels London, is located in the heart of the city's iconic film and theatreland. The building itself is a striking combination of classic red-brick architecture and a sleek, contemporary interior. Guests can enjoy incredible views from their rooms, taking in the London Eye, Nelson's Column, and Leicester Square Gardens—a fabulous vantage point during movie premiere nights. A 24-hour fitness room and six private meeting spaces (hosting between 2 and 120 people) complete the hotel's outstanding facilities. The 127 bedrooms include doubles, family rooms, and suites, featuring luxurious 350-thread-count Egyptian cotton bedding, down pillows, REN toiletries, Italian marble bathrooms, elegant decor, and cutting-edge technology. Samsung TVs offer up to 300 channels in multiple languages, and free high-speed Wi-Fi (up to 150mbps) is available on an unlimited number of devices. For a real treat, book one of the hotel's stunning square-facing rooms or suites and feel as if you are floating above the bustling Leicester Square. Leicester Square Kitchen offers superb food in effortlessly cool surroundings. Contemporary furnishings and a relaxed atmosphere provide the backdrop to a fabulous fusion of Peruvian-Mexican sharing plates, all prepared on-site. The Hampshire Lounge Bar and al fresco terrace offer afternoon tea and light snacks. Always on trend, the Lounge Bar also regularly collaborates with some of the world's finest food and drink brands. Famous sights and attractions, such as Soho, Piccadilly Circus, Chinatown, Covent Garden, Mayfair, Regent Street, Trafalgar Square's National Gallery and National Portrait Gallery, Fortnum & Mason, and the Embankment, are all minutes away, as is Leicester Square Underground station (linking to London Waterloo). Please provide a valid credit card upon arrival.

9018.description: This charming property is located just off Cromwell Road, in London. Guests can explore the nearby Natural History Museum, the Science Museum and the Victoria and Albert Museum. Kensington Gardens are located nearby. This property offers close proximity to public transport links, which provide ease of access to many of the city's renowned attractions. This charming hotel welcomes visitors with warm hospitality and the promise of a memorable stay. Stylish, comfortable guest rooms are well equipped with modern amenities. Excellent facilities are available to ensure that the needs of every type of traveller are fully catered for.

9019.description: A modern Newcastle hotel in quiet grounds just outside the city the Holiday Inn® Newcastle - Gosforth Park hotel sits in a peaceful setting close to the junction of the A1/A19 roads. Direct trains run to Newcastle from Cramlington Station, seven minutes' away by car. Business guests are within 15 minutes' drive of Nelson Industrial Estate, Apex Business Village, Quorum Business Park and Cobalt Business Park. The hotel's 10 meeting rooms hold up to 400 people. There's free Wi-Fi throughout the hotel. Eight electric charging points have been installed supplied by Project EV. Enjoy Newcastle's nightlife, watch the football at St. James' Park or catch the races at Newcastle Racecourse, all an easy distance from the hotel. Alnwick Castle, where the first two Harry Potter movies were filmed, is 30 minutes' away by car and Bamburgh Castle where Indiana Jones 5 has recently been filmed is 40 minutes' away by car. Enjoy a walk in the sprawling grounds, clock a few laps in the leisure club's indoor pool or wind down in the spa bath. Residents must book for spa treatments. Please call direct at 0191 2019965. Linger with a coffee or snack in the comfortable Open Lobby, or sip a cool beer on the patio. The formal dining serves an English and continental buffet breakfast and bistro meals. In this family-friendly hotel, you can chill out and Kids Stay and Eat Free.

9020.description: This hotel enjoys close proximity to the M23, in London. Just a few minutes' driving distance away from Gatwick Airport, this hotel offers convenience to suit business and leisure travellers. This stunning property boasts a magnificent architectural design, dating back to 1600. Beautifully retaining its heritage style, this former country manor is sure to impress. Stunningly-designed rooms respect the grace and classical grandeur of the building. An extensive range of first-class facilities and services can be availed of onsite. The property features a health centre, as well as many sports options. Guests can dine in style in the elegant surroundings of the restaurant. Conference rooms and a public internet terminal will assist visitors with their business needs.

9021.description: Travel stress-free at Sofitel London Gatwick with direct corridor access straight from the hotel lobby to Gatwicks North Terminal. Savour culinary delights as you choose from 4 delicious restaurants and refreshing hot buffet breakfast is served daily in Le petit reveur. Club Millesime rooms boast runway views and access to the exclusive Club Lounge with all-inclusive bites and drinks. The Park and Fly package offers stress-free travel with the ability to park, stay, travel and return home in style.

9022.address: West Park Road Copthorne, West Sussex
9022.description: Built around a historic and charming country house, the Copthorne Hotel Effingham Gatwick is a 4 star hotel set amidst a picturesque parkland estate that dates back to 1841. It's distinct character sets it apart from many of the local hotels, yet we are a very convenient 10-min drive away from Gatwick International Airport. Very close to The Hawth Theatre, The Bluebell Railway, The British Wildlife Centre and local hiking trails, we are also within easy reach of the South Coast, meaning there is plenty to do and see during your stay with us. Enjoy a round of foot golf, floodlit tennis courts, and a well-equipped gym too - a perfect balance of activities and relaxation. Those staying before setting off to the airport or in transit will have a perfect base to refresh, rest and prepare - making their trip even more relaxing and convenient.

9034.description:
A modern, art deco stylish hotel located off Grafton Street in Dublin 2, a popular and safe area to stay in Dublin due to its proximity to all the major attractions in Dublin City. 
Known as one of the cool hotels Dublin has to offer, The Grafton Hotel is your perfect home-from-home in the heart of Dublin. The Trinity College, Grafton Street, and The Guinness Storehouse are all within easy walking distance from the hotel. Stop by Temple Bar and enjoy a pint before heading off to Croke Park, Aviva Stadium or 3Arena for a gig.

9040.description: A smart central Birmingham hotel with a restaurant and extensive meeting spaceThe Holiday Inn® Birmingham City Centre hotel is a two-minute stroll from Birmingham New Street station.
