name.content: Doubletree by Hilton London - Marble Arch

13897.description: The Doubletree by Hilton London Marble Arch, located in the heart of London's West End near Oxford Street, offers contemporary accommodations and attentive service. Our hotel features modern amenities for business travelers and a prime location ideal for leisure guests. Spacious guest rooms and suites include generous workspaces, comfortable beds, and WiFi in public areas. Guests can enjoy our fitness center, with jogging paths and tennis courts nearby. Relax in the Indigo lobby lounge, or dine at the Fire and Spice Restaurant. Our flexible meeting and event facilities are housed in the historic Bryanston Suite. We look forward to welcoming you with our signature warm Doubletree chocolate chip cookie at check-in.

13898.description: This property sits just a few steps away from Hyde Park, in London. Guests will appreciate close proximity to a wide range of attractions, as well as a host of shopping, dining and entertainment opportunities. The Heathrow Express rail service at Paddington is just a short distance away, offering ease of access to Heathrow Airport. London's lively West End, with its range of theatres and attractions, can be found just a 10 minutes' walk from the hotel. Guests can relax and unwind in the calming surroundings of the rooms, which offer modern amenities for added convenience. The hotel's staff are on hand to cater for the needs of every type of traveller.

13900.description: This hotel has a convenient location in a quiet, tree-lined residential street near the elegant neighbourhood of Kensington and Chelsea, just metres from Earl's Court London Underground Station. Numerous historical tourist attractions, parks, museums and shopping areas such as Kensington and Knightsbridge can be reached within several minutes. In the vicinity, there are banks and restaurants. Hyde Park, Earl's Court Exhibition Centre and Olympia are all within easy walking distance. The hotel features 25 comfortable guest rooms with modern amenities including complimentary Wi-Fi Internet, fridge, air conditioning, complimentary coffee and tea making facilities and a hairdryer.

13904.description: This hotel offers 393 guest rooms, each equipped with a Smart TV, pillowtop bed, and private bathroom with complimentary toiletries and a hairdryer. While Wi-Fi is available for a surcharge, satellite programming is included. Guests can enjoy Italian cuisine at Carluccio's restaurant and bar/lounge, or take advantage of 24-hour room service. Cooked-to-order breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Recreational facilities include an indoor pool, spa tub, and sauna. The hotel also offers a 24-hour business center, express check-in/check-out, concierge and wedding services, and extensive meeting and conference space. Self-parking is available (subject to charges). Located near Stockley Park and just 3 km from Heathrow Airport (LHR), this hotel provides convenient access to Brunel University, Twickenham Stadium, and various other attractions.

13905.description:
Holiday Inn London Gatwick Worth is a convenient Gatwick hotel that has recently undergone a £9 million refurbishment and extension, transforming nearly all areas, including the reception, restaurant, and event suites. The extension added 40 new bedrooms, many of which are family rooms for up to 5 guests, making this one of the few hotels in the area to offer such accommodation. 

Located in Crawley, the hotel is perfect for both business and leisure travellers, with onsite car parking and excellent transport links. We are just 10 minutes from Gatwick Airport (LGW), and our Park, Stay & Go packages allow you to leave your car at the hotel and arrive at the airport feeling relaxed. Three Bridges station, nearby, provides trains to London Victoria in 40 minutes, while Brighton is only a 35-minute drive away. Local attractions include Wakehurst Place and Tulleys Farm, ideal for family days out. The Manor Royal Business District, home to over 500 companies including Thales, L3Harris, and Elekta, is also close by. 

Guests can enjoy free WiFi and a 24-hour reception desk. Our modern, spacious bedrooms feature tea and coffee making facilities and individual temperature control. Family rooms include sofa beds, while accessible rooms are also available. For extra comfort, our suites offer a separate lounge area and super-king-size beds.

name.content: Taj 51 Buckingham Gate Suites and Residences

14004.description: Located a short walk from St. James Park and Victoria Stations, Taj 51 Buckingham Gate Suites and Residences places you minutes from iconic landmarks like Buckingham Palace, Westminster Abbey, and the London Eye. This five-star hotel offers 86 contemporary suites, ranging from one to nine bedrooms, including specialty options like the Jaguar and Cinema Suites. Guests enjoy signature Taj excellence, including butler service, the Michelin-starred Quilon Restaurant, and a stunning award-winning courtyard garden. Families appreciate the children's amenities and impeccable five-star service. For further details about our commitment to safety and hygiene, please visit www. taj51buckinghamgate. co. uk/commitment-restrengthened/

14017.description: Hilton London Gatwick Airport is adjacent to the South Terminal and just 10 minutes from the North Terminal by free monorail, with access to the M23 and M25 motorways. Located just 30 minutes from central London by Gatwick Express, the hotel is a short train ride away from the city’s shopping, dining and entertainment scene. Visit nearby Brighton for the day or catch a ride on the Blue Bell railway to enjoy the English countryside. After a day of exploring, relax in a spacious guest room, including 22 family deluxe rooms, fully renovated in June 2021. All rooms include WiFi access and are sound-proofed for your comfort. Upgrade to an Executive Room for more space and exclusive access to the prestigious Executive Lounge. Our Gatwick hotel offers complimentary WiFi in public areas, a 24-hour fitness center, 24-hour Concierge and a business center. The Crew Lounge, newly refurbished in June 2021, offers complimentary WiFi, newspapers, magazines and tea and coffee. Unwind with a meal or cocktails at one of our bars or restaurants or enjoy the privacy of 24-hour room service. Start the day with a delicious breakfast in the family friendly Garden restaurant. Light lunch or snack in Amy’s Lobby Bar, or watch the game in Charlie Fry’s Sports Bar. Plan your next event for up to 450 people in our flexible meeting and event space, with 21 conference rooms including the versatile and fully renovated Ascot Suite.

name.content: Holiday Inn Express Oxford - Kassam Stadium

14030.description: The Holiday Inn Express Oxford - Kassam Stadium is less than five miles from Oxford's city center bus and train stations, with discounted flat-rate taxis making travel to the university's historic colleges easy and affordable. Free parking is available, and a bus stop is conveniently located right outside the hotel. For leisure, the charming villages of the Cotswolds are a 30-minute drive away, and the Ozone Leisure Park, featuring restaurants, a ten-pin bowling alley, a Vue Cinema, and the Park Leisure Club pool and gym (with special rates for hotel guests), is a five-minute walk away. Business travelers will appreciate the hotel's proximity to the Kassam conference and event center (capacity 700) and the BMW Mini plant (two miles away). The hotel offers a naturally lit meeting room for up to 18 guests and free WiFi throughout. Enjoy an inclusive buffet breakfast with sausages, scrambled eggs, and baked beans in the Great Room, and unwind in the lounge bar with evening drinks and views of the surrounding countryside.

14034.description: The following services and amenities are available, but with reduced service: Breakfast, On-site Restaurant(s), Pool, Room Service. The following services and amenities are currently not available: Airport Shuttle, Business Center, Complimentary Evening Social, Concierge, Fitness Center, Spa. Welcome to DoubleTree by Hilton Edinburgh Airport, where we'll greet you at check-in with a warm chocolate chip cookie. Our hotel is five minutes from EDI Airport. We're just 20 minutes from city centre and landmarks like Edinburgh Castle, Edinburgh Zoo and Princes Street. Catch a show at the EICC or Royal Highland Showground with ease during your stay. Our spacious guest rooms are styled in cool, calm tones and offer WiFi access, a 32-inch LCD TV, large work desk, USB charging ports, and daily newspaper. Upgrade to a Deluxe room to enjoy a welcome plate, mineral water, plush bathrobe, cosy slippers, and a later check-out time. Gather with friends and co-workers at The Space, a modern venue that merges restaurant, bar and lounge. Savour the diverse menus with locally sourced ingredients, and stay connected with WiFi access, charging stations and Bluetooth connectivity. For your convenience, our Edinburgh hotel also has 24-hour room service. Go for a swim in the heated indoor pool, take a class in the fitness centre, or book a beauty appointment in our spa. Planning an event in Edinburgh? Our hotel provides 22 fully equipped meeting rooms, all with WiFi access, natural daylight and air-conditioning. Host a meeting, social gathering or wedding reception for up to 250 people. The hotel is also pleased to offer event catering, a business centre and ample car parking.

14062.description: Strategically positioned at the heart of Knightsbridge, this superb establishment offers visitors a prestigious setting from which to explore the city. The property offers close proximity to public transport links, which ensure ease of access to many of the city's must-see attractions. This award-winning property has been awarded a Tripadvisor Certificate of Excellence, as well as the Gold Award for excellent accommodation, by Enjoy England. Stunningly-designed, self-contained apartments offer a home away from home. Well equipped with modern amenities, the accommodation options ensure the utmost in comfort and convenience. Professional, friendly staff are on hand to aid guests with ticket bookings and restaurant reservations, delivering a high level of customer service.

14080.description: Just 1969 feet from Victoria Coach and Railway Station, The House on Warwick has a 24-hour front desk elegant rooms with Free WiFi access. Buckingham Palace is a 15-minute walk away. Set in an elegant Georgian terrace, the cozy bedrooms at The House on Warwick have rooms with attached bathroom. There is a great range of international restaurants and Cafes just a short walk away. The hotel is located just a 20-minute walk from central Westminster, home to the Houses of Parliament, Big Ben and Westminster Abbey. Stylish Knightsbridge is a 20-minute walk away.

14084.description: Guests will enjoy a peaceful and calm stay at The Balkan Lodge as it counts with a total of 10 guest rooms. Wi-Fi internet connection is available on public areas. The Balkan Lodge does not offer 24-hour reception. A fee may be chargeable for some services.

14091.description: The Hotel Indigo® London Kensington is situated in the heart of the Royal Borough of Kensington and Chelsea, our London hotel blends beautifully into this boutique neighbourhood. We’re also located close to the Earl’s Court tube station, placing all of London’s destinations and major transport hubs like Heathrow (LHR) and London City Airports (LCY) within easy reach.

14104.description: This hotel is located in the centre close to Hyde Park and 400 m away from Lancaster Gate tube station and it has great access to all of London's attractions. London Heathrow Airport is approximately 17 km away. With a range of services, this newly refurbished hotel now resembles a more luxurious property with all the trimmings including gold tinted marble flown in from Italy and all furniture hand crafted to create a unique space to relax and unwind. The restaurant houses a stunning conservatory style seating area with floor to ceiling windows, a creative cocktail bar and a beautiful terrace to enjoy some al fresco dining in the summer months. The establishment has 3 fully air-conditioned conference and function rooms a fully renovated lobby with 24-hour reception and wireless Internet. The 168 generously sized guest rooms with large comfy beds and contemporary design offer a restful space away from the fast city pace.

14106.description: Set just a stone's throw away from the British Museum, the charming Grange Blooms Hotel enjoys a privileged location in the heart of literary Bloomsbury. Exclusive shopping venues on Oxford and Regent's Street, Covent Garden and The Brunswick shopping centre are within a short stroll, while famous attractions such as Buckingham Palace, St. Paul's Cathedral, Westminster Abbey, Houses of Parliament, Big Ben or the London Eye are within easy reach. The elegant boutique hotel is situated in an 18th century townhouse, and period features have been restored to their original condition. The beautifully appointed rooms are individually decorated, some with four-poster or canopy beds, and all feature modern amenities such as high-speed WIFI or LCD satellite-TV. With a nod to the area's literary background, the hotel offers a Malt Whisky Library, with a select choice of more than 30 malt whiskies. A true gem in a perfect location.

14107.description: Enjoying a convenient location in the West End of Edinburgh, close to many local attractions and surrounded by beautiful Georgian streets, this luxurious boutique hotel offers a combination of traditional hospitality and modern comforts, where guests can spend a relaxing holiday. Edinburgh's New Town is a beautiful area to explore and the friendly staff of the hotel will be more than happy to suggest some great places to visit. Boasting a Victorian façade, the hotel offers spacious accommodation, all with a stylish décor and especially designed with guests' comfort in mind. Characterised by a sophisticated urban styling, the on-site restaurant is an ideal place to enjoy a pleasant dinner, while sampling delicious local specialities as well as a fine selection of wines. The bar is popular for its light lunches, delicious cocktails and typical afternoon teas.

name.content: Mercure Dartford Brands Hatch Hotel & Spa

14140.description: The 4-star Mercure Dartford Brands Hatch Hotel & Spa is set amongst beautiful countryside, making it a great option for those looking to relax and explore. Brands Hatch Motor Racing Circuit is a short drive away, and London Golf Club can also be reached in just a few minutes. After a busy day of exploring, guests are welcome to unwind in the health club, which features an impressive indoor pool and a modern gym. Our Classic, Superior and Privilege room options are designed with style and comfort in mind.

14141.description: This charming London hotel offers a tranquil escape within walking distance of Hampstead Village, St. John's High Street, Primrose Hill, and Belsize Park, renowned for their shops, continental cafes, bars, and restaurants. Easy access to London's West End theaters and attractions is provided by public transport. Enjoy fine dining in the hotel's conservatory-style restaurant, or relax in the adjoining lounge bar, a favorite among guests and locals. The 135 well-appointed bedrooms feature modern comforts, including tea and coffee making facilities and private bathrooms with hair dryers. Limited paid parking is available under the hotel.

14170.description: This modern, glass-fronted hotel is situated in the heart of London's Docklands, offering magnificent views of Canary Wharf. Close to the O2 Arena and London City Airport (a mere ten-minute drive), the hotel provides easy access to the West End via the DLR and tube. Guests can enjoy on-site amenities such as air conditioning in public areas, a bar, two restaurants, and Wi-Fi (for a surcharge). Chargeable parking is also available. Spacious en-suite bedrooms feature TVs and tea/coffee making facilities, while upper-floor rooms boast spectacular views of the Thames and London skyline.

14401.description:
Bruntsfield Hotel, WorldHotels Elite is a townhouse hotel just a short walk from Edinburgh city centre, which is a UNESCO World Heritage Site. It’s perfectly located for both leisure breaks and business in the city and enjoys open views across Bruntsfield Links park and the Meadows park. The hotel is within walking distance of Edinburgh Castle, Princes Street and The Royal Mile, and only a short drive from the panoramic views on offer at Arthur's Seat. With this abundance of sights and shops nearby, be rest assured you'll never be met by a dull moment during your stay. 

Limited parking spaces are available on a first come first serve basis at a charge of GBP 12. 50 per day payable locally. A per person pre-authorization taken of 30GBP on arrival. Please note our restaurant will be closed on Mondays and Tuesdays. The bar will open for drinks only on Monday and Tuesday evenings from 5 p. m.

14403.description: Enjoy a central London stay at the Brunel Hotel, a short walk from both Kensington Gardens and Hyde Park. Start your day with a complimentary continental breakfast, served from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM, and later dine in our on-site restaurant. The hotel offers 40 guestrooms equipped with LCD TVs, digital programming, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Each room also features a private bathroom with designer toiletries and a hair dryer, along with convenient amenities such as a laptop-compatible safe and a desk. Business travelers will appreciate our business center and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. Additional services include concierge assistance and dry cleaning/laundry. Marble Arch is 1 mile away, while Kensington High Street is 1. 5 miles from the hotel.

14406.description:
Blending timeless British charm with modern sophistication, The Byron Hotel offers a stylish boutique experience in the heart of London. Perfectly suited for both leisure travelers and discerning business guests, our property provides a peaceful, welcoming retreat from the bustling city while keeping you just moments away from London's most iconic attractions. 

Each of our thoughtfully designed rooms features contemporary amenities, complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi, and plush bedding tailored for ultimate relaxation. With exceptional transport links right on our doorstep, exploring the West End, world-class shopping districts, and historic landmarks is completely effortless. 

Whether you are visiting for a weekend getaway or an extended stay, our dedicated team is committed to delivering personalized hospitality and a quintessential London experience. Book your stay at The Byron Hotel and discover your home away from home.

14414.description: Take in the views from a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. This hotel also features wedding services, a picnic area, and barbecue grills. Satisfy your appetite for lunch or dinner at the hotel's restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a business center, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Event facilities at this hotel consist of a conference center and meeting rooms. Free self parking is available onsite. Stay in one of 175 guestrooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wired and wireless internet access is available. Bathrooms have shower/tub combinations and hair dryers. Conveniences include desks and coffee/tea makers, and housekeeping is provided daily. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer.

14550.description: Nestled in London's elegant Bayswater neighborhood, this charming hotel occupies a beautiful 19th-century building, seamlessly blending classic design with modern amenities. A stay in this unique hotel offers a special experience, inviting guests to unpack amidst intimate Victorian surroundings. The hotel boasts convenient access to London's main attractions, points of interest, international airports, railway, and underground stations. Kensington Gardens, renowned for Kensington Palace, the Italian Gardens, the Peter Pan statue, and more, is a mere three-minute walk away. The onsite restaurant delights guests with specialty Malaysian cuisine and beverages. Each of the 111 thoughtfully furnished rooms and suites promises a blissful and relaxing stay.

14613.description:
greet London Harlow is perfectly positioned for both business and leisure travellers. Just 11 miles, around a 16-minute drive from Stansted Airport, the hotel offers easy access via the nearby M11 and convenient on-site parking. Direct rail links to Central London make it an ideal base for weekend city breaks. We can not wait to greet you. 

The hotel has four flexible meeting rooms, perfect for business conferences, training and team building events and social gatherings of up to 180 guests. Spaces are air-conditioned with modern equipment, Wi-Fi and catering options. Our function spaces can host your weddings, proms, graduations, celebrations of life, birthdays and anniversaries. Plus, the hotel offers plentiful breakfasts and delicious dinner options in our comfortable restaurant. 

Harlow is known as a "Sculpture Town" with over 100 pieces for you to explore nearby. Slightly further afield, our hotel also offers a great base to explore the open green spaces of Essex with Epping Forest reachable in under 30 minutes by car. 

Your comfort is our priority, and our dedicated team is here to ensure your stay is truly memorable. Enjoy every moment of your time with us at greet London Harlow.

14835.description: Novotel London Tower Bridge is a 4-star hotel at the heart of the British capital, just metres from the world-famous Tower Bridge and the Tower of London. With London's landmarks within walking distance and sitting in the shadow of its famous skyline, visitors to London will struggle to find a location better than this. On the doorstep of the City and a couple of stops from Canary Wharf, those visiting on business will love the location and can also take advantage of our excellent on-site facilities.

name.content: Holiday Inn London - Kensington High St

14836.description: Kensington High Street Hotel in the heart of London's Museum &Gallery DistrictHoliday Inn® London Kensington High Street, our London hotel is moments away from High Street Kensington Tube Station. There is an on-site car park with limited chargeable spaces. Local bus stops are two minutes' walk away provide easy access to the city. The Heathrow Express from Paddington Station, two miles away, whisks you to the airport in 15 minutes. The boutique shops of Kensington High Street are just around the corner, and the Science, Natural History and Victoria &Albert museums are all within a mile of our Kensington hotel. The South Bank, Buckingham Palace and central London's galleries and museums are also within easy reach. You can host an intimate event or a conference for up to 300 guests in the hotel's 13 flexible meeting rooms. The private garden is ideal for outdoor events. Printing facilities are available in the on-site e-bar. There's free Wi-Fi throughout the hotel. Wake up to a buffet breakfast at the Boulevard Restaurant, or finish the day with a taste of contemporary European cuisine. Access to the gym is free and, for a fee you can swim laps in the indoor pool. Grab a light lunch, afternoon tea or a glass of wine with friends in the relaxed Lounge Bar. Kids stay and eat free.

14917.description: The multi-award-winning Astor Court Hotel offers exceptional value in the heart of London's West End. Located on a quiet street, it's just a five-minute walk from Oxford Circus, Regent's Park, and Great Portland Street tube stations. Refurbished Superior rooms boast a stylish blend of modern comfort and Victorian architecture. Standard rooms on the lower floors provide an excellent base for business and leisure travelers, accommodating one to three guests. A complimentary continental breakfast is included. The hotel also features well-equipped, air-conditioned meeting rooms with natural daylight, ideal for various events. Experience a warm welcome and exceptional service from our dedicated hospitality team.

14919.description: The London Town Hotel is a converted Victorian townhouse, just 100 metres from Earls Court Underground Station. The hotel is situated in the heart of Earls Court in the Royal Borough of Kensington & Chelsea. Rooms at the London Town Hotel have an en suite shower and toilet with a selection of toiletries. They also feature a flat-screen TV, free Wi-Fi, a hairdryer, a safe and a telephone. All rooms are non-smoking. Continental breakfast is available on pre-order and is served in the breakfast room. Free tea and coffee is available in the guest lounge, which leads onto the terrace overlooking the garden. Olympia Exhibition Centre is a 15-minute walk away. The famous shopping districts of Kensington and Knightsbridge are nearby and the Tube provides easy access to the West End and Central London.

14923.description: Boasting an excellent central location in London, this convenient and delightful hotel is within easy reach from several points of interest either for business and leisure travellers alike. The establishment is well-serviced with public transport links and a few steps from one of the city's main shopping districts such as Oxford Street and the Kensington area. Hyde Park is also within easy reach from the premises, allowing its guests to enjoy leisurely walks. Built in a Victorian-style building, this hotel's guest rooms are nicely decorated and offer comfortable amenities for a peaceful stay in the British capital. In addition, guests can taste a complimentary, delicious breakfast every morning at the on-site facilities.

14967.description: This comfortable hotel lies amidst peaceful gardens and is situated close to the centre of London where there are countless shopping and entertainment venues just waiting to be explored. Links to the public transport network (Earls Court underground station) lie about 100 m away and restaurants and bars are to be found some 800 m from the hotel. This 6-storey hotel was built in 1860, renovated in 1998 and comprises a total of 18 double rooms, 2 twin rooms and 3 suites. Amongst the facilities count a foyer with a 24-hour reception desk, lifts and a cloakroom. There is also a café, a bar and free public wifi. Laundry and room services round off the offerings. Each of the well-equipped rooms comes with a bathroom, a hairdryer, a safe, a direct dial telephone, Internet access and satellite/ cable TV. Guests may select their breakfast from and bag to-go breakfast. .

14968.description:
The Edwin Hotel 

Located in the favoured neighbourhood for the rich and famous over the years (Freddie Mercury, Alfred Hitchcock, a young Diana, Princess of Wales and currently Gary Barlow), our boutique townhouse hotel marries period architecture and design with all the contemporary comforts. 

The Edwin Hotel offers the perfect retreat whether travelling alone, on business, or with the family. Earls Court Underground Station, Olympia Exhibition Centre, Harrods, Chelsea and various attractions such as the Natural History Museum and Science Museum are all nearby.

14969.description: Located close to the centre of London, between the districts of Bayswater and Notting Hill, this hotel lies just 1 km from restaurants, bars and various shopping venues. Links to the public transport network lies about 200 m away and Bayswater is the nearest underground station. Built in 1880 and renovated in the year 2000, this hotel comprises 5 floors with a total of 37 double rooms and 7 suites. Facilities include a 24-hour reception desk, lifts, safes and a cloakroom. The rooms come with a bathroom, a hairdryer, a direct dial telephone, satellite/ cable TV and central heating. Guests may select their breakfast from an ample buffet.

14975.description: Enjoy convenient amenities at Sidney Hotel London Victoria, including Wi-Fi (surcharge), concierge services, and a television in the common area. Take advantage of discounted access to a nearby fitness center and our reception hall. Dine in our restaurant and unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 7:30 AM to 9:00 AM. We also offer wired internet access (surcharge), a 24-hour business center, and limo/town car service. A roundtrip airport shuttle is available for a surcharge at scheduled times. Our 80 guestrooms feature LCD televisions with satellite programming, and wired/wireless internet access (surcharge). Private bathrooms with bathtubs include complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Each room also provides a phone, safe, and desk.

14982.description: Make use of convenient amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). For lunch or dinner, stop by XX-XXVIII Restaurant, a restaurant that specializes in international cuisine. Dining is also available at the coffee shop/cafe, and 24-hour room service is provided. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Continental breakfasts are served on weekdays from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM and on weekends from 8:00 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a business center, and express check-out. Planning an event in London? This hotel has 139 square feet (13 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 3 meeting rooms. Make yourself at home in one of the 86 air-conditioned rooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wired and wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming provides entertainment.

14985.description: This charming 4 Star boutique hotel is an ideal option for business and leisure stays in the heart of London, only a few minutes from Hyde Park and within walking distance of Oxford Street and Notting Hill shopping areas. Located in a typical and recently remodeled Victorian building, enjoy this peaceful setting in a residential area with privileged views of Queens Gardens. A tranquil oasis to unwind from the city's frantic rhythm. Its classic English style front is in contrast with the modern and minimalist interior, decorated with fascinating Roman mosaics. The hotel features 140 stylish fully refurbished guest bedrooms, with warm comfortable atmospheres and modern amenities. With a gymnasium, sauna, business room and two unique gastronomic areas, enabling you to savor creative Spanish cuisine in the heart of England's capital.

14986.description:
Situated near the iconic Tower Bridge and Tower of London, Leonardo Royal Hotel London City is the perfect destination for leisure, business, and family travellers seeking to explore the heart of the capital. With a prime city centre location, it offers convenient access to some of London's top attractions, including Petticoat Lane Market, The O2, and St Katharine Docks. 

The hotel is just a two-minute walk from Tower Hill tube station, while Fenchurch Street station and Tower Gateway DLR are only four minutes away. These nearby stations provide quick access to London City Airport and other parts of the city. 

 Guests can enjoy an afternoon at the historic Tower of London, home to the Crown Jewels, or visit the Whitechapel Gallery, just a 15-minute walk from the hotel. Covent Garden, Oxford Street, and Carnaby Street are easily accessible by tube for shopping enthusiasts. 

Leonardo Royal Hotel London City features 317 spacious and comfortable guestrooms, all with modern décor and DREAM beds by Leonardo, ensuring a restful stay. Executive rooms offer additional amenities for those seeking extra comfort. The hotel also offers rooms designed for wheelchair access, meeting the highest accessibility standards. 

Families are well catered to, with rooms accommodating up to four adults or two adults and two children, making it an ideal choice for a family visit to London. In-room amenities include free Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs, and luxury bedding for a great night’s sleep. 

Guests can enjoy a variety of dining options onsite. Leo’s Bar and Restaurant serves Mediterranean cuisine in stylish surroundings, while Corvo Bar & Café offers more casual dining with a selection of sandwiches, soups, and salads. Whether you’re looking for a hearty breakfast or a cocktail after a long day, both venues provide excellent choices for dining and relaxation.

14990.description: With the Gloucester Road subway station just across the road, our hotel is in a great location for exploring London. Located in the museum district, we are within a mile of Kensington Palace, Hyde Park, and the Natural History Museum. Knightsbridge luxury shops and eateries are just a mile away. Unwind in our private garden after a busy day.

14991.description: This modest hotel, built in the mid-19th century, is situated in a quiet area within walking distance of London's city center. Guests will find public transport conveniently located nearby, providing easy access to the city's many tourist attractions and cultural sites. Perfect for both couples and groups, this hotel offers flexible accommodations ranging from single rooms to family rooms with a mix of single and bunk beds, sleeping up to seven people. Rooms are clean, fresh, and simply decorated in a minimalist style. While a budget hotel, it prides itself on offering a little something extra. Guests can expect warm rooms with comfortable beds, private en-suite showers, flat-screen TVs, and Wi-Fi.

14993.description: Novotel London Bridge is a 4-Star hotel in an ideal location. Guests will find great tourist attractions such as the Shard, the Tate Modern, St. Pauls Cathedral and Borough Market - all within walking distance. Those looking to travel further afield can do so easily with multiple tube stations located nearby.

14994.description: A stay at Novotel London Waterloo places you in the heart of London, within a 15-minute walk of Westminster Abbey and London Eye. This upscale hotel is 0. 6 mi (1 km) from Westminster Bridge and 0. 9 mi (1. 5 km) from Big Ben. Enjoy recreational amenities such as a fitness center and bicycles to rent. This Art Deco hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Make yourself at home in one of the 187 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Bathrooms feature showers with rainfall showerheads and complimentary toiletries. Conveniences include phones, as well as laptop-compatible safes and desks. Stop by the hotel's restaurant, Elements, for lunch, dinner, or brunch. Dining is also available at the coffee shop/cafe, and 24-hour room service is provided. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Full breakfasts are available daily from 6 AM to 10 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-out, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. Planning an event in London? This hotel has 2153 square feet (200 square meters) of space consisting of a conference center and meeting rooms. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. St. Thomas' Hospital - 0.

14995.description: This modern hotel is located in London, lying within easy access of a host of shopping and entertainment venues. Guests will find themselves in close proximity to many of the city's most prominent attractions. London Heathrow Airport lies within easy access of this hotel. This charming hotel enjoys a delightful architectural design. The guest rooms are exquisitely designed, bathing visitors in luxury and classical elegance. The rooms are well equipped with modern amenities. Guests will appreciate the wide range of facilities and services that the hotel has to offer. Guests can enjoy delightful dining in the mornings, for a great start to the day.

14997.description: This charming hotel is situated at the heart of London near to the Royal Albert Hall and Hyde Park. The shopping quarter of Knightsbridge with the famous department store Harrods is only a few minutes away. Links to the public transport network are within 150m of the hotel.Bars, pubs, and restaurants are to be found in the vicinity.The hotel additionally offers a bar, an à la carte restaurant and a conference room. Room and laundry services are also offered.The comfortably furnished rooms come with an en-suite bathroom. All of them come fully-equipped as standard. Guests may make use of the sauna and the gym for those wishing to keep fit.Guests may select their breakfast and midday meals from ample buffets. Lunch and dinner may alternatively be taken à la carte or chosen from a menu.

14998.description: This elegant hotel is wonderfully situated in Covent Garden, within easy walking distance of several attractions, including the British Museum, Trafalgar Square, and Leicester Square’s entertainment district. From this ideal location, guests can readily explore the captivating city, with Kingsway Hall, popular theaters, and the Covent Garden metro station nearby. The hotel offers elegantly designed guest rooms, each richly appointed in classic style. Guests can also enjoy a delightful dining experience in the hotel restaurant.

15006.description:
Step off the busy streets of Fitzrovia and into a world where reality loosens its grip. 

Hidden behind an unassuming façade, Sanderson has spent decades blurring the line between hotel and fantasy. Designed by Philippe Starck, Sanderson is one of London's most imaginative destinations, where surreal design, playful details and unexpected moments wait around every corner. 

While the city hums away outside, life inside moves to its own rhythm. Drift between long lunches, hidden cocktails and late-night conversations, while the hotel's iconic spaces invite curiosity at every turn. From the famous Long Bar and enchanting Courtyard to bedrooms designed to view your retreat from a new perspective, Sanderson offers a London experience unlike any other. 

Located moments from Oxford Street, the hotel places some of London's most exciting neighbourhoods within easy reach, yet there's something about Sanderson that makes leaving feel entirely optional.

The hotel is conveniently located near Cromwell Road (0. 2 km). '

16076.description: Enjoy convenient amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a banquet hall. The hotel's restaurant, Langham Brasserie, offers lunch and dinner, while the coffee shop/cafe provides additional dining options. 24-hour room service is also available. Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are served on weekdays from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM and on weekends from 8:00 AM to 10:30 AM (fees apply). Business amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a business center, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. The hotel offers conference space and two meeting rooms. Make yourself at home in one of the 56 guestrooms featuring complimentary wired and wireless internet access, private bathrooms with shower/tub combinations, complimentary toiletries, hair dryers, phones, safes, and desks. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer.

16079.description: This hotel enjoys a unique location on Montague Street close to the spot where the Duke of Montague erected a big villa, which is now the British Museum. In spite of being quietly situated, the hotel is within minutes of the theatres of the colourful West End. The shops of Oxford Street and Covent Garden can be reached in around 15 minutes' walk from Grange White Hall. The hotel comprises a total of 52 rooms and features a cosy restaurant. The English Garden Restaurant looks out onto immaculate lawns. Guests can also relax in Elgin Lounge Bar, which is open 24 hours a day. All of the elegant rooms come en suite and well – equipped as standard. Some of the rooms have a view to the garden.

16105.description: Located in London's City Centre, Olympic House Hotel is a short walk from Hyde Park and Kensington Gardens. This hotel offers 40 guestrooms with flat-screen TVs, complimentary Wi-Fi, and private bathrooms with showers and complimentary toiletries. Guests can enjoy a bar/lounge, garden views, and convenient amenities like a 24-hour front desk, luggage storage, and on-site parking (subject to charges). Marble Arch is 1. 2 km away, and Oxford Street is 2. 1 km from the hotel.

16106.description: Located in London City Centre, the Orchard Hotel is within a 15-minute walk of Hyde Park and Marble Arch. This hotel is conveniently located 1. 2 miles from Oxford Street and 2. 4 miles from Buckingham Palace. The hotel offers 46 guestrooms equipped with flat-screen televisions and complimentary Wi-Fi. Private bathrooms include showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Desks are provided, housekeeping is offered weekly and irons/ironing boards are available upon request. Start your day with a complimentary continental breakfast served daily between 7:30 AM and 9:00 AM. Additional amenities include a 24-hour front desk and an elevator.

16108.description: The hotel is a comfortable, intimate hotel, located within the heart of London's West End, within easy walking distance of London’s lively and famous streets and activities like Oxford Street, Bond Street, Museums, Art Galleries and a wide choice of some of the best restaurants that London has to offer. With its 72 en suite, air cooled bedrooms and suites, the hotel provides the perfect base for the business and leisure visitor to London and provides a convenient, comfortable and tranquil haven amidst the pace of London's bustling environment.

16205.description:
Ten miles away from Oxford, yet a world away from the din of daily life in Bicester, The Jersey Arms Hotel, Sure Hotel Collection by Best Western is arguably one of England's finest country inns, and indisputably the best located. On the edge of the Cotswolds which boasts plenty of old inns, but few can rival the charms of this one... or its standards of friendly service! 
Good food and wine will settle you into your stay, Bicester Village discount shopping centre lets you nip back to normality for a short while just three minutes away by car, before you rejoin us in a tranquil retreat to enjoy peace and quiet once again. Picturesque villages, rolling countryside and market towns all wait, as do the beautiful colleges of Oxford, exciting cultural attractions and the birthplace of Winston Churchill, Blenheim Palace!

16206.description: As the closest hotel to the arrival and departure terminals, the 4-star Novotel Birmingham Airport hotel blends style with convenience. Just a minute's walk from the airport, the hotel is the perfect choice for your family or business trip. The airy sound-proofed rooms provide enough space to stretch out and relax, while the 24-hour bar is perfect for a pre-flight snack or well-deserved drink. Exclusive to our guests: discounted NCP parking tickets £12 for 24 hours in NCP : CP 1, 2&3 all next to the hotel.

name.content: Holiday Inn Express Edinburgh - Leith Waterfront

16210.description: Holiday Inn Express Edinburgh – Leith Waterfront is located on the outskirts of the city, in the cool harbour neighbourhood of Leith, also known as The Shore. Edinburgh Waverley train station is within easy reach and Edinburgh Airport (EDI) is 25 minutes away. Catch trams into the city centre from opposite the hotel. On-site parking is 11 GBP per night and spaces are limited. Stroll along to the Royal Yacht Britannia and explore the former yacht of Queen Elizabeth II. Delve into Scotland’s rich history at the magnificent Edinburgh Castle, then wander through the cobbled streets of the Old Town to visit the Scott Monument and the National Museum of Scotland. Watch live debates and MSPs questions at the Scottish Parliament Building or tour the Palace of Holyroodhouse, The King’s official residence in Edinburgh. Ocean Terminal shopping centre is a short walk away, while Princes Street and St James Quarter offer the best from high-street to luxury fashion and beauty. Multrees Walk is home to the iconic Harvey Nichols. For entertainment, catch a comedy or theatre show at the Edinburgh Playhouse, two miles away. Relax after a busy day in your room with a flat-screen TV and en-suite with shower. Enjoy a free buffet breakfast each morning before heading out for the day. Order light bites and coffees throughout the day and grab a pizza in the evening from our menu. Relax with drinks from the bar in our Great Room and catch up with free Wi-Fi.

16211.description: Located in the heart of Glasgow, Arthouse Hotel Glasgow offers upscale accommodations within a 15-minute walk of Buchanan Street and George Square. This hotel provides 76 guestrooms equipped with LCD televisions, complimentary Wi-Fi, and satellite programming. Enjoy cooked-to-order breakfasts (fee applies), concierge services, and discounted access to a nearby fitness center. Additional amenities include a banquet hall, dry cleaning/laundry services, and on-site self-parking (for a fee). Nearby attractions include Sauchiehall Street, Willow Tearooms, and the Royal Conservatoire of Scotland. Glasgow International Airport (GLA) is 9. 4 miles from the hotel.

16212.description: Holiday Inn Express® Glasgow - City Ctr Theatreland is right in the heart of Glasgow, just across from Buchanan Bus Station. Glasgow Central and Queen Street train stations are a 10-minute walk away, and Glasgow Airport (GLA) is only 15 minutes by car. Catch sell-out performances at Glasgow Royal Concert Hall or enjoy comedy and drama at King's Theatre, Pavilion Theatre and Theatre Royal, all a short walk away. Watch live acts at the OVO Hydro arena, from concerts to musicals and grab a pre-show meal at the Clydebuilt bar and Kitchen. Shop your favourite brands at Buchanan Galleries shopping centre and Buchanan Street, both packed with a range of stores. Hop on a bus to Kelvingrove Art Gallery and Museum or the Riverside Museum for a bit of culture and explore the history of Glasgow. Explore the Gallery of Modern, a 10-minute walk from our hotel for engaging displays and exhibits. Discover Glasgow Cathedral, a 20-minute walk from our hotel, or cheer on Celtic FC at Celtic Park and take a behind-the-scenes tour of the stadium. Relax after a busy day in your room with a flat-screen TV and en-suite with shower. Enjoy a free buffet breakfast each morning before heading out for the day. In the evening, you can dine at La Bonne Auberge Brasserie and charge it to your room. Relax with drinks from the bar in our Great Room and catch up with free Wi-Fi.

16229.description: This superb manor is located in Coulsdon, amidst 140 acres of landscaped parkland. London and Gatwick are just a 20 minutes' driving distance away, offering visitors the best of both worlds. This superb property was designed and built for the Byron family in the 1850s. Showcasing classical style and elegance, the property features stunningly-designed rooms, which are complemented with modern amenities. The surrounding golf course was developed in 1937, designed by the renowned H S Cold. Guests can enjoy an invigorating workout in the fitness centre, followed by relaxation in the steam room and sauna. A delectable dining experience awaits in the restaurant. The elegant terrace bar offers a peaceful setting in which to sit back and relax.

16233.description: On school or national holidays, this hotel offers a bespoke Family Experience for travellers below the age of 12. Children enjoy a Kids Welcome and a dedicated Kids Breakfast experience. Enjoy your family meals by selecting dishes from the Kids Menu. The hotel has kids amenities available on requestJust 17 minutes by train to London, Hilton London Croydon offers a great location to explore London city center attractions, as well as Croydon city center shopping, restaurants, nightlife, and family activities. The newly refurbished hotel with all new rooms, lobby, lounge, and bar, offers comfortable family rooms and kids dining options, wellness rooms, and suites for guests who are seeking an exceptionally relaxing experience, with plenty of space to catch up on your laptop in your room or in the lounge bar. Add on a private session in the Hilton Private Wellness Area to recuperate from your travels, feel your best and sleep well. With 15 meeting rooms for up to 300 guests and unique wellness meeting themes, a 24-hour Gym with weights and cardiovascular machines, and dining at The Larder Restaurant or in the Lounge Bar, serving dishes inspired by the best local comforts and tastes from around the world, guests are sure to enjoy their stay.

16234.description: This hotel is centrally located, just 100 metres from a public transport connection. Bars, restaurants and shopping venues lie within 500 metres of the hotel. And the nearest nightclub is located a mere 800 m from the hotel. The city hotel was built in 2001 and consists of 240 double rooms on 12 floors. Various facilities are available to guests including a foyer with a 24-hour reception, a safe and a currency exchange facility. In addition, Internet access, a small supermarket and shops are also available. Furthermore a conference room, a TV room and a laundry service are available to guests. There is also an à la carte restaurant. All of the comfortable rooms come with an en suite bathroom with hairdryer, a double bed and central heating. Guests may choose their breakfast from individual buffets. When dinner is included in the booking, vouchers will be provided which can be exchanged for meal in the restaurant.

16235.description: The following services and amenities are available, but with reduced service: Complimentary Evening Social, Fitness Center, Breakfast, Pool, Room Service. The following services and amenities are currently not available: On-site Restaurant(s), Spa. Welcome to DoubleTree by Hilton Dartford Bridge, a stylish hotel at the ‘Gateway to London. ' Located just 4 miles from the premier Bluewater Shopping Centre, we're also just off the M25 motorway, making exploring the Kent countryside a breeze. Travel to central London in 17 minutes from the Ebbsfleet International rail station, just 5 miles away. We'll greet you at check-in with a warm DoubleTree chocolate chip cookie. Settle into a spacious guest room with modern decor, an LCD TV, work desk and WiFi access. Deluxe rooms offer indulgent extras like a welcome plate, sparkling mineral water, bathrobes and slippers. Suites provide a separate living area, coffee machine, and a later check-out time. Enjoy international cuisine and views of the Dartford Bridge at QE2 Restaurant – perfect for celebrating special occasions or catching up on business. Our QE2 Bar has an extensive wine, beer and spirits list, and the QE2 Lounge is a great spot for specialty coffees, pastries and sandwiches. Exercise body and mind with a fully equipped fitness centre plus leisure facilities including a 15-meter swimming pool, spa bath, sauna and steam room. Planning an event? Guests have a choice of eight meeting and conference rooms, all well-equipped, air-conditioned and newly refurbished. The Swanley Suite is particularly impressive for larger events, boasting natural light and a private bar. Ask our friendly staff about event packages and catering options. Highlights:-Dartford hotel near the M25 with on-site parking-179 oversized and recently renovated guest rooms-QE2 Restaurant, bar, lounge and 24-hour room service-Fitness centre, large indoor pool and wellness facilities-Fresh and modern event venues for up to 250 guests

16274.description: Take in the views from a terrace and a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access. This hotel also features an arcade/game room and wedding services. Satisfy your appetite for dinner at Billabong Bistro, a restaurant which specializes in Fusion cuisine, or stay in and take advantage of the room service. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and luggage storage. Free self parking is available onsite. Stay in one of 90 guestrooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access is available to keep you connected. Private bathrooms with bathtubs or showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include safes and desks, and housekeeping is provided daily. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Jesmond Cricket Ground - 0. 6 km / 0.

16275.description: Overlooking the River Tyne, the Hilton Newcastle Gateshead hotel is 10 minutes' walk from the city center. Relax in the Executive Lounge or unwind in the gym or pool. Dine on local dishes in windows on the Tyne Restaurant or sip cocktails in Windows on the Tyne Bar. Work out or swim in the Hilton Newcastle Gateshead hotel's health club. Outside, walk across the stunning Millennium Bridge to numerous Newcastle attractions. Visit art galleries or Europe's biggest shopping and leisure center, go to horseracing or to a top football match. All Hilton Newcastle Gateshead hotel rooms offer high-speed internet access. Executive Room and Suite guests enjoy Executive Lounge access. Twenty minutes' drive from the airport and close to the business districts, the Hilton Newcastle Gateshead hotel has 10 meeting rooms for 2-80 and a function suite for 500, all with wireless internet access, a business center, and an Executive Lounge (over 18 years old).

16276.description: *Hotel completely non-smoking*Personally operated hotel in quiet suburban area, with a consistent reputation for good food, friendly and efficient service, in a warm and congenial atmosphere. Ideally situated for commercial area, shopping, rural and historic attractions. A welcoming and comfortable base for business and tourist clientele alike. Lower rates available at weekends. Enjoy your stay.

16296.description: Conveniently located near London Stansted Airport, this stylish 4-star hotel is just a six-minute shuttle ride from the main terminal building. Whether you're heading off on a new adventure or are new to the city, it's the perfect base camp to relax and plan during your stay in the capital. With spacious rooms and a dedicated business centre, as well as 24-hour access to our on-site fitness centre, you'll have a hard time thinking of an excuse to leave!

16297.description: A stylish Sutton hotel with a welcoming Open Lobby, serving food all through the day, with a relaxing indoor pool and sauna. Holiday Inn® London - Sutton hotel places you a short walk from Sutton train station and steps from town centre shops and restaurants. At nearby Sutton station, fast trains to London Victoria take half an hour. On-site parking is available at the hotel, and Gatwick (LGW) and Heathrow (LHR) airports are both under a 45-minute drive away. Business travellers are close to several corporate HQs, and a Business Centre with printing facilities is available. A short drive away, you can enjoy horse racing at Epsom Downs. Thirty minutes by car takes you to the rides and zoo at Chessington World of Adventures, Hampton Court’s maze and palace, or Centre Court tennis at Wimbledon. At this hotel you can enjoy:- Free Wi-Fi throughout- 24-hour room service- On-site parking at a daily rateStylish guest rooms feature comfy beds and pillow menus to guarantee a good night’s sleep. Start your day with a full English breakfast buffet, and enjoy lunch and dinner in our Open Lobby. Relax over Starbucks coffee or drinks in the lobby lounge. At Spirit Health Club you can enjoy the pool and gym, or pamper yourself with a spa session.

name.content: Birmingham North Moor Hall Hotel, BW Premier

16298.description: A delightful country house hotel set in parkland yet within easy reach of Birmingham, the NEC, the motorway network and attractions such as Drayton Manor Park and Cadbury World. Ideal for business or pleasure, the Birmingham North Moor Hall Hotel, BW Premier Collection offers 83 comfortable and well equipped ensuite bedrooms, including four posters, a choice of two restaurants, seven conference rooms and extensive leisure facilities including an indoor pool, hot tub, sauna, steam room, aerobics room and spa with three treatment rooms. There's ample free parking and conference and banqueting for up to 250. To complete the picture, our team of friendly and professional staff is always on hand to offer our unique brand of traditional personal service. Enjoy your stay. Main restaurant The Oak Room is closed on Sunday and Bank Holidays. Dinner rates include a 3-course Carvery instead.

16303.description: Holiday Inn Washington is a friendly, welcoming hotel close to Newcastle City Centre with free Wi-Fi and Carparking on-site. We are Just off the A1 motorway and only a 20-minute drive to Newcastle International Airport (NCL). We're just a 20-minute drive away from Newcastle, Durham and Sunderland Universities. History aficionados can explore a replica Edwardian village at the Beamish Open Air Museum, and sports fans can check out Sunderland's Stadium of Light. Our hotel is the perfect stopover en route to the Northumberland coast, and you can take the family to the interactive Centre for Life museum before heading off. We have three large conference suites and all are ideal for social banquets and corporate seminars, or you can chat with clients in one of our six smaller meeting rooms. At this hotel, you can enjoy 24-hour room service and Kids Stay and Eat Free. The light-filled Traders Restaurant serves breakfast and dinner, as well as hosting a weekly Indian feast. You can unwind with a freshly brewed coffee or a pint of lager in the bar area then retreat to a comfy guest room, where a pillow menu and blackout shades help ensure a good night's rest.

name.content: Holiday Inn Express - Edinburgh City Centre

16310.description:
A modern Edinburgh hotel in a Georgian building within walking distance of the city's top attractionsHoliday Inn Express® - Edinburgh City Centre hotel is a 10-minute walk from Edinburgh Waverley station in the city's New Town. It's a short stroll to the York Place tram stop, which has a direct connection to Edinburgh Airport (EDI). The Edinburgh Playhouse theatre and OMNI Edinburgh's restaurants and cinemas are right across the road. Princes Street and George Street's shops are a few minutes' walk away. You can ramble over the ramparts of Edinburgh Castle, 20 minutes' walk from the hotel. Or experience more royal flavour, less than a mile from the hotel, at the Palace of Holyroodhouse, the Queen's official Scottish residence. Amble through the expansive Royal Botanic Garden Edinburgh, half an hour on foot from the hotel, or wander into Princes Street Gardens to spot the huge floral clock. Business guests are on the doorstep of the financial district around St. Andrew Square and George Street, while the Edinburgh International Conference Centre is less than 10 minutes' drive away. The hotel has a smart meeting rooms. Enjoy free Wi-Fi and an inclusive hot Express Start Breakfast. A nearby Fitness Centre is available to guests. Unwind after a busy day's sightseeing over a cool beer in the lounge bar. 

Please note, if parking in the nearby Q-Park Omni, the hotel does have a discount code we can provide to give our guests a 30% reduction. Please contact the hotel front desk to get this code prior to parking in the Q-Park Omni

16333.description: The New Lanark Mill Hotel, nestled within a UNESCO World Heritage Site, offers spacious rooms with en-suite bathrooms. This 18th-century village, once a model industrial center, now boasts converted mill buildings, shops, museums, and the hotel itself. Enjoy stunning river views from the rooms or rooftop garden. Savor traditional Scottish cuisine in the restaurant overlooking the River Clyde, or unwind in the 52-foot pool, modern gym, sauna, and steam room. Conveniently located an hour's drive from Glasgow or Edinburgh, and just 1. 4 miles from Lanark Railway Station.

16351.description: Enjoy a comfortable stay at the Park Hotel in Falkirk, conveniently located within a 5-minute drive of Falkirk Town Hall and Falkirk Golf Club. We offer 73 guestrooms equipped with flat-screen televisions, complimentary Wi-Fi, and cable programming. Each room also includes a desk, coffee/tea maker, and a private bathroom with a shower/tub combination and hairdryer. Hotel amenities include a restaurant with room service (limited hours), a bar/lounge, complimentary wired and wireless internet access, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, dry cleaning/laundry services, and free self-parking. Nearby attractions include Callendar House (1. 4 mi), the Falkirk Wheel (2 mi), and The Kelpies (2. 6 mi). Edinburgh Airport (EDI) is 20 miles away, and Glasgow International Airport (GLA) is 32 miles away.

16416.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where massages, body treatments, and facials await. For recreation, the hotel offers a health club, indoor pool, and spa tub. Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). An area shuttle is available (surcharge). The hotel's Plumpy Duck Restaurant serves lunch, dinner, and brunch. Room service is also available during limited hours. Mingle with other guests at the daily complimentary reception, or unwind at the bar/lounge. Full breakfasts are available for a fee. Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services and luggage storage. The hotel also offers four meeting rooms and free self-parking. Each of the 22 guestrooms features a flat-screen television, premium bedding, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Bathrooms include complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Nearby attractions include Castle Semple Country Park (2. 2 mi), Kenmure Hill Temple (2. 3 mi), and Muirshiel Visitor Centre & Country Park (4. 3 mi).

16417.description: Enjoying a fabulous situation amidst beautiful and peaceful setting overlooking the charming Loch Lomond and stunning natural beauty of the Lomond National Park, the hotel is an optimal choice for all those wishing to escape from city hustle and bustle. The property lies within 32 kilometres from Glasgow and only 2 kilometres from Balloch. Housed in an impressive building dating back to 17th century, the establishment affords visitors high quality accommodation and top notch services. The rooms and suites welcome visitors in spacious and opulent surroundings fitted with comfy furniture and plush bed linens in warm and soothing hues to exude a peaceful yet elegant atmosphere. The on-site dining options will provide for a flavourful culinary experience accompanied by warm hospitality. The leisure facilities include a well-equipped spa and extensive golf courses. Corporate travellers may avail for versatile meeting rooms.

16418.description: Take in the views from a rooftop terrace and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Additional amenities at this hotel include a fireplace in the lobby and a banquet hall. Grab a bite to eat at Windows Restaurant, a restaurant which features a bar/lounge, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Full breakfasts are served on weekdays from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM and on weekends from 7:30 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and multilingual staff. Make yourself at home in one of the 64 guestrooms featuring free minibar items and LCD televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and digital programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with shower/tub combinations feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include safes and desks, as well as phones with free local calls.

16419.description: Take in the views from a terrace and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access and tour/ticket assistance. Grab a bite to eat at Beneroti, a restaurant which features a bar/lounge, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Full breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour front desk, luggage storage, and a safe deposit box at the front desk. Planning an event in Glasgow? This hotel has 538 square feet (50 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 2 meeting rooms. Stay in one of 91 guestrooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and digital programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with bathtubs or showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include desks and coffee/tea makers, and housekeeping is provided on request.

16420.description: Holiday Inn Express® Glasgow Airport is just off the M8 and a 3-minute walk from the terminal via a covered walkway. Catch the airport express bus into Glasgow city centre or board a direct train to Glasgow from Paisley Gilmour Street station, two miles away. Need some last-minute holiday shopping? Head to Braehead Shopping Centre to find a wide range of shops and enjoy meals at various restaurants or take the kids bowling and trampolining at XSite Braehead. Watch the best acts in entertainment at The OVO Hydro or explore the exhibits and planetarium at Glasgow Science Centre, both a 15-minute drive away. Cheer on your favourite team at Celtic Park, Ibrox Stadium or Hampden Park, all 20 minutes away. Visit one of Glasgow's many museums for free. Explore Kelvingrove Art Gallery for artwork by Charles Rennie Mackintosh, Ancient Egypt and Salvador Dali, a 20-minute drive away. Discover the Riverside Museum for innovative displays from Glasgow's transport heritage and take a walk around exhibits and installations at the Gallery of Modern Art, a 15-minute drive away. Relax after a busy day in your room with a flat-screen TV and en-suite with shower. Enjoy a free buffet breakfast each morning before heading out for the day. Order light bites and coffees throughout the day and grab a bite to eat in the evening from our snack menu. Relax with drinks from the bar in our Great Room and catch up with free Wi-Fi.

16421.description: Holiday Inn Glasgow City Centre Theatreland, an IHG Hotel is in the heart of Glasgow, within a 5-minute walk of Theatre Royal and Glasgow Royal Concert Hall. This upscale hotel is 0. 5 mi (0. 8 km) from Buchanan Galleries and 1 mi (1. 6 km) from George Square. Make use of convenient amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access, wedding services, and a television in a common area. This hotel also features discounted use of a nearby fitness facility and a vending machine. Stay in one of 113 guestrooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with shower/tub combinations feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as desks and coffee/tea makers. Enjoy local and international cuisine at La Bonne Auberge, a bistro which features a bar/lounge, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Full breakfasts are available daily from 6:30 AM to 10 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include express check-in, express check-out, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. This hotel has 4 meeting rooms available for events. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Sauchiehall Street - 0. 1 km / 0. 1 mi- Pavilion Theatre - 0. 2 km / 0. 1 mi- Buchanan Street - 0. 2 km / 0. 1 mi- Glasgow Caledonian University - 0. 2 km / 0. 1 mi- Theatre Royal - 0. 2 km / 0.

16424.description: Located in central Glasgow, the family-run Sandyford Lodge- offers free Wi-Fi throughout and a 24-hour front desk. On Glasgow’s famous Sauchiehall Street, it is just 10 minutes’ walk from the Exhibition Center Railway Station. The spacious rooms include a flat-screen digital TV, a direct-dial telephone, and tea and coffee making facilities. Each modern room benefits from an en-suite bath or shower room with a hairdryer. In the mornings, Sandyford Lodge- serves a famous cooked Scottish breakfast. Continental options are also available. Glasgow’s main shopping district is just 1 mile away and offers a wide range of restaurants. Glasgow offers a lively nightlife, with many pubs and bars within a 10-minute walk of the Sandyford Lodge-. Glasgow Science Center is 1 mile away and George Street is 30 minutes’ stroll from the property. The HYDRO is a 10-minute walk away and Glasgow International Airport is within 7 miles.

name.content: Glasgow Westerwood Hotel, Spa & Golf Resort

16425.description: The following services and amenities are available, but with reduced service: Breakfast, Golf, On-site Restaurant(s), Pool, Spa. The following services and amenities are currently not available: Fitness Center. Welcome to DoubleTree by Hilton Glasgow Westerwood Spa and Golf Resort. Our contemporary property is set within acres of wooded countryside overlooked by the beautiful Campsie Hills, yet offers quick and easy motorway access to Glasgow, Stirling and Edinburgh. With luxurious leisure facilities, first-class dining, flexible conference spaces and an 18-hole golf course designed by Seve Ballesteros, we're the perfect venue for weddings, corporate events, and weekend retreats. Unwind in one of our spacious guest rooms and enjoy complimentary high-speed WiFi and a 49-inch HDTV. Upgrade to a suite for a larger TV, separate lounge area and views across the golf course. Our hotel offers an award-winning spa with 10 treatment rooms, an indoor heated pool and extensive gym facilities, so you can relax and recharge throughout your stay. Enjoy award-winning food and service in our a la carte restaurant, Flemings. We offer local Scottish produce and classic dining in a semi-formal but relaxed environment. The Grill Restaurant and Bar is open from noon until 10pm and serves classic British pub favorites, while Flemings Lounge is open from 10. 30am for a range of beverages and cocktails throughout the day. Host a meeting or conference in our contemporary hotel. We offer 10 fully flexible meeting rooms catering for over 675 delegates, and all A/V needs can be catered for. Our stunning natural surroundings make us the perfect backdrop for bespoke weddings and events.

16642.description: A total of 80 guest rooms are available for guests' convenience at Travel Inn Glasgow North East .

16649.description: A stylish hotel close to Glasgow, with free Wi-Fi and a pool, hot tub and spa, plus meeting facilitiesHoliday Inn® Glasgow - East Kilbride hotel is conveniently located 15 miles from Glasgow Airport and 15 miles from central Glasgow. If you're driving, you can access the hotel in seven minutes from the M77 or in 15 minutes from the M74. Catch a train to Glasgow Central in 30 minutes from Hairmyres station, less than two miles from the hotel, or East Kilbride station, six minutes' drive away. Holiday makers are only five minutes' drive from Playsport, with its golf course, skate park and trampolining arena. Wander East Kilbride's old village, less than four miles away, or visit the National Museum of Rural Life, less than a mile away. Shoppers are just 10 minutes' drive from East Kilbride Shopping Centre. The hotel's nine well-appointed meeting rooms and function suites accommodate up to 250 delegates. A dedicated host will ensure your event runs smoothly, providing catering, equipment and support. Enjoy a meal at the cosy hotel restaurant, where kids stay and eat free. All guests enjoy free WiFi and access to the hotel's extensive health club, with its gym, pool and group fitness classes. Unwind in the spa and sauna, or pamper yourself with massage and beauty treatments.

16653.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages, body treatments, and facials. You're sure to appreciate the recreational amenities, including a health club, a spa tub, and a sauna. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a picnic area. Enjoy British cuisine at Coast Restaurant and Bar, a restaurant where you can take in the garden view and dine alfresco. Or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Relax with a refreshing drink at one of the 2 bars/lounges. A complimentary cooked-to-order breakfast is served daily from 7 AM to 10 AM. Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, luggage storage, and laundry facilities. This hotel has 3 meeting rooms available for events. Stay in one of 42 guestrooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access is available to keep you connected.

16727.description: The Macdonald Houstoun House is actually three houses in one: the towerhouse complemented by an elegant country manor and charming steading. This characterful combination ensures that most rooms boast wonderful views across the hotel's gardens or beyond to the Ecclesmachan Hills. Built in the early 17th century by John Shairp, the old tower of Houstoun remained the Shairp family home for 350 years. Vaulted ceilings and open fires combine with traditional Scottish hospitality to create an atmosphere that is warm and welcoming but is still distinctly refined and discreet. All 71 guest rooms are tastefully furnished and well equipped, coming as standard with full en suite facilities, satellite television, direct dial telephone, modem point, hairdryer, iron and board, trouser press, complimentary mineral water, working area with desk and a shoe shine service. An extensive wine list, together with skilful presentation of dishes and fresh local produce, have made Houstoun one of the most outstanding restaurants in Scotland's central belt. The award winning fine dining restaurant is situated on the first floor in the historic 16th century tower. Alternatively, the Leisure Club Bistro offers more informal fare and surroundings. Leisure facilities at the Vital Leisure Club include an 18 metre swimming pool, sauna, sun shower, steam room, gymnasium, aerobics studio, beauty salon, tennis court, and golf course. These facilities are free for guest usage. tennis court, and golf course. Please note that the hotel doesn't accept any cash payments

16730.description: Enjoy stunning views from the rooftop terrace and garden at The Glasshouse, Autograph Collection hotel in Edinburgh. This hotel offers complimentary wired and wireless internet access, concierge and wedding services, and a television in the common area. Savor British cuisine at The Snug Lounge restaurant with garden views, or take advantage of 24-hour room service. Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. English breakfasts are available daily (for a fee). The hotel also features limo/town car service and express check-in. For events, there's 3, 714 square feet of space including a conference center and five meeting rooms. Self-parking is available (subject to charges). The 77 air-conditioned rooms include iPod docking stations, LCD televisions, and cable programming. Private bathrooms offer separate bathtubs and showers, designer toiletries, and hair dryers. Additional conveniences include phones, laptop-compatible safes, and desks. Nearby attractions include the Edinburgh Playhouse Theatre, Calton Hill, and St. James Quarter. Edinburgh Airport (EDI) is the preferred airport.

16734.description: This cosy boutique hotel is located in Edinburgh's fashionable West End, within easy walking distance of shopping at Princes Street, the Scottish National Gallery, and Haymarket Station. Sightseers might also visit the National Museum of Scotland and the historic Edinburgh Castle, both only two kilometres away. Guests will delight in the unique designs of the plush guest rooms as well as useful amenities such as free Wi-Fi and flat-screen cable televisions. The hotel serves a fresh, cooked-to-order Scottish breakfast prepared with local, organic produce and with traditional options such as haggis and black pudding, and the sumptuous library offers an inviting place for guests to enjoy a coffee or tea over a daily newspaper by the fire. Business travellers can also make use of the modern business centre and events room. This hotel's stylish design and great services make it no ordinary bed and breakfast.

16738.description: This vibrant international hostel is ideally located in the heart of Edinburgh's Old Town, with the historic Royal Mile at its doorstep. It's an excellent base for exploring Scotland's capital city. The hostel offers bright, clean, and comfortable accommodations ranging from 6- to 15-bed dormitories with superb city views to private double and twin rooms in a self-catering apartment with a fully equipped kitchen and bathroom. All dormitories include hot showers and free linen. Guests can enjoy the Southern Cross Café, the hostel's world-style bistro, with special discounts for residents. Additional amenities include 24-hour reception, secure storage for valuables and luggage, a booking service, a communal self-catering kitchen, email and internet access, cable TV, a pool table, and darts. Secure car parking is available a 5-minute walk away.

16741.description: This 3 star hotel is located within the city of Edinburgh. The nearest station is Haymarket.

16742.description: This luxurious 5-star retreat has a fine-dining restaurant and romantic bedrooms about 3 km from the Royal Mile. Prestonfield is surrounded by gardens and a golf course. Buses to the city centre are a 5-minute walk away. Parking is free. Each stylish room at Prestonfield House has antique furnishings, free Wi-Fi, Smart TV, a stocked minibar and views of the gardens and parkland. Rhubarb Restaurant serves excellent Scottish cuisine and traditional afternoon teas. The terraces, drawing room and gardens are relaxed, beautiful places to unwind.

16744.description: ‘Black Ivy' is situated on the south side of Edinburgh in Bruntsfield which has a relaxed village feel and a unique mix of original boutique shops, artisan bakers and chocolatiers as well as great cafes, bars and restaurants and all within walking distance of the city centre. Enter the hotel bar and you would be forgiven for thinking you had stepped into another world with Black Ivy's design ethos rich in thought and attention to detail, resulting in a bar appearance which is a treat for the eyes and simply makes you think 'wow”. Housed in 3 adjoining historic and beautiful town houses the hotel is contemporary and modern, inside and out. The welcome is warm and uniquely Scottish where you immediately feel part of the family and realise you have just discovered your new home from home. Above this coolest of bars with its live music, tank beer, table tennis games room and extensive and original cocktail list sits our boutique 22 bedroom Hotel offering divine luxurious beds, high speed WIFI, working desk and complimentary White Company Noir toiletries. The restaurant is open from 7am for the service of breakfast through to the early hours and is popular with locals and visitors alike.
