Our all-day menu has been created to suit all palates and cater for any dietary requirements. The South Side, as well as being a mecca for culture lovers and architecture buffs, is dominated by the vast green space of The Meadows which sits in front of Black Ivy's garden space which houses two warming and dramatic fire pits, bespoke seating and a tropical vibe whether your sipping a cooling summer cocktail or toasting marshmallow in the winter by the fire.

16747.address: The Erskine Bridge Hotel & Spa, Riverfront, N/A
16747.description: Set within 18 acres of stunning parkland overlooking the River Clyde, this charming hotel offers a perfect retreat for leisure and business travelers. It provides easy access to both the airport (8 km) and Glasgow city center (a 30-minute drive). The hotel features comfortable, stylish rooms with modern amenities. Some boast incredible views of the Kilpatrick Hills, the River Clyde, and the Erskine Bridge. Enjoy delicious Scottish cuisine and refreshing drinks in the riverside restaurant.

16761.description: Pamper yourself with onsite massages, body treatments, and facials. You can take advantage of recreational amenities such as an indoor pool and a sauna. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and wedding services. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant or snacks in the coffee shop/cafe. The hotel also offers room service (during limited hours). Relax with a refreshing drink at one of the 2 bars/lounges. Full breakfasts are served on weekdays from 6:30 AM to 10:00 AM and on weekends from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, express check-out, and a 24-hour front desk. Free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 145 guestrooms. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and digital programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms have designer toiletries and hair dryers.

name.content: Glasgow Argyle Hotel, BW Signature Collection

16762.description:
Be it sightseeing, shopping, sport or business, there are many reasons to check into Glasgow Argyle. Built on a former rice mill, tastefully blends old and new and stands out on the Glasgow skyline close to the River Clyde. Within a mile of the city center, you can walk to many of Glasgows attractions: George Square, Merchant City and Buchanan Galleries shopping center. Well-placed for the citys amazing nightlife, whether going for a wee dram in a trendy whisky bar, attending a gig at The SSE Hydro or laughing at The Stand Comedy Club. 
Glasgow is famous for its warm hospitality, and youll always get a friendly welcome at Glasgow Argyle, no matter what time of day you arrive. With super-comfy beds to sink into in our 141 bedrooms, all with free Wi-Fi, large flat-screen plasma TVs and 24-hour room service. Our 12 stunning apartments occupy the old mill and feature exposed brickwork, original ornate iron columns and abstract artworks. Some are spread over two storys with beds on a mezzanine level, making them an attractive option for families and business travelers. Were one of the few hotels in the city center to have a swimming pool and gym, so theres even more reason to stay with us if youre into keeping fit. Whilst we don’t have onsite parking, we do have a guest parking partnership with 2 car parks: Your Parking Space - 12 Washington St, G3 8AZ. Closer to the hotel, at The Old School Building. Limited and operates strictly on a first come, first serve basis. Guest tariffs only available through the kiosk at hotel reception area: Up to 9 hours - £8. 00. Up to 24 hours - £12. 00 (Will then go up in 24-hour increments)
Q-Park - 99 Waterloo St, G2 6HS offers 40% discounted parking rate for Glasgow Argyle Hotel customers pre-booked. Please click on the following link: https://www. q-park. co. uk/en-gb/cities/glasgow/waterloo-street/ Using discount code please enter ARGYLE40. Pre-booked parking must be completed before arrival; the discount cannot be applied locally.

16770.description: Mussselburgh is a quiet fishing village. Edinburgh is one of the most exciting cities in the UK. So put yourself in pole position for both destinations, at Premier Inn Hotel Edinburgh A1 (Musselburgh). Whether you're here on business or pleasure, you'll have a great stay. Musselburgh is known as 'The Honest Toun', and we can honestly say you'll have a fantastic time here. Laugh your socks off at the Edinburgh Festival, or bet your shirt at the Musselburgh races. Don plus fours and have a round of golf at Royal Musselburgh, or visit Rosslyn Chapel, one of the most remarkable buildings in Scotland. Then come back to a hearty meal at our Brewers Fayre - no need to dress for dinner - and a lovely comfy bed. All reservations placed at this hotel are subject to Premier Inn’s standard Terms and Conditions, which can be found at premierinn. com

16803.description: Located in a prime setting for every type of traveller, this charming hotel is just a 5 minutes' walking distance away from Southport train station. The hotel is situated in close proximity to a wide range of attractions, as well as a myriad of shopping, dining and entertainment opportunities. This charming Victorian property boasts stunningly-landscaped gardens. The guest rooms have been designed to keep in with the elegance and character of the building. The restaurant offers delectable, traditional dishes. The bar has been designed in a golf style, offering a lively ambiance in which to socialise or unwind. 11 conference rooms are available for the convenience of those travelling on business or hosting a special occasion.

16815.description: The Hotel is just a few minutes from the M42 and has free on-site parking. Birmingham City Centre is a short drive away, and it is less than an hour to Stoke-On-Trent. Birmingham New Street Station offers regular rail services to all major destinations across the UK. Birmingham International Airport is a 15 minute taxi ride, whilst East Midlands Airport is only 35 minutes. Situated in 550 acres of beautiful countryside, this hotel offers world-class golfing, sumptuous dining, extensive health & fitness facilities, Spa and free parking. The hotel's sole ambition is to create the perfect experience for their guests, whatever they wish to do. Of course, no visit would be complete without a few rounds on one of their legendary Golf courses. Host to more Ryder Cup matches than any other venue in the world, the Hotel is steeped in tournament history. Taking refuge in one of the 324 en-suite rooms, guests are sure of a comfortable and relaxing night's stay. All of the rooms are tastefully decorated and appointed with all the necessary modern amenities, including: TV, direct dial telephone, hairdryer and tea & coffee facilities. For extra indulgence, Superior Rooms are available, most with stunning golf course views. There are also the luxurious Suites, offering king size beds and balconies in selected rooms. The Hotel is a Mecca for professional and amateur golf players alike. Play the Brabazon, the internationally recognised championship course, the PGA National, England's only PGA branded course or The Derby – a shorter, more relaxed course for players of all levels. Benefit from world-class tuition at the PGA National Golf Academy or indulge in retail therapy at Europe's largest on-course golf and lifestyle store.

16871.description: Situated in the heart of Edinburgh, this historic city hotel is just steps from Princes Street, Edinburgh Castle, the Royal Mile, and the vibrant Grassmarket area. Steeped in tradition and charm, the hotel's unique architecture features alcoves and turrets, creating a captivating atmosphere. The tastefully decorated contemporary rooms offer a relaxing retreat after a day exploring the city or attending events at the nearby International Conference Centre, located just 1. 5 km away. Start your day with the hotel's breakfast buffet, ensuring you're well-fueled for whatever adventures await.

name.content: Channings Hotel, an Ascend Hotel Collection Member

16872.description: This upscale hotel is undoubtedly one of the friendliest and most sophisticated in the city. It offers the rare charm of a country house atmosphere in an urban setting, making it ideal for both business and leisure travelers. Overlooking spectacular private gardens on a quiet, cobbled street, the hotel is just 10 minutes from the West End, with numerous shops and stunning views of Edinburgh Castle. Guests can choose from individually decorated bedrooms, including three suites and a four-poster room. Amenities include a private hot tub for a romantic stay, and a fabulous on-site restaurant is available for all guests.

16875.description: The 4-star Novotel Edinburgh Centre hotel is located in the heart of the Scottish capital. After a day exploring Edinburgh, recuperate in our heated pool & spa, and join us for cocktails and craft beers and contemporary cuisine in the Tap Kitchen & Bar. And when you're ready to relax, discover the meaning of true comfort in our newly upgraded rooms.

16876.description: Situated in the heart of the city, this luxurious hotel is the perfect place to explore cosmopolitan Edinburgh. In just a few minutes, visitors can walk to the world famous Princes Street, and the main business community, shopping and entertainment areas are all within easy reach. Rooms have been tastefully and traditionally furnished in keeping with the character of the building and offer a high standard of accommodation. The hotel also appeals to delegates meeting for a day or two, families and friends attending a city wedding, theatregoers and couples making the most of Edinburgh on a weekend break. Whether it is business or leisure, there is always time to relax amongst the comfort and warmth of this establishment.

16900.description: The Best Western Kings Manor Hotel offers an idyllic retreat in Edinburgh's quiet eastern suburbs, yet remains conveniently close to the city's vibrant attractions, shops, bars, and restaurants, just 20 minutes away. Housed in a charming 160-year-old former convent, this hotel boasts a rich history. Located just half a mile from Musselburgh's picturesque harbor and Portobello Beach's golden sands, and a short 20-minute drive from Edinburgh Castle and the Scottish National Gallery, the hotel offers easy access to key attractions. The hotel features a large leisure club, the second largest among Edinburgh hotels, and offers 100 en-suite rooms, including twin/double rooms, club rooms, and accessible accommodations. Dining options abound, from the contemporary Lauders Restaurant with its impressive à la carte menu to the relaxed Options Bistro serving classic and modern dishes, and Bar Zest for drinks and snacks. Children under 12 stay free when accompanied by two adults.

16903.description: This 4 star hotel is located in the suburbs of Edinburgh. The hotel has a gorgeous brasserie restaurant and bar on site, featuring bistro and á la carte menus. The grounds have several walking paths in the surrounding woods, a water fountain often featured in outdoor weddings, and neighbouring friendly horses.

16964.description: The Royal Scots Club is a 31-bedroom property located in Edinburgh's New Town, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Occupying three Georgian townhouses, the club is spread over six floors, with lift access to all levels. Located opposite a peaceful garden, the club is less than a 10-minute walk from Princes Street, with local bus routes just a 2-minute walk away. The club offers bed and breakfast, meeting and event spaces, private dining, and excellent cuisine in our dining room. With several meeting rooms catering for parties of 2 to 182, it's ideal for business trips or private events. Enjoy the stunning Queen Street Gardens during a private dinner. For GPS, use postcode EH3 6QE or W3W location: tent. odds. covers (55. 956283, -3. 197780). Breakfast is offered for £12. 50. The Royal Scots Club is Green Tourism certified.

16969.description: The Mercure Livingston Hotel is a sophisticated 3-star hotel in the city heart. Just 16 miles south of Edinburgh and close to some of Scotland's best country parks, it offers guests the perfect blend of style and convenience. With eight meeting rooms and a dedicated restaurant and bar offering international cuisine, it is the prime destination for business and leisure guests.

16970.description: Welcome to Holiday Inn Express Edinburgh Airport. With on-site parking, an airport shuttle, and a complimentary breakfast, it’s the perfect choice for a stress-free pre or post-flight stay. For travel, consider our Park, Stay & Go packages. Edinburgh's main train stations, Haymarket and Waverley, are both within a short drive. Explore nearby attractions like Edinburgh Castle, The Royal Mile, and Princes Street with a quick tram or bus ride into the city centre. Thrill seekers can visit the Edinburgh International Climbing Arena, while animal lovers will enjoy Edinburgh Zoo, just five miles away. For shopping and dining, visit the Gyle Shopping Centre or St James Quarter. If you're attending events, the Royal Highland Centre is a short walk from the hotel, and Scottish Gas Murrayfield Stadium is a 20-minute drive away. After a busy day, unwind in our lounge with a snack and a drink, or start your day with our free buffet breakfast.

16971.description: Situated to the south of Glasgow, this property sits proudly on a tree-lined avenue, immersed in peace and serenity. The hotel is just a 20 minutes' driving distance away from the bustling city centre. Hampden Stadium is a 15 minutes' drive away. Links to the public transport network can be found nearby, offering ease of access to other areas of the city to be explored. This charming property greets visitors with the promise of a memorable, enjoyable stay. The guest rooms are fully furnished and well equipped with modern amenities. Guests can enjoy a delightful meal in the restaurant, followed by a refreshing drink from the bar. The hotel also offers conference facilities for the convenience of business travellers.

name.content: The Caledonian Edinburgh Curio Collection Hilton

16973.description: Please always contact the property if you require a connecting room. The Caledonian is one of Edinburgh’s most significant landmarks. Standing proudly at the West End of Princes Street, this former Victorian railway building hotel nestles in the shadow of the imposing Edinburgh Castle. Its reputation for style and excellence has attracted international visitors and notable personalities for over one hundred years. Admire some of the best views in Edinburgh from our 231 guest rooms and suites and dine at Dean Banks at The Court. The Caledonian Edinburgh, experience the grandeur of The Lounge, formerly the station concourse and ticket office, now a haven for afternoon tea and elegant evening drinks. Treat yourself to some of the finest Scottish whiskies and signature cocktails at The Caley Bar, or indulge at the Spa at The Caledonian, a sanctuary of luxury and relaxation, home to a luxurious swimming pool, sauna, steam room, whirlpool, and two gyms. The Caledonian Edinburgh is one of the most splendid venues Edinburgh has to offer for meetings, events and weddings. Since opening in 1903, The Caledonian Edinburgh has staged many prestigious events, from extravagant wedding celebrations and star-packed parties to lavish corporate gatherings and grand banquets.

16974.description: Located in Edinburgh's stylish West End, this luxurious hotel seamlessly blends its 1860s heritage with chic, modern interiors. Guests will appreciate original features like ornate staircases and detailed coving alongside contemporary decor. Just 200 meters from Haymarket station and a short walk from Edinburgh Castle, Princes Street, and the Royal Mile, it's an ideal base for exploring Scotland's capital. A range of spacious guest rooms, suites, and deluxe rooms, all filled with natural daylight, await. For corporate travelers, the hotel offers three conference suites and five elegant meeting rooms, accommodating up to 500 delegates with state-of-the-art technology and support. After work, unwind with a meal at the hotel restaurant or savor a Scotch whisky at the contemporary bar while enjoying live sports.

name.content: Apollo Ht London–Near Hyde Park & Paddington Stati

17122.description: 'This affordable, family-run hotel offers comfortable accommodations in a quiet residential street near London's Hyde Park. A short walk from Queensway and Bayswater tube stations, it provides convenient access to central London. All guest rooms feature private bathrooms, color TVs, direct-dial telephones, and tea/coffee making facilities. Wi-Fi is available for a fee. Breakfast is included, and chargeable street parking is managed by Westminster Council. Guests are required to provide credit card details upon check-in as security for incidentals. Reception is open from 7 am to 11 pm. '

17123.description: The Beverley House Hotel, located in the heart of London, is a short walk from Hyde Park and Kensington Gardens. The hotel offers 23 guestrooms equipped with flat-screen TVs, complimentary Wi-Fi, and private bathrooms with showers. Guests can enjoy room service (limited hours), complimentary newspapers, and the convenience of a 24-hour front desk and multilingual staff. Marble Arch and Oxford Street are within a short distance, making this hotel an ideal base for exploring the city.

17125.description: The Shaftesbury Premier London Paddington, nestled in a private terrace just two minutes from Paddington Station, offers a tranquil escape from the bustling city center. This 4-star hotel boasts all the amenities expected of a premier London accommodation, including a stylish bar stocked with a wide selection of beverages. The spacious, airy, and quiet rooms, decorated in warm colors with quality furnishings, provide an ideal base for exploring London's many attractions.

17126.description: Discover London from our recently renovated and rebranded hotel in the heart of the city. Close to landmarks like Hyde Park, Royal Albert Hall, and Oxford Street, Europe's favorite shopping destination, our stylishly original rooms offer supreme comfort. Each boasts fashionable Italian furniture, vibrant chairs, and contemporary chandeliers, creating a perfect haven of convenience.

17127.description: The Troy Hotel, a privately owned boutique hotel, is ideally situated on a quiet terrace just west of London's Hyde Park. Offering convenient access to Oxford Street and the West End via public transport, and a direct bus route to Heathrow Airport just two minutes away on Bayswater Road, its location is unbeatable. The hotel's 33 elegant, contemporary suites, classified as Deluxe and Executive, have been recently renovated to the highest standards. All rooms feature Sky TV, pay-per-view movie channels, mini-fridges, and direct-dial telephones. Executive rooms additionally offer air conditioning and a choice of shower, shower and bath, or jetted tubs. The Troy Hotel also provides fully equipped conference facilities to meet all your business needs. Please note: Triple rooms may consist of either three single beds or one double bed and one folding bed.

17128.description: This hotel is well served by public transport and is an ideal starting point for those wishing to explore London's many sights. Numerous tourist attractions such as Kensington Palace, Buckingham Palace and Hyde Park are all to be found in the hotel's immediate vicinity. Heathrow airport is approximately 30 km away. There are a total of 50 appealing rooms are spread over 4 floors. The hotel's facilities include a reception hall, which is open 24 hours and a lift. The standard rooms are all en suite and come equipped with a hairdryer, a telephone, satellite TV, Internet access and central heating. Each morning there is a continental breakfast on offer for guests. By Car: From London Heathrow Airport - Depart. At the roundabout, take the first exit onto Bolton's Lane. Turn left onto Bath Road A4. At the roundabout, take the first exit onto The Parkway A312. At the roundabout, take the fourth exit onto Slip Road (M4 J3). Continue onto M4. Continue onto Great West Road A4. At the roundabout, take the second exit onto Great West Road A4. Continue onto A4. Turn left onto Warwick Road A3220. Turn right onto Pembroke Road A3220. Turn left onto Earl's Court Road B316. Turn right onto Kensington High Street A315. Bear left onto Kensington Church Street. Turn right onto Notting Hill Gate A40. Continue onto A40. Turn left onto Saint Petersburgh Place. Continue onto Ilchester Gardens. Turn right onto Prince's Square. Arrive.

17130.description: Nestled on the edge of Cardiff, this attractive hotel is a perfect place for a family holiday, weekend gateway or a business travel. Provided a quiet yet still convenient situation, the property guarantees a memorable stay in a contemporary setting and hospitality to meet expectations of even the most discerning visitors. The hotel is close to the M4 Motorway and the A48M and 8 km away from Cardiff city centre. Cardiff Airport can be reached within 35-minute drive. Shopping centre, bars and restaurants can be found in the nearby area. Guests will have the opportunity to completely wind down in charming rooms filled with natural light and well-appointed with modern furniture and all the necessary amenities like a flat screen free view televisions, telephones, tea and coffee making facilities and hairdryers to provide all the necessary means for an enjoyable stay.

17144.description: Nestled in Newcastle-upon-Tyne, just 18 kilometers from Newcastle International Airport, this modern hotel is perfect for weekend getaways, family holidays, or business trips. Its convenient location just off the A167 motorway and only 5 kilometers from the city center makes it an ideal base for exploring the area's historical heritage. Twin, double, and accessible rooms are available to meet all guests' needs. Each room features elegant décor in natural tones, cozy furnishings, a flat-screen television, a desk, tea and coffee making facilities, a private bathroom, and a hairdryer. The on-site restaurant offers delicious local specialties and excellent service. Guests can also enjoy a beverage from the bar or read a newspaper on the terrace.

17145.description: This property is perched on the tip of the renowned Causeway Coastal Route, facing the soft, sandy beaches of Ballygally Bay and offering magnificent views over the surrounding landscape. Ideal for nature lovers, this charming property offers the perfect base from which to explore all this vibrant region has to offer, including the famous Giant's Causeway, Whitepark Bay and Glenariff Forest Park. A wide choice of outdoor activities is to be found on the Antrim Coast Ardclinis Outdoor Activity Centre, and Belfast International Airport is a 40-minute drive away. Designed with relaxation and comfort in mind, each of the rooms has been tastefully decorated, combining a modern décor with the charm of the castle. The onsite restaurant serves up a wide range of delicious dishes based on the finest local produce. Full of character, this beautiful establishment also includes meeting rooms ideal for corporate travellers.

17146.description: This luxurious hotel is ideally situated in the suburbs of Belfast. Immersed in the rich culture and history of the city, this hotel is just a short distance away from a wide range of attractions. A number of shopping, dining and entertainment opportunities can be found just a short distance away. This upscale hotel enjoys a mesmerising design. Dating back to 1876, it offers well-established, longstanding appeal and charm. The luxurious guest rooms immerse visitors in unrivalled elegance and comfort. Guests will be spoilt for choice with the hotel's 2 restaurants. They can enjoy an energetic workout in the gym, followed by a refreshing swim in the pool. Business travellers can avail of the conference room.

17147.description: Featuring a prime location in Belfast city centre, this luxurious hotel is a short distance from many of the most important attractions in the city, including Ulster Museum, Grand Opera House, City Hall, Titanic Belfast and the Odyssey Arena, a large sports and entertainment centre. Belfast International Airport is to be found some 30 kilometres from this outstanding property. Guests will find a wide choice of tastefully decorated and superbly furnished rooms featuring a charming atmosphere in which to completely unwind. This superbly appointed property features an excellent service and is equally suited to a short break, residential conference or a grand event. The onsite dining options serve a wide range of delicious dishes elaborated with fresh local produce as well as tasty snacks and pastries, while corporate travellers can take advantage of the state-of-the-art conference facilities.

name.content: Radisson Blu Hotel London Stansted Airport

17149.description: Take advantage of recreational opportunities offered, including an indoor pool, a sauna, and a fitness center. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and wedding services. Enjoy American cuisine at Station 169, one of the hotel's 3 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Full breakfasts are served on weekdays from 6:00 AM to 10:00 AM and on weekends from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-out, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Planning an event in Bishop's Stortford? This hotel has 13993 square feet (1300 square meters) of space consisting of a conference center and 15 meeting rooms. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Stay in one of 500 guestrooms featuring LCD televisions.

17311.description: This beautiful building from 1900 is situated in the heart of elegant Paddington, a few minutes from Hyde Park near Oxford Street and Marble Arch, near Paddington and Lancaster Gate metro stations. There is a plethora of shops, restaurants and bars in the surrounding area and the nearest night club is 2 km away. Madame Tussaud's wax museum is just 1. 6km away. Both Stansted and Gatwick airports are easily accessible by train from Paddington. The closest airport is London City Airport, 15 km away. Rooms are decorated in traditional style, equipped with everything that guests will need during the stay.

17394.description: This small and friendly hotel enjoys a fantastic location in the heart of London, perfect for sightseers looking for modest accommodation as well as easy access to city sights. Russell Square tube station is just a stone's throw away, and visitors will be able to reach the British Museum, Covent Garden, and Leicester Square all within an easy 20-minute walk. Madame Tussauds, Regents Park, and the shops of Oxford Street are also within walking distance. London City Airport is located 12. 7 km away. The hotel features a 24-hour reception and a bar. Each room comes with a television and tea and coffee making facilities. Refrigerators, irons and hairdryers are available upon request. There is one bathroom for every four rooms. This hotel's superb location makes it a great choice for a sightseeing weekend in London.

17396.description: Located beside a lake opposite Brentford Street. This hotel is within easy reach of Heathrow Airport.

17397.description: Located in the heart of London, the Travelodge London Kings Cross Royal Scot Hotel is within a 15-minute walk of Russell Square and University College London. This hotel is conveniently located near several key attractions: 1. 3 miles from the British Museum, 1. 4 miles from St. Paul's Cathedral, and 0. 7 miles from the British Library. The nearest airport is London City Airport (9 miles).

17411.description: Situated less than 1 kilometre from both Kings Cross Thames Link and St Pancras International, this smart urban hotel is ideal for visitors seeking accommodation that is close to major transport links in London. A short walk will take travellers to the world famous British Library, with its immense collection of over 13 million books. Those interested in art and culture, can take a trip to the British Museum and discover a global collection of art and antiquities that are sure to inspire them. With convenient amenities and services like the early check-in/late check-out option, the complimentary Wi-Fi Internet access and the cash machine on the premises, this hotel will satisfy the requirements of even the most demanding travellers.

17414.description: This hotel boasts a delightful setting in London, lying close to the River Thames. The hotel enjoys close proximity to Clapham train station, which is just 600 metres away. Guests can enjoy a range of exciting activities nearby. Sitting on the pleasant York Road, a host of attractions are located in close proximity to this charming hotel. The hotel is located close to Hurlingham Park, lying just 16 km away from London City Airport. This wonderful hotel tempts visitors into the comfort and style of the lobby. The guest rooms are superbly designed, offering a serene setting in which to unwind. This hotel prides itself on its homely ambiance, exemplary service, and dedication to customer satisfaction.

17415.address: Belgrave Road, Lillington and Longmoore Gardens, 53-57
17415.description: This popular hotel, built-in 1800 and housed in a traditional Victorian building, is located in the centre of the city, very close to Piccadilly Circus, the London Eye, Buckingham Palace and the famous Big Ben and other touristic sites of cultural and historic interest. Guests will also be able to find, countless shopping and entertainment sites reachable on foot. The public transport stops are also within walking distance. Victoria Station is approximately 5 minutes away and Westminster Abbey, the Houses of Parliament, as well as the Tate Gallery, are only a few minutes away. The modern rooms are beautifully decorated and equipped with wooden elements and parquet flooring. Each has a private bathroom with toiletries.

17455.description: This enchanting hotel enjoys a convenient location just 1 kilometre from the city centre and the railway station in the lively Liverpool. John Lennon Airport is just 12 kilometres away. Featuring magnificent views over the Queen's Dock and Mersey River, the hotel's welcoming rooms are comfortable and provide a functional décor with parquet floors and a large desk ideal for business travellers. Other in-room amenities include flat Screen TV with free view channels, en-suite with shower, telephone, tea and coffee facilities and hairdryer. A breakfast buffet is available every morning and guests staying at this charming property may have the chance to enjoy à la carte dishes for lunch and delicious specialities for dinner at the onsite restaurant. Ideal for a leisure or business stay, this property offers the perfect base to explore this stunning region.

17456.description: Located only 8 km from Belfast city centre, this hotel stands in 12 acres of beautifully secluded gardens and woodland. It is adjacent to Stormont Castle and situated within only 900 m from shopping venues, bars, nightclubs and public transport. The hotel offers luminous and well-appointed rooms, where guests may completely unwind after all day of work or venturing into the city. The units are en-suite and come complete with state-of-the-art amenities. There is a small gym located on-site offering a combination of cardio and weights - free for guests to use. There are a variety of dining options to suit all tastes. Guests can enjoy the cosmopolitan atmosphere of the bistro, or simply relax in the stylish lounge and reception area by the log-burning fire. Corporate travellers may avail for functional meeting facilities and afterwards while away at the welcoming bar.

17483.description: Work, relax, eat, and explore at the Holiday Inn® Oxford. Just off the A34, our hotel is three miles from Oxford City Centre and five minutes from Oxford Parkway, with trains to London and high-end shopping at Bicester Village. Explore the historic University of Oxford and its Ashmolean Museum. See the baroque Blenheim Palace, the birthplace of Winston Churchill, a 10-minute drive from the hotel. Our Oxford hotel offers a modern blend of work and leisure with comfortable rooms, an open lobby, and a casual restaurant serving British pub fare. Enjoy a workout in the gym, stay connected with free Wi-Fi, and unwind in our lounge. Host events in our Academy Conference Centre with 11 meeting spaces, catering, and a team to bring it together.

17501.description: Located in the suburbs of Glasgow, this upscale property enjoys close proximity to the centre of the city. A wealth of attractions are just waiting to be explored nearby. The hotel is located just a short distance away from the Princes Mall shopping centre. This hotel is a great choice for business and leisure travellers alike. Guests are greeted with warm hospitality and the promise of a memorable stay. Comfortable, elegantly-styled guest rooms offer a peaceful space in which to unwind. Guests are invited to take advantage of the many facilities and services that this sophisticated property has to offer. Please note that the hotel doesn't accept any cash payments

17670.description: With a stay at Novotel London ExCeL in London (Docklands), you'll be within a 5-minute walk of ExCeL Exhibition Centre and Royal Victoria Bridge. This upscale hotel is 0. 2 mi (0. 3 km) from IFS Cloud Royal Docks Station and 0. 3 mi (0. 5 km) from The Crystal. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a television in a common area. Make yourself at home in one of the 257 guestrooms featuring minibars and LCD televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks. Stop by the hotel's restaurant, Upper Deck, for lunch or dinner. Dining is also available at the coffee shop/cafe, and 24-hour room service is provided. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 10 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Planning an event in London? This hotel has 4532 square feet (421 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and meeting rooms. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. ExCeL Exhibition Centre - 0. 2 km / 0.

17679.description: This comfortable, 5-star hotel, dating back to 1881, is nestled in the heart of Birmingham, within walking distance of the city center and many top attractions. A variety of bars and pubs are just 500 meters away, and public transport is easily accessible on foot. Following renovations in 2003, the hotel now offers 112 rooms, including five suites. Guests can enjoy the air-conditioned lobby with a 24-hour reception desk, a stylish bar, and a restaurant serving both traditional English and international cuisine. Rooms feature a unique blend of Victorian and minimalist design, adorned with exclusive works of art. All rooms are equipped with standard amenities. Please note: the hotel is cashless. Discounted parking is available at two nearby car parks: Grand Central (B5 4DQ) and B4 (B4 6DG). Please inquire at reception for details.

17732.description: Indulge in relaxing massages, body treatments, and facials at this hotel, boasting a health club, indoor pool, and sauna. Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge and wedding services, and on-site dining at the restaurant or via 24-hour room service. A bar/lounge and full breakfast (fee applies) are also available. For business needs, there's a computer station, complimentary newspapers, dry cleaning/laundry services, conference space, and meeting rooms. Free self-parking is provided. The 72 guestrooms feature LCD TVs, cable programming, private bathrooms with complimentary toiletries and hair dryers, phones, desks, and electric kettles. Nearby attractions include Antrim Castle (3. 7 mi), Antrim Forum Leisure Centre (3. 7 mi), and The Junction Shopping Complex (5. 2 mi). The closest airport is Belfast International Airport (BFS), 5. 8 miles away.

17734.description: This charming hotel is located just steps away from Belfast International Airport. It enjoys close proximity to the vibrant city centre, where a number of cultural and historical attractions can be found. The property offers visitors an insight into the rich heritage of the city. This establishment enjoys a modern style. The guest rooms are classically styled, featuring modern amenities that offer comfort and convenience. Guests can enjoy exquisite specialities in the onsite restaurant, followed by a refreshing drink in the bar. This wonderful hotel is ideal for business and leisure travellers alike. Hotel has implemented a full range of enhanced sanitisation procedures and new practices which have been rigorously reviewed by Bureau Veritas, a trusted, independent global leader in tested, inspections and certification.

17735.description: The Crowne Plaza Belfast offers a refined, modern experience within Lagan Valley Regional Park, just a 15-minute drive from Belfast city centre. This hotel is ideal for both business and leisure travelers, with convenient access to Titanic Belfast, city centre shopping, and major road networks. Both city airports are within a 30-minute drive, and Dublin is reachable in 2 hours by car. The hotel features 21 meeting rooms, including a 900-seat ballroom, making it a premier conference venue. Contemporary rooms offer air conditioning, flat-screen TVs, and free Wi-Fi. Executive rooms provide access to the Club Lounge with complimentary snacks, beverages, and continental breakfast. Guests can enjoy a seasonal menu at the signature Green Room restaurant, authentic Indian cuisine, or relaxed, family-friendly dining at The RiverBar Lounge & Bistro. The hotel's health club features a gym, 20m swimming pool (booking recommended), sauna, and steam room, and complimentary car parking is provided.

17737.description:
Perfectly positioned on Malone Road, innbelfast is smart choice for travellers looking for a hotel near Queen's University Belfast and within walking distance of top attractions. 
Just 2 minutes from Queen's, 4 minutes from Ulster Museum and Botanic Gardens and a 15-minture stroll to Belfast City Hall and Ulster Hall, you'll be right in the heart of it. St. George's Market, Limelight Belfast and Ormeau Park are all nearby, while easy access to direct bus and train routes puts Titanic Belfast, SSE Arena, and Boucher Playing Fields within quick reach. 
From the historic Crumlin Road Gaol to the buzzing Cathedral Quarter, Custom House Square, and Waterfront hall, innbelfast connects you to the best of the city - without the fuss. At innbelfast, every room is designed for one thing - a smart night’s sleep in the heart of the city. Whether you’re travelling solo, with friends, or in a group, our rooms keep it simple: comfy beds, private bathrooms, free Wi-Fi, and a location that’s minutes from Queen’s, Botanic Gardens, and Belfast city centre.

18218.description: This award-winning 3-star hotel is located in the heart of Liverpool, just a minute's walk from Liverpool Lime Street Train Station. Situated within St. George's Quarter, the hotel is perfect for exploring the city, with easy access to the Liverpool Empire Theatre, St. George's Hall, Anfield (home of Liverpool Football Club), and the world-famous Albert Dock. Its convenient location near Liverpool's Knowledge Quarter makes it an ideal base for both business and leisure travelers.

18220.description: This unique property is beautifully located in Crawfordsburn. It is located just a 10 minutes' driving distance away from Belfast City Airport. Bangor is also just a short car journey away. This property offers visitors the perfect setting in which to enjoy golfing, scenic walks, historical sights, sailing and shopping. It enjoys a unique style and a long history, dating back to 1614. The original thatched roof of this old coaching inn has passed the test of time. The guest rooms are individually styled and named, with many showcasing period furnishings and four-poster beds. Guests can enjoy superb cuisine in the restaurant, where award-winning chefs deliver a feast for the senses.

name.content: Holiday Inn Express London - Vauxhall Nine Elms

18223.description: A modern London hotel with free WiFi and breakfast included, plus easy access to London's sights and businessesHoliday Inn Express® London - Vauxhall Nine Elms hotel lies south of the River Thames, in central London. It's half a mile from Vauxhall station, where you can hop on a Victoria Line Tube to Victoria or Oxford Circus or catch an overland train to London Waterloo. Buses to Parliament Square stop near the hotel. London City Airport (LCY) is less than 10 miles away, and it's 18 miles to Heathrow Airport (LHR). Limited parking is available. Business guests are within easy reach of meetings, convention centres and exhibitions in the capital. The hotel's bright,  spacious lobby makes a good working space for informal meetings, with the hotel staff on hand to assist with photocopying and printing. The hotel is just four Tube stops from shoppers' heaven on Oxford Street. Half an hour's walk along the river takes you to the London Eye for panoramic city views, while a stroll over Vauxhall Bridge brings you to Tate Britain's exhibitions in 20 minutes. It's just over a mile from the hotel to concerts at the O2 Academy Brixton and a 15-minute walk to cricket at The Oval, and a 12 min walk to American Embassy. Use free WiFi to plan your day's activities over the inclusive Express Start Breakfast featuring scrambled eggs, sausages, bacon, croissants, Porridge, cereals.

18224.description: The hotel is situated around 3 km from the city centre, on the outskirts of Birmingham, with shopping opportunities, nightclubs and bars lying 2. 4 km away. Birmingham airport is a short distance away, only 14 km. The nearest train station is Birmingham New Street, which is around 2. 4 km away. The hotel includes its own professionally landscaped garden. The 24-hour reception, bar and the conservatory were modernised in summer 2006. Conference facilities are available. The restaurant offers a typical English meat buffet as well as an à la carte menu. The comfortable rooms come with an en suite bathroom and are well-equipped as standard. The well-tended grounds include a sun terrace. Guests may select their typical English breakfast and evening meals from varied (meat) buffets. Lunch and dinner may be selected from the menu. Snacks are available the whole day from the lounge menu.

18329.description: Conveniently located close to the airport in Glasgow, The Normandy is the ideal place to stay before setting off on your holiday or business trip. Our ‘Stay, Park and Fly' service allows you to spend a night at The Normandy Hotel before reaching the airport in plenty of time using our airport shuttle service. The Normandy Hotel offers nearly 750 on-site parking spaces and competitively priced parking & transfer packages are available. This hotel offers a great choice for every type of traveller visiting the city and the city centre is just a short driving distance away, where guests will find a myriad of attractions, as well as a wealth of shopping, dining and entertainment opportunities. Links to the public transport network are readily accessible nearby. The stylish guest rooms offer comfort and convenience. The restaurant and bar offer a wide range of dishes and drinks from early till late.

18336.description: The Inn on The Mile located on The Royal Mile in the heart of the city centre, offers an alternative boutique and luxury hotel experience in one of Edinburgh's most prestigious historic landmarks. Built in 1923 as the British Linen Bank, we have preserved, conserved and renovated our historical building into a place where you feel at home. Fully refurbished in 2013. A full Scottish and continental-style breakfast is served within The Inn on The Mile pub on the Royal Mile. Rooms at the hotel are situated across three floors and accessed by stairs only. If you require a lower floor please contact us directly in advance of your stay on 0131 556 9940.

18337.description: Take in the views from a terrace and a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access. Satisfy your appetite for lunch or dinner at the hotel's restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Full breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and luggage storage. Free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 10 guestrooms featuring minibars and LED televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access is available to keep you connected. Private bathrooms have complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include laptop-compatible safes and desks, as well as phones with free local calls. 18537.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages, body treatments, and facials. You're sure to appreciate the recreational amenities, including a spa tub and a sauna. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and wedding services. Enjoy local cuisine at Dungeon Restaurant, one of the hotel's 2 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary English breakfast is served daily from 8:00 AM to 10:00 AM. Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and multilingual staff. Free self parking is available onsite. Stay in one of 35 guestrooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and digital programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with shower/tub combinations feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers.

18545.description:
Village Hotel Birmingham Dudley is just 8 miles from Birmingham city centre and 6 miles from Wolverhampton.   The hotel is handy for the M6, M5 and M42 motorway links with easy access to the whole of the West Midlands and for exploring the Black Country. 

The hotel has everything you'd need under one roof including new look, fully refurbished bedrooms with big cosy beds, huge TVs and great showers, pool and state-of-the-art gym with all the latest tech and Village Pub and Grill where you can tuck into delicious food and drink.

Village Hotel Newcastle is located at the Cobalt Business Park sitting between the city centre and the stunning beaches at Longsands and Whitley Bay. Newcastle city centre is a 20 minute drive away with the main A19 and A191 roads just around the corner from the hotel.   If you would rather leave the car, the Northumberland Park Metro stop is a short walk from the hotel. Newcastle International Airport is 14 miles, the North Shields Ferry Terminal is 4 miles and Central Station is 7 miles away from the hotel.

18553.description:
Village Hotel is located in the town of Bromborough and close to Liverpool, Chester and North Wales.   The hotel is one mile from Port Sunlight train station, with a regular rail service into Liverpool and Chester.   Liverpool Lime Street train station is 5 miles away and Liverpool John Lennon Airport is 14 miles from the hotel. 

The hotel has everything you'd need under one roof including new look, fully refurbished bedrooms with big cosy beds, huge TVs and great showers, pool and state-of-the-art gym with all the latest tech and Village Pub and Grill where you can tuck into delicious food and drink.

18554.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and wedding services. Enjoy a meal at Collage, or stay in and take advantage of the hotel's 24-hour room service. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are served on weekdays from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM and on weekends from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-in, and express check-out. Event facilities at this hotel consist of conference space and meeting rooms. Make yourself at home in one of the 194 air-conditioned rooms featuring LCD televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with shower/tub combinations feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks. name.content: DoubleTree by Hilton Belfast City Ten Square

18613.description: Across from Belfast City Hall, our historic hotel puts you in the heart of the city centre, just steps from top attractions. Titanic Belfast is 10 minutes away, and several theatres, restaurants, and shops are within walking distance. Enjoy our relaxing rooms, fitness center, and onsite steakhouse serving memorable meals for breakfast, lunch, and dinner.

18614.description:
This hotel is located in Belfast, right opposite Botanic Railway Station, offering convenient transport from the crossing between Lower Crescent and Botanic Avenue. Plenty of entertainment opportunities, such as bars and restaurants are only steps away from the hotel. Queens University takes around 5 minutes to reach and the centre of the northern Irish metropolis is a 15-minute walk away. The city airport lies roughly 1.5 km away.

Renovated in 2003, this city hotel comprises a total of 17 double rooms spread over 3 floors. Guests may make use of the foyer with a 24-hour reception desk. An air-conditioned à la carte restaurant and a conference room are also to be found within the hotel. Room and laundry services can be taken advantage of.

The rooms come with a bathroom with hairdryer, a direct dial telephone, wireless Internet access, a plasma TV with multi channels, a radio alarm clock, a double bed, carpeting, central heating and tea and coffee making facilities. A trouser press, work station and turndown service also feature.

Bed and breakfast is offered. Lunch and dinner may be taken à la carte.

18818.description: Cairn Hotel Newcastle is a modern, boutique hotel located in the affluent area of Jesmond, less than a mile from the centre of Newcastle. Featuring award-winning dining and an entirely relaxing atmosphere, this is the perfect venue for your city break. The 78 beautifully styled rooms are located across two buildings, benefiting from modern amenities and comforts such as flatscreen TVs, free Wi-Fi and parking. Head out to explore independent shops and bars on your doorstep or dine in one of the two onsite restaurants or our bar. The contemporary Asian fusion at Sohe is well renowned with an exciting menu to tantalise the senses. The gastro pub 97 & Social, serves Californian-inspired cuisine alongside an innovative, extensive cocktail menu, and Spy Bar serves a wide selection of drinks and burgers. When booking more than 2 rooms, different policies and additional supplements may apply.

18827.description: Enjoy everything Newcastle has to offer from this classic hotel in the city centre. Providing a traditional, elevated design with a contemporary touch, the Royal Station Hotel is the perfect base from which to explore. You’ll love the features that make this a grade I listed building whilst enjoying all the modern amenities, from free Wi-Fi to flat-screen TVs. The iconic quayside and a host of theatres, art galleries, restaurants, and bars are situated just a short walk away. For attractions that are a little further afield, you’ll only need to walk for a minute to reach Newcastle’s central train and metro station; you’ll also inevitably enjoy spending plenty of time back at the hotel. Unwind in the swimming pool and sauna and stay on top of your exercise routine in the fitness centre. With 10 magical function rooms, Royal Station Hotel is also the perfect venue for weddings and events. Filled with Victorian architecture, each room is adorned with features to fall in love with. You’ll delight in everything from chandeliers to ornate fireplaces.

18917.description: At voco® hotels, we're all about the warmest of welcomes and providing our guests with those locally inspired touches. Our rooms provide a characterful space to unwind and spend some ‘me time’. Whilst the POMO Restaurant & Bar, allows guests to indulge in authentic local flavours. Superbly located with a scenic view, in the historic Gasworks district beside the tranquil banks of the river Lagan. voco® Belfast is within walking distance to the heart of Belfast city centre. Here you will be able to explore shops, restaurants, historic venues and fun family activities and attractions. Belfast offers an unforgettable experience for everyone, whether you're here for business or leisure, voco® Belfast promises a stay that is warm, inviting, and full of charm.

18998.description: A haven for outdoor enthusiasts, spa-goers and golfers alike. This seaside escape boasts views of Bass Rock and the Firth of Forth and sits within putting distance of North Berwick Golf Club. Our thoughtfully-curated rooms pay homage to the ancient Scottish Linksland, its beauty and glorious colour palette. Warm woods, pops of blue and heathery hues abound, while chocolatey burgundy and pink help to create a sumptuous space for guests to relax and unwind. Selected rooms boast stunning scenic views of the West Links golf course, Firth of Forth estuary and islands, while all offer an abundance of amenities for an enjoyable and fuss-free stay. The Lawn Restaurant offers all-day dining, showcasing the very best of British and Scottish dishes. We've made a solid commitment to Scottish produce and provenance, so expect to find outstanding local beef, game and freshly-landed seafood on the menu. Bass Rock, our famous neighbour - is the inspiration behind our Bass Rock Bar, after all it offers unrivalled views, providing a wonderful ambience in which to spend some down-time. A place of immense natural beauty to reflect, unwind and just ‘be', the Marine North Berwick Spaoffers guests a range of facilities including an indoor-outdoor spa with heated 18m swimming pool, hydro pool and state-of-the-art fitness centre, plus sauna and steam rooms. The destination spa is available to all, for those looking to relax after a day on the links or those seeking to escape the everyday.

19356.description: Thriller, mystery or romance? With the Earls Court and Olympia Exhibition Centres on your doorstep and the must-see museums just minutes away, we promise a fairytale city break. Follow in the footsteps of Hitchcock and Agatha Christie and explore the beautiful streets (and stylish shops) of Kensington. See dinosaurs and experience earthquakes at the Natural History and Science Museums. Stroll to the latest show or cheer on your team at Chelsea's Stamford Bridge Stadium. And, with our friendly team, spacious rooms and extra-comfy beds, you can be sure of a winning night's sleep. All reservations placed at this hotel are subject to Premier Inn’s standard Terms and Conditions, which can be found at premierinn. com

19570.address: Hagley Road, Five Ways, Birmingham, England, 12
19570.description: The Delta Hotels by Marriott Birmingham offers upscale accommodation in the heart of Birmingham, a short walk from Broad Street and fifteen minutes from Utilita Arena. Guests can enjoy amenities such as a 24-hour fitness center, a terrace with city views, complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge and wedding services. The 104 guestrooms feature smart TVs, pillowtop beds with premium bedding, and private bathrooms with designer toiletries. The hotel's restaurant, The Brew Bar Lounge, serves British cuisine and also offers 24-hour room service. Cooked-to-order breakfasts are available for a fee. Other amenities include a business center, express check-in/check-out, and on-site self-parking (for a fee).

19572.description: Thoughtful touches and discreet charm make your stay at voco™ St John’s Solihull different right from the start. A stylish yet unstuffy hotel with conference facilities. Birmingham NEC a convenient 10 minutes away. Close to Birmingham Airport and the Midlands motorway network. With 13 flexible events spaces and dedicated staff, we can deliver the ultimate corporate event or your dream wedding. Here to relax? Dive into the pool. Steam in the sauna, get a massage or hit the treadmill in the health club. Dine on seasonal dishes in Brasserie six5one and order a nightcap in the bar.

19726.description: Delta Hotels by Marriott Newcastle Gateshead is located in Gateshead's Swalwell area, a short 2-minute drive from Intu and 7 minutes from the Life Science Centre. This upscale hotel is 5 miles from St. James' Park and 5. 5 miles from Quayside. Guests can relax at the full-service spa, enjoying massages, body treatments, and facials. Recreational opportunities include a health club, an indoor pool, and a spa tub. The hotel also offers complimentary Wi-Fi, a hair salon, and wedding services. Each of the 150 guestrooms features a Smart TV, complimentary Wi-Fi, and satellite programming. Private bathrooms include shower/tub combinations, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Additional conveniences include phones, safes, and desks. Dine at the Cast Iron Bar & Grill, featuring a bar/lounge, or enjoy 24-hour room service. Full breakfasts are available on weekdays from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM and on weekends from 7 AM to 11 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-in and check-out. The hotel offers 5, 586 square feet of event space, including conference space and 9 meeting rooms. Free self-parking is available onsite.

19727.description: This hotel in Great Dunmow is conveniently located with easy access to the M11. It is just 7 miles from Stansted Airport and close to the historic City of Cambridge. Built in 1600, this is a historic coaching inn situated opposite the old market place on Great Dunmow's High Street and has been welcoming visitors for nearly 400 years. There are 31 guest rooms in total, spread over a 4-storey main building and a 2-floor annexe block. There are various facilities on offer including a 24-hour reception desk and 2 function rooms. The a la carte restaurant with highchairs for infants invites guests to stop off and indulge in some top cuisine featuring fresh local produce. All rooms include an en suite bathroom, a hairdryer, central heating, a direct dial telephone and Internet access. All rooms are carpeted. Breakfast may be selected from a buffet. Lunch and dinner may be chosen from a menu. Furthermore, special dietary requirements can be catered for as well as the preparation of individual-specific dishes.

19756.description: Located in the historical market town of Dunstable, this stylish hotel is perfect for travellers who are eager to unwind. The property is just a short walking distance away from the centre of the town. Luton is a 10 minutes' drive away. Luton Airport is also located nearby. This charming hotel enjoys a rich heritage, oozing warm, old-English charm. The spacious guest rooms are stunningly designed, exuding rustic elegance and luxury. This property offers visitors a boundless range of facilities and services, to meet guests' individual needs. The hotel features spaces for special occasions and events. The property also offers a gym, for those who like to keep in shape while away.

19759.description: Located in the heart of Cardiff, this hotel offers a wealth of amenities, including a 24-hour fitness center, complimentary Wi-Fi, and concierge services. Enjoy on-site dining at the restaurant or 24-hour room service, and unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. A buffet breakfast is available daily (fee applies). For business travelers, there's a business center and express check-in/check-out services. The hotel also boasts extensive event space, with over 5, 000 square feet of meeting and conference rooms. The 205 air-conditioned guest rooms feature flat-screen TVs, pillowtop beds with premium bedding, and private bathrooms. Nearby attractions include Cardiff International Arena, St. David's Hall, and Cardiff Castle. Cardiff International Airport (CWL) is the nearest airport.

19837.description: The Leonardo Hotel offers a prime location in Belfast, just steps from the Grand Opera House and a short walk from Victoria Square and Castlecourt Shopping Centre. A 20-minute stroll takes you to the Titanic Visitor Centre, while Queens University, the Botanical Gardens, and the Ulster Museum are within a 15-minute walk. The hotel features 190 spacious rooms equipped with flat-screen TVs with Freeview, free WiFi, and en-suite bathrooms with complimentary toiletries. Each room comfortably accommodates up to three adults or two adults and two children under twelve. Enjoy relaxing in a bubble bath after a busy day exploring the city. *Full names are required for each room when booking two or more rooms.

19877.description: The The Crown London, WorldHotels Distinctive offers 152 tastefully decorated guest rooms, each providing a contemporary yet homely feel. Guests can choose from a variety of room types, including double, twin (double with a single bed), family, superior, suites, and wheelchair-accessible rooms. Free Wi-Fi is available throughout the hotel. Guests can enjoy breakfast, lunch, and dinner, and access the hotel's leisure facilities. The Crown Pub, a beloved local Irish bar, offers a wide selection of beverages and a diverse bar menu.

name.content: Delta Hotels by Marriott Liverpool City Centre

20056.description: This Liverpool hotel offers 146 guest rooms with flat-screen TVs, pillowtop beds, and premium bedding. Complimentary Wi-Fi and digital programming are available. Private bathrooms include shower/tub combinations, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Enjoy on-site amenities such as a 24-hour fitness center, garden, and The Brew Bar Lounge, serving lunch and dinner. Room service is available during limited hours, and a buffet breakfast is offered weekdays and weekends (for a fee). The hotel also features 6458 sq ft of event space, including nine meeting rooms. Dry cleaning/laundry services and a 24-hour front desk are available. Self-parking is available for a fee. Nearby attractions include St. George's Hall, Liverpool Central Library, and several theaters. John Lennon Airport is approximately 10 miles away.

20058.description: This hotel is situated outside of the centre, right by Newcastle Racecourse. The public transport network is easily reached on foot. Set on 12 acres of parkland near the vibrant city centre and Newcastle International Airport, the hotel offers the ideal setting for short breaks and business travel. The chic lobby leads to spacious, beautifully renovated guest rooms. Exquisite dining awaits at the Park Restaurant, winner of one AA Rosette. It offers a superior conference facility for up to 600, with catering and an executive lounge. The charming rooms include an en suite and are all fully - equipped as standard. The hotel offers its own pool, an indoor pool, a pool bar, a hot tub, a solarium, a steam room, gym and a sauna. Guests are invited at the breakfast buffet. At lunchtime and in the evenings, guests may select dishes from a set menu.

20176.description: Crowne Plaza® Liverpool City Centre hotel overlooks the waterfront in the vibrant centre of Liverpool. Guests can park at the hotel for low daily rates in the onsite car park. Liverpool Lime Street Station is 10 minutes away. A short stroll down the River Mersey takes you to the iconic Royal Albert Dock with its restaurants, bars,  The Beatles Story attraction and Tate Liverpool Art Gallery. When you are done with sightseeing, you can work out in our well-equipped Fitness Centre and relax in our 18-metre swimming pool, spa pool, steam room and sauna. For our corporate guests there is WIFI throughout. The hotel is within walking distance of the Arena and Convention Centre Liverpool and the new Bramley dock stadium as well as a short drive from events at Anfield Stadium home to Liverpool Football Club. Our Crowne Plaza Meetings Director can help you plan anything from a board meeting to a gala dinner for 480. When work is done, you can enjoy cocktails with colleagues in our sleek Lounge Bar with its dock view terrace. Our lounge menu is ideal for guests on the go. But do take time to enjoy the huge buffet breakfast at The Restaurant.  It serves grill-style dinners – ideal for a client entertaining or a romantic meal – and there is 24-hour room service for added convenience.

20184.description: Canon Court Apartments offer stylish 4-star accommodations conveniently located within a mile of Edinburgh's vibrant Princes Street and Waverley Rail Station. A large supermarket is a mere 150 meters away, and the surrounding local shops, restaurants, and bars create a charming village atmosphere. The 41 contemporary apartments, spread across two four-story buildings, are brightly decorated and feature separate living rooms, kitchens, and bathrooms. All apartments offer complimentary Wi-Fi, a 32-inch TV with Freeview channels, a DVD player, a dining area, and a tiled bathroom with a shower/tub combination. Bedrooms can be configured as a double bed or twin beds upon request. A convenient on-site car park is available (chargeable). For stays of 7 days or longer, a complimentary weekly refresh service includes a change of bed linen and towels. Additional services are available for a fee. Local bus services to Princes Street are located directly outside the apartments. Edinburgh International Airport is 8 miles away and easily accessible by shuttle, taxi, or airport bus. The railway and bus station are a 15-minute walk or a 5-minute taxi ride away.

name.content: Premier Inn Glasgow City - George Square

20297.description: It's all go in Glasgow and, at the Premier Inn Hotel Glasgow City George Square, you're just a short stroll from all the sights and sounds. Located in the city's historic heart, you're also well placed for key business destinations like the SECC and Strathclyde University. Cheer on your team at Hampden Park, or shop 'til you drop in Glasgow city centre. Eat, drink and party in trendy Merchant City, or see the stars at the SSE Hydro. And, whether it's work or play, you're just two miles from the huge events at the Scottish Exhibition and Conference Centre. Then recharge in our tasty restaurant and relax in our spacious rooms and extra-comfy beds. All reservations placed at this hotel are subject to Premier Inn’s standard Terms and Conditions, which can be found at premierinn. com

20298.description: The hotel is located in the historical heart of the city, right next door to Haymarket station and only 4 minutes away on foot to Edinburgh International Conference Center. Varied selection of cafes, bars and restaurants are situated next to the hotel. Explore the numerous sights and events of the city such as Edinburgh Castle, Edinburgh Zoo, Murrayfield Stadium and much more. The hotel offers many modern rooms equipped with free Wi-fi. Have a refreshing start to the day with a an abundant Scottish breakfast buffet and enjoy traditional and modern dishes at the restaurant. Modern and well-equipped meeting room venues are available for business meetings.

21800.description: Two minutes from the M9 between Stirling and Edinburgh, this old Manor House has been lovingly transformed into a comfortable modern hotel with all the facilities that the modern day traveller would expect from a luxury four-star residence in the heart of central Scotland. Set in its own 44 acres of ground, the Inchyra Grange hotel is in the ideal location to explore the lands where some of the most pivotal moments in Scotland's rich and vibrant history took place. The Wallace Monument, Stirling Castle, Bannockburn Heritage Centre, Edinburgh Castle and the Falkirk Wheel are a few examples of the attractions that lay just a short drive away. Their 98 rooms are all en-suite and come as standard with WiFi access, satellite television and still/sparkling mineral water, as well as all the regular amenities you would expect from a quality hotel. Superior rooms also offer complimentary fruit bowl, slippers and bathrobes. Newspapers, interconnecting bedrooms and dry cleaning / laundry services are also available on request. With excellent chefs and the finest freshest produce, the Priory Restaurant offers a new flavour of Scottish Cuisine, called OPUS 504. Fine, traditionally prepared Scottish beef and wild, fresh fish are the centre-pieces of their mouth-watering menu, with other Scottish favourites like cullen skink and Stornoway black pudding making a welcome appearance. Please note that the hotel doesn't accept any cash payments

21898.description: Mar Hall is recognized as one of Scotland's top five-star golf and spa resorts. Its secluded woodland setting on the banks of the River Clyde, combined with its proximity to Glasgow Airport, makes it a popular destination for visitors. Guests enjoy first-class golf, a destination spa, luxurious suites, and fine dining, all just twenty minutes from Glasgow's main shopping and business districts. The 18-hole Earl of Mar championship golf course, with spectacular views of the River Clyde and Kilpatrick Hills, is a must for any golf enthusiast. Located within the grounds of the five-star resort, the course is only ten minutes from Glasgow Airport. Directions from the M8: Exit at Erskine Bridge following signs for Bishopton/Erskine. At the first roundabout, turn left towards Bishopton. Continue past HP Compaq, straight through the mini-roundabout, and past Bishopton Parish Church. Turn right at the Gatehouse, following the road into Mar Hall.

22438.description: Located in a prominent position on Shoreditch High Street, One Hundred Shoreditch is an independent hotel and home to 258 bedrooms and suites, five places to eat and drink, plus six meeting and event spaces. Blending modernity with East End charm, this dynamic district, nestled in the heart of Shoreditch, epitomises contemporary city living. From Lobby Lates and Seed Library, to their Eastern Mediterranean rooftop bar & kitchen, Kaso - there is much to see in this iconic contemporary hotel.

22522.description: Make yourself at home in one of the 193 guestrooms. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Royal Mile - 0. 3 km / 0. 2 mi- Edinburgh Vaults - 0. 3 km / 0. 2 mi- Museum of Edinburgh - 0. 4 km / 0. 2 mi- Real Mary King's Close - 0. 5 km / 0. 3 mi- Festival Theatre - 0. 5 km / 0. 3 mi- Parliament House - 0. 5 km / 0. 3 mi- St. Giles' Cathedral - 0. 5 km / 0. 3 mi- City Art Centre - 0. 5 km / 0. 3 mi- Holyrood Park - 0. 6 km / 0. 4 mi- Calton Hill - 0. 6 km / 0. 4 mi- Edinburgh Dungeon - 0. 6 km / 0. 4 mi- Scottish Parliament - 0. 7 km / 0. 4 mi- National Museum of Scotland - 0. 7 km / 0. 4 mi- University of Edinburgh - 0. 7 km / 0. 4 mi- Potterrow Student Centre - 0. 7 km / 0. 4 mi. The preferred airport for Travelodge Edinburgh Central is Edinburgh Airport (EDI) - 13. 2 km / 8. 2 miWith a stay at Travelodge Edinburgh Central, you'll be centrally located in Edinburgh, just a 4-minute walk from Royal Mile and 8 minutes by foot from University of Edinburgh. This hotel is 0. 6 mi (1 km) from Edinburgh Castle and 0. 3 mi (0. 5 km) from St. Giles' Cathedral.

22976.description: Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. You can take advantage of recreational amenities such as a health club, an indoor pool, and a steam room. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and wedding services. Enjoy local cuisine at Laguna Kitchen and Bar, a restaurant where you can enjoy drinks at the bar/lounge and dine alfresco. Or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7 AM to 10 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include express check-in, express check-out, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. Event facilities at this hotel consist of conference space and a meeting room. Make yourself at home in one of the 129 air-conditioned guestrooms. Complimentary wired and wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming provides entertainment.

23283.description: Enjoy garden views at this Oxford bed and breakfast, with amenities such as complimentary Wi-Fi and tour/ticket assistance. A snack bar/deli offers quick bites, and room service is available during limited hours. Continental breakfast is served weekdays and weekends from 8:30 AM to 9:30 AM for a fee. The property also provides dry cleaning/laundry services, luggage storage, and laundry facilities. Free self-parking is available onsite. The 17 guestrooms feature kitchenettes equipped with refrigerators and microwaves, flat-screen TVs with cable programming, complimentary Wi-Fi, desks, and minibars. Housekeeping is provided daily. Located in North Oxford, Marlborough House Hotel is within a 5-minute drive of Port Meadow and the Ashmolean Museum, 2 miles from the Oxford University Museum of Natural History, and 2. 5 miles from Oxford Castle.

23497.description: The 300 welcoming guest rooms offer a perfect place to relax at the end of the day. The establishment's common areas include Wi-Fi internet connection. All guests staying at this property will appreciate the 24-hour reception. Some services may be subject to additional charges.

23520.description:
The hotel is located at the heart of Dublin just 2 km from the nearest beach and 15 km from the airport.

This partly renovated city hotel comprises a total of 20 rooms spread over 4 floors. Amenities on offer to hotel guests include a 24-hour reception, a safe, a currency exchange facility, a lift, a nightclub, a bar and a car park. The air-conditioned restaurant is fitted with a non-smoking area and highchairs for children. A laundry service is also available.

The rooms come with an en suite bathroom, a hairdryer, a telephone, satellite/ cable TV, a radio, Internet access and central heating. All rooms come with carpeting as standard.

Breakfast is available to guests each morning. A breakfast buffet is available every morning. For lunch, guests may select dishes from the set menu. In addition, the hotel caters for guests with special dietary requirements.

name.content: Holiday Inn Express Glasgow City Riverside

23576.description: Located in the heart of Glasgow, the Holiday Inn Express Glasgow City Centre Riverside places you within a 5-minute drive of George Square and Glasgow Cathedral. This hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, a TV in the common area, and a vending machine. The 128 air-conditioned rooms feature flat-screen TVs, complimentary Wi-Fi, and private bathrooms with showers and hair dryers. Desks and electric kettles are also provided, and housekeeping is daily. Enjoy a satisfying meal at the hotel restaurant and unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily. The hotel also provides dry cleaning/laundry services and a 24-hour front desk with multilingual staff. Nearby attractions include Merchant City, St. Enoch Centre, and Glasgow Green. The nearest airport is Glasgow International Airport (GLA).

23841.description: Enjoy stunning views from the terrace and garden of this Victorian hotel in Edinburgh. With complimentary Wi-Fi, iPod docking stations, and flat-screen TVs, our 71 individually decorated guestrooms offer a comfortable retreat. Savor British cuisine at the 1886 Restaurant with garden views and alfresco dining, or enjoy 24-hour room service. Amenities include a bar/lounge, full breakfasts (fee applies), a 24-hour business center, free self-parking, and extensive conference space. Nearby attractions include Braid Hills Golf Course (0. 5 mi), Napier University (1. 2 mi), and The Meadows (2 mi). Edinburgh Airport (EDI) is 10. 4 miles away.

name.content: Holland House Hotel Cardiff By Sunday

23965.description: The Mercure Cardiff Holland House and Spa is a modern 4-star hotel situated in the vibrant capital city of Wales. Holland House is perfectly suited to your business and leisure needs, with the biggest conference facility in Cardiff capable of seating up to 700 guests. The hotel also boasts excellent transport links and is within walking distance of the iconic Millennium Stadium and Cardiff Castle, ideal for sightseeing in the city.

23979.description: 'Nestled within magnificent grounds, the Macdonald Linden Hall Golf and Country Club offers peace and comfort in a beautifully preserved 18th-century manor house. Classically furnished rooms blend traditional comforts such as plush beds with modern amenities like digital televisions. Each room boasts unique character and a spacious en-suite bathroom. Upgrade to an Executive or Feature Room for enhanced space and stunning countryside views. An accessible room is also available. Please note that the Dobson Restaurant is closed on Mondays during the summer months and the hotel operates a cashless payment policy. '

24396.description: This accomodation offers a total of 21 rooms. Wi-Fi internet connection is available on public areas. This hotel offers a 24-hour reception service, so that guests' needs will be fully met at any time of the day or night. A fee may be chargeable for some services.

24656.description: This modern hotel is located on the outskirts of Glasgow. The property is just 8 km away from the centre of the city, where guests will find a number of theatres, the Hydro, the Scottish Exhibition and Conference Centre and a shopping centre. Stirling is just a 25 minutes' driving distance away, providing a gateway to the Highlands of Scotland. This wonderful hotel comprises tastefully-designed guest rooms, which offer a peaceful ambiance, perfectly conducive to work and rest. The hotel's friendly, professional staff strive to meet guests' every need, providing them with a truly relaxing, carefree stay. The hotel comprises conference and meeting rooms, as well as a charming restaurant.

24696.description: Overlooking Hyde Park in prestigious Knightsbridge, The Lanesborough stands as an elegant example of London's Regency architecture. Ideally located near Buckingham Palace, Harrods, and the boutiques of Sloane Street, this landmark hotel offers guests a luxurious experience. Following a meticulous renovation by the world-renowned Alberto Pinto studio, The Lanesborough, now part of the Oetker Collection, features 93 sumptuously decorated rooms and 46 suites. Guests can enjoy elegant dining at Apsleys, set within a beautiful, naturally lit conservatory, or savor a rare cognac in the Library Bar. The Garden Room, London's most luxurious cigar bar, offers an impressive selection of Cuban and pre-Castro cigars.
