The hotel offers guest rooms, suites and apartments suitable for families, executives and leisure travellers. Each room or suite is decorated in soothing neutral tones with a chic, contemporary edge. The adjacent restaurant, the Gallery, specializes in hearty dishes made with local and artisan ingredients, and guests can start the day with a delicious continental or full Irish breakfast. Whether travelling to Belfast on business or for a weekend city break, this hotel is sure to please with its sophisticated rooms and warm, inviting atmosphere.

79621.description: A secret passageway connects the front of this property to Green Park, and within 5 minutes guests can walk to the Green Park underground station, Old Bond Street and Jermyn Street. Opened in 1912, parts of the establishment are almost 400 years old. After major renovation works, the hotel now offers 105 rooms, spread over 6 floors. Facilities include a traditional lounge and a fine-dining restaurant, as well as a distinctive American Bar, popular with royalty and a great spot for a light meal. The hotel is proud of its unique historical courtyard, provided with tables for outdoor dining. The elegant, traditional and quiet rooms each offer an en- suite marble bathroom and are fitted with complimentary wireless Internet access and individually regulated air conditioning and heating.

80431.description: Ideally located close to the stunning Ayrshire coasts, this hotel is immersed in peace and serenity. Located in the historical, picturesque village of Fenwick, this hotel offers visitors close proximity to the many natural and cultural attractions that the area has to offer. The property enjoys close proximity to Glasgow International and Prestwick airports. This wonderful hotel offers comfortable, stylish guest rooms, in which to escape the bustle of daily life. Offering facilities and services to meet the needs of business and leisure travellers, combined with impeccable attention to detail, this hotel is sure to impress.

80673.description: Housed in the 19th-century aristocratic residence of the Baron de Peellaer, this luxurious hotel enjoys an enviable setting in the centre of Bruges. Guests will be impressed by opulent décor featuring crystal chandeliers, brown wooden furniture and cutting-edge amenities to meet needs of even the most discerning visitors. The spacious and sun-lit rooms are fitted with cosy furnishings and plush bed linens, featuring a quintessence of luxury and refined taste. Visitors may treat themselves to ultimate relaxation at the hotel spa or have an invigorating workout at the fitness centre. The signature restaurant offers a rich and flavourful buffet-style breakfast and is sure to enchant patrons with sophisticated décor, exquisite gastronomy and excellent attention to detail. Meeting facilities are also available for those travelling on business purpose.

80786.description: Enjoy recreational amenities such as bicycles for rent, a terrace, and a garden at this Bruges hotel. Stay connected with complimentary Wi-Fi, and enjoy amenities including babysitting services (surcharge) and a cozy lobby fireplace. A coffee shop/cafe and bar/lounge offer dining and drinks. Start your day with a local cuisine breakfast (fee applies). Other conveniences include dry cleaning/laundry services, multilingual staff, luggage storage, and free self-parking. Each of the 31 guestrooms features a flat-screen TV with satellite programming, complimentary Wi-Fi, a private bathroom with shower and complimentary toiletries, a safe, and a desk. Hotel Olympia is located in Bruges' historical district, a short drive from the Bruges Christmas Market and Market Square.

80787.description: This modern, stylish city hotel is located in Tallaght on Whitestown Way, just 9 km from Dublin's city center. Ideal for business and leisure travelers, it's only 3. 5 km from the Arena and 20 km from Dublin Airport. The hotel is a short walk from the Tallaght Luas light rail station and The Square Shopping Centre. The on-site leisure center features a fully equipped gym, a swimming pool with hydro jets, a steam room, a hot tub, an aerobics studio, and a sauna. Rooms are available with comfortable double, queen, or two single beds; some rooms also have balconies and tea/coffee making facilities. Overlooked by the Dublin Mountains, the hotel boasts a two-floor conference center with 10 private rooms, the largest accommodating up to 275 people. The hotel has implemented enhanced sanitation procedures reviewed by Bureau Veritas and is accredited by Green Tourism.

80789.description: The hotel is just a 5-minute walk from the centre of Liverpool. It offers good access to public transport, with Liverpool Lime Street train station just 2 minutes away, and Queen Square bus station 5 minutes away. The Met Quarter and its shopping opportunities and the Walker Art Gallery are also in the immediate vicinity. Penny Lane and the Liverpool Tate Modern can be reached easily on public transport. The hotel is just 16 km from Liverpool Airport, while Manchester Airport is 57 km away. This city hotel, which dates back to 1900, was renovated in 2005. It has 50 rooms in total spread over 3 floors. The hotel offers a lobby with 24-hour reception, a hotel safe, lift access, a TV room as well as bar and limited dining facilities. There are limited parking spaces available (subject to fees). All of the standard rooms are finished in a basic style. They are clean and tidy and come with an en suite bathroom with bath (no shower). Tea and coffee making facilities are provided in the rooms. Individually adjustable heating features as standard. There are no televisions in the rooms. The Resident's Bar serves a wide range of premium brand alcoholic and non-alcoholic drinks. The DugOut Bar, a beer bar/sports bar with a difference, serves a wide range of bottled beers from around the world along with premium alcoholic and non-alcoholic drinks. Entertainment includes wall-to-wall plasma screens, a pool table and a dart board.

81150.description: A warm welcome and traditional hospitality await guests at the Plough and Harrow Hotel in Edgbaston, Birmingham. The red brick Victorian architecture of the original building, along with its large garden, lawns, and ample parking, distinguishes the Plough & Harrow from other Birmingham hotels. Built in 1704 as a wayside inn, the hotel boasts a rich history. It was renowned as one of Birmingham's most popular hotels in the 1980s and early 1990s, even earning the Egon Ronay Hotel of the Year award in 1984. Its restaurant was *the* place to dine, attracting celebrities, politicians, and prominent figures. Following a period of underinvestment and changing ownership, the hotel returned to private hands in 2010 under TTM Partnership LLP. They've embarked on a 10-year phased investment and refurbishment plan, aiming to restore the hotel to its former glory as a high-quality, independent boutique hotel. The owners envision the Plough and Harrow as the preferred choice for corporate and leisure travelers, weddings, local functions, and casual dining. Future plans include expanding the hotel and potentially adding a spa and beauty facility around 2020 or later, after the existing public areas and bedrooms are refurbished.

81231.description: The hotel is located in the heart of the city and linked directly to Birmingham International Convention Centre and Symphony Hall. It is within walking distance of Broad Street and Brindley Place, the city's vibrant nightlife area. The family-friendly residence features deluxe accommodation combining a central location, beneficial for both business and leisure travellers. It comprises a total of 319 guest rooms and guests are invited to make use of a number of in-house facilities and services. They can wine and dine in the two restaurants, one of which is located at the main lobby level under a unique glass-roofed atrium, and the other offers a relaxed atmosphere nestled around Roman pillars and naturalistic surroundings.

name.content: Holiday Inn Luton South M1, JCT.9

82669.description: A modern Luton Airport hotel near the M1 with free parking, a smart restaurant and a poolHoliday Inn® Luton - South hotel offers family-friendly accommodation a 10-minute drive from Luton London Airport (LTN). The hotel's Park, Stay & Go package allows guests to catch flights refreshed, leaving their car in a secure parking lot. For staying guests parking is free, and the nearby M1 makes it easy to get around. Travelling with kids? The lions and elephants of Whipsnade Zoo are just five miles from the hotel, and it’s a 20-minute drive to the Harry Potter tour at Warner Bros. Studios. Milton Keyes, 30 minutes away, draws shoppers with thecentre:mk, a covered mall with over 200 shops plus restaurants and a special events hall. Grand St. Alban's Cathedral, with the longest nave in England, is just eight miles away. Business travelers appreciate the location a short drive from central Luton businesses. You can host anything from a client meeting to a banquet in one of the hotel's five purpose-built rooms. Free Wi-Fi, in-room work desks and a Business Centre will help you stay productive. The skylit pool and spa area is a lovely place to unwind or cool off after a workout in the fully equipped fitness centre. Treat yourself at Borders restaurant with a delicious buffet breakfast and à la carte dinner. Arriving late? There's 24-hour room service. Kids stay and eat free.

82971.description: This historic Georgian townhouse welcomes guests to central Edinburgh, conveniently located near excellent bus services to the city center. Enjoy complimentary off-street parking and a continental breakfast served in your room. The hotel adheres to WTTC guidelines, with disinfected rooms and contactless check-in/check-out. Please contact the hotel for late arrival information and your lockbox code. All bathrooms are either ensuite or private. From this elegant and peaceful setting, explore the vibrant city of Edinburgh, with its unique blend of historical and modern attractions. Edinburgh Castle, the Scottish Museum, Holyrood Palace, Dynamic Earth, the Royal Mile, the University of Edinburgh, the Royal Commonwealth Pool, and golf courses are easily accessible. The hotel offers stunning views of Edinburgh's renowned architecture and beautiful hillsides from every room. Our staff is happy to assist with directions, tour bookings, and local information. Edinburgh has mainline rail connections to London and other parts of Scotland. We are a 20-minute drive from the airport and 5 minutes from Waverley Train Station.

83150.description: Located a short driving distance from London City Airport and only 3 km from Woolwich Ferry, this charming hotel is ideal for those seeking accommodation for a holiday stopover or wanting to explore the vibrant English capital. Travellers can explore the ExCel Exhibition Centre, an international exhibition and conference centre which hosts a variety of interesting events, or visit Upton Park to see the grounds of West Ham Football Club. For shopping fanatics, Galleons Reach Shopping is a dream centre where they can discover over 35 major stores all in one convenient location. Alternatively, if guests are looking for hotels near the world-famous O2 Arena then this is a great option, as the thriving entertainment venue is only 9 km away, making it the perfect place to stay if visitors have tickets for an up-and-coming show. The hotel has a fresh new look and features a new room design complete with Dreamer Bed so travellers can be sure of a great night's sleep. Guests staying at this modern property can take advantage of the café bar and parking facilities, all for a comfortable stay in London.

84242.description: This hotel enjoys a superb location on the South Bank, rubbing shoulders with many of London's most famous attractions such as the Houses of Parliament, Westminster Abbey, London Dungeons and the London Eye. Named ‘Best Family Friendly Hotel' at the HRS Hotel Excellence Awards 2011, the hotel specialises in treating children like VIPs through its Family Fun in the City package. Spacious family rooms include substantial closets and plenty of space to relax and unwind, while Studio Rooms and Penthouse Apartments afford an enhanced feeling of indulgence with defined sleeping and living areas. Additional facilities include a restaurant and a bar where the guests can enjoy a nice meal and a beverage and a modern fitness centre were guests can keep up with their routine.

84356.description: The hotel is centrally located in Bloomsbury, with Euston, Russell Square and King's Cross/St Pancras stations close by. Ideal location to explore attractions around the hotel, the London Zoo, the British Museum, Madame Tussauds and Camden Market are at a short driving distance. This stylish property was recently restored and is housed in a building which dates back to 1906. Italian architect Guiseppe Boscherini has created a fresh, contemporary design to meet the needs of a highly discerning corporate and conference market. The hotel offers 100 rooms spread over 6 floors. Facilities and amenities include conference and banqueting for up to 250 delegates, air-conditioned common areas, a restaurant and Internet. All bedrooms have en-suite facilities with everything that guests will need during the stay.

84456.description: Birmingham offers a wealth of cultural attractions and a fascinating history, as well as fantastic nightlife, and this luxurious apartment hotel puts guests in the heart of it all. Visitors can see the historic Bull Ring market, Victoria Square, and the jewellery quarter, and those with a sweet tooth will not want to miss Cadbury World. The serviced apartments are bright and spacious, each with a fully-equipped kitchen, open-plan lounge and dining area, private bathroom, and one or two bedrooms. Guests can take advantage of the kitchen and complimentary DVD rentals in reception to prepare a wonderful home-cooked meal and have a night in, though the hotel is surrounded by the city's best restaurants, pubs and entertainment venues. The hotel also offers a range of helpful services such as reception, parking and grocery shopping delivery service, all for a productive business trip or delightful city break. Check In: Reception opening hours are 08:30 to 19:00 Monday to Friday, 10:30 to 19:00 on Saturday, closed on Sunday. If you are arriving outside these hours, please contact The Spires reception. Please be aware we require a £250 security deposit before arrival which requires to be paid through our secure on-line payment portal. IMPORTANT** Please contact The Spires reception 48/72hours before your arrival date**

84798.description: Make lasting memories in the Midlands at the Best Western Appleby Park Hotel. Located on the outskirts of Tamworth in Appleby Magna, this hotel is ideal for both business and leisure travelers. Situated just off Junction 11 of the M42, you'll be within easy driving distance of major cities like Birmingham, Loughborough, Derby, and Nottingham. A visit to Cadbury World in Birmingham is a must, only a 45-minute drive away. Closer to the hotel, enjoy family fun at Drayton Manor Theme Park (under 20 minutes) or Twycross Zoo (just four minutes). The hotel offers 88 en-suite rooms, including doubles, twins, interconnecting rooms, and family options. Enjoy a meal at The Park Restaurant, our contemporary bistro, before settling in for the evening.

name.content: Marlin Apartments London Bridge - Empire Square

85077.description: The hotel area is steeped in London history with many sites and museums close by. Some such attractions include the Clink Prison Museum, the London Dungeons, the Tate Modern, Shakespeare's Globe Theatre, the Tower of London, Tower Bridge, Southwark Cathedral and many more. Any discerning wine enthusiasts should feel right at home at Vinopolis, located near to the hotel. Close by is the world-renowned Borough Food market which attracts traders from all over the UK and as far afield as Mainland Europe. This delectable market is a must for food lovers. Heathrow International Airport is 29 km from the hotel, Gatwick International Airport is 47 km away and Stansted Airport is located 57 km from the hotel. This 202 unit apartment-hotel is a new development which encompasses an internal square the size of Piccadilly Circus. Additional benefits include complimentary broadband, lift access, welcome basket and a weekly maid service. Rising from the northern tip of the development is a 22-storey landmark tower, specially designed to make its own distinct architectural statement. Designed by award winning architects, this landmark development presents a new vision of contemporary city living. The hotel features a lobby with WLAN Internet access and a 24-hour concierge operates on site. Many extra services are available on request, such as next day dry cleaning, car parking, childcare, additional maid service, and many more. The site is complimented by landscaped public areas, and facilities for cafes, restaurants and shops.

85081.description: In Runcorn town centre, this The Runmere Hotel is 120 metres from Runcorn Railway Station and 7 minutes' drive from the M56 motorway. The restaurant is a traditional French-style bistro. All rooms have modern decor and satellite TV. The en suite bathrooms have both a bath and a shower. The restaurant serves traditional French and British dishes. The breakfast buffet includes hot items and guests can relax in the bar or on the terrace. The hotel offers outdoor parking and Wi-Fi is available throughout the hotel. Luggage storage and shoe-shining services are available. John Lennon Liverpool International Airport is 15 minutes' drive away and the city centre is 35 minutes from the hotel. The River Mersey and the Runcorn Docks are less than a mile away.

85082.description: This stylish hotel is just 2 km away from Basildon Centre. The property sits proudly at the heart of Essex, within easy access of the city centre of London. The coast at Southend-on-Sea is just a 20 minutes' driving distance away. This property features charming guest rooms, which are bright and tastefully decorated. The rooms are fitted with up-to-date amenities, for guests' convenience. Guests can enjoy a hearty buffet-style breakfast in the mornings, with cooked and continental options. A delectable dining experience can be enjoyed in the elegant surroundings of the restaurant. Perfectly conducive to work and leisure trips, this hotel is sure to impress.

85116.description: This 4-star city centre hotel is one of London's most stylish and is home to the chicest destination restaurant in the area, The Lampery, Seething Lane. Serving everything from beautiful breakfasts and exciting cocktails to decadent dining and more, we know you'll take delight in every bite! Situated near St Paul's Cathedral and Tower Bridge, find yourself fully immersed in all that London has to offer whether travelling for work, play, or taking a trip with the family.

85147.description:
The Hotel Rafiya is a budget hotel with standardised amenities at the best value. It is located in Redditch, providing you with easy access to nearby attractions such as the National SEA LIFE Centre Birmingham and Kingfisher Shopping Centre. The property has free WiFi and parking facility for your convenience. 
This hotel provides everything you need for your stay, including a hair dryer and an electric kettle. You can enjoy a cup of coffee or tea in the morning with breakfast service and TV. This hotel also has a smoke detector for peace of mind. 
This hotel has many amenities to make your stay more comfortable. You will be able to enjoy a designated smoking area for guests, never worry about housekeeping with their daily service, and have a smoke-free environment with smoke detectors in every room. For families traveling with pets, this hotel is perfect for you.

85278.description: Located between Oxford and Henley, this hotel boasts great location near a quiet part of the River Thames. Wallingford's centre is just a 5-minute drive away, while Oxford can be reached in 20 minutes by car. Windsor Castle is 50 minutes' drive away, and Dorchester is less than 10 minutes away from the hotel. Guests can enjoy free parking, and a restaurant and bar. Rooms at the hotel feature a private bathroom with a hairdryer. Some rooms are in the main building, while others are in the hotel's grounds. Some rooms also include river views. The River View Restaurant serves freshly prepared food and has panoramic views over the hotel's grounds and lawns to the Thames. The River Bar serves light meals and snacks and has an outdoor terrace with river views.

85281.description: The voco® Oxford Thames Hotel is nestled on the banks of the River Thames, offering a tranquil Oxfordshire countryside escape with fresh air and open space. Just three miles from historic Oxford, you can explore renowned museums like the Ashmolean, Pitt Rivers, and Bodleian Libraries, as well as the world-famous Oxford University, with its 38 independent colleges, including the magnificent Christ Church. Consider a guided tour of Oxford Castle and Prison, immersing yourself in centuries of history. For a quintessential Oxford experience, try punting down the River Thames. Retail therapy awaits at the Westgate Shopping Centre and the independent shops within the 18th-century covered market. Further afield, explore Bicester Village, a luxury shopping destination with over 160 world-famous brands. No trip to Oxfordshire is complete without a visit to Blenheim Palace, boasting 2, 000 acres of parkland. Family fun abounds at Cotswold Wildlife Park and Crocodiles of the World.

85429.description: This superb hotel is located off the N7 on the Naas Road, next to the Citywest Business campus, just 13. 5 km from Dublin city centre. The hotel offers easy access to the city with a public bus service to the city centre from outside the hotel and the new extension to the red line 'Cheeverstown stop' is a short 15-minute walk from the hotel and will bring guests to Dublin city centre.

85440.description: This superbly located hotel is a short 3-minute walk from O'Connell Street, Dublin's main entertainment and shopping hub, making it ideal for a city break. Easily accessible from Dublin Airport, bus, and train stations, the hotel is just 10. 2 kilometers (around 25 minutes by car) from the airport. The air-conditioned rooms with double-glazed windows ensure a relaxing and comfortable stay amidst the bustling city. Each room is equipped with tea and coffee making facilities, a hairdryer, and a private bathroom with a bath and shower. Furthermore, the hotel has implemented enhanced sanitation procedures, rigorously reviewed by Bureau Veritas, and holds Green Tourism accreditation for its sustainable practices.

85536.description: If you're jetting off to somewhere special, or you just want to pay a flying visit to Dublin, Premier Inn Hotel Dublin Airport is a great place to stay. We're perfect if you've got an early flight, or if you fancy a late night out in Ireland's first city. Whether you're lifting the spirits with a city break, or raising the roof at the Wright Venue, you'll find so much to enjoy. Discover world-class shopping on O'Connell Street, or business-class facilities at the Airside business park. Swords Village is worth a visit too, voted one of Ireland's most pleasant places to live. Then come back for a tasty meal at our restaurant, and a lovely comfy bed. All reservations placed at this hotel are subject to Premier Inn’s standard Terms and Conditions, which can be found at premierinn. com

86087.description: Enjoy garden and terrace views at The Black Swan Hotel, located in the heart of Bruges. Amenities include complimentary Wi-Fi, express check-in/out, multilingual staff, and self-parking (for a fee). Each of the 16 guestrooms features an LED TV, digital programming, and a private bathroom with a shower/tub combination, complimentary toiletries, and a hairdryer. Phones, safes, and desks are also provided. A paid breakfast is available. The hotel is a short walk from Bruges Market Square and the Historic Centre of Brugge, and conveniently close to attractions like the Bruges Christmas Market. The nearest airports are Ostend-Bruges International Airport (OST) and Brussels Airport (BRU).

86183.description: Discover central Scotland from our Falkirk hotel. In a quiet, green area of the town, you're well placed to get out and explore the countryside or zip off to business and leisure destinations in Edinburgh and Glasgow. Host your special event at Glenbervie House. Take a spin at the Falkirk Wheel, the world's only rotating boat lift. Step into Scotland's history at Stirling Castle, or get your boots on and explore the Lowlands. Then plot a course for our fantastic restaurant and a great night's sleep in one of our super comfy new generation bedrooms, with an impressive 40" flat screen TV, freshly-updated bathroom with large shower head, and brand new, slumber-inducing, king-size Hypnos bed. All reservations placed at this hotel are subject to Premier Inn’s standard Terms and Conditions, which can be found at premierinn. com

name.content: Premier Inn London Ilford - Newbury Park

86184.description: A friendly London hotel with excellent transport links, meeting rooms, free Wi-Fi and breakfast includedHoliday Inn Express® London - Newbury Park hotel is 200 metres from the Newbury Park underground station. On-site parking is available for a small daily fee, and direct trains to central London take around half an hour. The nearby M11 and M25 motorways provide easy access to the city and London Stansted Airport (STN), half an hour's drive away. You can drive to London City Airport in 25 minutes. Central London's shops, museums and businesses are only 30 minutes away by Tube. The huge Westfield Stratford City shopping centre is seven miles away, and you can try out the facilities at the Lee Valley Velopark or the London Aquatics Centre in the neighbouring Queen Elizabeth Olympic Park. Book a round of golf at Hainault Forest Golf Club, four miles from the hotel. You can host your clients in the hotel's two naturally lit meeting rooms, complete with free Wi-Fi and space for up to 220 guests. If you're expecting a long day, buffet lunches can be arranged. Set yourself up for the day with an Express Start Breakfast with scrambled eggs, baked beans, sausages and continental items, included in your room rate. Settle down to dinner with friends during the week in the bright, roomy lounge, or enjoy a snack and a pint at the lobby bar.

86280.description: With a stay at The Adamson Hotel in Dunfermline, you'll be within a 15-minute drive of Deep Sea World and Pittencrieff Park. This hotel is 16. 2 mi (26. 1 km) from Edinburgh Zoo and 15. 6 mi (25. 1 km) from Royal Highland Centre. Make use of convenient amenities, which include complimentary wireless Internet access and a picnic area. Featured amenities include luggage storage and laundry facilities. Free self parking is available onsite. At The Adamson Hotel, enjoy a satisfying meal at the restaurant. Need to unwind? Take a break with a tasty beverage at one of the 2 bars/lounges. To-go breakfasts are served on weekdays from 7 AM to 9 AM and on weekends from 7:30 AM to 9:30 AM for a fee. Stay in one of 39 guestrooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless Internet access keeps you connected, and digital programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with bathtubs or showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include desks and coffee/tea makers, and housekeeping is provided daily.

name.content: Radisson Blu Hotel, London Canary Wharf East

86531.description: The Radisson Blu Hotel, London Canary Wharf, part of Edwardian Hotels London, offers a sleek and stylish retreat with a relaxed, boutique atmosphere. Soft lighting, water features, and a riverside terrace provide a welcome escape from the bustling Canary Wharf district. Situated opposite the O2 Arena (accessible via the Underground) and conveniently close to the Excel Centre and London City Airport via the East India DLR station, the hotel boasts a tranquil East River Spa featuring ESPA treatments, a sauna, steam room, and a 24-hour gym. Eight meeting rooms cater to events from 2 to 250 guests. The 169 spacious bedrooms at New Providence Wharf offer rich furnishings, 350-thread-count Egyptian cotton bedding, down pillows, REN toiletries, and Italian marble bathrooms, some with freestanding baths. Guests enjoy free high-speed Wi-Fi, USB charging sockets, and Samsung TVs with 300+ channels. Ten river-view rooms offer stunning Thames vistas. The Scoff & Banter restaurant serves a seasonal modern European menu featuring locally sourced produce. Guest favorites include fish and chips, shepherd's pie, Eton mess, and afternoon tea, complemented by a wide selection of wines and cocktails. A full-sized American pool table adds to the entertainment. Floor-to-ceiling windows provide outstanding Thames views from the dining room and riverside terrace. A valid credit card is required upon arrival.

86799.description: Welcome to the Holiday Inn Express in Hamilton! Our hotel, located close to Hamilton Central Station, offers easy access to Glasgow City. Next to the M74, drive to Glasgow Airport and Edinburgh Airport in under 40 minutes. For sports enthusiasts, the Ravenscraig Sports facility is just a short distance away, offering a range of activities, and Emirates Arena is a world-class venue nearby. Cheer on the football at Celtic Park stadium, just 15 minutes away by car. Nature lovers will enjoy a visit to the nearby Strathclyde Country Park, where they can explore its network of walking and cycling trails while enjoying scenic views of the surrounding area. For families, M&D's Theme Park is a must-visit. This fun-filled park offers a range of exciting rides, attractions, live entertainment, and it’s a 5-minute drive from our Hamilton hotel. We provide comfortable bedrooms for our guests in a variety of room types to meet their needs. Our rooms feature modern amenities such as free Wi-Fi, air conditioning, flat-screen TVs, and coffee/tea-making facilities. Start your day with a delicious breakfast from our Express Start Breakfast Buffet included with your stay and allow our 24-hour front desk staff assist you with anything you need. Business guests can drive to Eurocentral or take advantage of our 3 meeting rooms.

87059.description: Let our Address become yours…Welcome to The Address Connolly in the heart of Dublin City Centre. This Address is the perfect downtown haven if you're visiting Dublin city for business or leisure. This design driven hotel offers an eclectic mix of luxe interiors and traditional design pieces all sourced from and crafted in Ireland. The Address Connolly promises the ultimate 4 star hotel experience full of special touches that surprise and delight. Our location across the road from one of Dublin's primary train stations, Connolly Station, gives you a wide variety of travel options nationwide and across the wider city – but don't worry, if it's in Dublin City Centre, you're just a short walk to everything including some of Dublin's most popular venues, business districts and tourist attractions; 3 Arena, Dublin Convention Centre, Bord Gais Energy Theatre, Aviva Stadium, Croke Park Stadium, IFSC, Dublin Docklands, Dublin Port, Epic Museum, Dublin Zoo – to name but a few!McGettigans Cookhouse is the independently-branded bar and restaurant within the hotel. The Cookhouse provides a casual, diverse and relaxed dining environment serving international cuisine with an extensive cocktail list, craft beers and specially selected wines, where you can join a friend or business colleague for a meal. The food curation focuses on sustainability, seasonality and locality for its inspiration and is open for both lunch and dinner. We look forward to welcoming you to your new Address in Dublin City Centre. This is not just any Address…this is The Address Connolly, an address like no other!

87060.description:
The hotel is located on St. Stephens Green in the heart of Dublin city centre on the doorstep of the cultural, financial and political districts. Grafton Street, the main shopping precinct, is just around the corner where the flavour is both international and local. On Kildare Street, at the side of Brownes, guests will find the Irish Parliament - the Dail, along with the National Art Gallery while the hotel is also close to all the museums and galleries, Trinity College and Temple Bar. Dublin Airport is 15 km away.

The hotel is a stylish, 18th century Georgian townhouse on St. Stephens Green offering 10 rooms and 1 suite alongside personalised service in the heart of one of Europe's most historic and vibrant cities. The hotel is also home to one of Dublin's finest restaurants. It has a 24-hour reception, limited lift service, a bar and a conference room. Publicly available wireless Internet access is available for a fee, as are room and laundry services.

The en suite bedrooms have been individually designed and furnished with a luxurious sense of style with comfort and character in mind. All the bedrooms have been tastefully furnished with carefully chosen fabrics and antique furniture to make the guest feel comfortable, as if they were in their own home. They have the intimacy and character of a privately run townhouse yet each guest's bedroom comes equipped with cable TV, a CD player, Internet access, a telephone and fax lines.

Not only is it an exquisite townhouse hotel, it is also home to the magnificent Brownes Restaurant which evokes all the nostalgia of times gone by. At Brownes Restaurant guests can enjoy some of the finest cuisine available in an upmarket cosmopolitan atmosphere and often in the company of diplomats and famous faces.

Follow directions from the airport for the city centre and then follow signs for Stephens Green. Alternatively take the Aircoach and ask to be dropped off at Stephens Green.

87280.description: Situated on a quiet road just a 3-minute walk from Earl's Court tube station, this hotel offers convenient access to London's attractions. With 24-hour bus routes to Oxford Street, Knightsbridge, Hyde Park, and Kensington High Street, exploring the city is effortless. Heathrow Airport is 21km, Gatwick 47km, and Stansted 63km away. The hotel provides a 24-hour reception with express checkout and complimentary Wi-Fi throughout. Guests can enjoy the air-conditioned lobby and breakfast room. Each fully-equipped room features a kitchenette with a fridge, microwave, and coffee maker, along with a hairdryer, plasma-screen TV with satellite channels, telephone, and ironing facilities.

87611.description: The London House Hotel comprises five interconnected Victorian era buildings to form a 103 room hotel. The air-conditioned large lobby has cream walls, which contrast with the black reception desk and vibrant purple lounge chairs. It features charcoal grey chandeliers hanging from high ceilings, while tall mirrors add sunshine and a sense of spaciousness. All the rooms have been furnished with a blend of style and functionality in mind. Simple painted walls mean rooms feel light, while surfaces feature a dark wood veneer, such as bedheads, shelves and wardrobes. Each room has an en suite shower room tucked behind a white wooden door. Comfortable beds are accessorised with Byzantium purple cushions. The Breakfast Room is located on the lower ground floor, accessed just off the lobby. Dark tan chairs sit against square wooden tables. There is a wall of mirror lined with soft crimson chairs. Like the rest of the hotel, it's a sunny space, with five skylights. We offer a Continental breakfast selection between 7am and 11am as well as a range of services and amenities. This hotel offers excellent value for money in one of the world's most vibrant cities.

87698.description: Take in the views from a garden and make use of amenities such as concierge services and a television in a common area. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour front desk, multilingual staff, and a safe deposit box at the front desk. 87699.description: In the heart of London, in the multicultural and cosmopolitan district of Notting Hill, the Palace Court Hotel offers convenient budget accommodations just 5 minute walk from Hyde Park and the shops and restaurants of Queensway. We are very close to Bayswater and Queensway tube stations, just a few minutes away from Oxford Street and the West End. The Palace Court Hotel operates without a reception desk, with very quick and straight forward check-in and check-out procedures.

88164.description: Enjoy a range of recreational amenities, including a sauna, a 24-hour fitness center, and bicycles to rent. Additional features at this Baroque hotel include complimentary wireless internet access and tour/ticket assistance. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include express check-out. A dry cleaning/laundry service is available on weekdays, upon request and for a fee. Make yourself at home in one of the 37 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and Smart televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms have complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. 88752.description: Enjoy garden views from the terrace at the Coachman Hotel in Glasgow. The hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, a business center, and event spaces. Dine in the onsite restaurant and bar/lounge, with breakfast available for a fee. The 11 guestrooms provide a comfortable home base. Nearby attractions include The Westerwood Golf Course (4. 5 mi) and Palacerigg Country Park (6 mi). Glasgow International Airport (GLA) is 28. 6 mi away.

88875.description:
This hotel is nestled in the peaceful village of Chesterton within easy reach of the M40. It is just minutes from the renowned Bicester Village Retail Outlet and only 16 km from Blenheim Palace. Bicester centre is about a 5-minute drive away. The nearest train station is also about a 5-minute drive away, as are restaurants, bars, nightclubs and shopping facilities. Oxford can be reached in approximately 20 minutes by car and Warwick Castle is a 50-minute drive away. The hotel is 71 km from London Luton Airport, 82 km from Coventry Airport and 83 km from London Heathrow Airport.

Built in 1740, with 22 individually styled bedrooms, this family-friendly hotel blends traditional old-world Cotswold charm with country house comforts. Facilities include a reception hall, restaurant, bar and conference room.

All rooms have their own individual style and decoration. Facilities include en suite bathroom, double or king-size bed, hairdryer, direct dial telephone, TV, radio, iron and board, individually regulated heating and Internet access (fees may apply). In-room tea and coffee making facilities also come as standard.

Guests looking to play golf can make the short walk to Bicester Golf Club, just 10 minutes from the hotel.

A daily breakfast is provided. Lunch and dinner may be ordered à la carte or from a set menu.

From M40, Junction 9. Take the A41 towards Bicester. After 1.6 km or so, there will be a sign post to Chesterton/Wendlebury. Take this turning. The hotel is signposted from this exit. The distance is approximately 1.6 km.

88878.description: Seek out a refuge that’s beyond the norm. Modern, stylish, and distinct, our hotel lets you explore everything Oxford has to offer, just a short stroll away. Whether you’re here to take in the sights, visiting the University of Oxford, exploring landmarks, or kicking back with friends, we’ve got the best of Oxford on our doorstep. Stay minutes from the Bodleian Library, Ashmolean Museum, and Oxford Botanic Garden, and just a 20-minute drive from Bicester Village. You could spend days uncovering everything the city offers, from strolling along the River Thames, to checking out the local shopping and nightlife. When it’s time to recover, visit our spa, with a sauna, steam bath, and host of treatments. The rooms are the best part. Welcoming voco™ touches greet you, like premium bedding and invigorating aerated showers. With airflow cooling and heating, you’ll stay cosy and in control whatever the weather. And for added convenience, guests can enjoy ample on-site parking at the hotel, charged at £20 per car, per day. Wake up to a buffet breakfast, and enjoy all-day dining and drinks from Deacons. If you're hosting a special event, choose from our versatile meeting rooms. They’re perfect for conferences, social events, or weddings. Whatever you’re seeking, we’ll help you find it at voco® Oxford Spires. Come on in.

88879.description: The following services and amenities are available, but with reduced service: Breakfast, On-site Restaurant(s), Room Service. The following services and amenities are currently not available: Fitness Center. Experience a friendly welcome when you arrive at Hilton Garden Inn Abingdon Oxford. Located just 6 miles south of historic Oxford, our modern hotel is nestled in historic Abingdon Town. Visit Abingdon Abbey and Abingdon Bridge, or utilize the excellent local transport links to discover charming Oxford. See the real-life Hogwarts when you visit the iconic Oxford University, or explore Blenheim Palace, the birthplace of Winston Churchill, featuring stunning Capability Brown gardens. After a busy day, relax in your contemporary guest room or suite, featuring an HDTV, mini-fridge and coffee and tea making facilities. Use our complimentary WiFi to stay connected, then get work done at the desk or enjoy room service. When you're ready to rest, drift off to sleep on the comfortable bed. Enjoy delicious all-day dining in our restaurant, featuring a buffet breakfast every morning. Work out in our fitness center, or host a conference or event in one of three meeting rooms.

88885.description: With two magnificent manor houses dating back to the 19th century, Mercure Oxford Hawkwell House blends tradition with contemporary elegance, making it a perfect venue for leisure, business, events, and weddings. Offering 77 Oxford-inspired bedrooms and the option of exclusive use, its grounds provide one of Oxford's most picturesque settings and destination wedding venues, with beautiful gardens ideal for hosting outdoor civil ceremonies. Located in the quaint village of Iffley, nestled within 3 acres of private gardens, just 2 miles from the historic city of Oxford and a stone's throw from the River Thames, Hawkwell House is steeped in history, blending character with contemporary design.

88919.description: Enjoying an ideal location close to the town centre of London, this hotel is perfect for business and leisure travellers visiting London. The property is conveniently situated just a 15 minutes' drive from London Luton Airport. This modern property is surrounded by a number of shopping, dining and entertainment opportunities. Stylish, comfortable guest rooms offer a peaceful setting in which to work and rest. The restaurant offers a wonderful dining experience, with a choice of traditional and international dishes. Business travellers will appreciate the hotel's conference spaces, as well as the helpful, professional event staff.

90017.description: This castle hotel is situated on the south side of Glasgow, in the stunning residential surroundings of Pollokshields. Glasgow International Airport is a 15 minutes' driving distance away. The property is located within easy access of Hampden Stadium, Ibrox Stadium and the Burrell Collection. Beautifully-designed guest rooms come complete with modern conveniences. Guests can enjoy the delectable dishes that the restaurant has to offer. The property also provides conference facilities for the convenience of those travelling for work purposes.

90066.description: Situated between Phoenix Park and Blanchardstown, this award-winning country hotel is just a 15-minute drive from Dublin city centre and 25 minutes from Dublin Airport. Enjoy luxurious bedrooms within its lush grounds, featuring an on-site golf course. Each bright room offers tea/coffee making facilities and a bathroom with underfloor heating, a separate shower, and a bath. The extensive leisure facilities include an 18-hole golf course, a newly renovated Leisure Centre and Spa, and a heated swimming pool with a separate children's pool. With 13 meeting rooms and suites, the hotel can accommodate conference groups of up to 350 delegates.

90239.description: This lovely hotel is situated beside a charming canal in the heart of Bruges, just 100 meters from the nearest public transport stop. A short stroll takes you to numerous restaurants and shops, as well as to bars serving a wide variety of Belgian beers, allowing you to experience the city's unique atmosphere. For those who prefer to stay in, the hotel's cozy bar features a warm fireplace and an extensive drinks menu. The royal breakfast buffet, also served by the fireplace, is complemented by candlelight and classical music, setting a relaxing tone for the day. This charming city hotel comprises 46 guest rooms, along with a series of lounges and reception rooms offering guests flexible space and serene interiors.

90392.description: Hotel Velotel, the 4-star cycling hotel in Bruges! Welcome! Hotel Velotel offers an oasis of tranquility on the edge of the historic city center of Bruges (distance to the main square is 3km). You overlook a beautiful piece of nature, but you are within walking distance of the bustling center of Bruges. Enjoy a short walk or bike ride to the lively city centre and be surprised by the architectural treasures and numerous impressive sights. Hotel Velotel is a real paradise in a green and quiet oasis in Bruges. Everyone is welcome, but Hotel Velotel is certainly a 'Walhalla' for cycling enthusiasts. Want to relax in the evening? This is possible with a nice meal in our restaurant or a typical Belgian beer at the bar.

90482.description: Theatre break? Shopping trip? Business meeting or just seeing the sights? Whatever your reason for heading to the capital, this charming hotel is the perfect base for your adventures. Tucked away in sought-after Kensington it's just a short stroll from the upmarket High Street and a great selection of restaurants and shops. Or you can hop on the tube and be smack bang in the hustle and bustle of London in minutes. You'll find our 54 newly-refurbished bedrooms just the tonic for your stay in the capital – each kitted out with free Wi-Fi, air conditioning, a flat-screen TV with Freeview, full-length mirror and safe.

90658.description: Located in Liverpool city centre, this hotel is only a short walk from both the shopping and business districts. It is just a 5-minute stroll from the waterfront where the popular Albert Dock complex and Liverpool ACC can be found. Liverpool Lime Street train station is some 500 m and from there guests can get to the John Lennon Airport for around 30-minutes. Nestled in the 'Beatles Quarter', this boutique hotel features a sophisticated Beatles theme throughout. The centre piece of all beautifully-appointed rooms is a specially commissioned piece of Beatles artwork, some of which will surely surprise even the most dedicated fans of the band. The hotel also offers 2 restaurants and 2 bars along with 2 function suites and its very own 'Two of Us' wedding chapel for those who decide to make the all important step in this charming venue.

91136.description:
In terms of culture, history and character, few destinations can rival Liverpool. This is the city of The Beatles, the Grand National and the Ferry Cross The Mersey. A historic maritime port, today it’s a cultural powerhouse, home to more museums and galleries than any UK city besides London. So whether you’re visiting to hear live music at The Cavern, to pay pilgrimage at Anfield or Goodison Park football grounds, or to take in a show at the Everyman or Playhouse, you won’t be disappointed. And if you’re wondering which Liverpool hotels will give the warmest of Scouse welcomes, look no further than Leonardo Hotel Liverpool. 

Get your bearings

Liverpool city centre is split into several districts, so the best way to get a sense of the place is to choose where you want to head first. On the waterfront docks, you can explore attractions such as the Tate Liverpool, The Beatles Story and the Museum of Liverpool, while in the Georgian Quarter, you’ll find the city’s two dramatically different cathedrals, as well as the Philharmonic Hall. 

Don’t miss

Shopping is big business in Liverpool, and alongside the RopeWalks district’s mix of independent stores and boutiques you’ll also find the huge Liverpool ONE shopping complex with all the high street’s biggest brands. Just 15 minutes’ walk from there brings you to the Baltic Triangle, the city’s exciting up-and-coming creative quarter, where former factories are being transformed into music venues, bars and co-working spaces. 

While you’re there

You can’t come to Liverpool and not hear live music. As well as the iconic Cavern Club, where The Beatles played some of their earliest gigs, the Cavern Quarter is full of tributes to this melodious city.

91269.description: This 4 star hotel is centrally located in the city centre of Bruges, along a tranquil canal. It is close to the Market Square and right next to the small and picturesque yacht harbor. The spacious rooms offer all modern comforts to ensure that your stay is relaxing and memorable. In the mornings you could enjoy a delicious buffet breakfast in the Orangerie, overlooking the rose garden. The bar is the ideal place to relax and sample different kind of Belgian beers after a day of exploring

91615.description: Less than 0. 5 miles from Paddington Rail Station and Hyde Park, this 4-star hotel offers boutique-style serviced suites in the heart of London. Each suite has free WiFi and a modern kitchenette. The Cleveland Square links modern design with Victorian period features. Each air-conditioned unit features a flat-screen TV, a seating area and luxury private bathroom. Guests can enjoy food self-prepared in the well-equipped kitchenettes, which include a hob, kettle, a fridge, cutlery and crockery. Friendly, multilingual staff are on hand 24-hours a day. There are 4 major London Underground stations within a 10-minute walk of The Cleveland. The West End, Westminster and the South Bank are all within 15 minutes on the Underground. All room categories are located on every floor, including ground floor.

91659.description: The Gore is a charming boutique hotel located in the heart of South Kensington, offering 50 unique bedrooms packed with history. Free WiFi is available. All the rooms at The Gore are individually furnished with hand-picked pieces, period pictures and ornate feature beds. All rooms include a flat-screen TV. The Gore contains the iconic Bar 190, the refined 190 Queen's Gate Restaurant and three bespoke event rooms. Bar 190 offers luxurious yet intimate surroundings where guests can unwind and peruse the extensive cocktail list, while at 190 Queen's Gate the gastronomic proposal combines English culinary tradition with contemporary flavours. Just a short walk from Kensington Palace, Hyde Park, the Natural History Museum, the Science Museum, Victoria and Albert Museum, Harrods and the chic designer boutiques of Knightsbridge. The shopping, theatres, sightseeing and nightlife of the West End are just 10 minutes away by bus or Tube. Kensington and Chelsea is a great choice for travellers interested in museums, parks and culture.

91736.description: This hotel is set overlooking Miramar Beach, in Manzanillo. It lies just a short distance away from a number of shops and restaurants. It also offers a seemingly boundless range of facilities and services, attending to the needs of every type of traveller. Young guests will be pleased by the playground and kids' club. Delightful dining options are just waiting to be enjoyed.

92625.description: Conveniently located a short walk from the Canary Wharf financial hub, this hotel is an ideal base for guests working in the area. The nearest underground station is just 8 minutes on foot from this city-hotel. Guests will find numerous restaurants, bars and shopping facilities right on its doorstep. London Heathrow is the nearest international airport, just 37 km away. The hotel comprises 96 elegant executive apartments, showcasing the best of contemporary design and furnishings. Each apartment offers magnificent views over Canary Wharf, the River Thames and a marina fronted by the O2 Dome. Corporate travellers will find convenience in the hotel's business centre and the Internet access provided. Parking facilities are available for those arriving by car.

93454.description: Fountain Court Apartments - Harris offers 18 one and two-bedroom serviced apartments. They are ideal for up to four people visiting the city for either business or pleasure. Facilities include a 24-hour reception nearby (subject to change), lift access, WiFi access and limited car parking nearby. Parking is chargeable at £15 per night per car and is on a first come first served basis, located at the main check in reception. The apartments offer an open plan lounge/dining area. The fully fitted kitchen comes complete with a dishwasher, fridge, oven, microwave and washing machine. The 2 bedroom apartments come with a double bed and 2 single beds as standard. 2 double beds are available on request. The 1 bedroom apartments have a double bed. All apartments have a bathroom with a shower over bath configuration, hairdryer, selected satellite channels and iron/ironing board. The apartments also have self-controlled heating. The apartments are self-catering, breakfast packs are available to book in advance at an additional fee of £7 per person per night. The breakfast packs are placed in the apartment. Breakfast is not guaranteed for bookings made less than 48 hours prior to arrival. Dogs may be accommodated on request, maximum 2 dogs per apartment (dependant on size). This is chargeable at £15 per dog per night. The apartments shall be serviced every 4 days and additional cleaning can be arranged at an extra charge. Please arrange this directly with Fountain Court. Check in to the apartments is at the main reception located at 121 Grove Street, EH3 8AA. Check in is from 3pm and check out is 10. 30am. Upon arrival, guests must provide the credit/debit card used for the booking. This card will be pre-authorised for GBP 100- 200 for use against any incidental charges, such as damages. Photo ID which matches the name on the card must also be provided. If a guest does not have the card, an alternative payment must be provided and the original card shall be refunded.

93455.description: The apartment hotel is situated in the West End, 2 minutes' walk from the Edinburgh International Conference Centre. Haymarket Station is just across the road and Murrayfield Stadium is a mere 15-minute walk away. The 27 self-catering apartments offer space, flexibility and convenience in the heart of the city, with everything guests may need for a comfortable stay. All units are accessible by lifts and each of them offers a double bedroom and private bathroom. A fully equipped kitchen is provided so that guests can prepare their own meals. A lounge area with Freeview TV, CD player and complimentary WI-FI access serves for entertainment purposes. In each unit guests will find an array of quality appliances, including individually regulated air conditioning units. The apartments shall be serviced every 4 days and additional cleaning can be arranged at an extra charge. Please arrange this directly with Fountain Court.

93756.description: Perfectly located within the tranquil parish of Strathblane near Loch Lomond, this elegant hotel offers a magnificent view over the Campsie Hills. Glengoyne Distillery is only a few minutes away, and Glasgow International Airport can be reached in less than 45 minutes. Nestled beneath the exhilarating backdrop of the rolling Campsie Hills, this Scottish country house hotel dates from 1601 and has retained many of its original features whilst adding up-to-date comforts. Providing a traditional ambience, this 16-room inn is ideal for relaxation or business. The hotel's facilities include a bar and restaurant with highchairs. In the hotel lobby, guests may take advantage of 24-hour reception and check-out services, as well as the currency exchange counter. WLAN Internet access and room and laundry services are provided. Conference facilities are available for business guests, and there is a free car park for guests. Each room has individual characteristics, and some have spectacular views of the Campsie Fells. Standard fittings include an en suite bathroom with a bathtub/shower and a hairdryer. A TV set, radio, hospitality tray, Internet access and a direct dial telephone are further in-room features. Additional amenities include an iron and ironing board, individually regulated heating and a balcony/terrace. The nearest golf course is some 25 minutes' drive from the hotel. A full Scottish breakfast is provided every morning. In the hotel's dining area, guests can enjoy specialities made from fresh Scottish produce.

94003.description: Situated on Lisburn Road, this complex occupies one of Belfast's most south-after addresses. It enjoys spectacular views over the Black Mountains, just a 15 minutes' driving distance away from the centre of the city. George Best Belfast City Airport is 8 km away. This complex features modern, fully-serviced apartments, which are designed in a contemporary style. The apartments offer modern conveniences, including a fully-fitted kitchen, a spacious lounge and a work station, meeting the needs of discerning business and leisure travellers alike. Exemplary amenities ensure that guests enjoy all the comforts of home.

94249.description: Nobody makes it easier to explore Edinburgh than the 4-star Novotel Edinburgh Park hotel, which offers ample car and coach parking and immediate train and tram access. Our 170 stylish rooms include family-friendly options and modern air-conditioning, while our full-service bar and restaurant offer a casual setting for fresh, modern cuisine. After exploring Edinburgh's sights, unwind in our heated indoor pool, whirlpool, sauna or gym, all part of our contemporary leisure centre and free to guests.

94500.description: These apartments are accessible from Byng Street, off Westferry Road. It is approximately a 7-minute walk from the apartments to the heart of Canary Wharf and the Jubilee underground line with fantastic underground and rail links to London's West End and London City. The development is about a 3-minute walk from either South Quay or Heron Quays DLR station. It is also conveniently located near to London City Airport, which is some 33 km away. These apartments comprise the newest development in this sector. Each of the 42 apartments at this apartment hotel has been specially designed with space and convenience in mind and contains all the luxuries of home-away-from-home living. Facilities include easy-to-operate entry phone systems, a reception area and lifts. WLAN Internet access is provided, and there are parking spaces for guests arriving by car (charges apply). These modern apartments include furnished living and dining rooms. Facilities available to guests include a satellite/digital TV, DVD player and free broadband Internet access. Apartments also feature a fully equipped kitchen with a dishwasher, washer/dryer, oven and hob, as well as a fridge and freezer. An iron and ironing board and tea and coffee making facilities are also provided. The bedrooms include a double bed with a walnut headboard, in addition to a telephone and alarm clock. Each apartment comes with a private bathroom with a power shower, heated towel rail, a hairdryer and a shaving socket. Central heating and a balcony/terrace are further standard features. Guests can take advantage of significantly discounted passes to Canary Wharf's premier gym.

94501.description: These luxurious serviced apartments are within easy walking distance of many of London's main attractions, including the Tate Modern, Shakespeare's Globe, St. Paul's Cathedral, and the Royal Exchange. Heathrow Airport is 27 km from the property, Gatwick is 49 km, and both Stansted and Luton are 57 km away. Located in the heart of London's financial center, this premier corporate housing development comprises 90 luxurious serviced apartments, including six studios ideal for short and long-term corporate rentals. The stylishly designed contemporary apartments are furnished to the highest standards, emphasizing quality and space. Their central location and sophisticated style are perfect for the discerning corporate traveler. The building features a lobby with 24-hour reception and check-out service, and lift access to all floors. One of the City's most architecturally significant buildings, this unique development boasts bold design, sash windows, and contemporary materials, making these apartments the perfect base for business and leisure guests. Its convenient setting provides unmatched access to some of London's most important financial and civic buildings. Each apartment includes a private bathroom with a shower, bathtub, and hairdryer, along with a fully equipped kitchen featuring a fridge, cooker, microwave, and tea and coffee making facilities. Guests also enjoy a king-size bed, direct dial telephone, satellite TV, radio, internet access, a washing machine, an ironing set, and central heating. For stays of two nights or longer, a welcome hamper with food and drinks is provided.

94931.description: Conveniently situated in the Jesmond district of Jesmond, Kensington House by Warren Collection is located 1 km from Northumbria University, 1. 7 km from Theatre Royal and 1. 7 km from St James' Park. All rooms feature a kitchen and a private bathroom. Private parking can be arranged at an extra charge. Featuring free WiFi, the units have a washing machine and a flat-screen TV. Newcastle Train Station is 2. 7 km from the apartment, while Sage Gateshead is 3 km away. The nearest airport is Newcastle International Airport, 11 km from Kensington House by Warren Collection.

95616.description: This attractive hotel is set in a beautifully restored, 19th-century Masonic School in Sandymount, Dublin's embassy belt and business district. The Sandymount train station is only a five-minute walk from the hotel, bringing guests quickly and easily to the city centre, and the RDS Arena is right next door. The building's preserved original features give it a unique charm, and the Thomas Prior Hall, originally the drill hall, makes an exceptional venue for business and social events. Guests might take advantage of the work desk and free Wi-Fi to get some work done in the elegantly furnished guest rooms, or rest soundly thanks to the hypoallergenic pillows and double-glazed windows. The hotel's Brasserie Restaurant and carvery offer hearty, satisfying meals while the Atrium lounge bar and Tom's Bar offer drinks, light snacks and delicious international dishes, all for a high-powered business trip or pleasant holiday in Dublin. Hotel has implemented a full range of enhanced sanitisation procedures and new practices which have been rigorously reviewed by Bureau Veritas, a trusted, independent global leader in tested, inspections and certification. Hotel has been accredited by Green Tourism, a certification program that provides a framework to achieve a sustainable business in the tourism industry.

95617.description: This hotel is located about 8 km south of Dublin city centre. The Sandyford LUAS tram station is just a short walk away, while Aircoach links the hotel with Dublin International Airport, which is 36 km away. Leopardstown racecourse is just a short walk away, and Dundrum Shopping Centre can be reached in 15 minutes by car. This fully air-conditioned hotel offers modern simplicity with a traditional twist. It offers a restaurant, a bar and a café. Other amenities include meeting rooms and WiFi in public areas. The spacious and superbly appointed en suite rooms feature satellite TV, safe and tea and coffee making facilities. Complimentary Internet access is available and the heating may be individually regulated. The hotel offers an Irish breakfast and an excellent carvery lunch featuring a wide selection of daily specialties, delicious salads and freshly made sandwiches. Hotel has implemented a full range of enhanced sanitisation procedures and new practices which have been rigorously reviewed by Bureau Veritas, a trusted, independent global leader in tested, inspections and certification. Hotel has been accredited by Green Tourism, a certification program that provides a framework to achieve a sustainable business in the tourism industry.

95618.description: This elegant hotel is perched amidst extensive verdant surroundings, situated at Dublin's gateway to Ireland, junction 9 on the M50 motorway on the Naas Road (N7) allowing travellers to easily reach Dublin. Avid golfers may find extensive and verdant golf courses within a 10-minute walk and just a short drive from Aviva Stadium. This modern, fully air-conditioned property greets visitors in the spacious lobby, offering a warm and friendly atmosphere in which to feel at ease whether travelling for business or leisure. The rooms feature ample and luminous surroundings fitted with commodious furniture, crisp-white bedding and cutting-edge amenities to guarantee a fully enjoyable stay. The in-house restaurant offers mouth-watering dishes for breakfast and dinner, which might be followed by a cup of delicious coffee or a refreshing drink from the welcoming bar. Corporate travellers may take advantage of functional event rooms and those travelling by car may take advantage of the private parking. Hotel has implemented a full range of enhanced sanitisation procedures and new practices which have been rigorously reviewed by Bureau Veritas, a trusted, independent global leader in tested, inspections and certification. Hotel has been accredited by Green Tourism, a certification program that provides a framework to achieve a sustainable business in the tourism industry.

95619.description: This newly refurbished Clayton Hotel Dublin Airport enjoys a strategic location near the M1/M50 interchange, just 4 kilometers from Dublin Airport. A complimentary 24-hour shuttle service provides easy access to the airport. Guests can also enjoy free Wi-Fi throughout the hotel and a private underground car park with 1, 500 spaces. The hotel has implemented enhanced sanitation procedures, rigorously reviewed by Bureau Veritas. The soundproofed rooms feature hypoallergenic pillows and duck-down duvets, along with flat-screen TVs, ensuite bathrooms with luxury toiletries, tea/coffee facilities, work desks, and ironing supplies. Four distinct dining areas cater to various tastes, complemented by a 24-hour coffee dock serving fresh ground coffee and snacks. Breakfast, including a traditional Irish option, is served from 6:00 am. A carvery lunch featuring fresh, seasonal produce is available daily, while the à la carte dinner menu is served from 3:00 pm, and a bar menu is offered until 10:00 pm. Guests can maintain their fitness routines in the on-site gym, equipped with treadmills, exercise bikes, a rowing machine, free weights, and more. The hotel also offers a fully equipped conference facility and 15 meeting rooms. The coastal villages of Malahide and Howth are a short drive away, and Dublin city center, with attractions like Dublin Castle and the Guinness Storehouse, is easily accessible within 20 minutes by car. The hotel is also accredited by Green Tourism, demonstrating its commitment to sustainability.

95853.description: KM Hotel, located next door to KM Apartments, offers modern accommodation in an enviable location that sits between Edinburgh’s historic Old Town and lively Southside. A stone’s throw from the Royal Mile and Waverley Train Station, guests can easily explore Edinburgh and enjoy the local neighbourhood. The vibrant Southside combines charming Victorian architecture and leafy public squares with a bustling array of independent, vintage and eco-friendly shops, brilliant budget-friendly cafes and restaurants, as well as a whole host of entertainment and events venues. Only a couple of minutes’ walk away is Arthur’s Seat, Edinburgh’s number one free attraction, where you can climb 250m above the city for stunning panoramic views and the perfect Instagram moment. You also have free access to The University of Edinburgh’s award-winning Pleasance Sports Complex with its modern gym facilities.

96534.description: This hotel is located 3. 5 km from Dublin city centre and within walking distance of the Dublin City University and the Helix complex. It is just off the M50 and the M1 for easy access to destinations north or south of the city. The leisure traveller will find the most beautiful coastline and beaches in the country, at Malahide and Howth, just a short drive away. This hotel is just 5 minutes' drive from Dublin Airport. This contemporary city residence opened in 2006 and offers 125 spacious rooms designed to meet the needs of today's budget-conscious families and corporate guests. The reception desk is manned around the clock providing travellers with convenient flexibility and useful information. The breakfast room features modern décor and can seat up to 60 people in an open-plan setting.

97114.description: On an exclusive Victorian street in Ballsbridge, this hotel is nestled in the heart of Dublin city centre's most sophisticated quarter. This outstanding boutique property is located 10 minutes' walk from Grafton Street, St. Stephen's Green, the Aviva Stadium, the O2 and the RDS, and is in the epicentre of Dublin's happening cultural scene. This hotel features a sharp eye for detail and a dashing knack for stylish indulgence. Its prime situation just off Baggot Street in Dublin's south city centre makes it the ideal choice to discover all the stunning region has to offer. This upmarket establishment provides a choice of individually designed guest rooms that will delight even the most discerning visitors, equipped with the latest technology and offering a stylish décor. The award-winning restaurant and cocktail bar serves upmarket bistro cuisine with the finest Irish produce, all for a unique stay in Ireland.

97576.description: An elegant hotel, ideally located for both Business and LeisureWelcome to Crowne Plaza London Gatwick Airport Hotel. We are located just 5 minutes drive from LGW Airport and less than 1 mile from Crawley Manor Royal Business District, home to many multinational companies such as Thales, Elekta, and the Boeing Flight Simulator. The Gatwick Express offers a direct rail link to London in just 30 minutes and regular trains from Three Bridges and Crawley, just under 2 miles from the hotel, also offer links to London and Brighton. Our comfortable bedrooms have free Wi-Fi, USB chargers and satellite TV and the Sleep Advantage® programme offers premium bedding and quiet zones so you will not be disturbed. The Cube Restaurant serves delicious locally sourced food for breakfast and dinner and drinks and light meals are available all day in the trendy Bar 92. When you are off duty, relax and enjoy cocktails with your colleagues on the heated outdoor terrace, enjoy our 24 hour Fitness suite. Our chic meeting spaces include private boardrooms and a gorgeous event suite with a foyer and a bar, so you can host receptions or dinners for up to 200 guests or 280 guests for meetings. Your Crowne Plaza Meetings Director can help take care of all the details.

name.content: Great Hallingbury Manor, BW Signature Collec

97661.description: This eco-friendly hotel is beautifully situated amidst the splendour and appeal of the English countryside. The property is located within easy access of Hatfield Forest and Flitch Way. Links to the public transport network can be found just 1 km away, in the town of Takeley. Restaurants, bars and nightlife opportunities are just 5 km from the property, in Bishops Stortford. Stansted Airport is conveniently located 3 km from the hotel. This classical, Tudor-style mansion is set amidst its own private parkland, which features a natural lake. Guests can dine in style in the restaurant, or enjoy a more relaxed meal in the lounge.  Standard double and single rooms are located in our Annexe across the road, Hallingbury House. All patrons of these rooms are welcome to enjoy all the benefits of the main building and its facilities.

98112.description: It's hard to imagine a more convenient spot than the Premier Inn Hotel Glasgow City Centre South. You're just up the road from two of Scotland's biggest football teams. And, if you don't get your kicks on the pitch, you'll find all the nightlife, city centre attractions and businesses just a saunter away. See 'The Beautiful Game' at Celtic Park or Ibrox. Or people watch and window-shop your way along Argyle Street. Make great music your goal at the Hydro, then come back and kick off your shoes and relax with some fabulous food at our restaurant. Then take a dive into a lovely comfy bed. All reservations placed at this hotel are subject to Premier Inn’s standard Terms and Conditions, which can be found at premierinn. com

98207.description: Indulge in a visit to the spa, offering massages, body treatments, and facials. Recreational amenities include a hot tub, sauna, and fitness center. This hotel also features complimentary Wi-Fi, wedding services, and a lobby fireplace. Enjoy modern European cuisine at The Ivy restaurant, overlooking the garden, or take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are available daily (7:00 AM to 10:00 AM) for a fee. Business amenities include a business center, complimentary newspapers, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Event facilities consist of a conference center and meeting rooms. Free self-parking is available. The hotel offers 145 guestrooms with complimentary Wi-Fi, private bathrooms (separate bathtubs and showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers), safes, and desks. Housekeeping is provided daily. Nearby attractions include Blanchardstown Shopping Centre (5. 7 mi), Carton House Golf Club (5. 9 mi), Maynooth University (5. 9 mi), and Dublin Airport (16. 4 mi).

98281.description: This city hotel is located in the centre of Cardiff, close to a number of bars, restaurants, shops and the Principality Stadium. It lies just 500 metres from the central railway station and 4. 8 km from the M4 motorway. Cardiff International Airport is 26 km from the accommodation, whilst Bristol International Airport is some 84 km away. This hotel offers a cool, boutique style and quite spectacular views over Cardiff city. The 60-room hotel enjoys a city centre location and features facilities including 24-hour reception and check-out service, hotel safe, cloakroom and lift access. Guests will find a lounge bar serving refreshments, as well as 2 conference rooms and wireless Internet access in all bedrooms and public areas. Guests arriving by car can leave their vehicles in nearby car park at reduced rates (fees apply). The hotel comprises cool and contemporary bedrooms with individually regulated air conditioning and heating, quadruple glazing, high-speed Internet access and a direct dial telephone. The rooms feature spacious en suite bathrooms with power showers and also come with flat-screen TV, a laptop safe, hairdryer, tea and coffee making facilities. Please contact the hotel prior to arrival with regards to room requests and additional information on 02920 550750 or email reception@theroyalhotel. uk. com.

98421.description: Enjoy your stay at Kings Park Hotel in Glasgow, conveniently located a 5-minute drive from Hampden Park and 10 minutes from the OVO Hydro. This hotel offers 26 comfortable guestrooms, complimentary Wi-Fi, and wedding services. Savor a meal at the on-site restaurant and unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. A business center, 24-hour front desk, and luggage storage are also available. Event facilities include conference space and a meeting room. Free self-parking is provided. Nearby attractions include Glasgow Green, Emirates Arena, and Queen's Park. Glasgow International Airport (GLA) is approximately 17. 6 km away.

98733.description: Enjoy stunning views from the terrace at Astors Belgravia, a centrally located London hotel. Start your day with a complimentary continental breakfast, served from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM. Stay connected with complimentary Wi-Fi and enjoy the convenience of concierge services, a 24-hour front desk, and luggage storage. Relax in one of the 47 air-conditioned rooms, each equipped with a flat-screen TV, safe, and desk. The hotel is within a 15-minute walk of Buckingham Palace and Victoria Station, and a short distance from Sloane Square and Harrods.

99040.description: Novotel Brugge Centrum is a newly renovated hotel and offers a contemporary, relaxed atmosphere in Bruges city centre, ideal for families and business travellers. Easily accessible by train and with a car park nearby, our 4-star hotel is the perfect base for exploring the Venice of the North on foot. Enjoy tasty dishes in our modern restaurant or a cheerful moment at the bar. In fine weather, our heated outdoor swimming pool awaits.

100038.description: A welcoming Redditch hotel with free parking and breakfast includedHoliday Inn® Express Birmingham - Redditch hotel places you in the town centre within easy reach of the M42 motorway. Steps from the hotel, Redditch Station offers direct trains to Birmingham New Street Station. Catching your flight is a breeze, with Birmingham Airport (BHX) just 30 minutes away by car. Business guests can host meetings for up to 50 delegates in our 2 naturally lit conference rooms. Within a 30-minute drive, you can sink your teeth into chocolate production at Cadbury World, or explore England's grisly history in the medieval dungeon of Warwick Castle. In Stratford-upon-Avon, also an easy drive away, visitors can view the half-timbered house where William Shakespeare was born, and see productions of his plays at the Royal Shakespeare Theatre. At this hotel you can enjoy:- Free Wi-Fi- Complimentary on-site parking- Business CentreThe Express Start™ Breakfast buffet included in the room rate features sausages and scrambled eggs, as well as continental items. After a busy day, settle down to a satisfying evening meal in the smart restaurant, or enjoy a glass of wine or a pint in the bar. Comfy guest rooms come with handy bedside USB ports to keep your devices charged, and a choice of pillows for a restful stay.

name.content: Holiday Inn Express Strathclyde Park M74 JCT 5

100043.description: Clean, COVID-secure and recently refurbished Holiday Inn Express® Strathclyde Park M74, Jct. 5. The hotel is dog-friendly and features ample free car-parking and breakfast included. Holiday Inn Express® Strathclyde Park M74, Jct. 5 hotel sits at the edge of the beautiful and dynamic Strathclyde Country Park. Up the road, Motherwell offers regular rail services to London.
