Our iconic architecture boasts unparalleled views and sets the stage for an unforgettable stay. Whether you're unwinding in our award-winning Spa at St. David's, indulging in exquisite dining at Tir a Môr, or simply relaxing on your private balcony, every moment is infused with luxury and relaxation. Venture beyond our doors and explore the vibrant city of Cardiff or the serene countryside, both a short distance away. Stroll along the waterfront promenade, take a leisurely boat ride, or simply immerse yourself in the beauty of our surroundings. For those seeking relaxation, our spa beckons with rejuvenating treatments and luxurious amenities, including hydro and swimming pools. But voco St. David's Cardiff is more than just a retreat; it's also a premier destination for events and celebrations. With eight contemporary event spaces boasting breathtaking views of Cardiff Bay, our hotel provides the perfect backdrop for weddings, conferences, and more. Located near major transport links and just a stone's throw from the city centre and the renowned Principality Stadium. Whether you're here for business or pleasure, our hotel promises an unforgettable experience from the moment you arrive. So come on in, make yourself at home, and let voco St. David's Cardiff be your gateway to the best of Wales.

113617.description: Based in a typical Anglo-Norman style building, which merges perfectly with the charming style of the city, this enchanting hotel is centrally located, just a few minutes' walk from Bruges' ancient market square and a 2-minute walk from 't Zand Square. Guests will fall in love with this beautiful city where they can go for a boat trip on the picturesque canals, taste some local specialities in the restaurants and visit the famous Belfry tower. The hotel presents a modern colonial interior design, offering a charming atmosphere where guests will feel right at home. Room facilities include parquet flooring, a flat-screen TV for guests' entertainment and Wi-Fi access is available throughout the building. Family rooms as well as a special kid's corner with a range of activities and games are available for those travelling with children. Guests who want to keep their gym routine may take advantage of the hotel's fitness room and relax by taking a dip into the sparkling indoor pool.

113868.description: Take in the views from a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access and wedding services. Additional features at this hotel include a fireplace in the lobby, a picnic area, and a banquet hall. Satisfy your appetite for lunch or dinner at the hotel's restaurant, DuVall's Restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Full breakfasts are served on weekdays from 7:00 AM to 9:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary newspapers in the lobby, a 24-hour front desk, and multilingual staff. Event facilities at this hotel consist of conference space and meeting rooms. Free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 87 individually decorated guestrooms. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and digital programming is available for your entertainment. Bathrooms have shower/tub combinations and hair dryers.

114513.description: Located near Gatwick Airport, this hotel offers 218 guestrooms with LCD TVs, digital programming, and private bathrooms. Enjoy amenities like a fitness center, garden, restaurant, bar/lounge, and room service. Business travelers appreciate the 24-hour business center and meeting rooms. Complimentary Wi-Fi is available in common areas, while in-room Wi-Fi is available for a surcharge. Buffet breakfast is offered daily (fee applies). The hotel provides a convenient airport shuttle (surcharge) and on-site parking (fee applies). Nearby attractions include Manor Royal Business Park and Gatwick Aviation Museum.

114913.description: The Ramada London Stansted Airport, built in 2009, is conveniently located near motorway junction 8 off the M11, just four miles from Stansted Airport. This hotel offers free Wi-Fi, complimentary newspapers, and digital Freeview flat-screen TVs with over 60 channels in each of its executive and interconnecting family rooms. Guests can enjoy a full English breakfast (for a fee) and 24-hour reception service. On-site amenities include a cash machine and adjacent petrol forecourt and food court. Parking is available for £5 per night. All rooms feature triple-glazed windows, walk-in wet rooms with power showers, coffeemakers, and Hypnos deluxe beds. Taxis are available upon request. Cambridge City is 14 miles away, London Docklands a 25-minute drive, and Olympic Park a 20-minute drive. Please note that pets are not allowed.

114914.description: This hotel, conveniently located a short taxi ride from London Stansted Airport, offers a variety of rooms, including executive rooms and rooms with laptop safes. All rooms feature flat-screen TVs with 60+ digital Freeview channels and free Wi-Fi is available throughout the property. Guests can also take advantage of on-site parking, 24-hour reception, and pet-friendly accommodations (fee applies). Additional amenities include hot drinks and snacks available for purchase at reception, a free newspaper, and a cash machine.

name.content: Southcrest Manor Hotel BW Signature Collection

114993.description: Built in 1921, this former manor house offers 63 stylish bedrooms, each featuring modern decor and contemporary conveniences. Guests enjoy complimentary access to a fully equipped fitness suite, outdoor hydrotherapy hot tub, and Swedish & infrared saunas. The elegant Laura Ashley-designed restaurant and bar, inspired by the hotel's stunning surroundings, provides a uniquely British setting for special occasions. The menu offers a range of delicious dishes, including the popular Sunday roast, along with an exciting cocktail menu and an extensive wine list. In the charming Laura Ashley Tea Room, guests can enjoy a delightful afternoon tea experience, featuring homemade sandwiches, fresh scones, beautiful cakes, and a selection of teas, catering to all dietary requirements. The Elemis-approved Manor Health & Beauty Club offers a unisex range of luxury products and treatments. The hotel also caters to a variety of events, from interviews and conferences to private dinners and weddings, with a range of meeting rooms and outdoor spaces.

114996.description: Our Edinburgh Haymarket hotel is located in Edinburgh's elegant West End, perfect for those wanting a quiet base within touching distance of everything the Scottish capital has to offer. And we're just around the corner from the train station. Set in a listed Georgian building, it's great whether you're in town for the Festival, Edinburgh Castle, world-class shopping and restaurants or just want to soak up the vast history and culture of this majestic city. All rooms feature a comfy king size bed with four plump pillows and a cosy duvet. Our on-site restaurant and bar serves breakfast and tasty evening meals.

115210.description: Staybridge Suites Liverpool offers comfortable fully-equipped studio and one-bedroom suites in the Royal Albert Docks area of Liverpool. Liverpool Lime Street Station is a twenty-minute walk, with Moorfields and Central Stations both just ten minutes away. The M62 motorway is a twenty-minute drive and Liverpool John Lennon Airport (LPL) is 25 minutes by taxi. Work delegates can make use of our 14-capacity Den Meeting Room and have 24-hour access to the business centre's copying and scanning services, as well as complimentary Wi-Fi. During your stay, workout in our 24/7 Fitness Centre, stock up on provisions from The Pantry, and why not join us for our Staybridge Social events, where you can enjoy a drink and bite to eat on us three times a week. Explore Liverpool from our centrally located hotel. You can find us right opposite the M&S Bank Arena and our hotel is part of the iconic Royal Albert Docks. Enjoy all that our city has to offer during your stay with us including the famous Wheel of Liverpool, The Beatles Story museum, the Tate Liverpool and a great selection of bars and shopping right on our doorstep.

115211.description: Staybridge Suites® Newcastle offers relaxing, home-like apartment-style accommodation with all the comforts of home, whether you’re staying for a night, a weekend or for an extended business trip. Features include spacious suites with living spaces & fully fitted kitchens, 85 on-site parking spaces, complimentary Wi-Fi, fitness studio, laundry facilities and a 24/7 reception and Pantry. All guests can enjoy our complimentary breakfast buffet with English breakfast and continental choices and mid-week evening socials with drinks and nibbles included, excludes Bank Holidays. Located just a short walk from Millennium Bridge, Staybridge Suites Newcastle is perfectly positioned for those who want to explore the sights and nightlife of the city. Newcastle Central Station is a twenty-minute walk and the nearest Metro Station, Manors, can be found 5 minutes up the road. The A167 motorway is easily accessible as well as the A1. The nearest airport, Newcastle International Airport is 20 minutes by taxi. Delegates can book our 14-capacity, boardroom style, Den Meeting Room and have 24-hour access to the Business Centre's services, including click-share, as well as complimentary Wi-Fi. Newcastle has a fantastic choice of bars and restaurants that can be found along the Quayside. Music fans are a six-minute drive from the Utilitia Arena, a 15-minute walk from the waterfront concert venue, Sage Gateshead, and the Baltic Centre for Contemporary Art.

name.content: The Royale Chulan Hyde Park Hotel London

115212.description: Enjoy convenient amenities at The Royale Chulan Hyde Park, including complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and a reception hall. Room service is available during limited hours. The hotel also offers a 24-hour front desk, luggage storage, and an elevator. Self-parking is available onsite (subject to charges). The 52 guestrooms feature kitchenettes equipped with refrigerators and stovetops, flat-screen televisions with digital programming, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Desks and electric kettles are also provided, and housekeeping is offered daily. Located in London's City Centre, the hotel is within a 10-minute walk of Kensington Gardens and Portobello Road Market, and a short distance from Kensington Palace and Hyde Park.

name.content: Four Points Flex by Sheraton Cardiff

115214.description: Make use of convenient amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access, a fireplace in the lobby, and tour/ticket assistance. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant or snacks in the coffee shop/cafe. The hotel also offers room service (during limited hours). Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are served on weekdays from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM and on weekends from 8:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include express check-out, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Make yourself at home in one of the 95 air-conditioned guestrooms. Complimentary wireless internet access is available to keep you connected. Private bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include desks and coffee/tea makers, as well as phones with free local calls. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Cardiff Tourist Information Centre - 0. 2 km / 0 .

115413.description: Ideally located next to the Excel Centre, only 40 minutes to Central London by public transport, 20 minutes from the O2 Arena by public transport and 20 minutes by car. London City Airport is just 1 mile away. Conveniently located for Prince Regent DLR station. Our London Docklands (Excel) Premier Inn has everything you'd expect, incredibly comfy beds in every room and an integrated restaurant serving a mix of traditional and contemporary dishes. All reservations placed at this hotel are subject to Premier Inn’s standard Terms and Conditions, which can be found at premierinn. com

115613.description: The Bermondsey Square Hotel is located in the heart of Bermondsey, London. This 90-room hotel is designed to meet the needs of discerning guests, from business travellers to party people, to those simply looking to relax and enjoy the local attractions. Bermondsey is one of London's most happening areas, with great galleries, boutiques, bars and restaurants, all within a stone's throw of the City Centre, the London Eye, Shakespeare's Globe and TATE Modern amongst other attractions. With a thriving restaurant, bar and clubs, art galleries, design studios and boutique shops are located just a short distance from the hotel as well as main attractions like the Design Museum, Borough Market, Tate Modern and Tower Bridge, the Bermondsey Square Hotel is the ideal place to stay.

115655.description: Enjoy modern comfort and convenience at Future Inns Cardiff Bay. Located near the Wales Millennium Centre, this hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, an on-site restaurant and bar, and room service during limited hours. Start your day with an English breakfast (fee applies), or grab a bite at Thomas Restaurant. Host your next event in our spacious conference facilities, and unwind in one of our 197 air-conditioned rooms featuring flat-screen TVs and private bathrooms. Free self-parking is available. We're a short drive from Cardiff International Airport (CWL).

name.content: Holiday Inn Express London Heathrow T5

115835.description: The comfortable, 300-bedroom Holiday Inn Express London - Heathrow Terminal 5 is conveniently located a short 10-minute drive from the terminal. With an included Express Start Breakfast and ample on-site parking (fee applies), we offer everything you need for a great stay, whether for business or leisure. The hotel provides easy access to numerous local companies and business parks, including Balfour Beatty, Travelport, DHL, and Royal Mail. Slough Trading Estate, home to many global headquarters, is only 5 miles away. Just minutes from the M25, M40, and M4, and situated outside the newly extended ULEZ zone, the hotel offers convenient links throughout Greater London. Direct trains from nearby Slough station can whisk you to London Paddington in just 20 minutes. The hotel's seven well-equipped meeting rooms can host up to 120 guests, with packages available for all events, from day delegate and all-inclusive rates to room hire, residential conferences, private dinners, and social celebrations. For leisure travelers, Windsor Castle and Windsor Racecourse are a short drive away. Families with children will find the Holiday Inn Express T5 a perfect base for visiting Legoland® Windsor Resort. Relax and enjoy a meal and a drink in our Great Room Restaurant and Bar after a busy day.

115927.description: This welcoming hotel is situated in a peaceful area of Knowsley, on the outskirts of Liverpool. The hotel is just a short driving distance away from Liverpool John Lennon Airport. Many attractions can be found in the area. This attractive hotel welcomes visitors with the promise of a comfortable stay. The guest rooms are relaxing and peaceful, offering a welcome escape from the bustle of daily life. The property offers conference facilities for the convenience of business travellers. Attentive service, warm hospitality and the utmost in comfort and convenience combine to make this property the perfect choice for every type of traveller.

115943.description: This family-friendly hotel is located just steps from the historic town centre and the Concertgebouw (concert hall). Guests will find a range of restaurants and shopping venues within 500 m of the accommodation. Public transport links via rail can be found just 100 m away and Brussels Airport lies some 100 km from the hotel. A large and varied cold buffet breakfast is served. There is a safe underground carpark. Further fittings include internet corner in the lounge and WiFi in the rooms. The comfortable and tastefully furnished units come equipped with a private bathroom with a bathtub, shower and hairdryer. Further in-room amenities include cable TV, radio and a safe. Furthermore, all rooms are centrally heated. A buffet-style breakfast is served at this hotel.

116233.description: Indulge in a visit to the hotel spa, offering massages, body treatments, and facials. Maintain your fitness routine at the health club or unwind in the sauna. Bicycle rentals are also available. This hotel provides complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and a hair salon. Enjoy a meal at Le Mystique restaurant and bar/lounge or order 24-hour room service. Full breakfasts are available daily for a fee (8:00 AM to 11:00 AM). Business amenities include a business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. A roundtrip airport shuttle is available for a surcharge (24 hours), and limited onsite parking is provided. Each of the 27 individually decorated guest rooms features an iPad, a flat-screen television with satellite programming, complimentary Wi-Fi, a safe, a desk, and a phone with free local calls. Bathrooms include designer toiletries and hair dryers. The hotel is conveniently located near Bruges City Theater, the Friet Museum, and the Historium. The preferred airport is Brussels Airport (BRU).

116234.description: Hotel Dukes’ Palace is a 5-star superior hotel located in a unique 15th-century former ducal palace in Bruges, just 280 meters from the Markt. Dukes' Palace Brugge combines classically elegant décor with luxurious 5-star amenities. The hotel features 135 rooms across three wings. The main building’s castle wing offers Deluxe rooms and suites with high ceilings. Our Heritage Junior suites, Heritage suites and the Mary of Burgundy suite, blend sumptuous comfort with preserved historical details. The abbey wing accommodate our standard 'superior' rooms, while the Pavilion building, situated within the hotel's 3000 m² private garden, presents 21 modern rooms and 3 unique suites providing a contemporary contrast to the historic surroundings. Guests can unwind at Bar Julien, which offers a casual and comfortable setting for drinks and tapas, or enjoy refined Belgian cuisine at Restaurant Julien, where the menu highlights seasonal ingredients. Relax in ‘The Spa’ (additional fee) with sauna, bio sauna, UV and infrared cabins, salt wall and fitness room. The hotel offers private, secured on-site parking, accessible to guests for an additional fee.

116235.description: This cosy, family-friendly hotel is situated in the heart of Bruges, in the shade of magnificent mature trees. The market square is just a 2-minute walk from the hotel and guests will find a range of restaurants, bars and shopping venues close by. Brussels Airport lies some 80 km from the accommodation. Comprising comfortable rooms, this charming hotel welcomes guests into a lobby. All of the rooms radiate a warm and cosy atmosphere, with French oak panelling and romantic shades of colour.

116236.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as a fitness center or take in the view from a terrace and a garden. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, tour/ticket assistance, and a vending machine. Take advantage of the hotel's room service (during limited hours). Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Continental breakfasts are available daily from 7:30 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a computer station, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 46 individually decorated guestrooms, featuring refrigerators and minibars. Flat-screen televisions with satellite programming provide entertainment, while complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected. Private bathrooms with bathtubs feature designer toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include desks and coffee/tea makers, and housekeeping is provided daily.

117155.description: Take in the views from a terrace and a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access. Enjoy a satisfying meal at Dinner serving guests of Celtic International Hotel Cardiff Airport. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Cooked-to-order breakfasts are served on weekends from 7:30 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and multilingual staff. Free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 50 individually decorated guestrooms. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and digital programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with bathtubs or showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as desks and coffee/tea makers. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Porthkerry Country Park - 2. 2 km / 1. 3 mi- Penmark Castle - 3 km / 1.

117653.description: Enjoy modern conveniences like complimentary Wi-Fi, gift shops, and even wedding services at this Dublin hotel. Additional amenities include a TV lounge, tour/ticket assistance, and a ballroom. A convenient area shuttle (surcharge) simplifies travel. The hotel offers dining options ranging from a restaurant to a coffee shop/café, plus room service during limited hours. Unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. Full breakfasts are available for a fee on weekdays (6:30 AM - 9:00 AM) and weekends (7:30 AM - 11:00 AM). Business travelers appreciate the 24-hour business center, express check-out, and complimentary newspapers. With 10, 000 square feet of event space, including a conference center and 12 meeting rooms, it's ideal for conferences and events. Free self-parking is available. The 273 guest rooms feature flat-screen TVs with satellite programming, complimentary Wi-Fi, and bathrooms with bathtubs/showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Coffee/tea makers and desks provide added convenience. Nearby attractions include Park West Business Park (4. 7 km), Citywest Convention Centre (4. 7 km), and The Square Tallaght (4. 9 km). Dublin Airport (DUB) is 23. 7 km away.

118123.description: This hotel enjoys a peaceful setting in Bruges. The hotel is situated close to the city's main shopping street, lying just a 3 minutes' walking distance from Market Square. Guests will find a range of bars, restaurants and nightlife venues just metres away. Links to the public transport network are easily accessible from the hotel. This wonderful hotel occupies a stunning, former Flemish mansion. The hotel enjoys a charming design, beautifully incorporating traditional and classical elements. The guest rooms are beautifully designed, exuding refined elegance. IMPORTANT INFORMATION:- Check-in at Hotel Dukes' Palace (Prinsenhof 8 in Bruges), afterwards you will be accompanied to your room at Hotel Prinsenhof. - Breakfast is served at Hotel Dukes' Palace. - As a guest of Hotel Prinsenhof, all facilities of Hotel Dukes' Palace can be used (bar, restaurant, spa, fitness, . . . ) during your stay. - Check-out at Hotel Dukes' Palace (Prinsenhof 8 in Bruges), possibility to leave luggage in the luggage room.

118560.description: Get away from it all at the Premier Inn Hotel Glasgow (Paisley). If you're looking to escape the great British weather, we're ideally located for Glasgow Airport. Or if you just want to escape the hustle and bustle, the tranquility of Loch Lomond is only a short drive away. Listen in at the Glasgow World Pipe Band championships or head out on the slopes at Snow Factor. Snap up the bargains at intu Braehead Shopping Centre or get down to Linwood Leisure Centre. Then come back for some tasty food at our Brewers Fayre restaurant and a great sleep in a comfy bed. All reservations placed at this hotel are subject to Premier Inn’s standard Terms and Conditions, which can be found at premierinn. com

119165.description: Once a wealthy cotton merchant's home, Liverpool Aigburth Hotel, Sure Hotel Collection by Best Western exudes period charm and sophistication. The hotel overlooks the magnificent green oasis of Sefton Park – with its tranquil boating lake, classical statues and restored Palm House – yet is only 2 miles from the buzzing restaurants, culture and nightlife of Liverpool city center. You'll be spoilt for choice for things to do in this vibrant, cosmopolitan city, whether you're sipping cocktails in a swanky bar on Albert Dock, shopping for designer clothes at Liverpool One or following in the legendary footsteps of The Beatles. You don't even have to step far from the hotel to find activities. Go for a morning stroll or jog around Sefton Park, or enjoy a drink in one of the bohemian pubs and restaurants of the Lark Lane district. For business travellers to the city, we offer free parking, superfast Wi-Fi and a restful night's sleep in one of our 41 cosy bedrooms. All our rooms have comfortable mattresses, crisp white linen sheets and plump pillows, as well as high-end toiletries and 24-hour room service. Some of our more luxurious rooms boast large Edwardian windows and four-poster beds draped in delicate fabrics. Away from your room, there are several guest lounges and a conservatory restaurant where you can relax and catch up with the day's events.

name.content: Best Western Premier Suites Hotel Spa Liverpool-Kn

119816.description: This 4 star hotel is located within the city of Liverpool and was established in 2000. It is a short drive away from the Safari Park. The Hotel has a restaurant, a bar, an indoor swimming pool and a fitness centre/gym. All 96 suites are equipped with hairdryer, safe, iron, ironing board and trouser press.

119974.description: Hope Street Hotel is an independent 4 star boutique hotel. 149 rooms are divided between Standards, Deluxes, Studios and Suites all with a city chic style. The hotel has two restaurants – The London Carriage Works (TLCW) and 1931. TLCW is an award-winning restaurant with a focus on fresh, seasonal and local produce and 1931 serves delicious hand-stretched pizzas, pasta and sharing boards. Our gorgeous new spa opened in 2021. Access to the award-winning Hope Street Hotel Spa, including swimming pool, outdoor vitality pool, saunas and steam room is available to hotel residents at a discounted rate of £45 per person Monday to Thursday and £55 per person Friday to Sunday. Advance booking is recommended. Over 18s only.

120120.description: Enjoy recreation amenities such as a fitness center or take in the view from a terrace. Additional features at this Georgian hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, wedding services, and a banquet hall. Satisfy your appetite for lunch or dinner at the hotel's restaurant, 144 on the Hill, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. Full breakfasts are served on weekdays from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM and on weekends from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include express check-in, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Event facilities at this hotel consist of a conference center and meeting rooms. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 142 air-conditioned rooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access is available to keep you connected.

120121.description: Housed in an elegant eighteenth-century building at the top of Richmond Hill, this hotel is an excellent option for visiting Surrey and London's West End. To the right of the venue is Richmond Terrace, where they can enjoy magnificent views across the Thames valley that has for centuries been an inspiration for poets and painters. To the left are the 2, 500 acres of Richmond Royal Park, home to herds of red and fallow deer. This soothing and tranquil surrounding is the perfect place for a relaxed stay. Guests can treat themselves to a visit to the Health and Leisure club where an indoor swimming pool and 6-metre spa pool awaits. There is also a modern gym equipped with both cardio and free weights equipment and for the perfect recovery they can unwind in the spa afterwards. The restaurant is the perfect choice for a delicious, proper sit-down meal with friends and family.

name.content: PERM CLOSED POCOTEL GLASGOW CITY CENTRE

120126.description:
This hotel enjoys an enviable situation in the heart of Glasgow, within easy reach of top attractions such as Buchanan Street, the Gallery of Modern Art and the Lighthouse, making it the ideal base to mix business with pleasure. It is 150 m from the centre, from bars, restaurants, shops and nightspots. The hotel is located within walking distance of Glasgow business district, Queen Street and Central Station and is provides easy road access to the main M8 motorway. St Enoch shopping centre is around 800 m and the Scottish Exhibition and Conference Centre is 1.8 km away.

This hotel comprises a total of 100 comfortable, colourful and stylish guest rooms (including business-friendly rooms, family rooms and suites) and features award-winning dining options. The hotel is ideal for business travellers and holidaymakers alike and its interior features a stunning waterfall and fireplace. Facilities on offer to guests at this air-conditioned establishment include a lobby area, lift access, a cafe, a bar and a restaurant. Business travellers will appreciate the conference facilities and WLAN Internet access and guests can also take advantage of the 24-hour room service.

The hotel offers beautifully-appointed, colourful, modern guest rooms, business-friendly and family rooms as well as suites. All rooms come with a private bathroom with a shower and a hairdryer and offer a king-size bed. They are equipped with a direct dial telephone, satellite TV, a radio, a hifi and Internet access. Furthermore, tea and coffee making facilities, an ironing set and heating are provided in all accommodation as standard. All rooms and suites are non-smoking and rooms for disabled guests are available upon request.

This hotel features an award-winning restaurant. Guests can select their continental breakfast from a buffet and the evening meal is available à la carte or in set menu form.

120134.description: Harrington Hall is centrally located beside St Stephens Green and Grafton Street with its own private car park. Family owned and run this private hotel was meticulously refurbished in 1998 retaining most of its original features. Once the home of Dublin's Lord Mayor, this four star property offers a warm friendly atmosphere with impeccable standards of service and accommodation.

120135.description: Butlers Townhouse; a 20 bedroomed boutique townhouse which offers luxury and style, in an intimate and beautifully elegant setting. Located in the heart of Ballsbridge, Dublin 4 directly opposite the Aviva Stadium – situated on the corner of Lansdowne Road and Shelbourne Road, a 5 minute walk from the DART Station, a 15 minute walk from RDS, a 25 minute walk from the 3 Arena and a 15 minutes walk from the Grand Canal Theatre. You have every amenity you need on your doorstep, and every luxury you can imagine on the other side of that door at Butlers. In 1995, the then owners set about the task of restoring a derelict building in the heart of Ballsbridge Dublin 4 to its former glory as an exclusive property. After almost two years of extensive renovations, the result was Butlers Town House, one of Dublin's finest small luxury townhouses. The previous owners played a crucial part in the re-design and reconstruction of the building. Affirming the atmosphere of a private home, the 20 uniquely designed bedrooms offer the guest a unique taste of Victorian life. The lavish Drawing Room, with its coved ceiling, delicate decor and oversized chairs create a ‘Private Club' atmosphere, whilst the Conservatory Restaurant offers a gourmet breakfast daily. Every last detail was considered, designed and decorated to the highest standard; to conjure up a stunning, unforgettable, beautifully elegant property. The current owners and management have taken special care to keeping with the old, and so honouring the history, whilst maintaining the renowned style and elegance. We aim to continually provide our guests with the best boutique townhouse experience. Our philosophy, steeped in tradition and distinction, is to serve as one would like to be served. This philosophy extends to every detail, not least the selection of a devoted staff, who endeavour to please the most discerning of guests, and all with a genuine Butlers smile.

120161.description: This family-friendly city hotel is ideally situated in Hammersmith. The property is located just a 5 minutes' walking distance away from Hammersmith tube station. Offering the ideal base from which to explore the sights of London, the property is within easy access of the West End, the Lyric Theatres and the River Thames. The Olympia and Earls Court exhibition centres are also located nearby. London's Heathrow Airport is just 18 km away. This property comprises tastefully-designed guest rooms. The property offers a range of facilities and services, catering for the needs of business and leisure travellers alike.

120174.description: Enjoy a stay at Hotel du Vin & Bistro Edinburgh, an eco-certified hotel nestled in Edinburgh's historic Old Town, just steps from the University of Edinburgh and a short walk from Edinburgh Castle. This charming hotel offers 47 air-conditioned rooms, each equipped with a flat-screen television, complimentary Wi-Fi, and a coffee/tea maker. Bathrooms include complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Guests can enjoy French cuisine at the on-site Bistro du Vin, 24-hour room service, and a relaxing drink at the bar/lounge. A full breakfast is available for a fee. Additional amenities include concierge and wedding services, dry cleaning/laundry services, and luggage storage. The hotel is conveniently located near major attractions, including the Royal Mile and Princes Street.

120175.description: Nestled in the heart of Edinburgh, overlooking Princes Street and Edinburgh Castle, these luxurious apartments offer excellent destination for all those looking for peace and comfort. Positioned in the heart of Edinburgh's city centre, Princes Street Suites is located at Waterloo Place and only a two minute walk from Harvey Nichols and St. Andrews Square and a short stroll from Waverley Station. This elegant property includes 3-bedroom, 2-bedroom and studio apartments. Ideal for short or long stays in Edinburgh, each chic, sophisticated apartment has a kitchen, a bathroom and a lounge area with a TV and DVD player. The rooftop terrace has stunning panoramic views of the city and is a great place to enjoy the annual Edinburgh International Festival Fireworks, held each August in Princes Street Gardens. The complex boasts an award-wining spa, where patrons may balance body and soul.

120418.description: Situated in the midst of the lively area of Soho, this property is surrounded by elegant shopping opportunities and theatres. Oxford Street, Bond Street and Liberty's Department Store can be found just a short distance away. This elegant hotel offers a luxurious haven for travellers who are eager to explore everything that this vibrant capital has to offer. Style and tradition combine at this property, to create a sophisticated setting in which to unwind. Classically-styled guest rooms offer the utmost in luxury. A luxurious spa offers visitors an escape, in which to indulge in the ultimate rejuvenation. Sumptuous dishes can be enjoyed in the upmarket restaurant. The property also features a cinema and a stunning rooftop terrace, where guests can admire the spectacular views over the city.

120913.description: The conveniently located Maldron Hotel Dublin Airport offers a relaxing setting for travelers before or after their flight. Recently refurbished, the hotel provides a complimentary 24-hour airport shuttle, free Wi-Fi, on-site parking, and air-conditioned rooms. Dining options include the Red Bean Roastery and the Grain & Grill Restaurant. A variety of rooms, from twin and double to family and interconnecting, cater to diverse needs. The hotel holds accreditation from Green Tourism, reflecting its commitment to sustainability, and has received certification from Bureau Veritas for its enhanced sanitization procedures.

120964.description: Tucked away on Copthall Avenue, this 4-star boutique hotel sits in the heart of London's old city. The Clayton Hotel London Wall offers a variety of stylish rooms and suites with free Wi-Fi, a modern gym, and convenient access to everything the city has to offer. Each room includes a flat-screen TV, super king-size beds, and a luxurious en suite bathroom with Antipodes organic toiletries. Make yourself at home with the Nespresso coffee machine and Bowers & Wilkins wireless Bluetooth speaker. Some rooms also feature private balconies overlooking the city (subject to availability). Cots and highchairs are available upon request. For dining, the Clayton Bar & Restaurant serves delicious dishes in an art deco setting. If you prefer to explore the local culinary scene, Old Spitalfields Market and the vibrant Shoreditch district are less than a mile away. The hotel boasts excellent transport links, with three tube stations and Liverpool Street Station nearby, providing easy access to Westminster, the West End, and beyond. You'll also find yourself surrounded by some of London's greatest attractions, including St. Paul's Cathedral and the iconic London Bridge.

121006.description: Enjoy modern comfort and convenience at the Radisson Blu Hotel Cardiff. Located near Cardiff International Arena, this hotel offers 215 guest rooms with Smart TVs, complimentary Wi-Fi, and private bathrooms. Amenities include a 24-hour business center, express check-in/out, and an onsite bar/lounge, Tafarn Bar & Kitchen, serving dinner and offering 24-hour room service. Buffet breakfast is available for a fee. For events, the hotel boasts over 4, 000 square feet of meeting space. Self-parking is available (charges apply). Nearby attractions include St. David's Hall, Cardiff Castle, and Principality Stadium. Cardiff International Airport (CWL) is the closest airport.

121059.description: Reborn and redesigned, this impressive hotel is the choice of interesting people the world over. Visitors will immerse in an imaginary world, no longer the past, not quite the future. Located in Dublin's leafy Northside suburbs, this enchanting establishment is a stone's throw from a city bursting with life, energy and vitality, history and history in the making. With turrets, tapestries and an ancient history, the thick castle walls conceal a hotel interior and spacious rooms and suites offering unmatched luxury and utmost comfort to make guests' stay as enjoyable and memorable. The ancient castle walls hold firm the traditions of Ireland combined with the best dining, beautiful natural scenery and exceptional facilities such as the fitness room and welcoming bars. Visitors may rest, daydream or play. Visitors will find here the serenity in the security of the castle, underpinned by impeccable standards of service and attention to detail.

121306.description:
The hotel is located just 1.7 km from Junction 4 of the M6, 4.8 km from the NEC/Birmingham International Airport and it is just a 17-minute train ride to Birmingham City Centre from Coleshill Parkway. The other closest airports include West Midlands International (about 33 km), East Midlands (53 km), London Luton (130 km), Ringway International (139 km) and Liverpool John Lennon (163 km).

This hotel is small and cosy enough to have all the friendliness of a traditional country establishment, but big enough to offer great food, wine and comfort. Whether staying for business or pleasure, a really warm welcome awaits every guest. The modern bar and restaurant serves a variety of tasty meals and the two function rooms are ideal for weddings and conferences. The hotel is non-smoking throughout. There are 23 rooms available in total and guests are welcomed in the lobby. Internet access and a car park are also available.

Each of the bedrooms offers an individual character, split between the main building and the Georgian annexe, Ferndale House, which is directly across the road. Facilities and services include a telephone, daily housekeeping, a TV and tea and coffee making facilities. All are en suite with a shower and bathtub. A double bed, radio, Internet access and an ironing set also come as standard.

The bar and restaurant offer seasonal menus, with a wide selection of modern and traditional British favourites, from the  all morning breakfast' to hearty main courses and lighter snacks, complimented by real ale, carefully selected wine, and speciality teas and coffees. During the summer months these may also be enjoyed on the heated terrace.

121310.description:
The hotel is an ideal base for exploring the beautiful Oxfordshire and Cotswolds regions. The university city of Oxford is within easy reach for excellent shopping. The closest airports include London Heathrow (about 96 km), West Midlands International (102 km), Birmingham International (115 km), London Luton (122 km), Bristol (124 km), London Gatwick (150 km) and Heathrow (164 km).

The name of the hotel has rather an unusual origin. In days gone by, wealthy farming gentry sent their offspring to be educated in Oxford and would arrive there complete with their horses and hunting dogs. The colleges allowed their students to stable horses but not the dogs! With nowhere else to house the animals, the proprietor of the local inn offered an invaluable 'dog sitting' service and as such the hotel received its name. In recent times, it has still been requested that they provide a dog sitting service. The hotel is non-smoking throughout. There are 20 rooms in total at this historical hotel, where guests are welcomed in the lobby. Guests can enjoy a drink at bar and dine in the restaurant. Internet access and a car park are also available.

The rooms each include a telephone, daily housekeeping service, a TV, en suite bathroom with a shower and bath, and tea and coffee making facilities. A double bed, radio, Internet access and an ironing set also come as standard.

The hotel is close to Frilford Health Golf Club and is perfect for a relaxing golfing break.

The restaurant specialises in good simple English food. The bar also serves delicious meals, together with traditional ales.

By car: From M4 junction 13 onto A34, travel on A34 north. Take the Marcham Interchange exit and turn left at the roundabout onto the A415 towards Marcham/Witney. Take the first right towards Shippon, Dalton Barracks and Frilford, and travel about 4.9 km. The hotel will be on the right-hand side of the road.

121396.description: This hotel is situated in the heart of England and set within 17 acres of stunning manicured gardens and rugged woodland. Featuring an idyllic location, the establishment is nestled between the charming towns of Warwick, Leamington Spa, Stratford-upon-Avon and Kenilworth, and is within easy reach of all neighbouring motorways and main roads. Restaurants, bars and pubs are some 25 minutes' walk away, and nightspots and shopping venues are to be found in Leamington Spa, which is some 10 minutes away by car. Leamington Spa's railway station is about a 15-minute car ride from the hotel, and Birmingham International Airport is approximately 20 km away from the establishment. This hotel is steeped in history with the original house dating back to 1902 when it was a family home. With its stone entrance, red roofed turrets and black and white panelling guests are beckoned into the hotel with a warm and friendly welcome as soon as they walk through the doors. In addition to a reception area with 24-hour reception and check-out services, a hotel safe, currency exchange facilities, cloakroom and lift access, amenities available to guests at this 205-room, family-friendly rural house include a bar, restaurant, conference facilities and public Internet access. Room and laundry services are provided and there is a bike hire service on site. Guests arriving by car may park their vehicles in the hotel car park free of charge. The hotel bedrooms feature a contemporary feel in addition to plush surroundings. They are beautifully appointed with every modern convenience and comfort (including LCD screen televisions and private bathrooms with a bathtub/power shower and a hairdryer). Further in-room amenities include a direct dial telephone, radio, Internet access and tea and coffee making facilities. Furthermore, double beds and an iron and ironing board also feature as standard, along with central heating and a safety deposit box.

121614.description: Set amidst the beautiful, rural location on Forest Row, this hotel is steeped in peace and serenity. Close by, guests will find Royal Ashdown Forest, the home of Winnie the Pool. Many attractions can be found nearby, including the Bluebell Steam Railway and Sheffield Park Garden, where 5 lakes and 120 acres of grounds offer a haven of relaxation. Royal Tunbridge Wells and Brighton can also be found nearby. This hotel is set in a charming, 17th-century country house. Rich in old-world charm, the hotel features oak beams and open fires. The guest rooms retain an element of rustic elegance, combined with contemporary convenience. A wide range of exemplary facilities and services are available, ensuring a memorable stay for every type of traveller.

121616.description: This wonderful property is situated close to the centre of Dunstable Downs. The property boasts spectacular views over the Vale of Aylesbury, enjoying close proximity to the London Gliding Club, Whipsnade Zoo and Dunstable Golf Club. Bletchley Park and the Enigma code de-cypher centre are also located nearby. St Albans, with its Roman ruins of Verulamium and the Cathedral, can be found just a 20 minutes' driving distance away. This charming property comprises stylish, traditional guest rooms. Guests can enjoy a traditional dining experience in the relaxing surroundings of the restaurant, followed by a refreshing ale in the bar.

121822.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as a fitness center or take in the view from a terrace and a garden. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access and wedding services. Enjoy Regional cuisine at Sequoias Restaurant, one of the hotel's 2 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Need to unwind? Take a break with a tasty beverage at one of the 3 bars/lounges. Full breakfasts are available daily from 7 AM to 10 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour front desk, luggage storage, and a safe deposit box at the front desk. Free self parking is available onsite. Stay in one of 37 guestrooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and digital programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks.

122041.description: With a stay at Mama Shelter London - Shoreditch in London (Shoreditch), you'll be within a 15-minute walk of Columbia Road Flower Market and Victoria Park. This upscale hotel is 1 mi (1. 5 km) from Brick Lane and 1. 6 mi (2. 5 km) from Old Spitalfields Market. Enjoy a range of recreational amenities, including a fitness center, karaoke, and bicycles to rent. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and an arcade/game room. Stay in one of 194 guestrooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access is available to keep you connected. Private bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant or snacks in the hotel's coffee shop/cafe. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. English breakfasts are served on weekdays from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM and on weekends from 8:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour front desk, multilingual staff, and luggage storage. This hotel has 3 meeting rooms available for events. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Columbia Road Flower Market - 0. 7 km / 0. 4 mi- Victoria Park - 0. 8 km / 0. 5 mi- Brick Lane - 1. 2 km / 0. 7 mi- Old Spitalfields Market - 2. 2 km / 1. 3 mi- Liverpool Street - 2. 5 km / 1. 5 mi- The Gherkin - 2. 8 km / 1. 8 mi- Barbican Arts Centre - 3 km / 1. 9 mi- Sky Garden - 3. 3 km / 2.

122082.description: Located in the heart of Bruges' historic center, Monsieur Ernest is a charming hotel just a short walk from the Bruges Christmas Market and Market Square. The hotel offers 28 guestrooms equipped with flat-screen TVs, complimentary wired and wireless internet access, and private bathrooms. Guests can enjoy amenities such as a terrace, garden, bar/lounge, and room service (limited hours). Continental breakfast is available (fee applies). Additional services include express check-in/check-out, dry cleaning/laundry, and airport shuttle (surcharge). Self-parking is available onsite (subject to charges).

122133.description: In the very centre of Belfast, this Ibis hotel offers modern rooms with satellite TV, 5 minutes' walk away from Belfast's nightlife and bars. Parking is available at the property. All rooms in the hotel are fitted with a flat-screen TV, WiFi access, tea/coffee making facilities and a private bathroom with a shower . The rooms also include air conditioning and a desk. Belfast's main shops can all be reached within a 10-minute walk. Castle Court Shopping Centre is just a 2-minute walk, and Belfast Cathedral is 10 minutes away on foot. The Grand Opera House is 500 metres from the hotel.

122134.description: Beyond the bedrooms, ibis Belfast Queens Quarter ticks off everything you need in an affordable hotel: Pet friendly, an on-site restaurant for daytime snacks and evening à la carte, a welcoming, 24hr lobby bar for enjoying a nightcap or two (we suggest indulging in a t asty local gin and getting competitive over a board game), and an unlimited, hearty breakfast spread every single morning. And it's all topped off with the warmest welcome from our friendly hotel staff.

122358.description: Located in the heart of London, this aparthotel is within walking distance of the city's most famous attractions and financial district, as well as a variety of restaurants and bars nestled in traditional cobbled courtyards. The vibrant Shoreditch and Brick Lane area is just moments away, and Aldgate and Aldgate East tube stations are easily accessible, providing service to the Hammersmith and City, Circle, District, and Metropolitan lines. London City Airport is approximately 8 km away, and Heathrow Airport is about 32 km from the property. Built in 2009, this impressive aparthotel comprises two towers housing 100 new luxury serviced apartments. A spacious 24-hour reception area offers concierge and check-out services. Free Wi-Fi is available throughout the property, and lift access is provided. The stylish apartments feature fully-fitted kitchens equipped with a fridge, cooker, microwave, and tea and coffee making facilities. Elegant en suite bathrooms include a power shower, bath, hairdryer, and complimentary designer toiletries. Apartment interiors are expertly designed with superior soft furnishings and cutting-edge technology. Additional amenities include a double bed, direct dial telephone, TV, radio, ironing set, and central heating. Complimentary internet access, towels, and linens are also provided.

122614.description: Centrally located in Glasgow, Kimpton Blythswood Square Hotel, an IHG Hotel is within a 15-minute walk of George Square and Gallery of Modern Art. This luxury hotel is 1. 2 mi (1. 9 km) from Glasgow Cathedral and 1. 3 mi (2. 1 km) from Glasgow Green. Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. You're sure to appreciate the recreational amenities, which include 2 indoor swimming pools, a fitness center, and bicycles to rent. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Make yourself at home in one of the 113 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and digital programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with shower/tub combinations feature hair dryers and slippers. Conveniences include safes and desks, and housekeeping is provided daily. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant or snacks in the coffee shop/cafe. The hotel also offers 24-hour room service. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Full breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and luggage storage. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Sauchiehall Street - 0. 1 km / 0. 1 mi- Willow Tearooms - 0. 2 km / 0. 1 mi- St Vincent Street Church - 0. 2 km / 0. 1 mi- Glasgow School of Art - 0. 3 km / 0.

122699.description: Enjoy a central London stay at the Trebovir Hotel, conveniently located a short drive from Kensington High Street and the Natural History Museum. We offer 61 guestrooms equipped with complimentary Wi-Fi, private bathrooms with rainfall showers, and coffee/tea makers. Daily housekeeping is provided, and irons/ironing boards are available upon request. Start your day with our complimentary continental breakfast and take advantage of amenities such as concierge services and an area shuttle (surcharge). Our multilingual staff at the 24-hour front desk is always ready to assist with luggage storage and other needs. Hyde Park and Westfield London Shopping Centre are within a short drive. We are also near: Cromwell Road, Olympia Conference and Exhibition Centre, Imperial College London, Kensington Gardens, Victoria and Albert Museum, the Science Museum, Kensington Palace, Stamford Bridge Stadium, Royal Albert Hall, the Thames River, Eventim Apollo, and Harrods.

122859.description: Situated on a sprawling 69-hectare estate, once belonging to a now-ruined abbey, this golf hotel offers convenient access to major attractions. A short drive from Junction 2 of the M42, guests are within easy reach of Birmingham, the NEC, historic Stratford-upon-Avon, and Warwick. Redditch town centre, with its vibrant nightlife, shops, and transport links, is also just minutes away. Explore local gems like Cadbury World and West Midland Safari Park, or venture further to Birmingham's Bullring shopping centre, Sea Life, the ICC, and the NIA. Multiple airports, including Birmingham International, are easily accessible. The hotel's modern architecture houses 100 en-suite rooms, a first-class restaurant and bar, and ample conference facilities, perfect for weddings and civil ceremonies. Unwind on the championship golf course, a frequent host of county matches. Guests can also enjoy 24-hour reception, currency exchange, Wi-Fi, and on-site parking. Room and laundry services are available for a fee. Stylish contemporary rooms feature en-suite bathrooms with shower, bathtub, and hairdryer. Amenities include cotton duvets, complimentary Wi-Fi, H2K toiletries, direct-dial telephone, satellite TV, trouser press, ironing set, radio, individual heating controls, tea and coffee making facilities, comfortable seating, and full-length mirrors.

122897.description: This city and business hotel enjoys a convenient location, close to the underground and the railway stations, and only a short taxi ride from mainline central London train stations. The establishment is well serviced by buses travelling to and from central London and is easy to get to by car. This business and conference hotel offers bedrooms designed with a thoughtful layout and furnished with an impressive attention to detail. The 4-storey hotel is fully air-conditioned and welcomes both leisure and corporate guests with equal care and provision. Each of the stylish guestrooms has been creatively furnished with excellent designer materials - from the hand-built furniture to the Hansgrohe bathroom fittings. The conference facilities offer top-of-the-line equipment for hosting various business functions.

123288.description: Our welcoming, lakeside Holiday Inn Express Tamworth hotel is just moments from the M42 and in walking distance of historic Tamworth town centre, Tamworth Castle and the train station. We're neighbours with the SnowDome, Drayton Manor is a ten minute drive away, and Birmingham Airport, NEC and city centre are all around a half an hour's drive so we're not just ideally located for Tamworth itself. Our guests enjoy modern, en suite rooms, free WiFi and buffet breakfast. If you're visiting on business, you can host and attend meetings in our four conference rooms. The Great Room is a relaxed spot to enjoy dinner and drinks, and food is available 24/7 so you can always grab a bite to eat at our Tamworth hotel.

123879.description: Enjoy stunning views from the terrace and garden of this hotel, and stay connected with complimentary Wi-Fi. The hotel offers a variety of amenities, including a TV in the common area, a picnic area, and a banquet hall. Dine at the on-site restaurant or enjoy 24-hour room service. Unwind with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary English breakfast is served daily from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM. The hotel also provides dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and luggage storage. Free self-parking is available. Each of the 43 guestrooms features a Smart TV and complimentary Wi-Fi. Private bathrooms are equipped with bathtubs or showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Coffee/tea makers and desks are also provided, and housekeeping is offered daily. Nearby attractions include Gouldings Garden Centre (2. 6 mi), Chatelherault Country Park (2. 8 mi), and Cambusnethan Priory (3. 4 mi). The nearest airport is Glasgow International Airport (GLA), 27. 5 mi away.

124240.description: This modern Bromsgrove hotel offers easy access to Birmingham, free Wi-Fi, ample meeting space, a restaurant, and a spa. Located just off the M5 motorway, the Holiday Inn® Birmingham - Bromsgrove hotel is a 30-minute drive from Birmingham City Centre. Free parking is available, and direct trains from Bromsgrove station, a mile away, take 30 minutes. Birmingham Airport (BHX) and the NEC are easily accessible via the nearby M42. You can reach the Cadbury World chocolate factory or the Black Country Living Museum in about 30 minutes. West Midlands Safari Park is also close by. The stylish Fairfield Suite has its own bar and can accommodate up to 220 guests, making it a popular wedding venue. Host an intimate business gathering or a conference in one of the hotel's 10 hi-tech meeting rooms. Wi-Fi is free throughout the hotel, and a dedicated events team can arrange catering and business services. Relax in the steam room, swim laps in the heated indoor pool, and enjoy delicious meals in our Sourced restaurant, which features daily specials. Alternatively, unwind with a refreshing drink in the lounge bar. Kids stay and eat free.

124698.description: The Everglades Park Hotel in Widnes offers convenience as well as comfort. In a semi-rural location, you'll be in the heart of the North West's commerce, industry and leisure venues. Just a few miles from Liverpool, it's also very convenient for all that city has to offer too – including Premier League football at Liverpool's Anfield and Everton's Goodison Park stadiums, as well as excellent shopping, culture and world-renowned music heritage. The Everglades Park Hotel is also pet-friendly and you can have your dog stay over for a small charge. Although you'll enjoy all the advantages of being close to the city center, you'll also benefit from relaxed suburban surroundings. Less than five minutes from the M62 and 10 minutes from the M56, the North West is your oyster. John Lennon International Airport is just a short drive away too. The excellent transport links also make this fine Florida-themed hotel in Widnes an ideal place to hold a business conference. We have state-of-the-art facilities along with everything you need if you're working out of the office – so it's a superb hotel near Liverpool in which to hold a meeting. A wide selection of flexible rooms also makes the Everglades Park Hotel a wonderful wedding hotel in Widnes. Our dedicated team will make your big day extra special by taking care of all the details and by offering a preferential rate for guests staying over.

125040.description: Discover the beauty of this historic city at the Novotel Liverpool Centre hotel. This stylish 4-star hotel is set in the heart of the city and is in close proximity of the Liverpool Echo Arena, Albert Dock and Liverpool One shopping centre. Ideal for tourists and guests looking for a weekend escape, the hotel is conveniently located just 1. 6km from Liverpool Lime Street station. Keep fit in our fitness centre or relax by the pool. Q-Park Hanover Street offers, parking for guests at a 30% discounted rate.

125103.address: The Green Business Park, Dog Kennel Lane
125103.description:
Village Solihull is just off the A34, one of the main roads into the city and well connected to the M42 at Junction 4 and M40, meaning you are just a short drive from historic towns like Stratford-upon-Avon, Warwick and Leamington Spa. The hotel is located in peaceful surroundings yet less than 10 miles from Birmingham city centre, 9 miles from Birmingham International Airport and under 2 miles from Shirley train station. 

The hotel has everything you'd need under one roof including new look, fully refurbished bedrooms with big cosy beds, huge TVs and great showers, pool and state-of-the-art gym with all the latest tech and Village Pub and Grill where you can tuck into delicious food and drink. 

Access to Leisure facilities is charged at £5 per day per room. Club Room guests receive free access. 

Parking charges apply Monday - Sunday, 24 hours a day
Parking is free for up to 4 hours Monday - Sunday
Parking is charged at £10. 00 for 24 hours then £10. 00 per day thereafter Monday - Thursday
Parking is charged at £5. 00 for 24 hours then £5. 00 per day thereafter Friday - Sunday

 Club Room guests park free for the duration of their stay.

125353.description: Located within easy access of the city of the centre, as well as the many attractions for which it is renowned, this establishment is the ideal choice for every type of traveller. As part of a terrace of houses, the property oozes tradition and charm. Occupying a Victorian building, this property offers visitors an insight into the rich history of the area. The guest rooms are charming, tastefully designed and well equipped with modern amenities. Excellent facilities and services are offered to enhance each stay at this property. Professional, friendly staff are on hand to ensure that guests' needs are fully met. The hotel kept the traditional look, property has no AC or lift, every room comes with a fan, kettle and fridge. The bunkbeds and single bed configuration can not be guaranteed. There is no rate difference and the configuration is upon request subject to availability.

125362.description: Enjoy a pampering spa visit with massages, body treatments, and facials. This eco-certified hotel also offers complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and a banquet hall. Take advantage of room service (limited hours) or relax with a drink at the bar/lounge. Weekend breakfasts are available for a fee (8:00 AM to 10:30 AM). Additional amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and luggage storage. The 49 individually decorated guest rooms feature private bathrooms with shower/tub combinations, complimentary toiletries, hair dryers, phones, laptop-compatible safes, and desks. Located in central Newcastle-upon-Tyne, Grey Street Hotel is a short walk from Castle Keep, Tyne Bridge, Quayside, and the BALTIC Centre for Contemporary Art. The Bigg Market, St. Nicholas' Cathedral, and Theatre Royal are also just steps away. Newcastle International Airport (NCL) is conveniently located approximately 7. 3 miles from the hotel.

125417.description: Located near Twickenham Stadium, the upscale Radisson RED London Twickenham offers convenient access to Hampton Court Palace (8. 8 km) and Stamford Bridge Stadium (13 km). Guests can enjoy an indoor pool, sauna, and fitness center. The hotel provides 156 air-conditioned guestrooms with complimentary Wi-Fi, satellite TV, phones, safes, and desks. Dining options include 22 South Restaurant with a bar/lounge and 24-hour room service. Buffet breakfast is available for a fee. Additional amenities include a business center, express check-out, complimentary newspapers, and event facilities. Self-parking is available (charges apply).

125837.description:
Cheval Harrington Court in South Kensington presents is ideally located just a two-minute walk from South Kensington Tube Station. Guests benefit from complimentary WiFi and elegantly designed, spacious accommodation. Each air-conditioned studio and apartment is equipped with a flat-screen satellite LCD TV, iPod docking station, and a dining and seating area adorned with wooden flooring. Strategically situated, Cheval Harrington Court is in proximity to a variety of London’s renowned attractions, including the prestigious Natural History Museum and the Victoria and Albert Museum, both just a five-minute stroll away. Hyde Park is a 15-minute walk from the property. 
Cheval Apartments have introduced a service charge policy. This is a discretionary service charge which will be applied to accommodation bookings. The service charge applied will be 4% for all bookings .

125882.description: This property offers visitors the perfect setting from which to explore everything that Glasgow has to offer. The property is just a short distance away from Kelvingrove Art Gallery and Museum, Celtic Park and the Scottish Exhibition and Conference Centre. The property is also surrounded by ample opportunities for dining, shopping and entertainment. Glasgow International Airport is conveniently located just 15 km away. Appealing to business and leisure travellers alike, this property offers exemplary service, delightful accommodation options and superb facilities. The guest rooms have been designed in a simplistic, yet comfortable style. Guests can enjoy classic fish and chips in the onsite cafe bar.

125883.description: This comfortable and charming hotel boasts a peaceful position in Renfrew, within easy reach from several entertainment and leisure options. Thanks to the hotel's proximity to the famous Soar family amusement centre and to a shopping centre, this is ideal choice of accommodation when travelling with the whole family. Those interested in history may visit nearby sightseeing attractions, such as Paisley Abbey or Crookston Castle. The spacious and modern guest rooms are nicely fitted with everything necessary for a relaxing stay. They boast a cheery and stylish look and come equipped with tea and coffee making facilities for added comfort and a large bed for a restful night's sleep. Those travelling with their own vehicle may take advantage of the on-site complimentary parking facilities. Guests can enjoy a delicious breakfast buffet and unwind with a refreshing drink at the on-site café.

125884.description: This comfortable airport-hotel features a fresh new look and new room design complete with Dreamer Bed so guests can be sure of a great night's sleep. Located at just 3km from the Edinburgh Airport it is the perfect choice for anyone arriving through it. Thanks to the convenient shuttle service guests can be relaxing in the comfortable rooms just minutes after stepping off the plane. The property is also well placed for local transport links including Edinburgh Waverley train station and Edinburgh Bus station. Guests can soak up Edinburg's history, visit Linlithgow Palace or St Giles Cathedral in a matter of minutes. They can enjoy family attractions including Edinburgh Zoo or get back to nature at Almondell Country Park and the Edinburgh Botanic Gardens. For rugby fans, Murrayfield Stadium is well worth a visit and is located just over 10km away.

125887.description: The hotel is located 2.4 km from Edinburgh city centre, making it ideal for a stay in the city whether for business or leisure. All local points of interest are easily reachable and the vicinity offers many amenities, such as shops, dining places and entertainment venues. This establishment is a comfortable budget hotel offering 115 rooms in total. All accommodation units are simply, contemporarily furnished and strive to provide guests with all modern day necessities. Each guestroom features a king-size bed, a television and tea and coffee making facilities. The hotel offers 24-hour reception which ensures flexibility.

126005.description: Floor-to-ceiling windows, carefully-designed, uncluttered interiors and a peaceful communal terrace. If you're looking for your own space in the very centre of the action, your search is over. Choose from one, two and three-bedroom apartments, all with spacious living areas and large kitchen tables. Park your car on-site and check-in. Then pull back the curtains, make yourself at home, and maximise every minute of your trip. At Cove - Paradise Street you'll be only minutes from the central station, and a short walk from Chinatown, the iconic Royal Albert Dock and the Ropewalks, which is home to independent shops and eateries. If your visit is a working one, the commercial district is a short stroll away, as is FACT Liverpool and the Bluecoat arts and culture centre. Tate Liverpool and the famous Cavern Quarter, where the Beatles honed their craft, are also nearby - meaning you should be able to pack a little bit of everything into even the shortest of staysDog Stays (cats and other pets are not allowed) - We have dog friendly properties where 1 dog of up to 30 kilos is welcome. Registered service animals will be permitted in all locations where notice has been given prior to arrival. Additional charges apply for dogs (excluding registered service dogs) and a completed pet waiver upon check-in is mandatory. It is your responsibility before arrival to check that dogs are permitted at the Property. Storage of luggage after 23:59 on the day of arrival and/or departure (storage is free until 23. 59 pm on the day of arrival and/or departure). We provide a weekly cleaning service for stays of 7 nights or more. We can arrange an additional cleaning service if requested for an additional fee. Smoking Charge and Hardkey replacement - additional fee

126260.description: This beautiful hotel is located on the south side of Westminster Bridge, with views across the river to the Houses of Parliament and Big Ben. The hotel is only a short walk from Waterloo Station. The restaurants and bars of South Bank are just 100 m away and it is 200 m from the Thames. It is perfectly situated within short walking distance of London's key tourist attractions, including Big Ben, the Houses of Parliament, the London Aquarium, the London Eye, the Imperial War Museum, Westminster Abbey, Trafalgar Square and Buckingham Palace. Decorated with contemporary flair and a hint of boutique-style elegance, the comfortable hotel rooms, Suites and Penthouses offer striking city views and modern amenities.

126479.description: This aparthotel in Kensington and Chelsea places you near London's top attractions, including Harrods, the Royal Albert Hall, and the National History, Victoria and Albert, and Science Museums. The West End's vibrant shopping, dining, and entertainment scene, along with Hyde Park and Kensington Gardens, are easily accessible. South Kensington tube station is a mere 550 meters away, and Heathrow Airport is just 22 km from the hotel. The six-story aparthotel offers 38 stylish apartments, featuring a minimalist design. Guests enjoy a 24-hour reception, lift access, a hotel safe, and laundry service. Each spacious apartment is meticulously clean and boasts modern furnishings and state-of-the-art technology. The well-equipped kitchens cater to diverse tastes. All apartments include a private bathroom with a shower/bathtub and hairdryer, a double bed with daily linen changes, a direct dial telephone, TV, internet access, a safe, a fridge, cooker, microwave, tea and coffee making facilities, an ironing set, air conditioning, and central heating.

name.content: Holiday Inn Express Hotel Dublin Airport

126481.description: The modern Holiday Inn Express Dublin Airport hotel offers free Wi-Fi and breakfast. It's a short drive or free shuttle bus ride from Dublin Airport (DUB) and 20 minutes from Dublin city centre. Guests can take advantage of the Park, Stay & Go package, leaving their car in the on-site parking lot. The nearby M1 and M50 motorways provide easy access to the city centre, business parks, and the coast. Popular attractions like the Guinness Storehouse, Temple Bar, and Trinity College are within a 25-minute drive. Malahide Castle and the coastal town of Howth are less than 30 minutes away. The hotel features a lounge bar suitable for informal meetings, a lobby computer, and free Wi-Fi. Larger meetings and conferences can be accommodated next door at the Crowne Plaza Dublin Airport hotel, with 25 meeting rooms for up to 1000 people. Enjoy an inclusive buffet breakfast with hot items like sausages and scrambled eggs. The Express Bar offers cold drinks and pizza. For more elaborate dining, try the sleek restaurant at the Crowne Plaza, featuring dishes like wok-fried noodles and slow-cooked Asian pork belly.

128047.description: Set in nine acres of countryside, the Russ Hill Hotel is just 4 miles from London Gatwick Airport and offers value overnight accommodation before or after Gatwick flights. All 190 bedrooms have an ensuite bathroom, television, telephone, tea and coffee making facilities and hairdryer. The hotel's Rusper Restaurant serves typical English dishes. Light snacks and a wide range of drinks are served in the Garden Lounge Bar. An airport shuttle operates to and from the airport (payable). As of the 2nd June 2015 transfers to and from the airport are by taxi and cost approx. ?9. 00 each way. Please contact hotel for details

128188.description: ibis London Stratford positions you perfectly for your London getaway and, from check-in to check-out, we've got your every need covered. Our bar will keep you refreshed from morning to midnight, and our on-site restaurant offers a relaxing spot to enjoy a lazy lunch or an indulgent evening meal. So whether you're here to take in a show at the O2, shop 'til you drop at Westfield or take care of business at Canary Wharf, we've got you covered for a great stay.

128699.description: Surrounded by a vibrant dining scene, colorful bars, and unique shops, our hotel puts you within walking distance of the best of the City of London. We're a half-mile walk from Spitalfields Market, Brick Lane, and the Jack the Ripper Museum. Aldgate East Station is a five-minute walk from our doors, and the Tower of London is less than 10 minutes away.

128702.description: This superb design hotel is very nicely situated on the famous known Waterloo Road, just 5 minutes' walk from Waterloo Tube Station. Guests will be able to reach on foot a number of touristic and cultural attractions, such as the London Eye, the River Thames, Big Ben and the Houses of Parliament. Waterloo Train Station is approximately 600 m away. London Heathrow is at a distance of approximately 29 km, London Luton at some 45 km and London Gatwick and London Stansted are both at around 50 km from the hotel. The H10 London Waterloo has bright, recently renovated modern rooms, with laminate wood flooring, that are equipped with all the amenities you could need for a comfortable stay. Classic superior rooms - 19 m² room with modern décor and large picture windows with street views. Classic Superior Sky View rooms - 19 m² room located on the upper floors, with modern décor and large picture windows that offer panoramic views of London **Important note: The Sky Bar will be closed on the 31st December 2026.

128787.description: Stay at the luxury, 4* Pestana Chelsea Bridge Hotel and enjoy London's trendy Chelsea Wharf development. Nestled between scenic Battersea Park, the river Thames and the iconic Battersea Power Station, our hotel features 217 spacious, modern bedrooms, including one and two-bedroom Suites. Each one is equipped with individual bath and shower facilities. Pestana Chelsea Bridge's excellent facilities and first-class service make it a perfect fit, whether you're visiting on business travel, enjoying a family vacation or a weekend for 2. The Hotel's ideal location allows guests to enjoy easy access to the city's major attractions, without compromising the opportunity to relax in the tranquil surroundings of Battersea Park, alongside the River Thames. Our Restaurant will be open for breakfast from 7am to 11am and our Bar will be operating between 12pm to 10. 30pm for drinks and from 12pm to 10pm for food. Our Room Service is available from 5pm to 10pm. Kindly note that our Spa facilities, which includes the indoor pool, sauna, steam room & Spa treatments has reopened and our Gym is available 24hours.

128875.description: Step back in time with a stay at voco® Grand Central Glasgow, an iconic landmark hotel nestled in the heart of Glasgow. Located adjacent to Glasgow Central Station and steeped in 19th-century railway history, our hotel offers unrivalled glamour combined with convenience. With grand high ceilings, glittering chandeliers, and timeless wood panelling, the hotel creates an atmosphere where contemporary and elegance converge. Admire the majestic Grand Staircase and explore our famous Wall of Fame. Perfectly located beside Glasgow Central Station, voco® Grand Central is the ideal starting point for your adventures. Stroll to Buchanan Galleries, George Square, and the lively Merchant City, or easily reach the West End, OVO Hydro, or SEC for events. Shop along The Style Mile or take the convenient shuttle to Glasgow Airport. Relax in elegant guest rooms, from cosy singles to expansive suites and lofts. Start your morning with a traditional Scottish breakfast, and later, sip champagne or crafted cocktails at our renowned Champagne Central bar. At voco® Grand Central Glasgow, experience a stay teeming with heritage and contemporary comfort.

129876.description: With a stay at Greywalls Hotel and Chez Roux in Gullane, you'll be next to a golf course, just steps from Muirfield Golf Course and a 3-minute drive from Gullane Golf Course. This 5-star hotel is 13. 7 mi (22. 1 km) from Musselburgh Racecourse and 0. 6 mi (1 km) from Gullane Beach. Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as an outdoor tennis court or take in the view from a terrace and a garden. Additional features at this Edwardian hotel include complimentary wireless Internet access, concierge services, and a fireplace in the lobby.
