163382.description: The DoubleTree by Hilton London - West End is ideally located in London's historic Bloomsbury district, between Holborn and Russell Square Underground stations. This full-service hotel offers business and leisure travelers the perfect location just a stone's throw from the British Museum and within walking distance of top attractions such as Covent Garden, the West End, and Oxford Street shops. Heathrow (LHR) and Gatwick (LGW) airports are easily accessible by tube, rail, and bus. Behind its beautiful Edwardian façade, our newly renovated West End hotel retains its historic charm with modern conveniences. Inviting guest rooms, suites, and executive accommodations include pampering bath amenities, generous work surfaces, flat-screen TVs, our luxurious Sweet Dreams bedding, and wireless high-speed internet access. Guests will also appreciate: a well-equipped fitness center by Precor, concierge services, and 24-hour in-room dining. After a day of business or sightseeing, enjoy a light bite, afternoon tea, or evening cocktails at Bar 92, where you can watch the news or sporting events. Join us at The Level Restaurant for sleek and modern dining, serving a selection of international cuisines. Don't forget to start your day with our extensive DoubleTree breakfast buffet. The DoubleTree by Hilton London - West End enjoys a prime location between the Financial District and popular West End attractions and neighborhoods like Soho and the Theatre District. Our Bloomsbury location is also close to many wonderful cafés and restaurants, from casual eateries to fine dining. The hotel is also situated near three colleges, including University College London. For business meetings, conferences, weddings, and receptions, the DoubleTree by Hilton London - West End offers attractive and flexible meeting room spaces, a professional banquet staff, and creative menus.

name.content: The Hari London by IHG, Vignette Collection

163411.description: Designed for those with a penchant for modern elegance, The Hari London by IHG, Vignette Collection is glamorous yet intimate, leaving guests feeling like they have found a hidden home away from home in the heart of London. Located moments from Harrods and the luxury shops of Knightsbridge, The Hari London by IHG, Vignette Collection is also within walking distance of Buckingham Palace, Hyde Park, The Royal Albert Hall and London's most famous museums. The Hari London, Vignette Collection is one of the most luxurious hotels in London, with 85 designer bedrooms, including 14 luxury suites. Each guest room boasts a mix of plush velvet upholstery, marble bathrooms, contemporary art and cosy furnishings, designed to make your stay as relaxing as possibleAll rooms offer complimentary Wi-Fi and portable handy phones with free local and international calls and 3G internet, as well as Noble Isle amenities. The Garden Terrace, The Hari's unique outdoor oasis with living ivy walls, a retractable roof and heaters, is also accessible to all guests. This hotel's chic, dignified atmosphere makes it perfect for a sumptuous London retreat.

163498.description: The Comfort Inn Westminster hotel in London, England is located in the heart of the prestigious Royal Borough of Westminster near famous attractions like the Royal Albert Hall, South Bank, Westminster Abbey, Madame Tussauds and House of Fraser. The Comfort Inn Westminster is also close to The Queens Gallery, Victoria Shopping Centre, London Eye and Tate Britain. Guests of the hotel are invited to enjoy free breakfast and free WiFi. All guest rooms offer a desk, flat-screen TV and in-room tea and coffee. This is a non-smoking hotel. Create your perfect stay at the Comfort Inn Westminster in London. Book now to enjoy easy access to attractions and wonderful amenities while we help you relax and feel at home.

163782.description: Experience small-town charm near big-city amenities at the Hampton Inn Yorkville. Located on the Fox River in Kendall County, one of the fastest-growing counties in Illinois, Yorkville offers both relaxation and excitement. Within minutes of the hotel, you'll find parks, racetracks, a casino, water parks, museums, hiking, cycling, and kayaking. Enjoy diverse shopping opportunities in nearby Chicago and surrounding areas, plus easy access to the Chicagoland Speedway in Joliet. Discover the quaint charm of Yorkville's historic downtown and the excitement of Chicago.

164363.address: Richmond Court North End Road Fulham
164363.description: The apartment hotel is just a 10-minute walk from West Brompton Underground Station and only 500 metres from the famous Cromwell Road. Chelsea Football Club is a 20-minute walk away making this city hotel the perfect accommodation for out-of-town supporters of the team. The fully furnished apartment hotel comprises of 12 units in total. The apartments come complete with everything guests would expect to find at home and weekly servicing is provided as standard. They are perfect for families or groups travelling together in style. All accommodation units are en-suite with a shower and a bath. They come further equipped with a TV and Internet access, as well as a kitchen, which features a fridge, a cooker, a microwave and a washing machine. Central heating is provided for additional comfort.

164412.description: The establishment is ideally located within walking distance of Earls Court tube station and attractions such as the Earls Court Exhibition Centre, Natural History Museum, Victoria and Albert Museum, Stamford Bridge Stadium and many more. A variety of shops, entertainment venues and restaurants can be found within the vicinity of this city hotel. The residence features stylish guest rooms, all of which have private en-suite bathrooms and in-room entertainment facilities. WiFi high-speed Internet access is available throughout the hotel. Every morning guests can enjoy a continental breakfast buffet.

164543.description: A small, family-run hotel set in a Victorian terrace in Glasgow's fashionable West End, the Argyll Western Hotel has a strong Scottish identity and provides guests with a traditional Scottish welcome. The hotel is close to Glasgow University and the popular Byres Road, with its vibrant bars and restaurants, and benefits from easy transport links to the city centre. Each of the 17 comfortable modern guestrooms is decorated using a different tartan and features an en-suite bathroom plus TV with Freeview, free Wi-FI and tea/coffee making facilities. Breakfast is served daily in the bright, high-ceilinged breakfast room and reception is 24-hours

164545.description:
A waterside hotel in Liverpool city centre offering comfortable en-suite rooms, friendly service and free guest parking. Perfectly located for the Albert Dock, Liverpool ONE and the M&S Bank Arena. 

Please note: We do not accept Hen or Stag Parties. 

For a smooth check-in, please email your contact details to: liverpool@dolbyhotels. co. uk 

When booking 3 rooms or more, different cancellations terms and policies apply.

164782.description: A Victorian style venue that has been tastefully refurbished in order preserve its original elegance and atmosphere. Located right in the heart of Southport on the main shopping artery - Lord Street Boulevard, it is near to all of its attractions and fine restaurants. The Southport Pier is 3km away and the Rail Station can be reached within a 5-minute walk, while the New Pleasureland theme-park is just 10 minutes away. This family-friendly beach hotel combines elegant and stylish decor with modern luxury and conveniences The establishment is perfect for business meetings or for those looking for a quiet stay by the sea. With traditional restaurants, a cocktail lounge and real ale bar, guests will have plenty of options for dinning or for that celebratory end-off-the-day pint of beer.

164789.description: Take in the views from a terrace and a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access. This hotel also features concierge services, a fireplace in the lobby, and a picnic area. Grab a bite from the snack bar/deli, or stay in and take advantage of the hotel's 24-hour room service. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Continental breakfasts are served on weekdays from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM and on weekends from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include express check-out, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Make yourself at home in one of the 39 air-conditioned rooms featuring refrigerators and minibars. Your Select Comfort bed comes with Egyptian cotton sheets. 49-inch Smart televisions with satellite programming provide entertainment, while complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected. Private bathrooms with showers feature rainfall showerheads and designer toiletries.

164966.description: Treat yourself to a comfy stay in the capital at The Best Western London Highbury, as this incredibly convenient hotel places in the heart of London. You'll be offered the warmest of welcomes and ultimate access to the city, thanks to the great transport links nearby. Finsbury Park and Manor House Underground tube stations are just 500 meters from the hotel, giving you a fast connection to Central London, Kings Cross Station and St. Pancras International. Central London is bursting with famous tourist attractions, entertainment hotspots, music venues, and diverse cultural districts. You'll also find some of the capital's most prominent business areas and sporting venues, such as Tottenham Football Stadium nearby, so there will never be a dull moment. Stop off at Kings Cross for a visit to the Harry Potter Shop, and a quick photo on platform 9 ¾ - before you head to Hogwarts of course. The two tube stations also offer direct routes to Trafalgar Square and Camden, and the famous canalside Camden Market. A public bus service is also available just outside the hotel, so you can come, go and come back again as you please. The Best Western London Highbury enjoys the luxury of a charming location, overlooking the wonderful Finsbury Park, one of the first great London parks landscaped in the Victorian era. Each en suite bedroom – whether it be a single, double, twin, triple or quadruple - is tastefully decorated with shades of cream and inviting splashes of red. Satellite television and tea and coffee making facilities are also included to complete your comfortable stay, so book today and enjoy having the whole of London at your fingertips.

name.content: DoubleTree by Hilton Tower of London

164990.description: The following services and amenities are available, but with reduced service: Breakfast, Room Service. The following services and amenities are currently not available: Executive Lounge. Easy access to the Olympic Park, this contemporary custom made hotel is in the heart of London's financial district. Located beside the Tower of London and built on the site of the medieval Crutched Friars Monastery, Samuel Pepys House and the 18th Century Naval College, the hotel is in one of the key historical and tourist areas of London. With its blend of modern design and high quality facilities, this is the biggest hotel of its kind in the City of London. • Stylish guestrooms with flat screen TVs, • Luxury suites and Executive rooms • 10 meeting rooms - with built-in audio and natural daylight• Complimentary WiFi available in the public areas

164991.description: Riu Plaza London The Westminster, an iconic hotel comprising of stylish and uniquely designed rooms. Located in the heart of historic London, Riu Plaza London The Westminster is characterised by some of the most iconic landmarks of the capital. The Houses of Parliament, one of the world's most famous clocks, ‘Big Ben' and Westminster Abbey are just a short stroll away. The property has been fully renovated in 2021 with stylish and modern décor throughout, a 24-hour front desk and concierge services are available.

164992.address: Park Lane Corner of Mount Street and Park Lane, 86
164992.description: Grosvenor House Suites by Jumeirah Living offers contemporary luxury and privacy on London's sophisticated Park Lane, overlooking iconic Hyde Park. Located in Mayfair, these apartments are close to major attractions, catering to both leisure and business travelers. A stunning second-floor atrium welcomes guests with its seven-story vaulted glass ceiling and majestic fireplace. Enjoy delicious contemporary cuisine in an exquisite setting. The newly refurbished 1920s era building houses 130 modern apartments and penthouses, ranging from studios to a five-bedroom penthouse. Guest facilities include a private entrance, full kitchens, courtyard dining, 24-hour room service, a deli-style delivery service tailored by the At Home team, fitness room access, and state-of-the-art technology. Each apartment features stylish contemporary interiors, from lavish dark oak flooring to chic wall paneling. Grosvenor House Suites combines classic and contemporary elements, offering a dedicated concierge service, state-of-the-art technology, and bespoke furniture.

165046.description: Clients will enjoy a peaceful and calm stay at Walrus Inns as it counts with a total of 9 rooms.

165401.description: Located in the heart of Batam, I Hotel offers upscale accommodations just a 4-minute walk from Nagoya Hill Mall and a short drive from Harbour Bay Ferry Terminal. Guests can enjoy a variety of amenities, including an outdoor pool, spa tub, sauna, two bars/lounges, and a restaurant with 24-hour room service. The hotel also features a business center, conference facilities, and complimentary Wi-Fi. The 165 air-conditioned rooms include minibars, private bathrooms, and convenient amenities such as safes and desks.

167506.description: With a prime location in the city centre, this hotel is a short walk from Hyde Park. Paddington station is only 300 m from the hotel, putting the whole city and its attractions within easy reach, and Big Ben is only 600 metres away. The hotel offers cosy apartments with a stylish décor, modern kitchens and Wi-Fi access, with bare wooden floors and a contemporary design. The hotel also provides laundry and bicycle rental services.

167507.description:
Hyde Park Economy Apartments offers self-catering accommodation just 150 m from central London's leafy Hyde Park. Queensway Tube Station is just 2 minutes' walk away.
Set within a Georgian townhouse, Hyde Park Economy Apartments offers a choice of studios and apartments. Each comes fully equipped with a flat-screen TV, a dining area, and a private bathroom. Laundry facilities are also available. The studios have a cosy seating area and the apartments boast a separate lounge.
The compact kitchenettes in the apartments and studios have a microwave, fridge, and essential kitchenware. There are numerous restaurants, bars, and cafes within a 5-minute stroll.

In lively Bayswater, Hyde Park Economy Apartments are a 5-minute walk from Whiteleys Shopping Centre. The shops of Oxford Street and the famous Museum Mile can be reached after a 20-minute walk.

167508.description:
The serviced Paddington Apartments enjoy a wonderful location in London, only a 5-minute stroll away from Hyde Park. Marble Arch and the elegant shopping of Oxford Street can be reached within a short stroll, while attractions such as Buckingham Palace, the Natural History Museum or the Victoria and Albert Museum are within easy reach. Paddington train and tube stations are just a step away, providing easy access to all areas of the city.
The tastefully furnished apartments are excellently appointed and sleep up to four people. They are decorated in an urban style with wooden floors and contemporary furnishings. Excellent features include complimentary wireless internet access, flat-screen satellite-TV and a well-equipped kitchen. This is an ideal base for couples, families or groups of friends wishing to explore all this vibrant city has to offer.

167509.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as a fitness center, or other amenities including complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Additional amenities at this hotel include wedding services, a television in a common area, and a banquet hall. Satisfy your appetite for lunch or dinner at the hotel's restaurant, Cast Iron Bar and Grill, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Buffet breakfasts are served on weekdays from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM and on weekends from 7 AM to 11 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-in, and express check-out. Planning an event in London? This hotel has 4144 square feet (385 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 9 meeting rooms. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Stay in one of 217 guestrooms featuring Smart televisions. Your room comes with a pillowtop bed.

168920.description: Experience the grace of Edinburgh’s 18th-century New Town in our boutique Hotel Indigo® Edinburgh, set in the buzzing heart of the city. Step inside and you’ll find an oasis of vibrant colours and contemporary comforts in our Georgian townhouse. After a long day’s shopping and sightseeing, cocoon yourself in your bespoke guest room, where every detail references Scottish creativity, from soft fabrics that caress to local artworks on the walls. You’ll love our indulgent bathrooms with rainfall showers and bespoke toiletries. At night, sip a dram of finest malt whisky in our cosy Bar and Lounge area. Minutes away, you’ll find the city’s best nightlife plus major Edinburgh Festival venues on our doorstep.

169011.description: Indulge in a treatment at the full-service spa, where massages, body treatments, and facials await. Maintain your routine at the health club and sauna. This hotel also offers complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and a hair salon. Enjoy dinner or brunch at The Perception Bar, or take advantage of 24-hour room service. Full breakfasts are available daily (7 AM to 10 AM) for a fee. For business travelers, a business center, express check-in, and express check-out are provided. Planning an event? The hotel offers 915 square feet (85 square meters) of conference and meeting space. Each of the 192 guestrooms features an iPod docking station, a minibar, and a pillowtop bed with Egyptian cotton sheets. A 32-inch LCD TV with pay movies and complimentary Wi-Fi provide entertainment and connectivity. Private bathrooms include bathtubs or showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Located near Leicester Square, Piccadilly Circus, and Trafalgar Square, the hotel offers convenient access to London's top attractions. The nearest airport is London City Airport (LCY).

169012.description: Nestled in 300 acres of Hertfordshire parkland, just 35 minutes from central London and 20 minutes from Heathrow, The Grove offers a sophisticated country escape. Reopening August 1st, 2020, this grand estate boasts contemporary design, an impressive art collection, and exceptional leisure facilities. Enjoy a championship golf course, the world-class Sequoia Spa, a private beach with luxurious beach huts, and a heated outdoor pool. Indulge in a variety of dining experiences at three distinctive restaurants and bars. With 227 luxurious rooms and suites, The Grove provides a relaxing retreat with easy access to the city.

name.content: Mornington London Kensington, BW Premier Collectio

169079.description: The Mornington Hotel London Kensington, recently reopened after complete refurbishment, embodies Victorian elegance in the heart of London. This 4-star boutique hotel seamlessly blends modern luxuries with Victorian charm. Start your day with a decadent breakfast in the newly refurbished restaurant and unwind in the recently added bar, inspired by nearby Exhibition Road. Located moments from Earl's Court Station, the Natural History Museum, and Harrods, the Mornington Hotel is ideal for sightseeing, shopping, luxury excursions, and business trips.

name.content: The Bold Hotel, BW Signature Collection

169108.description: The Bold Hotel, BW Signature Collection, originally constructed in 1832 by Thomas Mawdsley in the late Georgian style, is situated amid the Victorian grandeur of Lord Street, an elegant, tree-lined boulevard in the heart of Southport, Merseyside. Having undergone a £2 million refurbishment in 2015 and a further £300, 000 in renovations in early 2020, our Grade II listed hotel offers luxurious accommodation and elegant, stylish surroundings. Dine at our carvery, enjoy a drink, or catch up with friends. We also have a beautiful function room, complete with a dazzling bespoke chandelier, available for private parties and functions. Each of the hotel's 23 spacious and luxuriously appointed en-suite bedrooms is well-equipped with modern facilities for a relaxing and comfortable stay. Some rooms feature Victorian bay windows overlooking Lord Street.

169115.description: The hotel occupies a fantastic location in one of London's oldest and most fashionable areas. It is close to Westminster Abbey, the Houses of Parliament, Buckingham Palace and St. James Park, while the Olympic Park is 4 km away. Westminster underground station is roughly 650 metres from the hotel. The nearest airports are London Heathrow, approximately 27 km away, and London Gatwick, which is about 48 km from the hotel. This city hotel comprises a total of 34 rooms. The ground floor is traditional in style, but smart and modern in execution. The hotel offers amenities such as a bar, a restaurant, Internet access, and room and laundry services. There is also a car park for those arriving by car. The rooms have all been furnished to a high standard and are decorated with top quality furnishings and comfortable bed linens. The rooms are en suite with a shower and a hairdryer. They come further equipped with a direct dial telephone, satellite/cable TV, Internet access and a safe, as well as a fridge and tea and coffee making facilities. Guests can also expect to find an ironing set and air conditioning as standard features of all accommodation units. The hotel serves a breakfast buffet, while the lunchtime and evening meals are available as a set menu.

169119.description: This charming London hotel, built in 1910, offers 64 guest rooms near the Tower of London. A short walk from the Underground, it provides easy access to the city's attractions, including the River Thames, St. Katherine's Dock, and a bustling street market. Liverpool Street Station is about 1. 5 km away, and London City Airport is approximately 10 km away. The air-conditioned hotel features a 24-hour reception and check-out service, a hotel safe, currency exchange, and lift access. Guests can enjoy a pub, a stylish brasserie restaurant, and 24-hour room service. Business travelers will appreciate the conference facilities and wireless Internet access. Laundry service and a car park are also available. Each en suite room includes a shower, bath, hairdryer, and a comfortable double bed. Modern amenities such as a direct dial telephone, satellite/cable TV, radio, internet access, a safe, and a mini-fridge are provided. Tea and coffee making facilities, an ironing set, and individually controlled air conditioning and heating are also standard. For golf enthusiasts, the Aquarius Golf Course is approximately 9. 4 km away.

169146.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages, body treatments, and facials. You're sure to appreciate the recreational amenities, which include 2 spa tubs, a nightclub, and a health club. This hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. If you'd like to spend the day shopping, you can hop on the shuttle (surcharge). Grab a bite at Athena Restaurant, one of the hotel's 2 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Relax with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge or the poolside bar. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a business center, and dry cleaning/laundry services. A roundtrip airport shuttle and a ferry terminal shuttle are provided for an additional charge. Make yourself at home in one of the 180 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars. Complimentary wireless internet access is available to keep you connected. Private bathrooms have hair dryers and slippers.

169275.description: This hotel enjoys a convenient setting in Bayswater, less than 100 metres from London's world famous Hyde Park. Within a short distance, guests can enjoy a host of local attractions, including Notting Hill, Portobello Road Market and Oxford Street. Guests can also enjoy the London Eye and the charming surroundings of Soho. The perfect setting in which to relax or work, the guest rooms are tastefully appointed, and come complete with modern amenities for added comfort and convenience. Ideal for guests wishing to explore the delights of London, this hotel offers warm hospitality and comfortable surroundings.

169276.description: Offering the perfect base from which to explore the essence and intrigue of the area, this hostel takes great pride in its ease of access to a host of local attractions. Within a short distance, guests can enjoy the captivating surroundings of Camden, as well as a host of local dining, shopping and entertainment venues. Guests will appreciate the spacious, tastefully-decorated rooms, where a soothing ambience of tranquillity awaits. Ideal for guests wishing to explore the surroundings, as well as those seeking a relaxing setting in which to unwind, this hotel offers a central location with professional service. This hotel is ideal for backpackers and leisure travellers alike.

169277.description: Situated just off Russell Square, the attractive hostel Smart Russell Square enjoys a fantastic location just a few steps away from the British Museum, the British Library and Oxford Street, while the trendy area of Camden Town with its alternative shops and restaurants is within easy reach. The train stations London Euston, King's Cross and St. Pancras with the Eurostar Terminal are within a few minute's stroll. The hostel with its young and international atmosphere offers a wide variety of room types. Features include custom-designed beds with curtains, complimentary WIFI and a room locker for guests' valuables. For added convenience, the hostel offers a 24-hour internet café, no curfew, kitchen facilities, a 24-hour reception and a travel shop where guests can get information or buy tickets. Every morning, a free breakfast is served. This hostel is a perfect place for young people and budget travellers wishing to explore this vibrant city.

169900.description: Located in the heart of London, this modern hotel is just a short distance from the iconic Oval cricket ground and within easy reach of major attractions like the London Eye, Buckingham Palace, the Tate Modern, and Nine Elms. The O2 Brixton Academy is also within walking distance. Guests enjoy comfortable, stylish accommodations with Wi-Fi, coffee makers, hair dryers, and safes. While a superb breakfast was previously offered, it is currently unavailable due to COVID-19 restrictions. The hotel prioritizes customer satisfaction and offers convenient access to numerous attractions, making it an ideal base for exploring the city. Please note the following COVID-19 policies: maintain social distancing and wear face masks in public areas; NHS workers only; face masks required at check-in; no breakfast or room service; towels available upon request; £60 damage deposit required (refundable within 7 days); no smoking (£100 penalty); valid photo ID required; no visitors allowed; and management reserves the right to refuse admission for abusive behavior.

name.content: Hampton by Hilton Birmingham Broad Street

169905.description: Welcome to the Hampton by Hilton Birmingham Broad Street, located in the heart of Birmingham. The hotel is a short walk from the ICC, Arena Birmingham, Symphony Hall, Town Hall, and the O2 Academy. With easy access to the M6, M5, and M42 motorways, the hotel offers excellent connections to the north and south of England. The NEC, Resorts World Arena, and Birmingham International Airport are only 14 miles away. Relax in spacious guest rooms featuring modern amenities, a workspace, free Wi-Fi, and a comfortable bed. For your convenience, wired high-speed internet access is available in the Work Zone. Guests also have access to a well-equipped fitness room (currently unavailable). Enjoy our lounge bar, offering a variety of drinks, light meals, and snacks 24 hours a day. Start your day with our complimentary hot and continental breakfast (currently with reduced service). Located in a bustling area, we are close to corporate offices like RBS, HSBC, Deutsche Bank, Kraft Foods, and the BBC. We're also convenient to tourist attractions such as Sealife, Legoland Discovery Centre, Cadbury World, Drayton Manor Theme Park, and the Jewellery Quarter Museum. The city boasts fantastic restaurants, gastropubs, and bistros. Explore the Balti Triangle, with over 50 restaurants offering delicious curries. The Mailbox, Bullring, and Grand Central shopping centers are within walking distance.

170109.description: The following services and amenities are available, Fitness Center, Breakfast, Room service, Lunch and Dinner, On-site Restaurant(s). We're in Brindleyplace, less than a mile from Utilita Arena Birmingham, Symphony Hall, ICC, LEGOLAND, and National SEA LIFE Centre. The Bullring, Grand Central, and the Jewellery Quarter are a 20-minute walk. We’re four miles from Thinktank Birmingham Science Museum. Enjoy our event space, fitness centre, and all-day dining at our Recess Restaurant. Relax in a stylish guest room with complimentary WiFi, 55-inch HDTV, ergonomic workspace, a mini cooler and deluxe bathroom with a walk-in shower. Savor a refreshing beverage or a freshly cooked meal at our restaurant offering an extensive terrace area or unwind in our Lounge with a selection of light bites, cocktails, beers, wines and whiskeys. Stock up on those travel essentials at the Pavilion Pantry®, open any time for your convenience. Plan a meeting or event for up to 120 people in one of six flexible conference rooms at the Hilton Garden Inn hotel in Birmingham. Each room features sound-proofed walls, complimentary WiFi, natural lighting and an Apple computer, with catered refreshments available. Our hotel staff is committed to offering guests affordable accommodations, friendly service and a range of 24-hour complimentary facilities including a modern business center and a fitness center.

name.content: Hilton Garden Inn Glasgow City Centre

170111.description: The following services and amenities are available, but with reduced service: Breakfast, On-site Restaurant(s). The following services and amenities are currently not available: Fitness Center, Room Service. Our award-winning hotel, situated on Glasgow's River Clyde, is near the SSE Hydro Arena and SEC. In the heart of the city, we're perfectly located for exploring all that Glasgow has to offer including shopping, museums, botanic gardens and eclectic nightlife. After a busy day, relax in your contemporary guest room and look out across the riverbank through floor-to-ceiling windows. Stay connected with complimentary WiFi or unwind in front of the 42-inch TV. Enjoy casual dining at Recess our new space where you can eat, drink and meet day to night. Dine indoors or al fresco on the outdoor terrace, complete with spectacular views of the river and beyond. For those travelling on business, our hotel is within easy reach of the business district. Our flexible meeting rooms are perfect for conferences, meetings or private dinners. Local and national rail networks are within 5 minutes and Glasgow International Airport is only a 15-minute drive away. Keep up your fitness regime during your stay, our high-tech Precor gym is available free of charge, 24-hours a day. Guests can enjoy on-site car parking (fees apply) and bus service picking up from the front of the hotel.

170177.description: Stay Central, Explore Endless Possibilities Set in a beautifully Fitzrovian building, voco London Bloomsbury blends historic charm with modern comfort. Located just steps from the British Museum and within easy reach of Tottenham Court Road, Covent Garden and Soho, it’s the perfect base for exploring London’s vibrant culture. The hotel features 114 stylish bedrooms with contemporary amenities, complemented by a contemporary bar and restaurant for relaxed dining and drinks. Whether you’re visiting for business or leisure, our welcoming service and central location make every stay effortless, vibrant, and a little unforgettable. Russell Square and Holborn Stations are approx. 3 minutes’ walk form the hotel.

name.content: Mercure Newcastle George Washington Golf & Spa

170179.address: Stone Cellar Road High Usworth Washington Tyne an, N/A
170179.description: Make yourself at home in the luxurious Mercure George Washington Hotel Golf and Spa, set in the tranquil surrounds of Washington. Located just 15-minutes from Newcastle Upon Tyne and Sunderland, the hotel features a restaurant, a lounge bar and an 18-hole championship golf course. After a busy day of shopping and sightseeing, take advantage of our spa and treat yourself to a relaxing break with a treatment session. There's also an indoor pool, hot tub and steam room too for your added convenience.

name.content: The Glenview Hotel And Leisure Club

170434.description: Relax at the full-service spa, where you can enjoy massages, body treatments, and facials. If you're looking for recreational opportunities, you'll find a health club, an indoor pool, and a sauna. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, babysitting (surcharge), and an arcade/game room. Grab a bite to eat at the Woodlands, a restaurant where you can take in the garden view, or stay in and take advantage of 24-hour room service. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Full breakfasts are served on weekdays from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, complimentary newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Event facilities at this hotel consist of conference space and meeting rooms. Free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 70 air-conditioned rooms featuring LCD televisions.

171188.description: Whether it's a night on the town or a quiet evening in, Premier Inn Hotel London Rainham is a great choice. You'll have direct links right to the centre of London and we're handy for Greenwich, the O2 and local businesses too. Cheer on the sports stars at Queen Elizabeth Olympic Park. Or head into town and see the iconic sights. Do some window shopping along Bond Street, enjoy a picnic in Hyde Park, or pick up a bargain or two at Lakeside Shopping Centre. After a busy day, come back to the hotel for some great food and a lovely comfy bed. All reservations placed at this hotel are subject to Premier Inn’s standard Terms and Conditions, which can be found at premierinn. com

name.content: 11 Cadogan Gardens by Iconic Luxury Hotels

171406.description: 11 Cadogan Gardens, The Apartments, and The Chelsea Townhouse by Iconic Luxury Hotels are three properties offering an excellent variety of luxury accommodation in three gorgeous townhouse buildings located just off Sloane Square in the heart of Chelsea. 11 Cadogan Gardens features 56 bedrooms and suites spread among four Victorian townhouses, as well as spacious and eccentric public spaces. Hans' Bar & Grill, a neighborhood favorite with a creative menu, backs onto the beautiful Pavilion Road. The chic Chelsea Bar serves classic cocktails and superb wines to locals and visitors alike. The stylish bar is decorated in grand Victorian style and serves classic cocktails and fine wines. Hans' Bar & Grill has an innovative menu, which features fresh ingredients and local produce. The newly opened Chelsea Townhouse (formerly the Draycott Hotel) is a magnificent, red brick townhouse that backs onto Cadogan Gardens and has been carefully refurbished to reflect traditional British elegance. Individually built rooms and suites complement the building's Victorian heritage. The Apartments by 11 Cadogan Gardens are located next to The Chelsea Townhouse. Six recently refurbished apartments, each taking up a whole floor of a terracotta brick Victorian townhouse, offer luxe-contemporary living and are excellent for people looking to stay for an extended period of time. These remarkable properties epitomise luxury and elegance, seamlessly blending timeless charm with modern amenities, captivating both refined travellers and locals alike.

171608.description: Just a half-hour walk from Glasgow's vibrant centre, our modern, affordable hotel puts you up in style without breaking the bank. Taking things out of the city a touch (but not too far) allows us to offer those little things that make all the difference, like free parking and super-low room rates.

171734.description: Located minutes from Heathrow Airport Terminal 5, the Hilton London Heathrow Airport Terminal 5 offers stylish accommodations within landscaped grounds, a short train ride from central London. Easy access to the M4 and M25 motorways is provided, and a frequent bus transfer connects the hotel to Heathrow Airport (charges apply). All guest rooms and suites feature soundproof windows, complimentary Wi-Fi, LCD TVs, and spacious work areas with ergonomic desk chairs. The hotel boasts 929 square meters of flexible conference space, ideal for global conferences, business meetings, and lavish gala events for 2 to 1170 guests. A business center with state-of-the-art audiovisual equipment, ample parking, and complimentary Wi-Fi throughout the hotel are also available. Indulge in a beauty treatment or massage at the on-site spa, or relax in the complimentary Thermo Suite and Relaxation Area. Guests can energize in the 24-hour fitness center or enjoy tranquil waterside views at the stylish River Bar. Savor pan-Asian specialties at Mr. Todiwala's Kitchen and dine on modern British dishes at The Gallery, prepared with fresh, seasonal ingredients.

171946.description: This elegant Georgian-style hotel enjoys a convenient location in Dublin's city centre, just minutes from the city's cultural attractions such as O'Connell Street, Temple Bar, Croke Park and the Dublin Writers Museum. Visitors might shop in the city centre with its charming boutiques, stroll through one of the many green parks or along the River Liffey, or visit Dublin's most famous attraction, the Guinness Storehouse. The hotel's charming guest rooms are all en suite with warm duvets and richly coloured accents. Each room boasts a tea and coffee tray and complimentary Wi-Fi for guest use. Guests can dine in one of two hotel restaurants, The Castle Vaults, set in an original 19th-century wine cellar or the Old Music Shop, set in a stylish Georgian Room overlooking Findlater's striking 19th Century Church. Enjoy a full Irish breakfast or vegetarian breakfast which is served complimentary on each day of your stay. The hotel bar provides satisfying Irish wheat beers and traditional live Irish music around the weekends. The hotel has its own gym and secure private car park. The 747 Airlink airport shuttle stops just 1 minute walk away, making this the perfect place to spend a holiday in Dublin.

171961.description: Enjoy a comfortable stay at The Resident Kensington, an eco-certified hotel in the heart of London. Located within a 15-minute walk of Kensington High Street and the Natural History Museum, our hotel offers convenient amenities such as complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and room service (limited hours). Each of our 65 guestrooms features a kitchenette equipped with a refrigerator and microwave, a flat-screen TV with digital programming, a safe, a desk, and a phone with free local calls. We also provide dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and multilingual staff. Self-parking is available onsite (subject to charges). Nearby attractions include Imperial College London (0. 7 mi), Hyde Park (1. 3 mi), and several museums. The nearest airport is Heathrow (LHR).

172419.description: A stay at DoubleTree by Hilton London - Ealing Hotel places you in the heart of London, a 4-minute drive from Chiswick Park and 6 minutes from Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew. This hotel is 4. 1 mi (6. 5 km) from Wembley Stadium and 4. 3 mi (6. 9 km) from Richmond Park. Enjoy recreation amenities such as a 24-hour fitness center or take in the view from a terrace. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and wedding services. Make yourself at home in one of the 189 air-conditioned rooms featuring refrigerators and MP3 docking stations. Wired and wireless internet access is complimentary, and LCD televisions with digital programming provide entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as laptop-compatible safes and desks. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant or snacks in the hotel's coffee shop/cafe. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. English breakfasts are served on weekdays from 6:30 AM to 10:00 AM and on weekends from 7:00 AM to 10:30 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary wired internet access, a computer station, and express check-in. Planning an event in London? This hotel has 3757 square feet (349 square meters) of space consisting of a conference center and 6 meeting rooms. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer.

name.content: DoubleTree by Hilton London - Hyde Park

172420.description: The DoubleTree by Hilton London Hyde Park is ideally located opposite Hyde Park, with Kensington Gardens just 400 meters away. Queensway and Bayswater Underground stations are equally close. This hotel offers a wide range of amenities, including a business center, concierge, fitness center, restaurant with room service, and breakfast options. Guests can enjoy convenient access to shopping at Oxford Street and Westfield Shopping Centre, just three Underground stops away. Kings Cross St. Pancras is a short taxi ride for Eurostar connections, and Paddington Station, with the Heathrow Express, is just one stop away. Spacious guest rooms feature generous workspaces, flat-screen TVs, ironing facilities, mini-fridges, laptop safes, and coffee machines. Complimentary Wi-Fi is available throughout the hotel. The hotel restaurant serves breakfast, lunch, and dinner, with seasonal dishes available. In the summer, guests can dine al fresco on the extensive open terrace. The bar is open until 11:00 pm. Two modern meeting rooms, suitable for boardroom meetings (up to 12 people) and interviews (up to 2 people), offer natural daylight and free Wi-Fi.

172693.description: Located in Kensington, London, this hotel is a short walk from attractions like Cromwell Road and Kensington High Street, and just three kilometers from Stamford Bridge Stadium. The stylish rooms are comfortably furnished and equipped with modern amenities, including climate control and ensuite bathrooms with eco-friendly toiletries and rain showers. Guests can enjoy a lounge bar, coffee shop, and rooftop terrace, along with 24-hour reception service. This classic hotel offers a comfortable home away from home experience in a prime location, ideal for both leisure and business travelers.

172694.description: This outstanding hotel is just 3 km from the International Convention Centre and the Bullring Shopping Centre. The property boasts elegantly furnished rooms with marble bathrooms. It features a stylish, modern bar and restaurant, free Wi-Fi and complimentary car parking also available at the hotel. All of the hotel's luxurious and spacious rooms include a wide choice of modern conveniences. Marble bathrooms offer large rain showers, bathrobes, and premium toiletries. The onsite restaurant serves classic British cuisine in a relaxing atmosphere with traditional cooked breakfasts available daily and the bar is an ideal place to enjoy a drink. The hotel is a 20-minute drive from Birmingham Airport and the NEC and is ideally located for all the City's major attractions.

172846.description: Blending perfectly into the historic surroundings of the Royal Mile, Hilton Edinburgh Carlton is an iconic element of the city. The building dates back to the 1900s and is part of the impressive North Bridge which links Edinburgh’s Old and New town together, giving you easy access to countless shopping, dining, and entertainment. Once one of Edinburgh’s top department stores, the building was fully refurbished in 2016 to bring the décor back to its stylish best. Our modern rooms offer complimentary WiFi, ergonomic work areas, and Suite Dreams by Serta® beds with luxurious linens. Select an executive room or suite for extra space and amenities, including access to the Executive Lounge, with complimentary breakfast and refreshments throughout the day. For an indulgent afternoon tea and a vast bar menu, pop into Herbie More's bar and Restaurant. Twenty-four-hour room service is also available. Enjoy our Fitness center which is open 24 hours for the Guests.

172872.description: Conveniently nestled in the charming suburb of the steeped in history city of Oxford, less than 10 kilometres from the famous Blenheim Palace, this chic hotel offers a unique lodge for business travellers and holidaymakers alike. A multitude of attractions to beguile the tourist and downtown Oxford are within less than 6. 5 kilometres away. Travellers may immerse themselves in the historical and cultural heritage, including the majestic Radcliffe Camera, the world-famous Oxford University, The New Theatre and the Bodleian Library. This impressive hotel offers oversized and bright rooms, where the commodious furniture and top-notch amenities create a cosy ambience. Travellers may start their day off with a wholesome breakfast and enjoy delicious dishes at the brasserie and sip refreshing drinks of aromatic coffee at the welcoming bar. Those who wish to balance the body and soul may benefit of an indoor pool, a spa, sauna and fitness centre.

172874.description: Offering a central location in Cardiff, this elegant hotel boasts Victorian architectural style and classical décor. The property lies right opposite the imposing Cardiff Castle and within walking distance of the Cardiff City Hall, Principality Stadium and the banks of the River Taff. Visitors will be impressed by the welcoming facilities and excellent services. Famous for its song festivals and historical attractions such as the Cardiff Castle are to be found within a short stroll. This impressive establishment boasts a wide range in the spacious and light-filled rooms and suites.   The flavourful continental breakfast is a perfect way to start one's day off on the right foot and throughout the day guests may dine on mouth-watering dishes from the hotel's restaurant or enjoy the afternoon tea. The hotel is dog-friendly.

173632.description: Boasting a privileged location, at only 5 km from London city centre and within walking distance from excellent public transport links, this cosy residence is an ideal place for those seeking an affordable accommodation close to all what the city has to offer. The hostel is situated at just 100 metres from Hyde Park and a 10-minute drive away from Buckingham Palace and Piccadilly Circus. Guests may choose between different types of accommodation units, ranging from shared to private rooms, all well-appointed with comfortable furniture and modern facilities to provide a pleasant stay. After a long day exploring the city, travellers may want to relax in the common lounge area, which is equipped with comfortable seating and a flat-screen TV for guests' entertainment. Other services include a cosy bar, a 24-hour reception and free Wi-Fi in public areas.

173843.description: Stay at the Apex Temple Court Hotel, a stylish hotel near the Strand, King's College London, and St. Paul's Cathedral. Enjoy amenities like a fitness center, terrace, two bars/lounges, and the Chambers restaurant with room service available during limited hours. The hotel offers 204 air-conditioned rooms featuring iPod docking stations, LED TVs, and private bathrooms. Complimentary Wi-Fi and digital programming are also provided. A business center, express check-in/out, and concierge services add to your convenience. Nearby attractions include the Royal Opera House, Tate Modern, and Covent Garden Market. London City Airport is 13 km away.

174290.description: Located in the heart of Dublin, Jacobs Inn Hostel offers convenient access to Trinity College and O'Connell Street, both within a 10-minute walk. Guests can enjoy a rooftop terrace, complimentary Wi-Fi, and tour/ticket assistance. The hostel features a restaurant, coffee shop, and bar/lounge. Buffet breakfast is available daily (fee applies). The 70 guestrooms include complimentary Wi-Fi, showers with rainfall showerheads, and daily housekeeping.

174434.description: Make use of convenient amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). This Victorian hotel also features gift shops/newsstands, a communal living room, and a vending machine. If you're ready for some gaming fun, you can hop on the casino shuttle (surcharge). Enjoy international cuisine at Stephanies Cafe/Bar, a café which features a bar/lounge, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Mingle with other guests at the complimentary reception, held daily. Buffet breakfasts are available daily from 7:30 AM to 10:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Planning an event in London? This hotel has 258 square feet (24 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and a meeting room. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 28 air-conditioned rooms featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions. Your Select Comfort bed comes with premium bedding. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and digital programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with shower/tub combinations feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Cromwell Road - 0. 2 km / 0. 1 mi- Holland Park - 0. 6 km / 0. 3 mi- Kensington High Street - 0. 7 km / 0. 4 mi- Design Museum - 0. 7 km / 0. 4 mi- Kensington Gardens - 1. 2 km / 0. 8 mi- Olympia Conference and Exhibition Centre - 1. 3 km / 0. 8 mi- Imperial College London - 1. 3 km / 0. 8 mi- Natural History Museum - 1. 6 km / 1 mi- Science Museum - 1. 6 km / 1 mi- Kensington Palace - 1. 7 km / 1. 1 mi- Royal Albert Hall - 1. 8 km / 1. 1 mi- Victoria and Albert Museum - 1. 8 km / 1. 1 mi- Hyde Park - 2. 1 km / 1. 3 mi- Portobello Road Market - 2. 2 km / 1. 3 mi- King's Road - 2. 3 km / 1. 4 mi.

174466.description: A well-appointed hotel near London Luton Airport, with dining and ample parkingHoliday Inn® London - Luton Airport hotel is a short walk or drive from the airport and a five-minute drive from the M1 motorway. Luton town centre is 2 miles away, as is Luton Airport Parkway station, which offers trains to central London in under 30 minutes. Stockwood Discovery Centre's beautiful gardens and fascinating historical exhibits are easily reachable by car. Wildlife experiences at Whipsnade Zoo and Woburn Safari Park are within 20 miles of our hotel. Warner Bros. Studio Tour: The Making of Harry Potter, a family favourite, is within a 25-minute drive. With on-site parking and excellent transport links, the hotel is a convenient meeting site. Two naturally lit conference rooms seat up to 80 people, and catering is available. At this hotel you can enjoy:- Free WiFi- Kids stay and eat free- Fitness CentreStart your day with a full English breakfast in the Grill & Kitchen Restaurant, also open for lunch and dinner. In the evening, unwind with a glass of wine in our bar, which combines sophisticated decor with a relaxed atmosphere. There's even a patio for good weather. Bedrooms have triple-glazed windows and a pillow menu to ensure a peaceful sleep. You can order something from 24-hour room service to savour as you watch a movie on the Smart TV.

174553.description: Set in the heart of Westfield Stratford’s urban shopping and entertainment complex, Hyatt House London Stratford offers spacious, apartment-style accommodations suitable for extended stays. Amenities such as a fully equipped kitchen and complimentary laundry room access help guests maintain their routine. Enjoy all-day dining in the Elondi Restaurant or a beverage on the fabulous terrace. With 24-hour gym access, complimentary wireless internet, and a grab-and-go market for essentials, you have everything you need to make your stay seamless. The hotel boasts fantastic connections to central London and the South East, allowing you to explore further afield or experience local attractions, including the Queen Elizabeth Olympic Park, home to iconic venues such as the Copper Box, ArcelorMittal Orbit, London Aquatics Centre, Lee Valley VeloPark, and the London Stadium, home to West Ham United football club.

174932.description: The Ampersand is an elegant boutique hotel in South Kensington. This beautifully restored Victorian treasure is a small luxury hotel near the V&A, Natural History Museum and many of London's most popular museums. It is also well located for Harrods and shopping in Knightsbridge, Hyde Park, Chelsea and the Kings Road. With South Kensington tube station just across the street, all of London is within easy reach.

175387.address: The Grove, Bath Road, Sipson, West Drayton
175387.description: The hustle and bustle of Heathrow is quickly forgotten once you enter the Hyatt Place Heathrow Airport hotel where our warm and welcoming lobby makes it easy to relax and unwind. Conveniently located with just a 5-minute drive from Heathrow Airport, the 4-star Hyatt Place Heathrow Airport hotel features spacious, soundproofed guest rooms, a 24-hour front desk and parking. Our newly refurbished, contemporary and spacious rooms are designed with comfort and convenience in mind; providing a place to unwind or to catch up on work with some of the rooms offering excellent views of the runway, you can relax in a peaceful and calm environment. A mini-fridge and a laptop safe are included in each of our fully air-conditioned rooms, all with a private bathroom and triple-glazed sound proof windows. A large 42inch HD TV, a hairdryer, alarm clock radio and tea and coffee making facilities have also been included for your convenience.

175389.description: Enjoy garden views and a terrace at The Crown Inn, along with amenities like complimentary Wi-Fi. Savor a meal at the Inn's restaurant or a drink at the bar/lounge. Start your day with a complimentary cooked-to-order breakfast, served daily between 7:30 AM and 9 AM. The Inn offers complimentary newspapers in the lobby, an elevator, and free self-parking. Each of the seven guestrooms features a flat-screen television, complimentary Wi-Fi, a private bathroom with complimentary toiletries and a hairdryer, a phone, a desk, and a coffee/tea maker. Nearby attractions include Eltham Palace (3. 4 mi), Greenwich Park (6. 4 mi), and the O2 Arena (8 mi). The nearest airports are London City (12. 9 mi) and Gatwick (38. 1 mi).

175391.description: An iconic hotel located in the heart of London's Covent Garden and surrounded by West End theatres, top sights, exclusive boutiques and the hottest restaurants. Where contemporary culture and design meets stunning architecture and bespoke service for an experience beyond accommodation. This lavish hotel enjoys an enviable setting right on the Strand in the very heart of London. Temple tube station can be reached in a five-minute walk, and Covent Garden and Charing Cross stations are also nearby, providing quick and incredibly easy access to all parts of this vibrant city. The hotel's luxurious Guestrooms and Suites offer contemporary design, state-of-art technology and floor-to-ceiling windows. Guests can enjoy fantastic city views from the stylish Radio Rooftop Restaurant and Terrace Bar, coffee and cocktails in the Marconi Lounge and vibe dining at the world-famous STK London. For travelers on a decadent city break or important business trip, this hotel is the perfect choice.

175732.description: The hotel is located just a 15-minute stroll from the Market Square of this beautiful old town. Zand Square, with its new concert hall and many bars and restaurants, is only 50 m away, and there are public transport connections within approximately 100 m. This city hotel comprises a total of 36 rooms. Guests are welcomed in the lobby. The hotel offers wireless Internet access and is entirely non-smoking. All rooms are en suite with a shower or bath and a hairdryer. Individually regulated heating is a standard feature in all accommodation. A full buffet breakfast is served in the elegant dining room.

176019.description: The Old Ship Inn Hackney, located next to the Hackney Empire, offers comfortable rooms above a classic British pub. Guests can enjoy food and drinks in our inviting bar and restaurant. Our ten well-appointed en-suite rooms feature hairdryers, complimentary toiletries, and tea and coffee making facilities. Each room blends the building's history with modern boutique style, offering comfortable singles and doubles, flat-screen TVs, and free Wi-Fi. Hackney Central station is a short two-minute walk, providing easy access to Stratford, Dalston, and central London via Highbury & Islington or the 55 bus to Oxford Circus. London Fields station, a five-minute walk, connects directly to Liverpool Street. Nearby attractions include the Hackney Empire, Arcola Theatre, Hackney Picture House, and Sutton House.

176565.description: Work, meet, dine, and experience the culture of London's East End at Holiday Inn London- Whitechapel. Surrounded by a popular art and fashion scene, our East London hotel offers spacious and inviting guest rooms. Enjoy global and English cuisine at 5 Cavell Street Kitchen and Bar. Ease into work mode in our coworking space or connect and celebrate in our meeting and event spaces. Experience London like a local. Our London hotel is within steps of well-known sites, including the Tower of London. Shop and dine at Old Spitalfields Market, Canary Wharf, or the curry restaurants on Brick Lane. We are a 10-minute walk to the London Underground Tube, Elizabeth Line and DLR trains at Whitechapel, Aldgate East, and Shadwell, with links to ExCeL London.

name.content: Best Western Plus Luna del Mar

176856.description: Discover the Best Western Plus Luna del Mar, nestled in the beautiful port of Manzanillo, Mexico. Located near the warm waters of the Pacific Ocean on the tranquil Las Brisas beach, our hotel offers the relaxing getaway you deserve. While there isn't an elevator on-site, 24-hour luggage assistance is available. Enjoy your stay.

177449.description: The Travelodge Gatwick Airport Central offers convenient access to Gatwick Airport, just a short drive away. This hotel features a restaurant and bar/lounge, and guests can enjoy a complimentary breakfast. The 254 air-conditioned guest rooms offer complimentary Wi-Fi and private bathrooms with bathtubs and hair dryers. Nearby attractions include the Archway Theatre and Gatwick Aviation Museum. Self-parking is available onsite (subject to charges).

177450.description: 'Beatlemaniac or art fanatic, Liverpool's got something to delight and inspire you. Our Liverpool Central The Strand hotel is right in the heart of the city, near the riverside, central shops and museums. The Albert Dock, Beatles Story and the Tate Liverpool are all within a mile of our hotel. It's also right by Liverpool ONE, a shopping haven combining high-street favourites and high-fashion brands. All rooms feature a comfy king size bed with four plump pillows and a cosy duvet. Our on-site restaurant and bar serves breakfast and tasty evening meals. '

name.content: Hotel De Castillion - Small elegant hotel

177601.description: Experience luxury and romance in the heart of Bruges at Hotel De Castillion, a family-run 4-star hotel. Located near St. Salvator's Cathedral and the Market Square, you'll be steps away from Bruges' exciting attractions. This 18th-century corner property, once home to Bruges' 15th bishop, is a listed heritage site. Today, the 20-room boutique hotel offers a blend of history and contemporary comfort. Start your day with a delicious breakfast in our medieval basement and end it with a drink in our cozy bar or Golden Art Deco Salon. We promise an unforgettable experience at Hotel De Castillion.

177602.description: This family-friendly hotel is situated in the historical centre of Bruges, just a few steps from the canal and within easy walking distance of a variety of cultural attractions. The Saint Salvador Cathedral, Groeningemuseum and Gruuthusemuseum are all within a ten-minute walk, and the Grote Markt is only 300 metres away. The hotel itself boasts a gothic façade dating from the 16th century and is thought to be the house where Flemish poet Guido Gezelle once wrote several poems. The stylish guest rooms feature a music theme and sleek, modern furnishings, all with a range of amenities inducing flat-screen televisions, minibars and Wi-Fi internet access. Guests might try the six-course menu offered in the romantic restaurant, and unwind with an afternoon coffee or evening cocktail in the opulent bar. This hotel's central location and cosy rooms make it a great base for exploring the medieval town centre of Bruges.

177807.description: Corinthia London is in the heart of London, within a 5-minute walk of Trafalgar Square and Horse Guard's Building. This luxury hotel is 0. 3 mi (0. 5 km) from National Gallery and 0. 5 mi (0. 8 km) from Big Ben. Pamper yourself with a visit to the spa, which offers massages, body treatments, and facials. You're sure to appreciate the recreational amenities, which include 2 indoor swimming pools, a sauna, and a 24-hour fitness center. This Victorian hotel also features complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and babysitting (surcharge). Make yourself at home in one of the 283 individually furnished guestrooms, featuring minibars and LCD televisions. Your memory foam bed comes with premium bedding. Complimentary wired and wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming provides entertainment. Private bathrooms with separate bathtubs and showers feature deep soaking bathtubs and rainfall showerheads. Enjoy Modern European cuisine at The Northall, one of the hotel's 4 restaurants, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Relax with a refreshing drink at one of the 2 bars/lounges. English breakfasts are served on weekdays from 6:30 AM to 10:30 AM and on weekends from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a 24-hour business center, limo/town car service, and complimentary newspapers in the lobby.

178289.description: Located in the heart of Dublin, the upscale Maldron Hotel Pearse Street is within a 15-minute walk of Trinity College and the Bord Gáis Energy Theatre. Enjoy views from the terrace and amenities such as complimentary Wi-Fi and concierge services. This hotel also offers wedding services and a vending machine. Each of the 115 guestrooms features an LCD television with satellite programming, complimentary Wi-Fi, a private bathroom with shower, complimentary toiletries and a hairdryer, a safe, and a desk. The hotel's Grain & Grill Restaurant serves lunch and dinner. A coffee shop/cafe and 24-hour room service are also available. Full breakfasts are served daily (7 AM to 10 AM) for a fee. Additional amenities include a business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. The hotel also features a conference center and meeting rooms. Self-parking is available onsite (subject to charges).

178431.description: The Comfort Inn Victoria offers luxurious accommodations in a beautifully preserved Victorian building, conveniently located near iconic London attractions. Guests are just minutes from Big Ben, the London Eye, Westminster Abbey, Buckingham Palace, Piccadilly Circus, and Oxford Street's renowned shopping district. Victoria Station, with mainline rail, underground (Tube), and bus connections, is within easy walking distance. Enjoy amenities such as complimentary continental breakfast, Wi-Fi, multilingual staff, and free local calls. Business travelers will appreciate in-room computer hookups and access to copy and fax services. All rooms feature coffee makers, desks, hair dryers, and cable television. Whether traveling for business or leisure, the Comfort Inn Victoria provides a comfortable and convenient base for exploring London. Children 14 and under sharing a room with two parents or grandparents receive complimentary extra bedding.

179139.description: Located in Frederick Street, the hotel is in a perfect central location, whether guests are visiting the city for a business break or a weekend getaway. Frederick Street is located off the city's premier shopping district - George Street, only minutes from boutique and high street shops alike. The hotel is equidistant to the East and West ends of the city, approximately 12 km from Edinburgh International Airport and a mere 5 minutes from Edinburgh Waverley Train Station. Glasgow International Airport is about 87 km away. This stylish city hotel has a total of 10 rooms. The premises are air-conditioned and guests are welcomed in a lobby. There is also a restaurant. Guests can take advantage of the Internet access and room service (the latter incurs an additional fee). The hotel offers the perfect antidote to unwelcoming corporate hotel chains. From the elegant walnut headboards to the enticing angora and lamb's wool blankets on the king-size beds, these are stylish Edinburgh hotel rooms. Each room has an en suite bathroom with a shower, bath and a hairdryer. All luxurious furniture has been custom designed and manufactured with comfort in mind, ensuring that the rooms are as calming as they are luxurious. Each room is equipped with a direct dial telephone, cable TV with DVD player and a sound system. A minibar, and tea and coffee making facilities are also provided. Breakfast can be delivered to rooms on request. Wireless Internet access, an ironing set and central heating are available. The restaurant serves traditional local dishes. A taxi from Edinburgh Airport will take each guest straight from door to door, whilst the Airlink Bus runs frequently between the airport and Edinburgh's Princes Street. If arriving by train, Edinburgh Waverley Station is around a 10-minute walk from the hotel.

179223.description: This hotel enjoys a strategic location, surrounded by the delights of Hammersmith. Within a short distance of the hotel, lie a host of local attractions. Guests can enjoy ease of access to an array of shopping opportunities, dining options and entertainment venues, where the essence and intrigue of the area can be uncovered. Guests will be impressed by the style and poise which the hotel displays. The hotel rooms are tastefully decorated, featuring soft, soothing tones and modern furnishings. The rooms come complete with modern amenities for added comfort and convenience. The hotel offers a warm, friendly atmosphere, alongside professional service, to ensure a memorable stay for each individual guest.

179295.description: Located at the mouth of the Tyne in South Shields, The Sea Hotel, Sure Hotel Collectionis ideally placed for taking trips to Sunderland and Newcastle; we're within easy reach of the A1 and A19. Above all, we're proud of our personality. . . and make every effort to make every stay superb. The friendly service, comfortable interiors and modern facilities certainly help us! For the business traveler, our meeting rooms are a must, while a secure car park means you can enjoy peace of mind in more ways than one. While you're here we recommend a stroll along the beautiful coast, though Beamish Open Air Museum, Durham Cathedral, Hadrian's Wall and the Angel of the North are well worth a look-see too! Enjoy your stay.

179314.description: We look forward to welcoming you at The Best Western Victoria Palace hotel in Central London, for a modern and cozy break in the capital. Whilst staying with us you will enjoy a prime location in the very heart of London, within walking distance of many of the city's most celebrated attractions. Buckingham Palace is less than a 20-minute walk away, so why not head there for 10:30 a. m. and get a good spot for the changing of the guard. You'll also be a 20 minute walk from the London Eye, for some breath-taking birds eye views of the city. Big Ben, Westminster Abbey, Trafalgar Square and Downing Street (to name a few) are also close by, meaning you'll be able to tick off all the biggest points of interest. For something a little more obscure – we'll have plenty of recommendations. Visit the night time food market Street Feast, Kayak down the Thames, or visit Jumeirah Carlton Tower for a spectacular 1960's afternoon tea. If you're visiting London for a weekend of spending, Carnaby Street and Oxford Street are both just 20 minutes away by tube. If you feel like a more extravagant splurge, London's highly exclusive Mayfair is also 20 minutes away. You're sure to work up an appetite during your day of sightseeing or shopping, so check out Time Out's listing of the best restaurants in London for some incredible - yet still very affordable – food spots. If you wish to venture away from London, we're proud to be a hugely convenient London hotel just five minutes' walk of Victoria Station and Victoria Coach Station.

179336.description: The Roker Hotel, BW Premier Collection® has been a landmark on the stunning North East coastline for decades and offers visits an unparalleled view of the sea. This classic hotel retains its traditional feel but with all the modern comforts, including rooms with state-of-the-art facilities. Guests can enjoy the many amenities including two very different - but equally as stunning – restaurants the Tavistock Italia and Tavistock Thai China which serve the best of Italian and Oriental cuisine.

179338.description: The Best Western Grand Hotel in Hartlepool offers the best of both worlds. Combining old and new, the traditional French Chateaux building plays host to a modern décor inside, while its wonderful coastal location is convenient for a number of inland attractions. Thanks to good transport links, our guests can not only get away from it all but get back to it easily too! Newcastle is within easy reach, while other northern cities and towns are also easily accessible. Wherever you decide to go during your stay, we'll be ready and waiting with a warm welcome on your return.

name.content: Derwent Manor Hotel, BW Premier Collection

179367.description: The Derwent Manor Hotel, BW Premier Collection is a delightful hotel near Durham that enjoys a rural location on the outskirts of Consett, nestled amongst 20 acres of Northumberland countryside. It’s right on the edge of an area of outstanding natural beauty in the North Pennines, overlooking Derwent Valley and yet is easily accessible from the A68. This hotel near Beamish is perfectly placed for those who want to see everything Northumberland and the North East has to offer. It’s just 30 minutes from the vibrant cities of Newcastle and Durham - so you'll have your pick of things to do. Famous attractions include the magnificent Durham Cathedral, the 360 indoor shops in the Gateshead Metro Centre and the historic coast-to-coast Roman construction, Hadrian’s Wall. The delightful market towns of Hexham and Corbridge, along with popular visitor attractions like Beamish Open Air Museum are also close-by - so you'll have ample opportunity to get out and about. Go walking, cycling, fishing or horse riding and see even more of the great outdoors. However if you’d prefer to stay close, the Derwent Manor Hotel, BW Premier Collection has its own on-site leisure facilities – including swimming pool, gym and sauna. If you’re looking for the ideal spot to hold a business meeting, the Derwent Manor Hotel, BW Premier Collection has several spacious suites – making this a fantastic conference hotel near Newcastle. The same facilities mean that this is a wonderful place to hold a wedding celebration too, with epic views of the Derwent Valley as your backdrop. With the Derwent Manor Hotel, BW Premier Collection as your base, the North East is yours to explore.

name.content: Best Western Mornington Hotel London Hyde Park

179390.description: The Best Western Mornington Hotel London Hyde Park enjoys a great location in the heart of Greater London. Close to Lancaster Gate tube and buses, our accommodation has been elegantly re-designed and is fully equipped! Our bedrooms are, of course, comfortable. . . and complemented by our intimate Library Bar which serves drinks and light snacks. Please note that whilst we only have a breakfast restaurant, there are a variety of good restaurants nearby. The great news is our free high-speed wireless Internet access will help you find them all! Shopping opportunities are countless in the capital, but if you simply want to wander around and see the sights, Hyde Park is the perfect starting point! The West End is less than two miles away if you fancy a show, and The Victoria & Albert and Natural History Museums will enthrall you as you explore. Enjoy your stay.

179392.description: This charming hotel is set amidst 3 acres of Strathaven countryside, just a short driving distance from East Kilbride. This delightful hotel is located in close proximity to a number of attractions in the area, including the Scottish Museum of Rural Life, Strathclyde Park Watersports and Country Park, Calderglen Country Park and Low Waters Museum. Guests will find themselves in close proximity to a number of shopping, dining and entertainment venues. This 18th century hotel was built in the style of Robert Adam Junior, and has embraced period elements. The guest rooms are sumptuously appointed, and provide a cocoon of peace and serenity in which to work and rest in comfort. Business and leisure travellers alike will appreciate the exemplary facilities the hotel has to offer.

name.content: Best Western Glasgow South Eglinton Arms Hotel

179395.description: Nestled in the semi-rural village of Eaglesham, the Best Western Glasgow South Eglinton Arms Hotel, a former coaching inn, has been a landmark since the mid-18th century. As Scotland's first conservation village, Eaglesham offers a quiet, relaxing escape from the hustle and bustle of city life. We are only eight miles from Glasgow, renowned for its architecture and shopping. Explore the Merchant City area, known as Little Italy, with its boutique shops and restaurants. For golf enthusiasts, the world-famous Turnberry Golf Course is just 20 miles away. Scotland's national stadium, Hampden Park, home to major sporting events and concerts, is only six miles away. Enjoy your stay.

179402.description: If you’re looking for a place to stay in London, the Best Western Swiss Cottage Hotel offers the best of both worlds. In a pleasant residential area near Regents Park, you’ll enjoy peace and quiet during your stay. Yet with London’s countless attractions just a few minutes away, the sights and sounds of the capital are never far away. This elegant Victorian townhouse is full of character and fascinating objets d’art, which add a unique charm to the hotel – including a grand piano, oil paintings and antique furniture. You can be sure your stay here will be memorable for all the right reasons. Our hotel is right next to Swiss Cottage tube station and just a few minutes from the West End by tube or bus. The Jubilee line links us directly to Lord's cricket ground, Madam Tussauds, Oxford Street, Big Ben, Wembley arena and many other attractions - so you'll spend more time deciding where to go than you will getting there. There are lots of convenient bars, bistros and brasseries around the hotel and for these reasons we have no restaurant for lunch or dinner. Instead, we provide a pleasant breakfast room that serves a range of cooked and continental items to give you the energy boost you need for a day of sightseeing.

179409.description: Completely rebuilt in 2015, this modern hotel in Central London offers innovatively designed, air-conditioned rooms. Relaxing rain showers, media streaming, large smart TVs, and touch-controlled mood lighting create a chic base for exploring the city. The Best Western Plus Delmere Hotel is a 5-minute stroll from Paddington Station and the Heathrow Express, with an airport journey time of only 15 minutes. Excellent tube and bus connections provide easy access to all major London sights. You'll be a stone's throw from Hyde Park and within walking distance of world-class shopping on Oxford Street and Soho's vibrant nightlife. For rainy days, there's a direct tube connection to both Westfield shopping centers. The local restaurant scene offers a vast selection for every budget, and numerous traditional pubs provide further choices. In the hotel, you'll find The Hub, offering complimentary tea and coffee—an ideal place to relax before exploring London. Our cozy and stylish rooms perfectly reflect the city's focus on style.

name.content: ibis budget London Whitechapel - Brick Lane

179527.description: Looking for a stylish and affordable stay close to central London, Ibis Budget London Whitechapel is an excellent choice. Located just a 7-minute walk from both Whitechapel and Aldgate stations, the hotel offers easy access to the best of East London. Enjoy a fresh continental breakfast to start your day, grab snacks whenever you need them, and explore nearby highlights like Brick Lane and Spitalfields Market—well known for their vibrant street food, art scene, and vintage shopping.

name.content: The Royal Hotel and Merrill Leisure Club

179610.description: This upscale hotel boasts a prime setting in the vibrant surroundings of Sandyford and is a short distance away from the main shopping venues in the area, as well as a host of dining options and entertainment venues. The hotel exudes elegance and sophistication, instantly impressing each individual guest. Enjoying the tranquil surroundings of Wicklow, guests can enjoy breath-taking natural beauty, as well as a host of recreational activities. Guests will be impressed by the eloquent style and poise that the hotel displays. The guest rooms are elegantly appointed, and come complete with modern amenities for added comfort and convenience.
