This hotel is 0. 6 mi (0. 9 km) from Victoria Station Travel Information Centre and 1. 2 mi (2 km) from Big Ben.

312018.description: Indulge in massages and facials at this luxurious hotel, and enjoy amenities such as an indoor pool and fitness center. Stay connected with complimentary wired and wireless internet access, and benefit from concierge and babysitting services (surcharge). Dine at the Brumus Bar and Restaurant, featuring a bar/lounge, or order 24-hour room service. Full breakfasts are available daily (fee applies). The hotel also offers complimentary wired internet access, newspapers in the lobby, and dry cleaning/laundry services. Each of the 50 individually decorated guestrooms features a minibar, LED television, Tempur-Pedic bed with down comforters and Egyptian cotton sheets, and satellite programming. Private bathrooms include designer toiletries and hair dryers. Located near Regent Street, Trafalgar Square, and the National Gallery, the hotel is conveniently close to London's top attractions. The nearest airports are London City (LCY), Heathrow (LHR), and Gatwick (LGW).

312022.description: The 40 welcoming units offer a perfect place to relax at the end of the day. In addition, Wi-Fi access is offered at the establishment's common spaces. The hotel provides 24-hour reception. The hotel may charge a fee for some services.

name.content: Canary Riverside Plaza London, Vignette Collection

312034.description:
Set against the historic quays and wharves of Canary Wharf, Canary Riverside Plaza London, Vignette Collection is a place with a story to tell. We offer a stay that feels personal, characterful and entirely your own. 

Each of our 141 rooms and suites is more than a place to rest – it is a calm riverside retreat, framed by sweeping views of the River Thames and the unmistakable London skyline. Whether you arrive for business or pleasure, every detail is considered to make you feel at home. 

Unwind in the adjoining Health Club & Spa, a tranquil sanctuary to restore body and mind. Or linger over vibrant Italian flavours at Quadrato, where the terrace and a celebrated afternoon tea invite you to slow down and savour the moment. 

In one of London's most spirited neighbourhoods, Canary Riverside Plaza London is your own quiet corner of the city – crafted with character, and waiting to be discovered.

312035.description: Those wishing to escape the hustle and bustle of daily routine will find peace and tranquillity at this hotel.

312054.description:
The hotel consists of 40 rooms. The property offers Wi-Fi internet connection on-site. This hotel does not operate a 24-hour reception. Some services of George Hotel may be payable. 

Please note - THIS SMALL SINGLE ROOM ROOM IS SUITABLE FOR A SHORT STAY DUE TO LIMITED SPACE AND BED SIZE (75CM WIDE)

312079.description: The premises count with 21 welcoming guest rooms. West Cromwell offers Wi-Fi internet connection in communal areas. All guests staying at this property are welcomed in a lobby with 24-hour reception. Some services of West Cromwell may be payable.

312082.description: In an elegant Victorian building, Brook Green Hotel is a traditional pub offering free Wi-Fi, real ales and home-cooked food. The hotel is just a 10 minute walk from the O2 Shepherds Bush Empire. The simple, stylish bedrooms at Brook Green have air conditioning and tea/coffee facilities. All rooms feature a flat-screen TV, suit press and a private modern bathroom with a hairdryer. Guests can enjoy a full English breakfast each morning, and hearty evening meals are also available. The cozy pub also features real open fires, leather sofas and a pretty terrace. Less than half a mile from Hammersmith Underground Station, The Brook Green Hotel is 1. 5 miles from Earls Court Exhibition Centre. Hammersmith Apollo is only half a mile away.

name.content: 100 Queens Gate Hotel, Curio Collection by Hilton

312099.description: Boasting a prime location in the prestigious Royal Borough of Kensington and Chelsea, 100 Queen's Gate Hotel London, Curio Collection by Hilton, is on the doorstep of iconic cultural attractions including the Royal Albert Hall, Natural History Museum, Science Museum, and Victoria & Albert Museum. Enjoy a leisurely stroll from our historic, Victorian-style hotel to Harrods, Notting Hill, Kensington Palace, Hyde Park and the designer boutiques of Knightsbridge. Following a multimillion-pound refurbishment, guest rooms and suites at our Kensington hotel exude elegance and feature complimentary WiFi, electronic newspapers, 49-inch flat-screen HDTVs with Chromecast, and bathroom amenities by Floris London. Unwind in a stylish Deluxe or Luxury bedroom with upgraded amenities and additional space. For a unique experience, select a two-level Duplex suite, boasting a top-floor location. Enjoy a workout in our state-of-the-art gymnasium or host a small meeting in one of two elegant boardrooms. Enjoy classic Italian cuisine at our signature restaurant Cento, or unwind with a late-night drink in our concept cocktail bar ESQ. For a traditional Botanical Afternoon Tea or pre-theater drinks in a sophisticated atrium setting, visit Botanica. 100 Queen's Gate Hotel London offers 24-hour room service so you can dine in the comfort of your room or suite, day or night.

312112.description: The Darlington Hyde Park offers a convenient London location, just a short walk from Hyde Park and Kensington Gardens. Enjoy a meal at the on-site restaurant, or take advantage of amenities such as the 24-hour front desk, laundry facilities and lift. Each of the 40 guestrooms features a flat-screen television, refrigerator, complimentary Wi-Fi, in-room safe, and work desk. Housekeeping is available upon request. Nearby attractions include Paddington Central, Marble Arch and Kensington Palace.

312114.description: Located in the Islington district in London, The Luxury Inn offers 3-star rooms with free WiFi. Among the various facilities are a garden and a shared lounge. Attractions in the area include Islington, 0. 9 mi away, or Emirates Stadium, set 1. 2 mi from the property. All rooms at this boutique hotel are equipped with a coffee machine. Every room is fitted with a flat-screen TV, and some rooms are equipped with a patio. Guests will have access to the shared lounge, kitchen and dining area provided. A continental self-serving breakfast is available daily at The Luxury Inn. Hoxton Square is 1. 2 mi from The Luxury Inn. London City Airport is 6. 2 mi from the property.

312117.description: This charming hotel is situated in Islington. The establishment comprises 41 cosy rooms. Islington Inn is an ideal base for business trips, long weekend breaks, sight-seeing trips, visits to London theatres, museums, galleries, historic buildings and all the other attractions that London has to offer. Those staying at this hotel may surf on the internet thanks to the Wi-Fi access ready to use on public areas. The property provides 24-hour reception. Pets are not allowed at Islington Inn. Hotel is not serving breakfast due to pandemic and until further notice.

312133.description: Royal London Hotel is a family run hotel only 10 minutes' walk from Hammersmith Underground and Bus station and 5 minutes from Shepherds Bush Underground station. Close to Westfield shopping centre or Shepherds Bush O2 Empire. Guests can enjoy a 3-star bed and breakfast accomodation, with easy access to many parts of London. All the rooms are en suite, with free Wi-Fi, a fridge, tea and coffee making facilities. There is a breakfast Lounge that guests can use to plan the day ahead in London. Lots of maps, tourist information and more is available on request. A continental breakfast is served in the morning.

312159.description: Next to Kings Cross Station and the Eurostar service at St Pancras Station, The Carlton Hotel is an ideally located budget hotel in central London, complete with free Wi-Fi internet. Just 656 ft down the road is The British Library, and restaurants and bars are also within walking distance. Oxford Street, Covent Garden and Leicester Square are all approximately 15 minutes away by Underground. Well-equipped rooms all include a TV, tea and coffee making facilities and a private shower room. Hairdryers and ironing facilities are available from reception. The Carlton Hotel has friendly service, luggage storage and a 24-hour reception for late arrivals. Guests at The Carlton have easy access to the London airports from Kings Cross Station, which is just a 3-minute walk across the road.

312238.description: Home to 130 guest bedrooms with invigorating en suite power showers, our affordable Ibis Budget Barking hotel sets you up with everything you need under one roof. Guests benefit from a choice of well-appointed triple, double and twin bedrooms, a friendly service around the clock, spotless attention to detail and nearby conveniences including a Tesco Superstore right next door.

312257.description: Located a mere 500 meters from Paddington Station and a short 5-minute stroll from Hyde Park, this hotel offers convenient access to London's key attractions. The Victoria & Albert and Science Museums are less than 2. 4 km away, and direct trains to Heathrow Airport depart regularly from Paddington. The hotel features artistically decorated bedrooms with complimentary Wi-Fi, along with an open-plan restaurant and bar serving traditional dishes and a full English breakfast each morning. Recently refurbished, each room boasts high-quality furnishings and an opulent artistic touch, reflecting the owner's passion for art. In-room amenities include a TV, complimentary wireless internet, tea/coffee making facilities, a refrigerator, and a private bathroom with a shower and hairdryer.

312272.description: Located in the heart of London, The Fairway Hotel offers convenient access to top attractions like Trafalgar Square and Piccadilly Circus, both within a 10-minute drive. This hotel provides 30 comfortable guestrooms equipped with complimentary Wi-Fi, desks, coffee/tea makers, and en suite bathrooms with showers and hair dryers. Guests can also enjoy amenities such as room service (limited hours), tour/ticket assistance, luggage storage, and a safe deposit box at the front desk. Nearby attractions include University College London, Russell Square, and The British Museum.

312309.description: With a stay at Abbey Point Cafe and B&B in London (Park Royal), you'll be a 5-minute drive from SSE Arena, Wembley and 10 minutes from Portobello Road Market. This bed & breakfast is 3. 5 mi (5. 6 km) from Wembley Stadium and 3. 8 mi (6. 2 km) from Westfield London Shopping Centre. Free self parking is available onsite. At Abbey Point Cafe and B&B, enjoy a satisfying meal at the restaurant. Breakfast is available for a fee. Make yourself at home in one of the 19 guestrooms.

312345.description: In Horley, 5 minutes away from Gatwick Airport. Holiday parking is available. Well placed for Gatwick Airport, the Corner House Hotel Gatwick with Holiday Parking offers a friendly atmosphere in which you can completely relax. The Gatwick Corner House is 25 miles away from central London, which is easily accessible by train.

312350.description: This establishment offers a total of 25 units.

312372.description: This cosy accomodation guarantees a quiet stay as it counts with just 12 accomodation units. Everyone staying at this accommodation may take advantage of the Wi-Fi connection on public areas at The Lawn Guest House. This hotel does not operate a 24-hour reception. A fee may be chargeable for some services.

312376.description: This modern bed and breakfast sits overlooking a private garden square, opposite Kings Cross and St. Pancras train station. The property is located in close proximity to a wide range of attractions in the area, enjoying ease of access to the centre of the city. This bed and breakfast is set in a Georgian townhouse. The property focus on offering comfortable accommodation in a convenient location. The tastefully-designed guest rooms are serviced daily, and come well equipped with modern amenities. Guests are invited to enjoy a sumptuous breakfast in the mornings, before setting off to explore everything that London has to offer.

312377.description: This cosy establishment guarantees a quiet stay as it counts with just 8 units. Norbury ApartHotel offers Wi-Fi internet connection in communal areas. Norbury ApartHotel does not offer 24-hour reception. Some services may be subject to additional charges.

312417.description: Located in 25 acres on the banks of the River Thames at Teddington Lock, The Lensbury Resort provides an inspirational backdrop for your next stay. With a famous 100 years of sporting history, The Lensbury is host to leading leisure facilities, elegant hotel bedrooms and an abundance of local attractions. The Lensbury is conveniently located, as well as offering complimentary guest car parking. 155 bedrooms 25 acres on the banks of the River Thames Wide ranging leisure facilities including 22 tennis courts, state-of-the-art gym, swimming pool and fitness studios Lounge and Terrace Restaurant serving modern British menu and range of event menus Water sports centre with access to the River Thames including motor boats, kayaks, canoes and sailing boatsSpa treatment rooms offering a range of ELEMIS treatments

312425.description: Ideally located at the heart of London, this property is surrounded by ample opportunities for exploration and discovery. Convenient links to the public transport network can be found nearby. Guests will find themselves in close proximity to a host of attractions, as well as a wealth of shopping, dining and entertainment opportunities. The hotel mixes traditional and contemporary decor, to reflect the elegance and charm of the city. The property accents refined comfort, offering luxurious accommodation options. The hotel provides a warm blend of elegance and comfort, making each and every stay memorable. Guests can indulge in the ultimate relaxation in the spa, with treatments and pampering to enhance the experience.

312439.description: Offering the ideal setting for explore the area, this family-run guest house is situated in Surbiton, Surrey. The property is ideally situated close to the A3, offering ease of access to Kingston Town Centre, Hampton Court, Chessington Zoo, Sandown and Epsom Race Courses. Guests are extended a warm, friendly welcome upon arrival. The guest rooms are well equipped and tastefully designed, offering comfort and style in a peaceful setting. This guest house provides an excellent standard of accommodation, customer service and comfort in a convenient location, making it a great choice for business and leisure travellers alike.

312462.description: Everyone staying at this accommodation will enjoy a peaceful and calm stay at Guilford House as it counts with a total of 12 guest rooms. The establishment's common areas include Wi-Fi internet connection. Travellers can enjoy the convenience of 24-hour reception. Guilford House follows environmentally sustainable practices.

312465.description: Sanctum Soho Hotel is an oasis of comfort, style and sophistication in the heart of London's buzzing West End. Situated on Warwick Street, two beautiful Georgian townhouses have been converted into a sumptuous 30-bedroom boutique hotel with luxurious event spaces. Sanctum Soho Hotel is an oasis of comfort, style and sophistication in the heart of London's buzzing West End. Situated on Warwick Street, two beautiful Georgian townhouses have been converted into a sumptuous 30-bedroom boutique hotel with luxurious event spaces.

312501.description: A 10-minute walk from Hyde Park and 5 minutes' walk from Edgware Road Tube Station, OYO 24 Sussex, London Paddington offers bed and breakfast accommodation and free Wi-Fi in the heart of London. All rooms at OYO 24 Sussex, London Paddington have a flat-screen TV and tea/coffee making facilities. Most rooms feature an en-suite bathroom with a shower. Guests can enjoy breakfast every morning in the dining area. The hotel is a 15-minute walk from Paddington Station, reaching Heathrow Airport after just a 15-minute train journey. The shops of Oxford Street are a 13-minute stroll away. The world famous Madame Tussauds wax museum is less than 20 minutes' walk away. The West End, containing many of the city's major tourist attractions, shops and entertainment venues, is a 20-minute Tube journey away. Westminster Borough is a great choice for travellers interested in shopping, parks and city walks. Couples particularly like the location — they rated it 9. 3 for a two-person trip. Note- A damage deposit of GBP 50 is required on arrival.

312532.description: Stay at Premier Inn Hotel Loughton/Buckhurst Hill, and you'll be just up the road from some famous filming locations for The Only Way is Essex. Central London is just a tube ride away too, and there are plenty of great tourist venues, business centres and family days out just waiting for you. Visit Belles & Beaus or Pet Couture to see if they're filming TOWIE. Or get away from it all wandering through the tranquillity of Epping Forest. Go bargain hunting at Stratford City Shopping Centre, or catch sporting or music events at the Olympic Stadium. Then come back to the hotel to a lovely comfy bed. All reservations placed at this hotel are subject to Premier Inn’s standard Terms and Conditions, which can be found at premierinn. com

312564.description: This Victorian hotel is centrally located in London, just a 5 minutes' walking distance away from Victoria rail and coach station. Buckingham Palace, Hyde Park and Harrods can be found just a short distance away. Guests are greeted with warm hospitality and excellent service. Stylish guest rooms offer comfort and convenience, featuring modern amenities. The hotel offers a wide range of facilities and services, attending to the needs of every type of traveller. Complimentary internet access is available, perfect for those who are eager to keep in touch with work or home. Complemented by excellent customer service, this hotel offers everything that guests will need for a comfortable stay.

312581.description: Situated in the city centre of London, this delightful hotel offers close proximity to many of the city's tourist attractions. Guests will find themselves just a short walking distance away from Buckingham Palace, Big Ben, Westminster Abbey and the Houses of Parliament. A treasure trove of shopping opportunities, dining options and entertainment venues can also be found nearby. Convenient links to the public transport network are readily accessible in the area. This charming property is perfect for business and leisure travellers alike. The guest rooms offer a high level of comfort and convenience. Guests are invited to avail of the many facilities and services that the property has to offer.

312590.description: The premises count with 50 welcoming units. Antoinette Wimbledon includes Wi-Fi internet connection in all public areas and rooms. The hotel provides 24-hour reception.

312655.description:
A stay at Hotel Earls Court places you in the heart of London, within a 5-minute drive of Stamford Bridge Stadium and Hyde Park. This hotel is 3. 6 mi (5. 8 km) from Buckingham Palace and 3. 8 mi (6. 1 km) from Piccadilly Circus. 
Make use of convenient amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access, tour/ticket assistance, and a vending machine. 
Featured amenities include a 24-hour front desk, luggage storage, and a safe deposit box at the front desk. 
Stay in one of 20 guestrooms featuring LCD televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access is available to keep you connected. Bathrooms have shower/tub combinations and hair dryers. Housekeeping is provided daily, and irons/ironing boards can be requested.

312660.description: Wake up just seconds away from the world's most iconic landmarks at our London Tower Bridge hotel. The hotel features our super comfy new generation bedrooms, with an impressive 40" flat screen TV, freshly-updated bathroom with large shower head, and kingsize Hypnos bed. After a great night's sleep and famous Premier Inn Breakfast, you'll be in sightseeing heaven within minutes - from the Tower of London and HMS Belfast to the Shard and Canary Wharf. Explore the history of the capital at world-renowned attractions. Discover new bars along the whole of the Southbank. Take to the river to get a fresh view of the city. And when you've ticked all the must-sees off your list, return to a top- notch restaurant and those extra-comfy beds. All reservations placed at this hotel are subject to Premier Inn’s standard Terms and Conditions, which can be found at premierinn. com

312714.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as a fitness center, or other amenities including complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the hotel's room service (during limited hours). English breakfasts are served on weekdays from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM and on weekends from 8:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, express check-in, and express check-out. Planning an event in London? This hotel has 1840 square feet (171 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and meeting rooms. Make yourself at home in one of the 265 guestrooms featuring iPod docking stations and flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and cable programming is available for your entertainment. Bathrooms have showers and hair dryers. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0.

312730.description: The Webster Covent Garden located on Lincoln’s Inn Fields and comprise 167 bedrooms. The Webster’s design has been brought to life by London-based architecture and interior design studio Red Deer. Guestrooms feature warm neutral palettes and textured plank flooring, alongside hand-knotted wool rugs and bespoke light fixtures of brass and alabaster. Nostalgic details include Marshall speakers, Jacob Jensen phones, classic alarm clocks, and hand-selected books, while bedrooms also feature bespoke artwork and custom-patterned drapery. Bathrooms feature terrazzo flooring and organic ceramic wall tiles in neutral tones, accented by brushed-nickel Kohler fixtures and softly illuminated mirrors. The Webster Covent Garden will offer a trio of dining and drinking destinations inspired by Italy. Italian-inspired restaurant and speakeasy, Carmelina’s, is located on the hotel’s lower level and features deep red velvets and a sculptural gold-hammered bar. Live jazz will also be offered during the evenings.

312741.description: Sydney House is a contemporary townhouse hotel, just a short walk from King's Road and Knightsbridge. Behind its listed Georgian façade lies a thoroughly modern hotel. Each of the 21 air-conditioned bedrooms is designed for comfort, featuring the finest linens, goose-down duvets, and sleek glass bathrooms. Individually designed, all rooms have discreetly integrated technology, including DVD players, flat-screen TVs, and Wi-Fi. With 24-hour room service and à la carte breakfast, Sydney House offers the experience of a 'Private Home in the City. '

312863.description: This apartment complex enjoys a prime London location, just 100 meters from St. Paul's Cathedral and a five-minute walk from St. Paul's Underground Station. The vibrant South Bank and Tate Modern are a short 10-minute walk away, placing guests near a wide array of shopping, dining, and entertainment options. This charming complex offers beautifully designed apartments, each exuding character and style. Modern amenities provide comfort and convenience for both business and leisure travelers. Please note: Due to the Coronavirus (COVID-19) pandemic, this property is not currently accepting visitors.

312900.description: Enjoy garden and terrace views at this Ealing hotel, featuring complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and a picnic area. The 29 guestrooms offer flat-screen TVs with cable, private bathrooms with complimentary toiletries and hair dryers, coffee/tea makers, and bottled water. Free self-parking is available onsite. Located near the Thames River, Hotel 55 is a short drive from Wembley Stadium and Westfield London Shopping Centre. Heathrow Airport is the closest airport.

312922.description: The Corner House hotel is a newly refurbished property, re-opened for its guests in 2008. It is located in a residential area within easy walking distance of the world famous Camden Market and Regents Park, 5 minutes from both Kentish Town and Camden underground stations. A bus stop with links to all major attractions in London is conveniently positioned just opposite the hotel. The rooms are all of medium size and brightly decorated with cream walls, warm coloured fabrics, oil paintings, wooden furniture and new, solid oak wooden floors. All rooms are equipped with plasma televisions, hair dryer, telephone and tea/coffee making facilities. The small bathrooms are all tiled up to the ceiling and have been equipped with bath tubs and showers. Both the bedrooms and bathrooms are in excellent condition, having been completely rebuilt and renovated in March 2008. This lovely hotel is located on the Camden Road, just ten minutes away from central London, a short walk from Kentish Town underground station and a ten minutes bus ride from Kings Cross underground and railway station. Fashionable Camden Town and Camden Market are only 10 minutes walk away.

312962.description: This property offers a total of 25 guest rooms. Boxmoor Lodge does not offer 24-hour reception.

312970.description: This magnificent hotel is ideally located in Marylebone. The property is situated just a 10 minutes' walking distance away from Wallace Collection, Selfridges, Madame Tussauds Wax Museum, Marble Arch and the Royal Academy of Museum. The hotel boasts a stunning, grand exterior, tempting visitors with a stay steeped in culture, history and luxury. The rooms are classically designed in a Victorian style, oozing character and charm. Guests can enjoy a sumptuous dining experience in the elegant surroundings of the restaurant. This property prides itself on attention to detail, as well as providing impeccable service and warm, friendly hospitality. Discerning business and leisure travellers are assured of a memorable stay at this property.

312972.description: This charming property is located at the heart of the historical area of Old Harlow. This establishment is surrounded by attractive streets and listed buildings, amidst the peace and serenity of Mulberry Green. The property is perfectly located for trips to the nearby Paradise Wildlife Park, historical Bishop's Stortford, and Bluewater and Lakeside shopping centres. This wonderful property is a 14th-century, former coaching station. Beautifully retaining its old-world charm, combined with conetmporary convenience, this property is sure to impress. The guest rooms ooze rustic elegance, yet offer modern, up-to-date amenities. Business and leisure travellers will appreciate the facilities that this establishment has to offer.

315151.description:
EXPERIENCE LONDON FROM ONE OF ITS MOST DISTINGUISHED ADDRESSES. 

At 54 Queen’s Gate, luxury is paired with the warmth and comfort of home—right in the heart of South Kensington, one of London’s most desirable postcodes. A short stroll from the peaceful edges of Hyde Park, this Grade II listed Edwardian townhouse has been beautifully transformed into an intimate boutique retreat where elegance, character, and relaxation come naturally. 

Offering more than a place to stay— it’s a luxurious home away from home. Expect attentive service, a calm boutique atmosphere, and the comfort of a space designed for both relaxation and exploration. Step outside and London’s finest attractions await: Hyde Park, Kensington Palace, the Natural History Museum, and the V&A are all within easy walking distance. The neighborhood’s stylish cafés, elegant bars, celebrated restaurants, and the world-class shopping of Knightsbridge—including the iconic Harrods—are right at your doorstep. 

Our 24 bedrooms offers a unique blend of comfort, style, and individuality. Arranged across four distinctive categories, every room is thoughtfully designed with décor inspired by some of Kensington’s most celebrated past residents. 

From Churchill to Coleridge, Eliot to Elgar, the rooms reflect the character and elegance of these iconic figures, creating spaces that are both sumptuous and wonderfully private. Perfect for discerning travelers, each room provides a tranquil retreat in the heart of West London. 

All rooms are equipped with modern conveniences to ensure a seamless stay, including en-suite showers, air-conditioning, high-speed Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs with streaming services, a hairdryer, ironing station, coffee and tea-making facilities, complimentary bottled water, a minibar with soft drinks, and a secure laptop safe. Every detail is designed to make your stay effortless, relaxing, and memorable.

315693.description: The Hanover Hotel, centrally located in Liverpool, is steps from Liverpool ONE and an 8-minute walk from Royal Albert Dock. This hotel offers 26 guestrooms equipped with complimentary Wi-Fi, safes, and desks. Bathrooms feature shower/tub combinations and hair dryers. Enjoy on-site dining at our restaurant and bar/lounge, or grab a quick bite at the snack bar/deli. Recreational amenities include a nightclub and an arcade/game room. We also provide express check-out, a 24-hour front desk, and luggage storage. Nearby attractions include the Cavern Club (0. 6 km) and Liverpool Empire Theatre (0. 7 km).

315738.description: The ibis London Excel Docklands hotel, located in London's Docklands, is a short walk from the ExCeL Exhibition Centre and a quick drive from the Thames River. This eco-certified hotel offers 278 guestrooms equipped with flat-screen TVs, complimentary Wi-Fi, and satellite programming. Bathrooms include showers and hair dryers, while rooms also feature safes and desks. Enjoy a meal at the hotel's FOGGS restaurant, a quick bite at the snack bar/deli, or a drink at the bar/lounge. A buffet breakfast is available daily for a fee. Hotel amenities include a business center, express check-in/check-out, and on-site parking (for a fee).

315757.description: Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi and concierge services at Oliver Plaza. Take advantage of the area shuttle (surcharge) to nearby destinations. The on-site restaurant offers a satisfying meal, with buffet breakfasts available for a fee on weekdays from 7:30 AM to 9:30 AM and weekends from 8:00 AM to 10:00 AM. Featured amenities include a 24-hour front desk, multilingual staff, and luggage storage. Self-parking is available for a fee. Each of the 49 guestrooms features a flat-screen television with satellite programming, complimentary Wi-Fi, a safe, and a coffee/tea maker. Private bathrooms include complimentary toiletries and a hairdryer. Housekeeping is provided daily. The hotel is conveniently located near Cromwell Road (0. 5 km) and Kensington High Street (1 km).

315783.description: This smoke-free inn offers convenient golf lessons nearby. Enjoy a meal at the Fox and Grapes restaurant, and unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. For your convenience, express check-in and check-out are available. The inn features three air-conditioned rooms, each equipped with complimentary minibar items, an espresso maker, and free Wi-Fi. Private bathrooms include showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. You'll also find electric kettles and irons/ironing boards. Located in Wimbledon, London, the Fox and Grapes Inn is a short drive from the Thames River and Clapham Common, and within easy reach of Kensington High Street and Westfield London Shopping Centre. The closest airport is Heathrow (LHR).

315786.description: There are a total of 40 accomodation units at Paddington Park Hotel. Everyone staying at this accommodation can make good use of the wireless internet connection available at the public areas of the accomodation. The reception desk is not open throughout the day. Some services may be subject to additional charges.

315799.description: Situated in Liverpool's city center, Base at Duke Street offers easy access to key attractions. A short walk from Liverpool One, the historic Chinese Arch, and the Royal Albert Dock, it's also convenient for nightlife with Concert Square and the Baltic Triangle nearby. This aparthotel provides a range of two and three-bedroom serviced apartments, including luxurious penthouses with stunning city views. Each apartment features a stylish, fully equipped kitchen, laundry facilities, widescreen TVs, and comfortable living spaces. Modern interiors cater to families, leisure, and corporate travelers alike. Lime Street Station is a quick ten-minute walk away, and on-site parking is available. Complimentary welcome packs and toiletries are provided, with travel cots available upon request. Free high-speed Wi-Fi is standard in every apartment. Note: Check-in is from 3 PM to 6 PM (late check-in available with pre-arrangement and additional charge), check-out is at 10 AM. Reception is open daily from 9 AM to 6 PM. While Base maintains a 25+ policy, families are welcome. Stag and hen parties are not permitted due to the apartments' location in a residential building.

315845.description: Discover South London's rich history in the city's area of Greenwich where our St Christopher's Inn hostel offers modern accommodation with brand new bathroom facilities and a newly refurbished Belushi's bar where hostel guests receive an exclusive 25% off food and daily drinks deals! With fast transport links to Central London, our hostel is in the perfect place to explore the city whilst still enjoying the beauty of Greenwich. What's not to love?

315863.description: Situated in the exclusive Belgravia district of London, this property is just a 5 minutes' walking distance away from Victoria Station and the Gatwick Express. Many of the city's attractions can be found nearby, including the West End, with its shops and theatres. The Docklands and Olympic Park are within easy reach. This property occupies a traditional, Grade II listed townhouse, which beautifully embraces contemporary interior design, while respecting its old-world charm. The stunningly-designed guest rooms echo the eclectic mix of traditional and elegance styles, for which London is renowned. Guests are invited to dine in style in the mornings, with a hearty full English breakfast, for a great start to the day.

315918.description: Opened in 2011, the Russell Court Hotel remains a popular budget-friendly option. Located just off Kensington High Street, it's conveniently close to Earl's Court, Kensington Olympia Exhibition Centre, and Kensington Olympia Station. All rooms are decorated to a high modern standard, designed for comfort and coziness. The staff is available 24/7 to attend to guests' needs.

315924.description: Take in the views from a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Additional features at this hotel include wedding services, complimentary use of a nearby fitness facility, and a banquet hall. Grab a bite to eat at Threadneedles Restaurant, a restaurant which features a bar/lounge, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. English breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary newspapers in the lobby, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Planning an event in London? This hotel has 2530 square feet (235 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 4 meeting rooms. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours). Make yourself at home in one of the 74 guestrooms featuring minibars and flat-screen televisions.

315926.description: This country house hotel is set amidst 34 acres in Crawley. The property is conveniently located just a 5 minutes' driving distance away from Gatwick Airport. Boasting stunning views over the countryside, this hotel enjoys an air of peace and serenity. The guest rooms are classically designed, featuring soothing, refreshing tones and a peaceful ambiance. This hotel offers a high level of comfort and convenience, ensuring that business and leisure travellers experience a truly memorable stay. Guests can enjoy a superb breakfast in the mornings. The hotel features a bar, as well as a restaurant, catering for guests' dining needs.

315928.description: Enjoy garden and terrace views at Crestfield Hotel, located in London City Centre, a short drive from the British Museum and Russell Square. The hotel offers 63 guestrooms with LCD TVs, digital programming, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Each room includes a safe, desk, and a bathroom with a shower and hairdryer. Hotel amenities include a bar/lounge, 24-hour front desk, luggage storage, and safe deposit box.

315932.description: With underground services into town taking just 25 minutes from Hanger Lane and Park Royal stations, Premier Inn Hanger Lane is a smart choice for West End sightseeing. It also does the business perfectly if you've meetings locally in Park Royal or Ealing. Get on side for international football at the impressive new Wembley Stadium. Or catch top shows at the Arena and Conference Centre. Park Royal Leisure meanwhile offers a great evening out at its Ten-Pin Bowling and digital multiscreen. And, after a day's work or play, return to the peace and quiet of your spacious room and comfy bed. All reservations placed at this hotel are subject to Premier Inn’s standard Terms and Conditions, which can be found at premierinn. com

315943.description: The hotel is within 2 kilometre(s) to main entertainment areas. Travellers can find the nearest golf course within 2 km from the establishment. Within 150 metre(s) guests will find links of transport that will allow them to explore the area. Travellers will find the airport within 22 km. The premises count with 20 welcoming units. Ridgeway Hotel offers Wi-Fi internet connection in communal areas. Guests will appreciate the 24-hour reception.

315948.description: Enjoy convenient amenities at this London hotel, including complimentary Wi-Fi, tour/ticket assistance, and a reception hall. Start your day with a complimentary continental breakfast served from 8:00 AM to 10:00 AM. Multilingual staff and luggage storage are also available. The hotel's 13 guestrooms feature flat-screen televisions with digital programming and complimentary Wi-Fi. Coffee/tea makers, phones, and desks provide added convenience. Located in the heart of London, the Columbus Hotel is within a 10-minute walk of Hyde Park and Kensington Gardens, and close to Paddington Central and Marble Arch. Nearby attractions include Kensington Palace, Regent's Park, and Royal Albert Hall. Heathrow Airport (LHR) is the preferred airport.

315952.description: Located in the heart of London, the Garden Court Hotel offers convenient access to Kensington Gardens and Kensington Palace, both within a 15-minute walk. This hotel provides complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and a cozy lobby fireplace. Guests can enjoy daily continental breakfast (for a fee) and room service. Business travelers will appreciate the business center and 24-hour front desk. The 40 individually decorated guestrooms feature digital programming, en suite bathrooms with showers and complimentary toiletries, laptop-compatible safes, and desks. Heathrow Airport is the preferred airport for the hotel.

315957.description: A total of 16 units are available for guests' convenience at Paddington Green - Concept Serviced Apartments. Those staying at this hotel may surf on the internet thanks to the Wi-Fi access ready to use on public areas. Paddington Green - Concept Serviced Apartments does not offer 24-hour reception. A fee may be chargeable for some services.

315962.description: The 96 welcoming rooms offer a perfect place to relax at the end of the day. Guests may take advantage of the Wi-Fi connection on public areas. This hotel does not operate a 24-hour reception. Some services may be subject to additional charges.

315973.description:
The Leonard is recognised as one of London’s leading boutique hotels featuring quintessentially British designed rooms and suites. Conveniently located by Marble Arch, The Leonard Hotel and Apartments is just a few minutes’ walk from Hyde Park and situated in the heart of central London. 

After a day of shopping or exploring, unwind with a drink at our bar before dining at Seymour’s Restaurant, which serves modern British and Asian cuisine for breakfast, lunch, afternoon tea, and dinner. We also offer 24-hour room service for all guests. 

A stay with us at The Leonard promises to offer a luxurious, yet traditional British experience – perfect for whatever your plans may be. 

Our central location is ideal for shopping, with Selfridges, Oxford Street, Bond Street, and Regent Street all within walking distance. If you’re looking to explore more boutique stores, we also recommend a visit to Marylebone High Street. Staying near Hyde Park allows easy access to the park’s tranquil spaces, boating on the Serpentine Lake, and various concerts such as BST Hyde Park, as well as Winter Wonderland – London’s most famous Winter attraction.

315975.description:
"Medieval castle or modern masterpiece? Our London Central Aldgate East hotel is a stone's throw from skyline icons the Shard and the Gherkin, and around the corner from from the Tower of London.

You'll be in the heart of London's East End, with Tower Bridge within walking distance and stylish Whitechapel and colourful Brick Lane close by. Or hop on a bus for the shops and attractions of the rest of London.

All rooms feature a comfy king size bed with four plump pillows and a cosy duvet. Our on-site restaurant and bar serves breakfast and tasty evening meals.

Useful information

Due to the close proximity of this hotel to the Tower Gateway DLR, some external noise may be heard."

315996.description: The Eurotraveller Hotel Express welcomes you to the heart of London, placing you within a 5-minute drive of iconic landmarks such as the London Eye and the Tower of London. This hotel offers 30 comfortable guestrooms, each equipped with a refrigerator, LCD television, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Enjoy the convenience of room service or dine at the on-site restaurant. Additional amenities include a 24-hour front desk and luggage storage. Each room also features a desk, coffee/tea maker, and a private bathroom with a shower and hairdryer. Daily housekeeping is provided. Big Ben is 1. 6 miles (2. 6 km) away, and St. Paul's Cathedral is 2. 4 miles (3. 8 km) from the hotel.

316016.description: Just five minutes' walk from Colliers Wood tube station, with Wimbledon tennis courts and village just over three miles away, our London Wimbledon hotel is ideal - whether you fancy wombling around the local attractions or taking a train into London. Get on a bus for a panoramic tour of the area. Catch a show at the New Wimbledon Theatre. With shops, bars and restaurants galore you'll be spoilt for choice. Then return to your home from home and get a great night's sleep in one of our super comfy new generation bedrooms, with an impressive 40" flat screen TV, freshly-updated bathroom with large shower head, and brand new, slumber- inducing, king-size Hypnos bed. All reservations placed at this hotel are subject to Premier Inn’s standard Terms and Conditions, which can be found at premierinn. com

316044.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as a 24-hour fitness center, or other amenities including complimentary wireless internet access and shopping on site. This aparthotel also features tour/ticket assistance, a banquet hall, and a vending machine. To-go breakfasts are served on weekdays from 6:30 AM to 10:00 AM and on weekends from 7:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and multilingual staff. Planning an event in Liverpool? This aparthotel has 70 square feet (7 square meters) of space consisting of conference space and 3 meeting rooms. Make yourself at home in one of the 126 guestrooms, featuring kitchens with refrigerators and stovetops. Satellite programming and iPod docking stations are provided for your entertainment, while complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected. Conveniences include phones, as well as safes and desks. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0.

316061.description: The establishment's common areas include Wi-Fi internet connection.

316062.description: The brand-new Hampton by Hilton London Croydon offers excellent road and rail links, situated in Croydon town centre, just 16 minutes from London Victoria and 14 minutes from Gatwick Airport by train. East Croydon Station is a short walk away. Located outside the London Congestion Charge zone, the hotel is also only 11 miles from the M25. Ideal for business or leisure travellers, the hotel is within walking distance of major corporate and government offices. Leisure travellers can enjoy a Thames River cruise, a ride on the London Eye, or a visit to Buckingham Palace and Regent Street. Croydon itself offers excellent parks and shopping, and Wimbledon's All England Lawn Tennis and Croquet Club is easily accessible via a 25-minute tram ride from East Croydon Station. Start your day with our complimentary hot breakfast buffet. Our on-site gym is available for a workout before breakfast or after a busy day. Unwind in our lounge with its inviting fireplace and enjoy your favourite drink from the bar. Free Wi-Fi is available throughout the hotel. After a long day, enjoy varied dining options without leaving the hotel, including international and traditional cuisine, with a children's menu also available.

316092.description: Boasting a charming setting in London, this property sits at the heart of the city's West End. Steps away, guests will find Baker Street, the bustling Oxford Circus and Marble Arch. A wealth of shopping, dining and entertainment opportunities can be found nearby. Guests will appreciate the convenience of the nearby public transport links. This property offers modern, stylish studios and apartments. The units all come well equipped with modern amenities. A great choice for business and leisure travellers alike, this establishment guarantees a high level of comfort and convenience, complemented by a homely ambiance.

316109.description: Those wishing to escape the hustle and bustle of daily routine will find peace and tranquillity at this establishment. Visitors can make good use of the wireless internet connection available at the public areas of the accomodation. Balmoral Lodge does not offer 24-hour reception. Additional fees may apply for some services.

316121.description:
In the heart of exclusive South Kensington, The Adria is much more than a boutique hotel. Behind the stucco façade of our 19th-century townhouse, you will discover a contemporary style designed to meet every modern comfort. 

Just a short walk from the Natural History Museum, Harrods department store and the Royal Albert Hall, this exclusive five-star hotel has a nostalgic members’ club charm. 

Our 22 elegant suites and rooms offer opulent furnishings, mini bars, workspace, underfloor heating and luxurious Italian marble bathrooms. 

An à la carte breakfast is served to suit your schedule, and as the day progresses, enjoy a traditional afternoon tea in our dining room before unwinding in the evening with a glass of champagne in the Games Room. 

Breakfast: £ 27. 50
Please note: when booking 2 rooms or more, different policies and additional supplements may apply.

316137.description: Enjoy garden views and amenities like complimentary Wi-Fi and concierge services at this centrally located London hotel. Additional features include a picnic area and a reception hall. Each of the 16 guestrooms provides a refrigerator, microwave, and flat-screen television with satellite programming. Private bathrooms include showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Conveniences such as phones, desks, and coffee/tea makers are also provided. A short walk from Tottenham Court Road and The British Museum, Regency House is conveniently located in London's City Centre, near Russell Square and Regent Street.

316180.description: The 16 welcoming accomodation units offer a perfect place to relax at the end of the day. In addition, Wi-Fi access is offered at the establishment's common spaces. Flexistay Aparthotel does not offer 24-hour reception. Some services may be subject to additional charges.

316183.description: The 50 luxury serviced apartments at 130 Queensgate Court range from spacious studios to one, two, and three-bedroom accommodations. For ultimate luxury, we offer two four-bedroom penthouse suites with private lift access. All apartments maximize natural light and are furnished in an elegant, international style, providing uncluttered, modern solutions for business or leisure travelers on short or long stays. Enjoy complimentary services such as 24-hour reception/concierge, a fitness room, lifts, linen changes, housekeeping, a secure entry system, and wireless internet access. All apartments feature heating and air conditioning, with baby cots and highchairs available upon request. Each apartment includes a direct-line telephone, a fully equipped kitchen with cooking facilities, a dishwasher, and a washer/dryer, complimentary toiletries upon arrival, a hairdryer, an iron and ironing board, and an in-room safe.

316189.description: The Lancaster Hall Hotel, located in London's City Centre, offers a convenient and comfortable stay just a short walk from Kensington Gardens and Hyde Park. Guests can enjoy a continental breakfast for a fee and unwind with drinks at the bar/lounge. The hotel features 80 guestrooms equipped with LCD TVs, complimentary Wi-Fi, private bathrooms with shower/tub combinations, and in-room safes and desks. Additional amenities include a 24-hour front desk and safe deposit box at reception. Nearby attractions include Kensington Palace, Queensway, and Paddington Central, all within a mile.

316233.description: Located less than 1640 feet from King's Cross St Pancras Railway Station and its Eurostar train services, the Swinton Hotel offers free WiFi and comfortable, cozy rooms. The Swinton Hotel has a convenient location for central London, with the shops, bars and theaters of the West End just a 5-minute journey by Tube from Kings Cross Station. All rooms have showers or baths, along with TVs, telephones and tea/coffee making facilities. Selected rooms have direct access to the garden. The hotel has a 24-hour reception desk, a secluded garden and a elevator for access to rooms on the upper floors. A continental breakfast is available every day and is provided in the dining room, which leads out to the garden. The hotel has a fitness center with direct access to garden.

316236.description: Located in the heart of vibrant Shepherd's Bush in West London, close to Westfield London shopping center, this modern hotel, housed in a former 1920s movie theater, offers easy access to Notting Hill, Kensington, London's West End, and other major tourist attractions. The area boasts excellent transport links, with Heathrow Airport a mere 30-minute drive away. This 8-story hotel retains the building's historic facade while showcasing modern architecture and design. It features a variety of bedrooms and suites, three meeting rooms, the Dorsett Lounge, an all-day dining restaurant serving delicious meals, a destination bar, and a top-floor spa overlooking the Green. The subtly Asian-inspired rooms and suites provide stylish comfort for both business and leisure travelers.

316261.description:
With free Wi-Fi and free parking, Reigate Manor Hotel is a convenient base just 0. 5 miles from junction 8 of the M25 and 8 miles from Gatwick Airport. 

Each bedroom has Freeview TV, a desk and an private bathroom. 

The restaurant at Reigate Manor serves an à la carte menu and hosts a carvery every Sunday lunchtime. There is also a lounge menu. 

Reigate Train Station is a 10-minute walk from Reigate Manor Hotel. For walkers, the North Downs Way footpath is about 1640 feet away. 

Reigate Manor Hotel is a convenient base just 0. 5 miles from junction 8 on the A217, just off the M25 and 8 miles from Gatwick Airport.

316295.description: Located in the heart of London, Hotel Oliver offers 55 guestrooms with flat-screen TVs, complimentary Wi-Fi, and digital programming. Enjoy amenities such as room service, a garden, and daily continental breakfast (fee applies). Luggage storage and a 24-hour front desk are available, along with self-parking (charges apply). You'll be within a 15-minute walk of Kensington High Street and the Natural History Museum, and a short distance from Hyde Park and Westfield London Shopping Centre.

316305.description: This smoke-free guesthouse offers complimentary parking nearby. Featured amenities include express check-in and express check-out. Free self parking is available onsite. Stay in one of 12 guestrooms featuring LCD televisions. Prepare your meals in the shared/communal kitchen. Bathrooms feature shower/tub combinations with rainfall showerheads and complimentary toiletries. Conveniences include coffee/tea makers and complimentary bottled water. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Ealing Broadway Shopping Center - 1. 1 km / 0. 7 mi- Thames River - 2. 4 km / 1. 5 mi- Syon Park - 3. 3 km / 2. 1 mi- Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew - 3. 6 km / 2. 2 mi- Twickenham Stadium - 7. 3 km / 4. 6 mi- Richmond Park - 7. 6 km / 4. 7 mi- Eventim Apollo - 7. 7 km / 4. 8 mi- Wembley Stadium - 8. 4 km / 5. 2 mi- OVO Arena Wembley - 8. 4 km / 5. 2 mi- Olympia Conference and Exhibition Centre - 8. 6 km / 5. 4 mi- Kensington High Street - 8. 7 km / 5. 4 mi- Cromwell Road - 8. 8 km / 5. 5 mi- Westfield London Shopping Centre - 9. 3 km / 5. 8 mi- Portobello Road Market - 10 km / 6. 2 mi- Stamford Bridge Stadium - 10. 3 km / 6. 4 mi. The nearest airports are: Heathrow Airport (LHR) - 18. 4 km / 11. 4 mi London City Airport (LCY) - 46. 5 km / 28. 9 mi Gatwick Airport (LGW) - 86. 2 km / 53. 5 mi Farnborough (FAB) - 54. 7 km / 34 mi Luton Airport (LTN) - 53. 9 km / 33. 5 mi The preferred airport for Aron Guest House is Heathrow Airport (LHR). With a stay at Aron Guest House in London (Ealing), you'll be a 4-minute drive from Thames River and 8 minutes from Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew. This guesthouse is 5. 2 mi (8. 4 km) from Wembley Stadium and 5. 4 mi (8. 7 km) from Kensington High Street.

316309.description: Located just 1 mile from Aintree Racecourse and 5 miles from LFC, The Park Hotel is ideally located for all the major road networks. All bedrooms are en-suite, offering free WiFi and Freeview channels along with a complimentary hospitality tray. The Aintree Restaurant and patio serves evening meals, and special offer 3-course dinners. A selection of carefully chosen beers, wines and spirits can be enjoyed in The Grand National Bar. The convenient location means that the hotel offers easy access to the region’s main roads and motorways, with Switch Island road junction just 800 metres away. Free private parking is available on site for residents and those attending one of the properties' 6 meeting/function rooms.

316310.description: Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi and concierge services at the Rhodes Hotel, a centrally located guesthouse in London, just a 3-minute walk from Hyde Park Stables and moments from Hyde Park and Kensington Gardens. The 36 air-conditioned rooms offer modern amenities, including flat-screen TVs with digital programming, refrigerators, and coffee/tea makers. Bathrooms include complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Additional conveniences such as phones and desks cater to both leisure and business travelers. The hotel also provides limo/town car service, multilingual staff, and luggage storage. For those flying in, Heathrow (LHR) is the preferred airport.

316320.description: There are a total of 41 accomodation units on the premises. Number Sixteen offers Wi-Fi internet connection in communal areas. This hotel offers 24-hour reception for guests' convenience.

316322.description: Enjoy a central London stay at the luxurious Knightsbridge Hotel, Firmdale Hotels, just a 3-minute walk from Harrods and 9 minutes from Hyde Park. This hotel offers 44 individually decorated guestrooms, each featuring a minibar, flat-screen TV, and private bathroom with designer toiletries. Stay connected with complimentary wired and wireless internet access. Enjoy 24-hour room service and English breakfasts (available for a fee). Concierge services and babysitting are also available. Other amenities include express check-out and complimentary newspapers in the lobby. Nearby attractions include the Victoria and Albert Museum (0. 4 mi), Natural History Museum (0. 6 mi), and Hyde Park (0. 7 mi). Heathrow Airport is the preferred airport.

316333.description:
Mabledon Court Hotel is ideally located less than 600 metres from King’s Cross and St Pancras International, as well as London Euston, offering excellent national and international transport connections. Guests can enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi, lift access, and a continental breakfast during their stay. 

The hotel is within easy walking distance of the British Museum and the British Library, placing guests close to some of London’s most iconic cultural attractions. 

Each room is comfortably furnished and features an en suite bathroom, TV, telephone, hairdryer, and tea and coffee-making facilities, providing a practical and comfortable base in the heart of the city.

316337.description: Stay in the heart of London at Hazlitt's, a boutique hotel just a 5-minute walk from both Leicester Square and Tottenham Court Road. Enjoy individually decorated guestrooms featuring minibars, LCD Smart TVs with satellite programming, and complimentary Wi-Fi. Start your day with a cooked-to-order breakfast (available for a fee), unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge, and take advantage of 24-hour room service and concierge services. Other amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services and a 24-hour front desk. Piccadilly Circus and Covent Garden Market are within easy reach.

316339.description: Boasting a peaceful setting on the edge of London's Hyde Park, this property is located close to the West End and Paddington. The property offers visitors the ideal setting from which to explore this mesmerising city. This boutique hotel oozes minimalist style and understated luxury. Styled by the renowned British designed, Anouska Hempel, the hotel oozes contemporary elegance and classical charm. The garden echoes the beauty of the interiors, with immaculately-kept plants and trees. Individually-styled guest rooms feature a soothing, crisp-white design with an infusion of Asian details. A touch of Zen bathes guests in comfort and relaxation.

316392.description: This smoke-free guesthouse in central London offers 14 comfortable guestrooms with flat-screen TVs and complimentary Wi-Fi. Guests can enjoy complimentary toiletries and hair dryers in the en-suite bathrooms, along with daily housekeeping and coffee/tea making facilities. Luggage storage and a 24-hour front desk are available. The hotel is conveniently located near the British Library and Russell Square, and a short walk from the British Museum. Nearby transport links offer access to London City Airport (15. 2 km), Heathrow (29. 7 km), Gatwick (88. 2 km), Luton (53. 8 km) and Stansted (57. 5 km).

316394.description: Take in the views from a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. This hotel also features a fireplace in the lobby and a banquet hall. Take advantage of the hotel's 24-hour room service. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Continental breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include dry cleaning/laundry services, a 24-hour front desk, and multilingual staff. Make yourself at home in one of the 33 air-conditioned rooms featuring refrigerators and minibars. 32-inch LED televisions with satellite programming provide entertainment, while complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected. Private bathrooms have designer toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include safes and desks, and housekeeping is provided daily. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. King's College London - 0. 8 km / 0. 5 mi- Barbican Arts Centre - 0. 9 km / 0. 6 mi- St.

316412.description: A total of 27 rooms are available for guests' convenience at Glenlyn Guest House. In addition, Wi-Fi access is offered at the establishment's common spaces. Glenlyn Guest House does not operate a 24-hour reception.

316414.description: The 73 welcoming accomodation units offer a perfect place to relax at the end of the day. Wi-Fi internet connection is available on public areas. The reception is open 24/7. A fee may be chargeable for some services.

316496.description: The Wardonia Hotel, located in a charming Georgian townhouse in central London, is just a 3-minute walk from King's Cross St. Pancras International and Eurostar stations. Its cozy, bright, non-smoking rooms offer modern amenities, including free Wi-Fi, a hairdryer, complimentary toiletries, daily housekeeping, tea/coffee making facilities, a European plug socket, a Freeview TV, and an ensuite bathroom. A short stroll away, you'll find Coal Drops Yard with its array of shops, cafes, bars, and restaurants, as well as King's Boulevard, home to a mix of independent stores, gyms, salons, and high-end brands. The hotel is also conveniently located near the British Museum, with easy access to other attractions such as Oxford Street, Covent Garden, Madame Tussauds, and Buckingham Palace. Guests traveling to events at Emirates Stadium, Wembley Stadium, The O2, or London Stadium will find the Wardonia a great base. Please note: This historic Georgian building does not have an elevator; all rooms are accessible by stairs only.

316528.description: A 5-minute walk from Baker Street Underground Station and 10 minutes from Oxford Street, this traditional London town house has free Wi-Fi throughout. In the heart of the West End, Marylebone Inn is surrounded by restaurants and shops, which can be reached in 5 minutes' on foot. Regent’s Park is also a 5-minute walk, and the city’s popular theaters are 15 minutes' away by underground train. With simple, modern décor, each room has a seating area and flat-screen satellite TV. Each also has a kettle and a bathroom with a hairdryer on request. All the rooms feature double glazed windows for noise insulation. Paddington Rail Station and the Heathrow Express service are a 10-minute taxi ride from Marylebone Inn. Buckingham Palace is around 2 miles from Marylebone Inn.

316541.description:
A friendly, contemporary Harlow hotel near Stansted Airport and trains to Central London

Set in the thriving town of Harlow on the border of Essex and Hertfordshire, Holiday Inn Express® Harlow hotel is 15 miles from Stansted Airport, with easy access to the M11 motorway. Harlow Town Station is a 20-minute walk away, where you can take a 35-minute train ride to London Liverpool Street Station or catch the Stansted Express to the airport. A major hub for buses and coaches, Harlow Bus Station is right next to the hotel. 

Corporate guests are less than 10 minutes' drive from Harlow Enterprise Hub, and the Harlow Business Exhibition is held in Town Park on the hotel's doorstep. Three elegant meeting rooms host up to 42 delegates, with audiovisual equipment and catering services. 

Popular attractions in Harlow include Gibberd Garden and Gibberd Gallery in the Civic Centre, and you can follow Harlow's Sculpture Trail as you shop along the pedestrianised Broadwalk. It's a five-minute stroll from the hotel to Harlow Leisurezone, and within 20 miles you can visit family-friendly attractions such as Broxbourne Paradise Wildlife Park and Hertford Castle.

316573.description:
Welcome to The Goodenough Hotel, a beautifully restored boutique hotel in Central London, located in the heart of the historic Bloomsbury district. Just minutes from King’s Cross, St Pancras International, and the West End, our hotel offers a unique blend of classic Georgian charm and contemporary luxury. 

Set across five elegant 19th-century Georgian townhouses, The Goodenough Hotel provides a tranquil escape from the buzz of the city – perfect for leisure breaks, business trips, or romantic getaways. Whether you're visiting London for work or pleasure, The Goodenough Hotel is your ideal home base – offering boutique accommodation in Central London with easy access to major attractions, theatres, museums, and transport links. 

At The Goodenough Hotel, our story is rooted in heritage, education, and giving back. More than just a boutique hotel in Bloomsbury, we’re proud to be a not-for-profit hotel in Central London – with 100% of our profits going towards supporting Goodenough College, a renowned postgraduate residence and academic community. 

When you stay with us, you’re not only enjoying a peaceful escape in one of London’s most historic and culturally rich neighbourhoods – you’re also contributing to the future of some of the world’s most talented students – including those on low incomes or from challenging backgrounds. It’s a stay that feels good and does good. 

In early 2026, The Goodenough Hotel will be undertaking phased heritage restoration works to the front of the building. These works are carefully managed, with little expected impact on guest access, comfort, or enjoyment of Mecklenburgh Square. Any limited works will be planned to minimise noise, and a small number of rooms will be temporarily closed, allowing us to carry out light-touch refurbishments, including new carpets. 

Experience authentic London, support a worthy cause, and sleep well, knowing your visit makes a difference.

The Dene Hotel is located in a quiet street but only 2 minutes walk from busy Osborne Road with its pubs, bars and restaurants. Shopping is available at nearby Acorn Road where amenities include banks, post office, supermarket, chemists, fashion boutiques and antique shops. 325308.description: The Best Western® Gibside Hotel, in the center of wonderful Whickham Village, has the location, location, location you are looking for - whether you are here on business or staying at your leisure. Our friendly staff, many of whom have been at The Best Western® Gibside Hotel for over 25 years, will give you a true home-away-from-home experience. 325599.description: Located on the bustling High Street in the Cotswolds village of Burford, this historic inn occupies a Grade II listed building dating back to the 16th century. 325905.description: Beer, Bread, Blankets. These are the staples that historically, Witney is famous for. The Blue Boar redefines these symbols, providing a stylish bar, restaurant and rooms in which quality and comfort is paramount. Formerly known as The Marlborough Hotel, The Blue Boar has benefited from a £3m investment, and boasts 20 boutique style bedrooms and an elegant function room. Each of the 20 en-suite bedrooms is individually designed in boutique-style, with luxury bathrooms and of course, the famous Witney blankets. All of the rooms also feature iPod docking stations, flatscreen televisions, tea and coffee making facilities and free WiFi. Whether visiting the Blue Boar for business or for pleasure, the high quality finish of the rooms guarantees a warm and comfortable stay.

325907.description: Whether you are popping in for a quiet drink, a great lunch or looking for somewhere to stay, The Cherry Tree offers a warm, homely welcome. A superb place to spend your time whilst in the Medieval village of Steventon. The Cherry Tree is a beautiful 18th Century building and is still run as a traditional village pub, serving as the heart of its community. The low ceilings, oak beams and 3 open fireplaces are cosy in the winter whilst the large courtyard with giant umbrellas and heaters are perfect for those warm summer evenings. We are well known in the village and surrounding areas for our diverse selection of real ales, featuring 6 full time Wadworth brews and a further rotating guest ales. Come and join our regulars for a relaxing drink or bite to eat, or for a more lively visit pop along to our ever popular pub quiz each Monday night. The Cherry Tree is also a B&B and has 7 Comfortable, En-suite Bedrooms, convenient for The Milton Business Park or Harwell Science Park

325995.description: Constructed in 1874 and set in 133 acres of parkland, The Springs is a fine example of a Victorian Tudor style country house. The elegant reception halls still retain all their period features such as oak panelling, beams and stone fireplaces where you will be welcomed with crackling log fires through the winter months. Nearly all the bedrooms have recently been refurbished in neutral colours with modern white bathroom suites and many have balconies and enjoy picturesque views across the lake and beautifully manicured grounds. All rooms are non-smoking. The award winning AA Rosette Lakeside Restaurant serves excellent cuisine. Only the finest freshly sourced ingredients are used so the menu is updated daily. As the name suggests, the restaurant enjoys wonderful views across the lake through attractive floor to ceiling latticed windows. The hotel offers golf, weddings, conference and banqueting facilities. Also on site, there is a putting green, croquet lawn, coarse fishing on the River Thames, sauna and outdoor pool. The pool was installed by former owner rock star, Ian Gillan, from the band Deep Purple) and is often commented on by guests for its quirky design in the shape of a guitar. Located amidst the rural and peaceful setting of the Thames Valley countryside, historic market towns such as Wallingford, Henley, Abingdon and Dorchester are all close by. Other places of interest are Oxford, Windsor, the Cotswolds, Blenheim Palace and Basildon Park.

326062.description: This family-run hotel, a former 15th-century coaching inn, exudes traditional charm with its antique pine and dark oak furnishings, wallpaper, and carpets. Some rooms offer more contemporary decor. Located in the heart of a bustling Cotswold market town, the hotel is a minute's walk from restaurants, a charming theatre, and a boutique cinema. Please note there is no elevator/lift and the swimming pool is currently unavailable. Ground floor rooms can be requested upon booking. This historic inn boasts a rich past, once owned by legendary drummer Keith Moon of 'The Who, ' who frequently entertained celebrity friends like Roger Daltrey. Comedy icon Ronnie Barker was also a regular, with his shop just three doors down; some of the hotel's furnishings were even purchased from his store.

360632.description: The Best Western® Motherwell Centre Moorings Hotel provides the magic near Motherwell! Built in 1891 as the private home for a member of a famous Scottish steel dynasty, our beautiful main building has held its charm and offers a unique, understated and timeless air of refinement to this day. The surroundings are undeniably chic, but the overall ambience remains humble enough to be homely. A 'B' listed building within a local conservation area, Best Western Motherwell Centre Moorings Hotel has built on its 19th century roots to meet 21st century needs and provides guests with classic character. We still have some of the original stained glass windows, and our hospitality is traditional and unintrusive. Enjoy your stay.
