360736.description: Featuring a terrace, a restaurant as well as a bar, Babbity Bowsters is set in the centre of Glasgow, less than 1 km from Glasgow Cathedral. 700 metres from George Square and 1. 2 km from Buchanan Galleries, the hotel features a ski school. The accommodation offers karaoke and a 24-hour front desk. At the hotel, rooms come with a desk and a flat-screen TV. At Babbity Bowsters all rooms are fitted with bed linen and towels. The accommodation offers a continental or Full English/Irish breakfast. You can play mini-golf at Babbity Bowsters, and the area is popular for hiking and skiing. Popular points of interest near the hotel include The Glasgow Royal Concert Hall, Glasgow Queen Street Station and Glasgow Central Station. The nearest airport is Glasgow Airport, 14 km from Babbity Bowsters.

361250.description: Set in a quiet street in the heart of Holborn, these bright, airy and modern apartments offer a very convenient location within easy reach of shops, museums and a range of tourist attractions. The apartments are finished to a high standard with simple and stylish contemporary décor, and benefit from plenty of natural light and a range of modern home comforts which ensure a relaxing and enjoyable stay. With a choice of accommodation ranging from 1 bedroom apartments to spacious duplex 2 bedroom, this is an ideal base in the centre of the city for any traveller.

361665.description: Just a short drive from the beauty of Kew Royal Botanical Gardens, the historic avenues of Richmond and the roar of Twickenham Stadium, the 4-star Novotel London Brentford Hotel sits beside some of Britain's best. Whether you're in the area for business or pleasure, we'll have your every need covered.

361696.description: Set amidst the traditional surroundings of East Kilbride, this hotel offers close proximity to a number of attractions in the area. Guests can enjoy the Village Theatre, many golf courses, skating and bowling nearby. The centre of Glasgow is just a 10 minutes' driving distance away. This hotel dates back to the late 18th century. Originally built as a cotton-spinning mill, the property enjoys a striking design. Beautifully retaining its original character and charm, the property comprises elegantly-styled, modern guest rooms. Guests can enjoy a hearty meal in the traditional surroundings of the restaurant.

361697.description: Take advantage of recreation opportunities such as a nightclub or take in the view from a terrace and a garden. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access and tour/ticket assistance. Satisfy your appetite for lunch or dinner at the hotel's bar/lounge, The Commercial Bar, or stay in and take advantage of the room service (during limited hours). Full breakfasts are available daily from 9:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. The front desk is staffed during limited hours. Free self parking is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 13 guestrooms. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with bathtubs or showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include desks and coffee/tea makers, and housekeeping is provided daily. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Cambusnethan Priory - 2. 7 km / 1.

361698.description: This luxurious hotel is situated in a prestigious residential area of Glasgow. The property is situated close to the city centre. Guests can explore the mesmerising beauty of the nearby Loch Lomond and the Trossachs. The spectacular Ayrshire golf courses can also be found close by. Convenient links to the public transport network are situated nearby. This charming hotel combines traditional grace with modern efficiency. Enjoying a long history, the hotel has beautifully retained many of its original features. The guest rooms offer style, luxury and comfort. The property offers a wide range of superb facilities and services, delivering an unrivalled level of comfort and convenience.

363395.description: 'Early flight or late arrival? This 24-hour hotel's ideally placed to give travellers a good rest. It's less than 2 miles from the NEC, so an ideal base for events. Birmingham's attractions and nightlife are a short drive away. If you need to stay near the airport, round-the-clock service means it's easy to pack up, check out, and jet off. All rooms feature a comfy king size bed with four plump pillows and a cosy duvet. Our on-site restaurant and bar serves breakfast and tasty evening meals. '

363929.description: Welcome to our luxurious riverside hotel in suburban Kingston, where modern comfort and sophistication meet unparalleled convenience. Boasting 121 elegantly designed rooms, our hotel offers a haven of tranquillity just moments away from London’s vibrant heart. Indulge in complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi, exceptional service, and four premium meeting rooms and a sky lounge, each fully equipped with cutting-edge technology for your professional needs. Our internationally acclaimed restaurant, Tamarinn 360, creates an unforgettable dining experience that blends tradition with innovation. Our state-of-the-art fitness centre ensures you can maintain an active lifestyle throughout your stay, offering a perfect balance of relaxation and vitality. Located just over a 30-minute drive from London Heathrow and Gatwick Airports, our hotel provides easy access to the best of the region. Surbiton Railway Station is only a 5-minute drive, while iconic local attractions, including the majestic Hampton Court Palace, the enchanting Kew Botanical Gardens, and the thrilling Chessington World of Adventures, are less than 20 minutes away. To ensure a smooth and secure stay, a £100. 00 security deposit will be pre-authorised at check-in on your card and refunded upon check-out, provided no damages are reported. Discover the perfect blend of luxury, convenience, and world-class service at our hotel – your gateway to an extraordinary stay in Kingston.

363932.description: This 5 star hotel is located in the city centre of Edinburgh and was established in 2013. It is close to the Edinburgh Castle and the nearest station is Waverley Train Station. The Hotel has a fitness centre/gym. All 50 rooms are equipped with hairdryer, safe and ironing set.

364016.description: The Hotel de Orangerie, a renovated 15th-century cloister, is located in the heart of Bruges, within walking distance of shops and historical sites. Situated on the picturesque Dijver canal, this charming hotel offers an oasis of elegance. Engravings, old paintings, tapestries, silk curtains, and antiques create a nostalgic atmosphere, while the combination of antique furniture and a contemporary, pastel-tinted interior gives the hotel a cozy yet modern feel. A member of 'Small Luxury Hotels of the World, ' the hotel offers breakfast and English Afternoon Tea on a terrace overlooking the water. Guests can also enjoy the cozy oak dining room or relax by the fireplace. Explore Bruges by canal boat or horse-drawn carriage, and savor the city's many gourmet restaurants.

364064.description: This hotel is located at the heart of Glasgow's West End. It is just a 5 minutes' walking distance away from Kelvinbridge Subway Station and Glasgow University. This property is just a leisurely stroll away from Byres Road. Kelvingrove Park is a 15 minutes' walk from the property. The Botanic Gardens are just 1. 5 km away. The Museum of Transport and the Glasgow Science Centre are also within easy reach. A great choice for business and leisure travellers alike, this property comprises elegantly-styled guest rooms. The staff are on hand to ensure that guests' needs are fully met, ensuring a comfortable, relaxing stay for every type of traveller.

name.content: Four Points Flex by Sheraton Edinburgh

364462.description: Located in Edinburgh's thriving Georgian New Town, just minutes from the city's famous Princes Street, Four Points Flex by Sheraton Edinburgh is ideal for a convenient stay in the Scottish capital. It is easy to walk to some of the city's top attractions, restaurants, and shops, including Edinburgh Castle, The Royal Mile and the historic Old Town. The 116 contemporary rooms and suites have been designed with comfort and simplicity in mind, and range from cozy and efficient doubles to generous suites. Add the friendly hospitality of our thoughtful team, and you'll feel right at home.

364837.description: Strategically situated at the heart of Scotland, this hotel is just a short driving distance away from Glasgow city centre. The property is with a 45 minutes' drive from Edinburgh and Glasgow international airports. The historical, medieval city of Stirling is just a 15 minutes' drive away, where guest will find themselves immersed in the rich culture and history of the city. Guests are greeted with warm hospitality upon arrival. The guest rooms offer modern amenities and a comfortable setting in which to unwind. The restaurant serves a variety of traditional dishes, which are sure to tempt even the most discerning palate. This wonderful hotel is a prime choice for business and leisure travellers alike.

365209.description: This hotel enjoys a charming setting in London. The hotel is situated close to a wealth of attractions in the area. Guests will find themselves in the perfect setting from which to explore this exciting city. The hotel is located just a short distance away from the many prominent points of interest that the city has to offer, making this a great option for business and leisure travellers. A wealth of shopping, dining and entertainment venues can be found nearby. The guest rooms are superbly designed in a classical style. Guests are invited to avail of the many facilities and services that this wonderful hotel has to offer.

365274.description: In the heart of the south Dublin suburb of Ballsbridge, an affluent and leafy area, this Victorian property, fully renovated in 2014, is a luxurious all-suite hotel. It is ideal for both short city breaks and longer stays and is within walking distance of fine restaurants, traditional Irish pubs and cafes. The RDS (Royal Dublin Society), hosting some of Ireland's main concerts and sporting events, the Aviva stadium, rugby clubs and foreign embassies are in Ballsbridge which is close to Sandymount Beach and 2 km away from Dublin's city centre. The DART rail line is within a 5 minute walk and there are frequent bus services almost outside the property. Amenities include parking, Wi-Fi, lounge with complimentary tea & coffee and gym. The suites have fitted kitchens, sitting area and elegant bathrooms with luxurious toiletries. Due to the latest Government restrictions, we are beyond disappointed to confirm that from Dec 27th to January 31st, we can only accommodate those staying for essential, non-social and non-tourist purposes. The only exception to this is if you are already staying with us or have a booking due to arrive between now and 26th Dec inclusive. If you are due to arrive for a leisure stay from 27th Dec onwards, we would ask you to please rebook your stay via the website or travel agent you booked with. You can also email the PREMIER SUITES team directly. We look forward to welcoming our leisure guests back from January 12th when hopefully restrictions will be lifted. We would like to thank you for your continued support and wish you a safe and peaceful Christmas.

365599.description: Take in the views from a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Satisfy your appetite for lunch or dinner at Melody, a restaurant which specializes in British cuisine, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Continental breakfasts are available daily for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Treat yourself to a stay in one of the 35 individually decorated guestrooms, featuring heated floors. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Conveniences include safes and desks, and housekeeping is provided daily. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Eventim Apollo - 0. 7 km / 0. 4 mi- Olympia Conference and Exhibition Centre - 0. 7 km / 0. 5 mi- Kensington High Street - 0.

366597.description: These serviced apartments offer elegant accommodations in central Edinburgh, a 5-minute walk from Princes Street. Enjoy easy access to nearby bars and restaurants, as well as Edinburgh Castle, a mere 10-minute walk away. The Edinburgh International Conference Centre is less than a 5-minute walk from the apartments, and Haymarket Rail Station is a short 7-minute walk. Each apartment features a comfortable, modern lounge area with sofas and a flat-screen TV. The fully equipped kitchens and living areas boast stylish wooden floors. The décor is simple yet elegant, and all apartments include a spacious, tiled shower room. Heating and Wi-Fi are standard. Depending on the size of the apartment you choose, amenities such as a dining table, dishwasher, and washing machine may also be available. These are included in the more spacious 1-bedroom superior and 2-bedroom apartments. Please note there is no on-site reception. Kindly contact us one week before arrival to arrange check-in. Our phone number is +44 131 510 7707, and our email is stay@edinburghsapartments. com. We are available Monday to Friday, 10 am to 5 pm. Guests arriving without prior arrangements will need to call an emergency out-of-hours phone number (listed on the building door) and may experience a delay in gaining access.

367768.description: Quality accommodation in an unbeatable central location less than a minute from Kings Cross and St Pancras railway stations. This is the ideal base from which to explore London or stay over before heading to Europe on the Eurostar. Tucked away from the hustle and bustle of the nearby streets, this hotel is housed in four attractive Georgian townhouses and offers 60 en-suite rooms ranging from small singles to extra-large family rooms with a double bed and four singles. Furnished in contemporary style, the rooms have a TV, safe and top quality bathroom amenities. Although there is no lift, a member of the helpful staff is always on duty at reception to give guests a hand with their luggage. There is a lounge bar and terrace where guests can relax, and the hotel also serves a delicious breakfast, just the thing to prepare guests for a busy day exploring the UK capital.

369430.description: This wonderful hotel is situated in the heart of London, ideally located for exploring the vibrant West End and Piccadilly Circus. The Prince of Wales Theatre is a mere 100 meters away, and Chinatown is just 200 meters from the hotel. Heathrow International Airport is conveniently located 37 km away. This stylish hotel offers elegantly appointed guest rooms and excellent service, ensuring a memorable stay in the heart of London.

369432.description: This hotel sits amidst the bustle and charm of the central London district of Victoria. The property is just a 5 minutes' walking distance away from Buckingham Palace and the train station. Victoria underground station is located nearby, offering ease of access to other areas of the city. Local theatres can be found close by. This hotel occupies a converted Victorian townhouse, oozing sophistication and classical elegance, with a blend of architectural styles. The guest rooms blend traditional and modern elements. Complimentary Wi-Fi is available onsite, for the convenience of business and leisure travellers.

369443.description: The hotel has everything you need for a couple of nights in town. Concentrated style, an out-of-town price, and a prime location. The hotel is a designer conversion of an Old Printworks, with 104 bedrooms arranged around a central lightwell over ground and five upper floors. The hotel is situated in the heart of the city centre right next to George Square. You step into your Z Room, and suddenly the price makes perfect sense. You're staying in the city, where space is at a premium. But you're not paying a premium. You're going to stay a couple of nights, revel in Glasgow, sleep in a sumptuous bed and wake in generously designed surroundings. So, for a true Urbanite, your Z room is carefully considered. With en suite wet room, crisp bed linen, 39” TV with a huge selection of channels, Wi-Fi

369445.description: This stylish property features a prime position in the first city to be awarded the European Capital of Culture, Liverpool. It is situated in the financial heart of the city, offering easy access to some of the most important tourist attractions, such as Old Hall Street. Other attractions not to be missed include Albert Dock, Pier Head, Mann Island and the Echo Arena. Combining modernity, design and stunning views, the comfortable accommodation units are the ideal place where to unwind at the end of the day. They are predominantly over the top three floors, featuring magnificent views over the surrounding urban landscape, and all come with a large choice of excellent services and amenities for guests to feel right at home. Accessible rooms are also available. The onsite facilities include a bar, ideal to enjoy a refreshing beverage while sharing nice moments with friends or the family.

369617.description: Located in London's vibrant Tower Hamlets district, the Travelodge London Bethnal Green is a 3-minute drive from Brick Lane and 5 minutes from Liverpool Street. This hotel is conveniently located near several iconic landmarks, including the Tower of London (3 km) and Tower Bridge (3. 3 km). The closest airport is London City Airport (LCY), while Heathrow Airport (LHR) is the preferred airport for the hotel.

369950.description: This charming property enjoys immediate access to the international Eurostar service, the National Rail and the London underground. Its convenient location makes it a great choice for business and leisure travellers alike. The British Museum and the Bloomsbury area are just a short walking distance away. The British Library and the University of London, as well as the famous Madame Tussauds, can be found in the area. This hotel blends effortlessly with its charming surroundings. Tastefully-designed guest rooms offer comfort and style, featuring modern furnishings and parquet floors. Guests can enjoy a wonderful breakfast in the mornings, before setting off to explore this captivating city. Customers must pay security deposit by cash or card of £100 on arrival. Deposit will be returned on check out. If paid by card it will be returned within 5 working days.

371099.address: Komp. Penuin center Blok OB No 1-7
371099.description: A complimentary airport shuttle takes guests to this elegant hotel, very popular among the business travellers visiting the larger Singapore area. The complimentary Wi-Fi Internet access, the business centre and meeting facilities, the close proximity to various corporate headquarters and the convenient laundry, dry cleaning and ironing services are also highly appreciated by the busy work guests. The spacious air-conditioned rooms offer all the necessary comforts, so one can truly relax after a long day. In the morning, guests can enjoy the complimentary breakfast in the common area or in their own suite.

371464.address: Komplek. Tanjung Pantun Blok F No. 7-8 Sei Jodoh
371464.description:
Kireinn Hotel is an ideal place for fun and relaxation. It is located in the Nagoya area of Batam Island. Set 12.3 km from the excitement of the city, this 2-star hotel commands an excellent location and provides access to the city's biggest attractions. This modern hotel is in the vicinity of popular city attractions such as Ferry Terminal.

Kireinn offers impeccable service and all the essential amenities to invigorate travelers. Room service, car hire, elevator, 24-hour front desk, smoking area are just a few of the facilities that set Kireinn apart from other hotels in the city.

Guests can choose from 55 rooms, all of which exude an atmosphere of total peace and harmony. The hotel offers many unique recreational opportunities such as massage. Whatever your reason for visiting Batam Island, the Kireinn is the perfect venue for an exhilarating and exciting break away.

373303.description:
This property is located just 8 km away from central London. Situated at the heart of a peaceful neighbourhood, the complex lies just a short walking distance away from shopping opportunities, entertainment venues and offices. Ideal for business and leisure travellers alike, this property offers comfortable, fully-furnished accommodation options. The apartments offer a stylish home away from home, and come well equipped with modern amenities, providing everything that guests will need for a comfortable stay. This property has been designed to meet the lifestyle needs of every type of traveller visiting the area.
Due to Coronavirus (COVID-19), this property does not currently accept visitors.

373913.description: The Concierge Plaza San Rafael, a charming hotel nestled in the tranquil town of Cuyutlán, Colima, offers a relaxing getaway just steps from the beach. Known for its breathtaking Green Wave phenomenon from May to June, Cuyutlán boasts a wide, inviting shoreline. Explore the nearby Estero Palo Verde Ecological Reserve and 'El Tortugario' turtle sanctuary, both less than 800 meters away, or discover the unique Salt Museum, less than 500 meters from the hotel. Savor fresh seafood at local restaurants and unwind back at the hotel with its outdoor pool, garden area, and multipurpose palapa. Enjoy free Wi-Fi access in the main area. Comfortable rooms provide all necessary amenities for a restful stay after a day of exploring. Select rooms offer stunning ocean views and air conditioning.

378308.description:
Village Hotel Liverpool, in the suburb of Whiston, is 400 yards from the junction of the M57 and M62 allowing easy access to Liverpool and Warrington. Liverpool John Lennon Airport is a 20-minute drive and Whiston train station is 1 mile away. Liverpool has a vibrant arts scene, legendary football clubs, fantastic shopping and fascinating maritime history. The hotel has everything you'd need; stylish bedrooms with big cosy beds, huge TVs, great showers, pool and state-of-the-art gym with all the latest tech. Village Pub and Grill where you can tuck into delicious food and drink. 

Access to Leisure facilities charges £5 per day per room. Club Room guests receive access free.

378310.description:
Village Hotel Cardiff is near the M4 Junction 32, half a mile from Coryton train station. 15 minutes drive from the bustling City Centre and the Cardiff Bay area. Wales' capital is packed with history, nightlife and a variety of things to do. For sports fans, the Millennium Stadium and Cardiff City Stadium are nearby.   Cardiff Train Station and Cardiff Airport are just 4 miles away. The hotel has everything you'd need; new look fully refurbished bedrooms with big cosy beds, huge TVs, great showers, pool and state-of-the-art gym with all the latest tech. Village Pub & Grill where you can tuck into delicious food and drink.

378322.description: The establishment comprises a total of 92 snug rooms. There is Wi-Fi throughout the hotel. The Great Barr Hotel provides 24-hour reception. A fee may be chargeable for some services.

378328.description: Enjoy garden views from the terrace at this Victorian hotel, which offers complimentary Wi-Fi, wedding services, and tour/ticket assistance. A complimentary cooked-to-order breakfast is served daily. The on-site Brasserie features a bar/lounge and room service is available during limited hours. The hotel also provides a business center, multilingual staff, conference facilities, and free self-parking. Each of the 25 guestrooms includes a flat-screen television with digital programming, a private bathroom with complimentary toiletries, and conveniences such as a coffee/tea maker and a desk. Located near St Mary's Church, the hotel is also a short drive from Nungate Bridge and Lennoxlove Historic House. Edinburgh Airport (EDI) is the preferred airport.

378368.description: Everyone staying at this accommodation will enjoy a peaceful and calm stay on the premises, as it counts with a total of 14accomodation units. Travellers can make good use of the wireless internet connection available at the public areas of the property. The front desk offers 24-hour reception.

378393.description: This establishment offers a total of 42 guest rooms. This accomodation was completely renovated in 2025. In addition, Wi-Fi access is offered at the establishment's common spaces. Everyone staying at this accommodation can enjoy the convenience of 24-hour reception. Some services may be subject to additional charges.

378417.description: An enchanting Cotswold retreat in the picturesque town of Burford, few could resist the rustic charm of this 16th century residence, whether it is for a leisure break, business trip or special occasion. Bay Tree won Small Hotel of the Year at the National Enjoy England Excellence Awards 2011. The hotel also has a Gold Award for Excellence from Enjoy England. The Bay Tree is steeped in history and awash with character, from the foundations of its mellow stone walls - clad with pinkish-purple wisteria blooms - to its wooden beam rafters. Oak-panelled public rooms, bare stone walls and original stone fireplaces, including an inglenook fireplace, provide a textured canvas upon which rich fabrics, woven tapestries and antiques have been laid down with exquisite flair. For your relaxation, you can select a good book from the hotel library, sink back into a comfortable chair and allow the stresses of everyday life to gradually seep away. In the summer months, the tranquillity of the walled gardens make for a relaxing haven where you can enjoy a refreshing drink on a warm evening.

378424.description: The 20 welcoming guest rooms offer a perfect place to relax at the end of the day.

378462.description: The hotel comprises a total of 31 snug accomodation units. Ballantrae Hotel offers Wi-Fi internet connection in communal areas. Ballantrae Hotel offers 24-hour reception for guests' convenience.

name.content: Dalmeny Park Country House Hotel Gardens

378468.description: The Dalmeny Park Country House Hotel and Gardens, a beautifully restored Scottish mansion, is nestled within several acres of stunning gardens and grounds. Located in a quiet residential area on Glasgow's south side, just off the A736, it's only a short drive from Glasgow International Airport and the city center. This premier Scottish wedding and conference venue offers a traditional setting with elegant furnishings and decor, complementing the grandeur of the house and its expansive gardens. The hotel boasts ample car parking and provides dedicated wedding/event managers and a master of ceremonies. Whether you envision your ceremony indoors or within the romantic Secret Garden (suitable for up to 180 guests), Dalmeny Park provides a picturesque backdrop for your special day. Contact the hotel directly for wedding brochures or conference information.

378476.description: Enjoy garden and terrace views at The Fox & Goose Hotel, featuring complimentary Wi-Fi, wedding services, and a banquet hall. Dine at the on-site bar/lounge or enjoy room service (limited hours). Full breakfasts are available (fee applies). The hotel offers a 24-hour front desk, multilingual staff, luggage storage, conference space, a meeting room, and free self-parking. The 73 air-conditioned rooms include refrigerators, flat-screen TVs with satellite programming, private bathrooms with complimentary toiletries and hair dryers, safes, desks, and phones with free local calls. Located near Ealing Broadway Shopping Centre (1. 8 mi) and OVO Arena Wembley (2. 2 mi), the hotel is conveniently situated for exploring London. Heathrow Airport (LHR) is the closest airport, located 11. 8 miles away.

378486.description:
A short walk from Cardiff city centre and the Millenium Stadium, Cardiff Central offers free Wi-Fi. The reception is open 24/7.

The bedrooms are modern and all have their own bathroom. Each of them offers satellite TV, tea/coffee and ironing facilities.

A continental buffet breakfast is served every morning at an extra charge of £5 per person.

378536.description: With a stay at Boston Manor Hotel in London (Hanwell), you'll be within a 15-minute drive of Twickenham Stadium and Wembley Stadium. This hotel is 6. 4 mi (10. 3 km) from SSE Arena, Wembley and 6. 7 mi (10. 7 km) from Kensington High Street. Make use of convenient amenities such as complimentary wireless Internet access, a hair salon, and a banquet hall. Featured amenities include express check-out, a 24-hour front desk, and luggage storage. Event facilities at this hotel consist of a conference center and a meeting room. You can enjoy a meal at the restaurant serving the guests of Boston Manor Hotel, or stop in at the grocery/convenience store. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Stay in one of 46 guestrooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless Internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature rainfall showerheads and complimentary toiletries. Conveniences include phones, as well as coffee/tea makers and fans.

378556.description: In the heart of Cardiff city center, this family-run hotel offers free high-speed Wi-Fi. Cardiff Central Rail Station is a 5-minute walk away. Each room at Cardiff Sandringham Hotel has an LCD flat-screen TV with Freeview channels. There is also a 24-hour reception. The Principality Stadium and Cardiff Motorpoint Arena are both 5 minutes’ walk away. St David's Shopping Center can be reached in 1 minute on foot.

378620.description: Visitors will enjoy a peaceful and calm stay at Sandaig Guest House as it counts with a total of 9 rooms. Guests may take advantage of the Wi-Fi connection on public areas at Sandaig Guest House. The reception desk is not open throughout the day. The hotel may charge a fee for some services.

378629.description: There are a total of 37 rooms at The White Hart Hotel. Those who stay at this establishment can make good use of the wireless internet connection available at the public areas of the hotel. This hotel offers a 24-hour reception service, so that guests' needs will be fully met at any time of the day or night.

378647.description: Enjoy recreation amenities such as a fitness center or take in the view from a garden. Additional features at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, wedding services, and a television in a common area. Enjoy local cuisine at Blues at the Park, a restaurant which features a bar/lounge, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. Full breakfasts are served on weekdays from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM and on weekends from 8:00 AM to 11:00 AM for a fee. Featured amenities include a business center, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Event facilities at this hotel consist of a conference center and meeting rooms. Free self parking is available onsite. Stay in one of 50 guestrooms featuring LED televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and digital programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with shower/tub combinations feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers.

378648.description: Enjoy garden views and amenities like complimentary Wi-Fi and concierge services at Hapimag Resort Edinburgh. This upscale hotel offers a snack bar, common area television, and picnic area. The 29 guestrooms feature refrigerators, LCD TVs with digital programming, and private bathrooms with separate bathtubs and showers, complimentary toiletries, and bidets. Additional conveniences include in-room safes, phones, and desks. Dry cleaning, luggage storage, and a safe deposit box are available at the front desk. Self-parking is available for a fee. Situated in the heart of Edinburgh, you're a 15-minute walk from Princes Street and George Street, and conveniently close to the Edinburgh International Conference Centre and Edinburgh Castle.

378668.description: The Royal Oxford Hotel offers spacious, air-conditioned rooms with free Wi-Fi, less than half a mile from Oxford's historic center. Within a 10-minute walk of many Oxford University colleges, the hotel is also conveniently located just 656 feet from Oxford Rail Station. Riverside pubs and restaurants are a short walk away, and Oxford Bus Station is 0. 2 miles from the hotel. All en suite bedrooms include toiletries and fluffy towels, along with a flat-screen TV and complimentary tea and coffee facilities. Breakfast is available for purchase at The Olive Branch Café, located on the ground floor. The 24-hour reception desk can provide information on local attractions.

378713.address: Lucas House Reception 48 Edgbaston Park Road, 48
378713.description: Located a short distance from the town center, this 70-room hotel offers convenient access to area attractions and transportation links. Guests can enjoy on-site dining in an elegant restaurant, plus amenities like Wi-Fi and a 24-hour reception desk. The hotel also offers accessible rooms and on-site parking. Business facilities are available for corporate travelers. The nearest golf course is within 1400 km, and the airport is 28500 km away. Additional fees may apply for some services.

name.content: Summer stays at the university of Edinburgh

378780.description: Edinburgh First - Chancellors Court is a superb new development on Holyrood Park Road and is part of the University of Edinburgh Residences. Accommodation is comparable to a 3-star hotel with En-suite rooms featuring telephone, TV and Tea/Coffee facilities. On-site amenities including shop, cash-point and taxi rank. Edinburgh's historic Royal Mile and the city's main shopping areas are a short walk away (appr. 1. 5 Miles) and Holyrood Park and Arthur's Seat are also nearby. In addition, the no. 33 bus service leaves from very nearby and goes to Princes Street and the top of Leith Walk. **Please note that this property has twin bedded rooms only. **

379806.description: The Witchery by the Castle offers a range of opulent suites in Edinburgh, each one unique with its own special features. Some rooms overlook Edinburgh’s Royal Mile, looking down towards Princes Street, or across to the old town. An indulgent breakfast hamper will be served in the room each morning or guests can choose to have a cooked breakfast served in the restaurant at no extra cost. The Witchery’s seductive glamor has caught the attention of The Times, The Telegraph and Condé Nast Traveler, and many celebrity fans have enjoyed its suites. The impressive restaurant also showcases fine Scottish dishes in similarly decadent surroundings.

Nearby you can also find Stowe Gardens and Park, the largest landscape garden in Britain, which features a magnificent Georgian garden full of romantic temples and lakes. The ideal base to attend Silverstone Racing Circuit or for exploring Banbury, Buckingham, Oxford and Northampton, the Crown’s comfortable surroundings offer a cozy retreat coupled with good old-fashioned hospitality after a long day’s traveling.

380418.description: The Laird And Dog is located in the Midlothian village of Lasswade, a 15 minute drive from Edinburgh. It offers an atrium-style restaurant, rooms with free Wi-Fi and free parking. Modern rooms are decorated with light colors and feature flat-screen satellite TVs and work desks. Rooms also include hairdryers and tea/coffee-making facilities. The bar and restaurant serves hearty Scottish meals including haggis dishes, as well as pub favorites. There is a beer garden with covered seating for guests to relax in. There is a bus stop close to the property, which has regular services to central Edinburgh. The 15th-century Rosslyn chapel, which featured in the Da Vinci Code movies, is just 5 miles away, while Musselburgh Racecourse is a 15-minute drive from the Laird And Dog.

380669.description: With a central Glasgow location, The Pipers’ Tryst Hotel is a unique 4-star restaurant with rooms located at The National Piping Center - the home of Scottish Bagpiping. Free Wi-Fi is accessible throughout and as a registered charity, all profits go back into teaching the bagpipes within Scotland and locations worldwide. Each room includes a flat-screen TV, a desk and tea/coffee making facilities. A full Scottish breakfast is included in the room rate with a choice of tea/coffee, fruit juice, a continental buffet and full cooked options. The Ropewalks are stuffed with music venues, creative businesses and record playing bars. Our aparthotel is just a 2 minute walk from Liverpool One Shopping Centre and super close to The Beatles Story and Tate Liverpool. Ideal for business and leisure travellers alike! This area got its name from its history of rope manufacturing! The long straight streets were designed in order to make ropes for the city’s bustling maritime industry. We have a private and secure on-site carpark operated by Yourparkingspace. Please note it cannot be pre-booked and spaces are available on a first come first served basis. 380856.description: The Leapark Hotel is a family-owned hotel in the historical port of Grangemouth, within 3 miles of The Kelpies and 7 miles from the Falkirk Wheel. Stirling is a 25 minutes' drive away. The en-suite rooms feature modern decor, tea/coffee making facilities and Freeview TV. The ballroom can seat over 200 people, whilst the well-stocked bar offers relaxation and live televised sporting events on the large-screen TVs. Leapark Hotel also contains several meeting and conference rooms that can be rented for events and delegations. Just 1. 5 miles from the junction for the M9 motorway, offering access to both Edinburgh and Glasgow.

380884.description: Set within a beautifully restored Georgian townhouse in the heart of Edinburgh, our four boutique bedrooms offer an intimate and refined place to stay. Each room is individually designed, blending traditional architectural details with understated luxury—think generous proportions, rich textures, and thoughtful comforts that reward slowing down. Upstairs is calm and considered; downstairs, the house comes alive. Our Michelin-starred restaurant LYLA anchors the building, drawing international guests and locals alike for cooking that is precise, seafood focused, and unmistakably confident. Before dinner our bar offers a more relaxed counterpoint—a place for a perfectly made cocktail, a rare whisky, or a glass of great champagne. Staying with us means being immersed in one of Edinburgh’s great food destinations, while enjoying the privacy and character of a townhouse that feels more like a private home than a hotel. Discreet, indulgent, and deeply rooted in the city—this is a stay designed for those who notice the details.

All rooms feature a comfy king size bed with four plump pillows and a cosy duvet. Guests can enjoy a variety of food and drink choices within easy walking distance from this hotel. '

383476.description: Our Sunderland Central hotel, located across the River Wear from the National Glass Centre and Stadium of Light, is a short walk from the Empire Theatre and Sunderland Museum and Winter Gardens. Explore the stunning beaches of Roker and Seaburn en route to Souter Lighthouse and The Leas, or enjoy scenic walks inland at Herrington Country Park. Each room features a comfortable king-size bed with four plush pillows and a cozy duvet. A wide variety of dining options are within easy walking distance. Please note: Due to the hotel's central location, some external noise may be experienced.

383482.description: Our Cardiff Central Queen Street hotel is moments away from Cardiff's key landmarks. Cardiff University is virtually next door, and the Principality Stadium, Wales' rugby HQ, is just around the corner. Don't miss the National History Museum, Wales' most visited attraction. Then there's the Wales Millennium Centre, a world-class venue and a beautiful building in itself. Head to Cardiff Castle and to add a touch of timeless tradition to your stay. This hotel has upgraded rooms that feature a comfy king size bed with four plump pillows and a cosy duvet. Our on-site restaurant and bar serves breakfast and tasty evening meals. Useful informationThe hotel entrance is situated on The Friary, off Queen Street next to the Principality Building Society. Due to the thriving nightlife of this central location, some external noise can be heard.

383496.description: 'Planning a day trip to Liverpool? Our centrally located Exchange Hotel is the perfect base. Liverpool ONE shopping centre is just a half-mile away, and the stunning waterfront, with access to the Museum of Liverpool, Albert Dock, and the Tate art gallery, is right at the end of our street. All rooms feature a comfortable king-size bed with four plump pillows and a cozy duvet. Enjoy breakfast and delicious evening meals at our on-site restaurant and bar. '

383497.description: Those staying at this hotel may surf on the internet thanks to the Wi-Fi access ready to use on public areas. Guests will appreciate the 24-hour reception.

383498.description: This cosy hotel can be found in Enfield.

383500.description: The accomodation comprises a total of 239 snug rooms. Wi-Fi internet connection is available on public areas. Travelodge London Ilford does not offer 24-hour reception. Additional fees may apply for some services.

383501.description: Our London Twickenham hotel is just minutes' walk from Twickenham Stadium, the home of England Rugby and the second-largest stadium in the UK. With a rail station practically on your doorstep, it's easy to get into central London too. For a relaxing afternoon, take a walk to Marble House, in its nearby namesake park. You'll find plenty of pubs and restaurants along the way. Or walk along the riverside to Ham House and Garden, an awe-inspiring 17th century mansion. All rooms feature a comfy king size bed with four plump pillows and a cosy duvet. Our on-site restaurant and bar serves breakfast and tasty evening meals. '

name.content: ibis Styles Liverpool Centre Dale Street - Cavern

383530.description: Play 'spot the Beatles lyric' as you explore our swinging 60s-inspired décor, enjoy an inclusive continental breakfast each morning, and after exploring the amazing city enjoy a drink or a night cap at our friendly, relaxed bar. With easy access to the best that Liverpool has to offer, book your room at ibis Styles Liverpool Dale Street today for affordable accommodation with a quirky twist.

383539.description:
When you stay at Kip in the Kirk in Glasgow, you'll be in a national park, within a 15-minute drive of Loch Lomond and The Trossachs National Park and Loch Lomond.  This bed & breakfast is 7.8 mi (12.6 km) from Balloch Castle and 9.1 mi (14.7 km) from Loch Lomond Shores.
Make use of convenient amenities, which include complimentary wireless Internet access and discounted use of a nearby fitness facility.
Featured amenities include luggage storage, laundry facilities, and coffee/tea in a common area. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours), and free self parking is available onsite.
A complimentary continental breakfast is served daily from 7:00 AM to 8:00 AM.
Stay in one of 2 guestrooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless Internet access keeps you connected, and digital programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include blackout drapes/curtains, housekeeping is provided daily, and irons/ironing boards can be requested.

383548.description: Located in Glossop and within 13 miles of Victoria Baths, The Bulls Head features a bar, non-smoking rooms, and free WiFi throughout the property. The property is around 13 miles from Manchester Apollo, 13 miles from Etihad Stadium Manchester and 14 miles from Manchester Museum. Clayton Hall Museum is 14 miles from the hotel and Whitworth Art Gallery is 14 miles away. At the hotel, every room includes a closet, a flat-screen TV, a private bathroom, bed linen and towels. University of Manchester is 14 miles from The Bulls Head, while Piccadilly Train Station is 14 miles away. Manchester Airport is 22 miles from the property.

385332.description: Located a short 2km walk from the town center, this hotel offers easy access to numerous attractions, including a golf course within 12km. Just 200 meters away, guests will find convenient transport links and the nearest beach. The hotel, renovated in 2012, features 149 cozy accommodations and provides Wi-Fi in public areas. A 24-hour reception desk and an on-site restaurant serving delicious meals cater to guests' needs, while tailored entertainment options ensure a memorable stay. The airport and harbor are within 30km and 6km respectively.

387386.description: Aloft Liverpool is just a few metres from the Moorfields Railway Station and half a mile from Liverpool Lime Street Station. Featuring a restaurant, bar, fitness centre, and evening entertainment, the hotel also offers a 24-hour front desk and free WiFi throughout. The rooms come with a flat-screen TV, modern décor and a large en suite bathroom with walk-in shower and free toiletries. At the restaurant, guests will enjoy a real taste from New York with the American service and style. Enjoy live music over the weekend and a cocktail at the bar. There is also a 24 hour snack bar available. Local attractions include Princes Dock and Parade, 1 mile away and the Titanic Memorial, 10 minutes’ walk away, while Merseyside Maritime Museum and the Tate Liverpool are 0. 7 mile away. Liverpool Cathedral is located 1 mile away.

389340.description: The Holiday Inn Cardiff - North M4, Jct. 32 is conveniently located just off the M4 motorway, a 10-minute drive from Cardiff city centre. Excellent transport links via bus stops right outside the hotel and nearby Coryton train station provide easy access to the city, the scenic South Wales countryside, and the Pembrokeshire coast. Cardiff Airport (CWL) is a 25-minute drive away. Ideal for business travelers, the hotel is within easy reach of business parks in Caerphilly, Treforest, Greenmeadows, and Pontypridd, and offers five conference rooms for events of up to 200 people. Leisure facilities include a complimentary leisure club with an indoor pool and Jacuzzi, plus beauty treatments. Dining options include the hotel restaurant, a Starbucks coffee shop, and a sports bar. Rooms feature pillow menus and 24-hour room service, while executive rooms include Smart TVs. Free Wi-Fi and parking are also available.

390320.description: Make use of convenient amenities, which include complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. Enjoy a meal at the restaurant, or stay in and take advantage of the hotel's 24-hour room service. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. Full breakfasts are available daily from 7:00 AM to noon for a fee. Featured amenities include complimentary newspapers in the lobby, dry cleaning/laundry services, and a 24-hour front desk. Self parking (subject to charges) is available onsite. Make yourself at home in one of the 37 air-conditioned rooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with separate bathtubs and showers feature rainfall showerheads and designer toiletries. Conveniences include laptop-compatible safes and desks, and housekeeping is provided daily. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer.

390868.description: Dream Apartments have been finished to the highest standard, with all the modern conveniences to ensure you have a delightful stay, including free Wi-Fi, Smart TV's and spacious living and dining areas. An energetic city, with a hip, youthful vibe, Belfast features splendid architecture, world-class culinary choices and a booming arts and music scene. Whether you are in this historic city for business, studies or a vacation with family and friends, Belfast's many ‘Quarters' (neighbourhoods) will charm you with their unique style and character. What could make your stay even more exceptional is the choice of over 100 spacious serviced apartments offered by Dream Apartments.

393165.description: Book a Bed Hostel is a budget-friendly hostel for travelers and backpackers in London. Our bright, fun, and recently refurbished space welcomes visitors from all over the world, located above The Royal Standard pub. All dormitories include free Wi-Fi, in-room lockers, and fresh linens. The hostel is conveniently located a short train ride from London Bridge in central London, 20 minutes from the Olympic Stadium in Stratford, and within walking distance of the Greenwich Mean Time and Meridian Line. Situated in West Greenwich, Book a Bed Hostel is close to three stations: Deptford Bridge (DLR), Deptford (National Rail), and New Cross (Overground), offering easy access to central London and attractions like the Royal Observatory, Cutty Sark, the Emirates Air Line, and the O2 Arena. We strive to ensure a great stay in a clean, comfortable, and safe environment. Book a Bed Hostel offers a unique and memorable London experience.

394145.description: Enjoy amenities like a 24-hour fitness center and terrace with city views. This hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, tour/ticket assistance, and dining at The Warwick Cafe, plus a coffee shop/cafe for snacks and a bar/lounge for evening drinks. Business travelers appreciate the 24-hour business center and other convenient services, such as dry cleaning/laundry and a 24-hour front desk. Each of the 315 guestrooms features a kitchen equipped with a refrigerator and oven, along with a pillowtop bed, Smart TV, and Wi-Fi (surcharge). A safe, desk, and phone are also provided for your convenience. The hotel is located near Cromwell Road, just a short distance from Kensington High Street and the Olympia Conference and Exhibition Centre.

395490.description: These bright and stylish apartments feature modern kitchens and free WiFi, and are located a 15-minute walk from London Bridge station and the South Bank. All kitchens at Residence Inn by Marriott London Bridge are fully equipped with kitchen utensils, an oven and hob and a microwave for cooking. A dishwasher, refrigerator, and washing machine are also included. Living areas provide flat-screen TVs and modern wood flooring. Guests can relax with comfortable sofas and a dining area with a table and chairs. Bermondsey Street with its chic shops and galleries is 5 minutes away on foot. The fashionable South Bank area, with the Tate Modern Gallery, is a 25-minute walk.

397945.description: With rooms with attached bathroom and a cozy bar and restaurant, the Fountain Hotel is 5 minutes’ walk from Seven Sisters Tube Station and 3 miles from Arsenal’s Emirates Stadium. The pub offers Japanese cuisine, and there is free Wi-Fi access throughout. Each room has a flat-screen TV, fridge and tea and coffee facilities. All have an en suite shower. Complimentary light breakfasts are available daily. They include cereal, orange juice, milk and tea/coffee which can be brought to the rooms. Guests also have use of a modern kitchen for self-catering. Seven Sisters has direct links to King’s Cross/ St Pancras and Oxford Circus on the Victoria Line, both less than 15 minutes away. Local attractions include Alexandra Palace, around 3 miles away.

399099.description: The Mercure Edinburgh Haymarket hotel is ideally located in the heart of Edinburgh, making it the perfect base for guests looking to explore this historic city. This stylish 4-star hotel provides all the comforts of home and more, with spacious rooms and plenty of on-site faculties such as a fitness centre and more. With easy access to the Edinburgh International Conference Centre (EICC) and Haymarket train station, the hotel is ideal for guests looking for style and convenience.

399439.description: Take in the views from a terrace and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access and concierge services. This hotel also features an arcade/game room and a picnic area. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary continental breakfast is served on weekdays from 7:00 AM to 9:00 AM and on weekends from 8:00 AM to 10:00 AM. Featured amenities include luggage storage, a safe deposit box at the front desk, and an elevator. Limited parking is available onsite. Stay in one of 32 guestrooms featuring flat-screen televisions. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and digital programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include desks and coffee/tea makers, and housekeeping is provided daily. Distances are displayed to the nearest 0. 1 mile and kilometer. Sefton Park - 0. 3 km / 0. 2 mi- Lark Lane - 1. 1 km / 0.

name.content: Forest Of Arden Hotel & Country Club

400799.description: Located in Meriden, Solihull, the Forest of Arden Hotel & Country Club is a short drive from Resorts World Birmingham and the National Exhibition Centre. This upscale hotel is also convenient to The Bear Grylls Adventure (9. 4 km) and Coventry University (14. 7 km). Indulge in a pampering spa treatment with massages, body treatments, and facials. Guests can enjoy outdoor tennis courts, an indoor pool, and a golf course. Complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and wedding services are also available. The hotel offers 214 guestrooms featuring Smart TVs, pillowtop beds with down comforters and Egyptian cotton sheets, and digital programming. Bathrooms include shower/tub combinations and hair dryers. Dine at The Fairway Bar & Grill, one of the hotel's two restaurants, offering British cuisine, or take advantage of the 24-hour room service. A bar/lounge and breakfast service (for a fee) are also available. Business travelers will appreciate the 24-hour business center, complimentary newspapers, and dry cleaning/laundry services.

401438.description: This elegant hotel is well located in Elstree. Conveniently situated on the M1, the hotel is situated just 26 km from Wembley Stadium and 24 km from Warner Brothers Harry Potter Studios in Leavesdon. Brent Cross Shopping Centre is a short drive away. Elstree and Borehamwood Railway Station is just 3. 2 km from the hotel. London Heathrow and London Luton airports are within 56. 3 km of the hotel. This property is classically styled. The guest rooms feature soothing tones, for a peaceful ambiance. Excellent facilities are available for the comfort and convenience of every type of traveller. The restaurant, bar and lounge offer excellent dining and relaxation options.

402697.description: This charming property is located at the heart of the stylish Bloomsbury district in London. It is just a 15 minutes' walking distance away from Euston Station. The hotel is a 5 minutes' walk from Russell Square Underground Station, offering ease of access to the city centre. The British Museum, Oxford Street and Covent Garden are all within easy reach. This hotel features bright, airy guest rooms, which are fitted with modern conveniences. Guests can enjoy a superb breakfast in the mornings, for a great start to the day. The hotel features a 24-hour reception desk, ensuring that guests' needs are fully attended to at any time.

403060.description: Holiday Inn Express London – ExCeL, conveniently located in the heart of East London, is perfectly suited for business or leisure stays. The hotel also boasts excellent transport links to Canary Wharf, the O2 arena and central London attractions. This stunning property boasts 204 bedrooms and three meeting rooms. Every guest staying will receive a free buffet breakfast as part of their stay, and our restaurant offers a 24 hour menu as well as alfresco dining on our hotel terrace. The hotel is just a short walk from the iconic ExCeL Convention Centre, within walking distance or a 5-minute taxi ride to London City Airport and 200 metres walking distance to the Docklands Light Railway at Royal Albert Station. Royal Albert has direct links to Custom House Station where guests can change to the new Elizabeth Line for a quick passage into Central London and Heathrow Airport. The hotel is also within easy reach of both Westfield Shopping Centre and the Olympic Park at Stratford, in addition to the O2 arena at North Greenwich only a short distance away by train. For up to two sleepers choose from Standard rooms with options of Double room offering Queen or King bed, or Twin room with 2 separate single beds. For families, our Family room is ideal and consists of Double & Sofa bed allowing up to 2 Adults & 2 Children (under 12 years) to stay. Our Accessible Double rooms for perfect for guests requiring Wheelchair or step free access.

403423.description: Enjoy Dublin from The Dean Dublin Centre, located in the heart of the city, just a short walk from Grafton Street and St. Stephen's Green. Make the most of the outdoor pool and fitness center. Dine at our rooftop restaurant, Sophies, specializing in international cuisine, or enjoy 24-hour room service. Relax with a drink at one of our three bars/lounges. Cooked-to-order breakfast is available daily (fee applies), Monday to Friday 7 am to 11 am, Saturday & Sunday 8 am to 11am. Amenities include a 24-hour business center and complimentary Wi-Fi. Our 51 air-conditioned rooms feature minibars, LCD TVs with satellite channels, pillowtop beds with Egyptian cotton sheets, and private bathrooms with rainfall showers.

name.content: Hampton by Hilton Birmingham Jewellery Quarter

404338.description: Centred in the Jewellery Quarter, we’re near Snow Hill Station. Birmingham Museum & Art Gallery is less than a mile away and the Utilita Arena is just a seven-minute drive. The city centre’s shops, bars, and restaurants are within minutes and the NEC is only 13 miles from us. Enjoy our fitness centre, Wi-Fi and free breakfast to help fuel your day.

404481.description: Enjoy a comfortable stay and a convenient location at Hampton by Hilton Newcastle. Our modern, stylish hotel is situated in the heart of the city, opposite Newcastle Central Station and within easy walking distance of the city’s biggest local attractions. Located just north of the iconic River Tyne, one of the leading riverside attractions in the UK, this Newcastle hotel is only minutes from the Utilita Arena, The Glasshouse International Centre for Music, the Baltic Centre, Laing Art Gallery, and Newcastle United Football Club’s St James’ Park. Enjoy superb local shopping within Newcastle’s main streets and districts, as well as some fantastic department stores. The corporate offices of many of Newcastle’s top companies are also within easy reach. Enjoy a variety of modern amenities and thoughtful touches in a bright, spacious guest room at this Newcastle hotel. Check emails with free WiFi and work in comfort at the large desk. Refresh in the invigorating walk-in shower and get a great night’s sleep in the comfy bed. There is a hot breakfast included when you stay at this welcoming Newcastle hotel. The relaxed Hub bar/lounge area is open 24/7 and is the perfect place to enjoy a coffee, light meal or drink. Energize with contemporary cardio, resistance and weights equipment in the free 24-hour fitness room, featuring a Peloton bike with toe cages. Stay productive in the 24-hour work zone, where you can print documents and surf the web with free WiFi.

407262.address: Key Eye Tower Ealing Road Brentford
407262.description: Perfect for a business trip as well as for your leisure stay, the Adagio London Brentford benefits from an ideal location. The aparthotel is situated close to London city centre and all the point of interest with direct transportation. London Heathrow airport is also at only 15 min by car. This property offers 100 apartments with a fully equipped kitchen, a large balcony, flat screen TV and free wifi access. For even more comfort, the aparthotel provides a fitness centre and an indoor private parking.

407649.description: Located just steps from the North Terminal check-in desks and a few minutes from the South Terminal via monorail, this hotel offers easy access to London, Brighton, and the South East, as well as nearby business hubs and attractions, including Crawley, East Grinstead, Redhill, Reigate, and Burgess Hill. Relax in air-conditioned guest rooms featuring free Wi-Fi, an LCD TV, a walk-in power shower, and a comfortable bed. Enjoy a complimentary hot breakfast each morning and grab a snack or light meal anytime from the 24/7 menu. Stay productive with flexible meeting room options or recharge in the free 24-hour fitness center, exclusively for guests. Expect friendly service, clean rooms, and comfortable surroundings – every time. Not satisfied? You won't pay with our 100% Hampton Guarantee.

411219.description: The following services and amenities are available, but with reduced service: Complimentary Evening Social, Fitness Center, On-site Restaurant(s), Pool, Room Service. The following services and amenities are currently not available: Concierge, Executive Lounge, Valet Parking. Featuring a stunning industrial design of bronzed metal, glass and layered brick, Hilton London Bankside places guests near trendy South Bank, Tate Modern and Borough Market. This new hotel is a short walk to Bankside, home of foodie festivals, popular bars and restaurants, and street artists. Attend a play at National Theatre, visit The Shard for spectacular city views, and stroll to Tower Bridge to watch the London Marathon. This unique split-level hotel offers an ideal vantage for New Year's Eve fireworks and River Thames events. Corporate visitors will appreciate the quick walk to the Financial District. Relax in a guest room detailed with contemporary furnishings and original artwork. For your comfort, all guest rooms feature air-conditioning, complimentary WiFi, interactive LCD TVs and a work desk with ample outlets. Upgrade to an executive room for access to the tranquil Executive Lounge, including refreshments and business services. Enjoy steaks and seafood with an innovative twist at OXBO Bankside, perfect for power lunches and after-work dinners. Unwind with a cocktail and light bites in The Distillery, a nod to the hotel building's heritage. Maintain your exercise routine with the heated fitness pool and fully equipped fitness center. With 1, 000 sq. meters of event space, this Bankside hotel is ideal for conferences and celebrations of up to 750 guests. Lead a seminar in one of eight meeting rooms, or treat wedding guests to dancing and catered dining in an elegant Ballroom.

411579.description: Take in the views from a terrace and a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access. Additional features at this hotel include wedding services, a fireplace in the lobby, and a ballroom. At Weston Manor Hotel, enjoy a satisfying meal at the restaurant. Wrap up your day with a drink at the bar/lounge. A complimentary buffet breakfast is served daily from 7:00 AM to 10:00 AM. Featured amenities include a 24-hour front desk, multilingual staff, and luggage storage. This hotel has 2 meeting rooms available for events. Free self parking is available onsite. Treat yourself to a stay in one of the 29 individually decorated guestrooms, featuring heated floors and LED televisions. Your Tempur-Pedic bed comes with premium bedding. Complimentary wireless internet access keeps you connected, and digital programming is available for your entertainment. Conveniences include phones, as well as complimentary bottled water and portable fans.

413084.description: Overlooking the iconic Wembley Stadium and set next to the historic Wembley Arena, this stylish and modern hotel is just 15 minutes from the city centre and 40 minutes’ drive from London Heathrow Airport. The hotel is also located adjacent to the London Designer Outlet, great for shopping and eating out. Check in to your bright and airy guest room and relax while watching a movie on the LCD TVs. Rooms also feature private bathrooms with free toiletries, desks, coffee and tea making facilities, mini bars, safes, hairdryers. The hotel has a bar and a restaurant and offers great value Italian and British cuisines. There is a business centre with contemporary equipment. Wi-fi is free of charge. Parking spaces available in our car park (upon request). Wembley Park (Jubilee Line and Metropolitan Lines) and Wembley Statium Station is a 7 minutes’ walk away. Bus stop at the hotel door steps.

416760.address: Hawthorn House, Forth Banks, Newcastle upon Tyne
416760.description: Smart central Newcastle hotel with refined meeting spaces and Gin BarJust steps from Newcastle rail station in the city centre, Crowne Plaza® Newcastle - Stephenson Quarter hotel offers upmarket style and gracious service. Newcastle Airport (NCL) is a 15-minute drive, and there’s paid parking in the multi-storey car park next door. A 10-minute walk takes you to Central Station for frequent Metro trains around the city. Corporate guests can host up to 400 people in 9 event spaces, and Completely Connected power access ensures you’re always productive. Conferences and concerts at the iconic Sage Gateshead cultural centre are less than a mile away. City centre shops are within a short walk, and football fans are 20 minutes by foot from Newcastle United’s St. James' Park. At this hotel you can enjoy:- Free WiFi- A 24-hour Business Centre- All Day DiningAfter a day of meetings or sightseeing, unwind in the spa, indoor pool or gym. Treat yourself to a massage, followed by cocktails in our Gin Bar. Savour brasserie-style British cuisine in Hawthorns restaurant – if you’re busy, Fast & Fresh menu selections help you stay focused. Our Sleep Advantage® programme ensures restful nights in stylishly decorated rooms with premium bedding and the option of Quiet Zone accommodation. For exclusive Club Lounge access, book a Club room.

417498.description: Nestled in Bo'ness' historical district, the Richmond Park Hotel offers a comfortable stay just a short drive from West Lothian Golf Club and Macdonald Inchyra Hotel Spa. Enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi, on-site dining at The Copper Kiln restaurant and bar/lounge, and a daily full breakfast (available for a fee). The hotel's 45 guestrooms feature private bathrooms with complimentary toiletries, electric kettles, and tea/coffee making facilities. Free self-parking and a 24-hour front desk are also available. Nearby attractions include Linlithgow Palace and Blackness Castle. Edinburgh Airport (EDI) is conveniently located 13. 3 miles away.

418761.description: These serviced apartments are centrally located in Edinburgh, with convenient public transport connections and popular destinations like Princess Street just two minutes away. The bright, spacious accommodations are tastefully designed and fully equipped, offering a relaxing haven from the city's hustle and bustle. Each apartment features a spacious open-plan lounge/dining area with a fully fitted luxury kitchen, a bathroom with a shower, and a comfortable bedroom. With studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom options available, there's an ideal choice for business travelers, families, or groups of friends. Check-in is available from 8:30 am to 7:00 pm, Monday to Friday, and 10:30 am to 7:00 pm on Saturday. Reception is closed on Sunday. For arrivals outside these hours, please contact The Spires reception. A £250 security deposit is required before arrival via our secure online payment portal. Please contact The Spires reception 48-72 hours before your arrival to provide your details.

name.content: ibis Styles Edinburgh St Andrew Square

419098.description: From the extensive continental breakfast spread each morning and 24-hour snack service, to the ever-cheery welcome at our on-site bar and restaurant, we work hard to make sure bellies are full and hearts are happy from sunup until well after sundown. And tucked away as we are in one of the prettiest districts of Edinburgh, your trip to this captivating Celtic charmer of a city is off to a braw start!

421259.description: Described by the New York Times as 'the most handsome inn in the world' the Feathers Hotel is one of Ludlow's most popular attractions. Set in a magnificent timber-framed building in the centre of picturesque Ludlow, 300 metres from Ludlow Castle and a 10-minute walk from the River Teme. The Feathers Hotel offers free car parking with limited spaces and free WiFi. Rooms at The Feathers Hotel Ludlow are elegantly decorated, and each has a private bathroom. All rooms have a hairdryer, flat-screen TV with a DVD player, and tea/coffee facilities. Room service is also available. The award-winning Feathers Restaurant serves a modern British menu using fresh, locally sourced produce. The Feathers Bar offers real ales, fine wines and afternoon tea/coffee.

name.content: King S Hotel Batam A Phm Collection

422796.address: Jl. Yos Sudarso Seraya Atas Batam Island
422796.description: Enjoy a wealth of amenities at Kings Hotel Nagoya Batam, including complimentary Wi-Fi and on-site parking. Stay warm on cooler days by the hotel's cozy fireplace. This smoke-free hotel offers designated smoking areas for guests' convenience. Start your day with a delicious breakfast and freshly brewed coffee at our in-house cafe. A variety of dining options are readily available throughout the day. Make sure to visit the hotel pool during your stay for a refreshing dip.

425579.description: The 4-star Pullman Liverpool Hotel is located at Kings Dock on Liverpool world famous waterfront. Pullman Liverpool offers 216 bedrooms - from Superior to Deluxe, Premium Deluxe to Suites - a bar, lounge and restaurant on-site, meetings and events space and fitness lounge, Pullman Liverpool is perfect for both Business and Leisure. Free Wi-Fi available throughout the hotel. Pullman Liverpool accepts card payments only throughout the hotel.

426278.address: Playa Miramar A38 y 39 Colonia Miramar, 1
426278.description: Situated on Manzanillo's finest beach, Miramar Beach, this exclusive hotel offers discerning guests tranquility and relaxation. Each of the six luxurious rooms boasts stunning ocean views and sunsets. Unwind with a massage under the gentle sea breeze or savor delicious cuisine and drinks at the palapa restaurant. Luxurious furnishings and amenities complete the experience.

436381.description: The Temple Bar Inn is located in the heart of Dublin's history and culture. Surrounded by bustling cafes, bars and some of Dublin's best restaurants, the Inn is also walking distance to Trinity College, Dublin Castle, and The Guinness Storehouse. This prime location means our guests can fully immerse themselves in Ireland's capital city. The Inn's funky and fresh design throughout is complimented by bespoke Celtic art influences. With complimentary wi-fi, a 24-hour coffee station and a comfortable lounge area, the Temple Bar Inn perfectly suits the needs of a modern-day traveler. Each room includes everything you need for the most comfortable of stays such as a flat-screen TV, secure safe, mini-bar, tea and coffee making facilities as well as toiletries and fresh towels daily. Relax in our bright and modern rooms with views of the famous Temple Bar quarter below. Just step outside to find all Dublin has to offer, the Temple Bar Inn will ensure your stay is unforgettable.

439321.description: This delightful property is situated right in the heart of Bayswater, in the serene street of Craven Terrace. Both Paddington and Lancaster Gate tube stations are only moments away, offering direct links to all of London's famous sites and attractions. With extremely comfortable and relaxing ensuite bedrooms ranging from single to family rooms and equipped with flat screen televisions, as well as complimentary tea/coffee making facilities, the hotel’s main aim is to ensure guest satisfaction throughout their stay. Rooms range in size and present a combination of both style and function, in order to tender to our guests requirements. The property offers accommodation of exceptional comfort, with some rooms providing views of Craven Terrace peaceful surroundings, as well as a cosy breakfast room to start the best way possible with a warm coffee and an English breakfast.

443581.description: These upmarket serviced apartments are located in the heart of London's Kensington district, close to Harrods, the Royal Albert Hall, and the Victoria and Albert Museum. Ideal for corporate travelers, leisure visitors, and families, these single and double apartments feature a private kitchen with a washing machine, cooker, and other amenities, including a large flat-screen TV, safe, and Wi-Fi. Breakfast is served daily. The Presidential Apartments are within walking distance of the underground, serving both the Piccadilly and District lines. All apartments are serviced daily by a team of professional housekeepers, and a 24-hour desk is available to assist with any needs, such as taxi and laundry services, as well as theater bookings.

444161.description: Enjoy recreation amenities such as a fitness center or take in the view from a terrace. Additional amenities at this hotel include complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and wedding services. Whatever your London plans include, our hotel in London Waterloo provides you with a central location from which to explore.

592266.description: One of the great Castle Mansion Houses of Scotland, Carberry Tower Mansion House and Estate is a place of intimate grandeur. And to arrive here, is to weave your own journey into a story that goes back to 1480 when our first foundation stone was laid. Since then, we have been a gathering place for Kings and Queens, Princes and Princesses and over the centuries the great and the good have also come to warm themselves by our fires and feast from our banqueting tables. And today, more strongly than ever, the banner that reigns over Carberry Tower continues to reflect the matchless values of excellence, abundance and grace - coupled together of course, with the very warmest of Scottish hospitality.

597704.description: Staying in Deptford Bridge puts you close to one of South East London’s most characterful corners, where old railway arches and former dockyard spaces have been reimagined as cafés, galleries, breweries, and creative hangouts. Spend the afternoon browsing Deptford Market Yard beneath the Victorian railway arches, hop on the DLR for a quick trip into central London, or wander over to Greenwich for open green spaces and riverside views. With Deptford Bridge DLR moments away, Canary Wharf and the City are both within easy reach, while the neighbourhood’s mix of local culture, live music, and creative energy gives it a distinctly London feel without the crowds. As always, our aparthotel makes your stay simple and stress-free, with spacious apartments, fully equipped kitchens, and a 24-hour reception team on hand whenever you need them. Deptford Market Yard sits beneath restored Victorian railway arches and has become a popular spot for independent food vendors, bars, and local businesses.

597771.description: Our beautiful aparthotel is located in Birmingham’s historic Jewellery Quarter. It’s stuffed with bars, restaurants and home to the iconic Jam House culture hub. Aston Villa FC and Cadbury World are just a short train ride away. Plus we’re just a 5 minute walk from central Brum and right beside the International Convention Centre. *Fancy a trip to a coffin-making museum? Victorian pens more your thing? Both museums are a 5 minute walk away! Our Staycafé is open 24/7 and serves a grab and go breakfast, snacks and pizzas (you can order these to go and enjoy them in your apartment if you prefer!), freshly ground coffee, bottled beer, cider, wine and soft drinks (note: sales of alcohol are restricted after 11pm).

597921.description: Experience the best of Dublin, from Viking history and bustling flea markets to trendy bars and leafy parks. Our aparthotel is nestled between Dublin's two iconic cathedrals, with Temple Bar and the Liberties on either side. Explore charming cafés, pop-up markets, and pizza bars, all within a 5-minute walk. Nearby, Thomas Street offers a taste of local life with street vendors selling flowers, fruit, and knick-knacks. Our modern apartments feature kitchens, living rooms, and free Wi-Fi. You can head to central London in 30 minutes and to London Heathrow Airport (LHR) in 25 minutes from Boston Manor Tube Station, just over a mile away. If you're travelling by car, the nearby Deans Garden Car Park offers low daily rates and free overnight parking. Browse stores in the Westfield London shopping centre, 30 minutes' drive from the hotel. Enjoy football? Head to a Premier League game at Wembley Stadium, just over five miles from the hotel. If you prefer musicals, hop on the Tube and go to a West End show, a 30-minute journey away. Make a day of it by visiting the London Eye and other central attractions. Host a meeting for up to eight people in the hotel's smart conference room. Staff can provide catering and the latest AV equipment, and delegates can enjoy free Wi-Fi throughout the hotel. Power your day with an inclusive breakfast with sausages, bacon, scrambled eggs and baked beans, plus continental options, from the contemporary Express Café, or you can grab a tasty pizza or soup from the all-day menu. Later, pull up a stool at the bright, modern bar or unwind in a comfortable armchair.
