Each of the 34 individually decorated guest rooms features a minibar, a flat-screen TV, complimentary Wi-Fi, digital programming, and a private bathroom with designer toiletries and a hairdryer. Conveniences include a phone, a laptop-compatible safe, and a desk. Located near the Thames River, the hotel is within 3. 2 km (2 mi) of the O2 Arena and ExCeL Exhibition Centre, and close to other popular attractions such as ABBA Arena and Queen Elizabeth Olympic Park. The closest major airport is London City Airport (LCY), 5. 5 km (3. 4 mi) away. 
Note-"An extra bed can be provided upon request at GBP 30 per night. "

615582.description: The hotel is located in Belfast's busy city centre. It is only 1. 5 km from Belfast Central Train Station and 17 minutes' walk from Belfast Botanical Gardens. George Best Belfast City Airport can be reached less than10-minute drive. Many popular attractions can be found within a short distance. From the hotel, Belfast Castle is 13 minutes' drive away and Belfast Zoo is a further minute away. The popular Titanic Quarter is also just 3 km away. For shopping, Victoria Square Shopping Centre is a 16-minute walk from the hotel. The hotel features rooms with suite bathroom, a flat-screen TV, a clothes rack and a work desk. In the morning, an unlimited continental breakfast is served in the dining room. Hot drinks, fruit juices, breads, cereals and dairy products are also available.

616760.address: blok VI, Jl. Pembangunan, Batu Selicin, Lubuk B
616760.description: Set in a prime location of Batam Island, Sahid Vanilla Nagoya Hotel Batam puts everything the city has to offer just outside your doorstep. The hotel offers a wide range of amenities and perks to ensure you have a great time. Free Wi-Fi in all rooms, 24-hour security, daily housekeeping, taxi service, 24-hour front desk are just some of the facilities on offer. Comfortable guestrooms ensure a good night's sleep with some rooms featuring facilities such as television LCD/plasma screen, free welcome drink, mirror, slippers, towels. The hotel offers various recreational opportunities. A welcoming atmosphere and excellent service are what you can expect during your stay at Sahid Vanilla Nagoya Hotel Batam.

616961.description: This 4-star hotel, established in 2017, is located in Belfast city centre, near Blackstaff Square and Great Victoria Street station. The hotel features a restaurant and 237 rooms equipped with a hairdryer, safe, ironing set, and air conditioning. Enhanced sanitization procedures, rigorously reviewed by Bureau Veritas, are in place.

617383.description: Well located in the heart of Dublin, Maldron Hotel Kevin Street provides buffet breakfast and free WiFi. Situated conveniently in the Dublin City Centre, the property is located a 5-minute walk from St Patrick's Cathedral. Grain and Grill restaurant serves an international cuisine and Maldron Hotels have developed its very own Vitality Breakfast . The nearest airport is Dublin Airport, 10 km from the property. Hotel has implemented a full range of enhanced sanitisation procedures and new practices which have been rigorously reviewed by Bureau Veritas, a trusted, independent global leader in tested, inspections and certification. Hotel has been accredited by Green Tourism, a certification program that provides a framework to achieve a sustainable business in the tourism industry.

617756.address: Jl. Sriwijaya No. 1, Kp. Pelita, Riau
617756.description: Aston Batam Hotel & Residence is a four-star hotel located in the center of Batam, a city where business and entertainment chime in harmony. The hotel is located only 25 minutes away from Hang Nadim Airport and only 8 minutes from Harbour Bay Ferry Terminal, making it one of the most strategic trading center in Indonesia. Aston Batam Hotel & Residence is pleasantly and stylishly designed with 232 rooms divided into four room types: Superior, Deluxe, Family, and Suite Room. All rooms are completed with modern room and bathroom amenities, and guests could enjoy high speed WiFi access inside their own room and throughout the hotel area. Diverse selection of facilities such as swimming pool, fitness center, and spa are available to pamper guests and ensure the most memorable stay in the city.

618041.description: Nestled in the bustling heart of London, Montcalm Royale London House, London city enjoys a central location, adjacent to Finsbury Square Garden and just a brief stroll from Liverpool Street. The hotel presents a rooftop bar affording breathtaking views of the city, along with a spa and fitness centre, an on-site brewery, and an array of luxurious amenities seamlessly integrated throughout. All rooms and suites here are air-conditioned and come with a Smart 55-inch TV with international channels, free Wi-Fi, an iPod docking station, a minibar, a Nespresso machine and a pillow menu. Montcalm Royal London House features 2 bars and 2 restaurants including a rooftop bar, brasserie and coffee area, and offers 24-hour room service and concierge.

618283.description:
Situated in the heart of Dublin, Dublin Central Suites feature 22 elegantly furnished self-catering apartments with free WiFi, fully equipped kitchen, a dining area and a 24 hour reception desk. 

Located just off Dorset Street (N1), the serviced apartments are less than 15 minutes' (10km) drive from Dublin Airport and 10 minutes' walk from Dublin's main shopping and entertainment streets including Henry Street and Grafton Street which are ideal places to visit for the shopaholics. 

The nearest LUAS (Tram) stop at Parnell Square is also less than 10 minutes' walk (900m) away. Football fans will find themselves in the close proximity of Croke Park which is only 8 minutes' walk (700m) away. Airlink Express bus stop is also down the road from the apartments on Lower Gardiner Street. 

All apartments are fitted with large LED Smart TVs with large selection of satellite TV channels and feature a digital safe, fridge/freezer, kettle, toaster, cooker and a work desk. Private bathrooms feature power showers and free toiletries. Washing machines are available on site. 

Most apartments feature sofa beds and are ideal for families, larger groups or business travellers who seek privacy and comfort of home only an apartment can offer. 
Kindly note the accommodation is located on the upper floors, and is accessible via stairs only. Therefore it may not be suitable for guests with mobility impairment.

There are no parking spaces at the property however, there is ample street parking and a large car park is only 2 minutes' drive away. The car park costs €15 per day. 

Be aware that Dublin Central Suites is strictly NON SMOKING throughout all guest rooms, guest lounge, corridors and public areas. Also smoking is not permitted in the rooms that has access to outdoor areas. 

Dublin Central Suites will commence welcoming guests from 15 January 2018.

619728.description: Europe's “first sustainable hotel”, this is an urban oasis just in the Dublin City Centre district of Dublin, a 4-minute walk from St. Stephen's Green. The hotel is contemporary modern in style, with a selection of rich wallpapers, touches of brass, gleaming mirrors, stylish tiled floors and lots of Navan-manufactured furniture. Guests staying in rooms at the side and back of the property will have great views of the Iveagh Gardens. Harcourt Street is an extremely busy street, but guests staying in the front of the hotel, where rooms form part of the Georgian facade, will be separated from the trams and partygoers by new triple-glazed windows.

619843.description: Enjoy terrace and garden views at this hotel, featuring complimentary Wi-Fi, concierge services, and access to a nearby fitness center. Dine at RAILS Restaurant, specializing in British cuisine, or enjoy the coffee shop/cafe and limited room service. Two bars/lounges offer refreshing drinks. Continental breakfast is available (fee applies). Business center, express check-out, and complimentary newspapers are provided. The 88 individually decorated guestrooms offer espresso makers, flat-screen TVs with satellite programming, private bathrooms with designer toiletries and hair dryers, safes, phones, and complimentary bottled water. Located near attractions like The Harry Potter Shop at Platform 9 3/4 (0. 3 km), the British Library (0. 4 km), and Coal Drops Yard (0. 6 km). London City Airport (LCY) is 17. 1 km away.

619882.description: easyHotel Liverpool is situated in the Liverpool Shopping District district in Liverpool, a 2 minute walk from Liverpool One shopping centre and 10 minutes from the waterfront. The hotel is a 3-minute walk from Liverpool St. James Station. Each room includes an en suite bathroom fitted with a bath or shower. There is a 24-hour front desk at the property. easyHotels are room-only, however there is a wide range of restaurants and cafes surrounding the hotel. Directly under the hotel is an Italian restaurant who serve a mix of Venetian small plates, pastas and risottos. Liverpool's famous Cavern Club is a 3-minute walk from easyHotel Liverpool, while Royal Court Theatre is 500 m away. The nearest airport is Liverpool John Lennon Airport, 12 km from easyHotel Liverpool.

619883.description: easyHotel Croydon offers the perfect blend of convenience for travelers seeking quick access to both Gatwick Airport and central London. Both destinations are just a 15-minute train ride away, making it an excellent value option. Guests can enjoy the attractions of London while appreciating the ease of airport proximity. Children under 18 must be accompanied by an adult. Those aged 11 to 17 may stay in separate rooms under the supervision of a parent, guardian, or authorized educational staff member. The supervising adult is required to remain on the premises. Photo ID and proof of guardianship may be requested.

619922.description: Located between Newcastle's vibrant city center and picturesque Quayside, easyHotel Newcastle offers budget-friendly accommodations just eight minutes from Central Station. Explore the city's attractions, enjoy the lively nightlife, or focus on business with ease. A variety of restaurants, bars, and cafes are within walking distance. All rooms feature air conditioning, heating, en-suite bathrooms, Wi-Fi, and TVs, providing comfort and convenience without compromising affordability.

621642.description:
Within 5 minutes' walk of Hyde Park, Oxford Street's shops and Marble Arch Underground Station, this 5-star hotel features a modern bar and an on-site spa. Free internet access is available throughout The Montcalm. Buckingham Palace and its gardens are just over 1 miles away.

An iPod dock, HD TV with satellite channels, a hairdryer and a minibar feature in each air-conditioned room. A rain shower and luxury toiletries are included in each private marble bathroom. Guests can choose from 6 fragrances for their room.

Fresh and seasonal international cuisine is served in the Crescent Restaurant and Lounge, while The Grill at The Montcalm provides modern British grill dishes. The Montcalm Bar offers an extensive bar menu and a variety of cocktails and traditional English afternoon teas.

The Montcalm Spa includes a relaxing spa pool, sauna, and steam room. Guests can also unwind on heated loungers, or use the modern, air-conditioned fitness room. 

Westminster Borough is a great choice for travellers interested in shopping, parks and history.

This is our guests' favourite part of London, according to independent reviews. This area is also great for shopping, with popular brands nearby: Cartier, Hermès, H&M, Zara, Nike.

623393.description: Situated in London's vibrant South Kensington, easyHotel offers budget-friendly accommodations for both business and leisure travelers. A short distance from Heathrow Airport, and moments away from the area's renowned museums and the West End, it's an ideal base for exploring the capital. The hotel features 34 compact, windowless rooms designed for a peaceful night's sleep, undisturbed by noise or light. A 24-hour reception team is available to assist guests with any questions or requests, ensuring a pleasant and convenient London experience.

623396.description: Welcome to Hotel Indigo® Cardiff, where bespoke design meets classic Welsh heritage. Our boutique bedrooms reflect our vibrant city, with the themes Made in Wales, Welsh Industry and Music embodied in local art and natural materials. Many also offer wonderful views of the Cardiff skyline, and they all have free Wi-Fi and invigorating rainfall showers. Moments from our front door you can sing along with the fans at the home of Welsh Rugby, explore the historic Cardiff Castle with its fairy tale towers, or rock out to that famous local music at the Cardiff Utilita Arena. Our fully equipped fitness suite will keep you on your toes, and after a day of discovery, visit our rooftop restaurant & bar 'Lefel 6 at Dominions Arcade', which is the perfect place to relax, with private dining option and not to mention a fabulous roof terrace.

623399.description: Hyatt Regency London Albert Embankment beautifully positioned on Londons South Bank, offers amazing views over the River Thames. Relax in an elegant, air-conditioned room with free wifi, Nespresso coffee machine, and floor to ceiling windows-many which overlook the River Thames. The hotels food and beverage outlets cater to a variety of tastes with POTUS restaurant and bar serving modern British and American cuisine while Mezemiso offers a variety of Lebanese and Japanese dishes.

623767.description: Abbey Lodge Hotel offers 17 guest rooms with complimentary Wi-Fi throughout. The reception desk is available 24/7 for guest assistance. While cots are not available, the hotel prioritizes accessibility and features wheelchair-accessible rooms and adapted facilities. On-site parking is available, though additional fees may apply for certain services.

623881.description: Welcome to newly opened four star hotel in Kensington, one of London's most popular areas. K Hotel Kensington provides luxurious, contemporary guestrooms in our grand, historic building, just a short walk from major attractions, convenient transport links and famous shops. Our guests love our location, only a 10-minute walk from the Natural History Museum, and just a couple of minutes further to the Science Museum and V&A Museum. Stroll for 20 minutes from our Kensington hotel and you'll come to the beautiful greenery of Kensington Gardens and Hyde Park, passing the Royal Albert Hall on your way. We're also just a 5-minute walk from Gloucester Road Tube Station, which provides a direct link to Heathrow Airport in less than 40 minutes. When you want to relax after a busy day exploring London you'll be happy to return to your room at K Hotel Kensington. Whether you've chosen a single, double, twin, family room for 3 persons or family room for 4 persons from our 138 air-conditioned rooms, you'll find yourself surrounded by chic décor and comfortable facilities. Freshen up in the power shower and use the complimentary toiletries before taking advantage of the free WiFi and tea and coffee making facilities.

624161.description: Aparthotel nearby Aldgate and Tower Hill tube stations. Modern accommodation with free WIFI, fully equipped kitchen, microwave, washing machine and dryer for self-catering during your stay.  Perfect base to explore London's attractions with The Tower of London within walking distance. Borough Market only a short journey away.

624445.description: A central location is the top priority for guests of a Dublin City Hotel. We ensure you have a relaxed atmosphere and a comfortable room to return to after a long day (or night) enjoying the buzzing metropolis. Hotel has implemented a full range of enhanced sanitisation procedures and new practices which have been rigorously reviewed by Bureau Veritas, a trusted, independent global leader in tested, inspections and certification. Rooms are compact but airy, and equipped with the comfiest beds, plumpest pillows and the softest linen, to help you get a great night's sleep. All rooms are air-conditioned and have a fridge, safe, ironing board and Nespresso machine. They also have a Smart Android TV with HDMI and USB connections. Hotel has been accredited by Green Tourism, a certification program that provides a framework to achieve a sustainable business in the tourism industry.

624597.description: Studios2Let provides impeccably kept studios and high quality service. Central yet refined the apartments are a perfect place to stay whilst you are visiting the City. Well-equipped for both business and pleasure our rooms can meet every demand at competitive prices. Each flat is functionally designed with every modern convenience allowing you a high level of autonomy during your stay. Complete kitchens are arranged alongside stylish and immaculate living areas, giving you everything you need for a comfortable visit. The freedom granted by our self-contained studios opens your options and gives you more control over how you spend your time in London.

624815.description: Situated just off O'Connell Street in Dublin City Centre, Clifden Guesthouse Dublin City is conveniently close to all the major tourist attractions in Dublin. Whether you are a first time or regular visitor to Dublin, you'll find our central location the ideal base to discover all that Dublin has to offer. You'll have your choice of our en-suite Single, Double/Twin, Triple or, Family Rooms with comfortable duvets, satellite TV's and Free Wi-Fi. We want you to have the most memorable visit to Dublin by offering high quality Dublin City Centre Guesthouse accommodation, in a great location at superb value. Our accommodation near Croke Park makes it a great choice for those visiting the home of GAA for a concert or to see their favourite team in action.

625032.description: The Crown, a popular pub and hostel in Battersea/Clapham, South London, offers a vibrant atmosphere with a stylish interior featuring a collage of framed photographs and a polished wooden bar. Guests can relax on cozy sofas, play board games, or enjoy a drink with friends. Sports enthusiasts will appreciate the regular sports screenings, while others can indulge in the award-winning burger kitchen, serving all-day meals and brunch until 6 pm. Weekly quiz nights and occasional live acoustic music add to the lively ambiance. The hostel offers a variety of dorm rooms, free Wi-Fi, and fresh linen. A 24-hour bar, reception, and security are available. The Crown is conveniently located near Clapham Common, a large park with various amenities. Clapham Picturehouse is also nearby for film lovers. Excellent public transport links, including three tube stations and two railway stations within walking distance, provide easy access to central London and attractions such as Big Ben, Buckingham Palace, and the O2 Arena (within 40 minutes). The Crown is an ideal choice for travelers interested in restaurants, attractions, and convenient public transport.

625041.description: Experience London like a local at The Exmouth Arms, conveniently located just five minutes from Euston and Euston Square Stations. This unique hostel, situated above a lively pub, offers a genuine London experience. Enjoy our award-winning burger kitchen, 24-hour reception and bar, free Wi-Fi, individual power sockets, and guest discounts on food and drinks. It's the perfect base for exploring the city's hidden gems. Beyond the usual pub fare, we proudly partner with local suppliers to offer the best in beer and gin, celebrating London's vibrant pub culture.

625042.description: The place to stay in London! The Steam Engine is a hop, skip and jump away from London's main attractions. Head towards the river to see London in all its glory. Walk between Big Ben, the London Eye, museums and more – and don't forget to get that perfect selfie. After you experience the London life, come back and relax in the pub with a drink and a burger from our friends at BurgerCraft. With an onsite pop-up award winning burger kitchen, 24hour reception and open bar, Free Wi-Fi, security bed screens, individual power sockets and guest food and drink discounts, we offer a classic night in London where you get to experience the fun and lively atmosphere of our pub. We're not just your normal Pub, we pride ourselves on working closely with our awesome suppliers to serve up the very best in beer and gin, with a focus on London products. And as PubLover's ourselves, we pride ourselves on the culture and want to make your experience a memorable one.

625043.description: Newly refurbished in July 2017, the Green Man Paddington offers you a different hostel experience. Spend your night above a pub and get to know the local life of London. Check-in at the bar, get settled upstairs and come back downstairs to mingle with London locals and other travellers. Located in central London, The Green Man in Paddington is only a 5-minute walk to Paddington Station and on the doorstep of Edgware Road Station, with trains taking you to all the attractions and famous sites across London. With an award-winning burger kitchen onsite, 24hour reception and bar, free Wi-Fi, security bed screens, individual power sockets and guest food and drink discounts, we offer a classic night in London where you get to experience the fun and lively atmosphere of our pub. We're not just your normal pub, we pride ourselves on working closely with our awesome suppliers to se

625044.description: Located near London's main attractions and transport hubs, our hotel allows you to explore the city with ease. Afterward, relax at our bar with a pint of local beer or a coffee. Open 24/7 exclusively for guests, you can enjoy a drink anytime. Our well-designed rooms and dormitories offer comfort and convenience, featuring power outlets, hooks, and luggage lockers for each guest. Multiple bathrooms and ample hot water are available. Best of all, your common room is a traditional British pub – socialize with locals and fellow travelers.

625102.description: Ideally located in central London, this hotel provides the perfect base for exploration, with Hyde Park and Oxford Street less than a mile away. Conveniently accessible from Edgware Road and Marble Arch tube stations, the hotel offers free Wi-Fi throughout and a welcoming on-site bar. Each room features a flat-screen television, complimentary toiletries, and a hairdryer.

625245.description: The HARRIS Resort Barelang Batam, a Tauzia Group hotel, is located near the iconic Barelang Bridge. This resort offers 176 rooms, including 168 HARRIS Rooms, 6 HARRIS Suites, and 2 HARRIS Villas, each with views of the garden, swimming pool, or the sea. Guests can enjoy a wide range of facilities including the HARRIS Cafe and Pizza with live cooking, a juice bar, Dino Kid's Club and water playground, an infinity pool and jacuzzi, a modern beach club with its own pool and jacuzzi, a boutique, the Bay House for weddings and parties, a spa, reflexology services, a fitness center, eight meeting rooms for up to 500 people, motorized and non-motorized recreation sports, jogging and cycling tracks, a business center, internet corner, mini-mart, an exclusive white sand beach and parking for 200 cars.

625561.description: Centrally located in Belfast, AC Hotels by Marriott Belfast is a 5-minute drive from Titanic Belfast and the Obel. This upscale hotel offers complimentary Wi-Fi, a terrace with city views, and wedding services. The 188 air-conditioned rooms feature refrigerators, espresso makers, and LCD televisions. Private bathrooms include showers, complimentary toiletries, and hair dryers. Enjoy lunch or dinner at Novelli at City Quays, or order 24-hour room service. A bar/lounge and buffet breakfast (for a fee) are also available. Business travelers will appreciate the business center, complimentary newspapers, and dry cleaning/laundry services. The hotel also offers 1421 square feet of event space.

625563.description: Located in the heart of Glasgow's vibrant Merchant City, the Moxy Glasgow Merchant City hotel offers guests convenient access to top attractions like George Square and Buchanan Street (within a 15-minute walk). This modern hotel features 181 guestrooms equipped with LCD TVs, complimentary Wi-Fi, and satellite programming. Guests can enjoy a daily buffet breakfast (for a fee), dine at the on-site restaurant, grab a snack at the deli, or unwind with a drink at the bar/lounge. A fitness center, 24-hour business center, and express check-in/out services are also available.

625887.description: 'Our London Greenwich High Road hotel is surrounded by must-see attractions like the Cutty Sark and beautiful Greenwich Park. A stone's throw from Greenwich Station and the DLR, it's also ideal for exploring the city centre. Business travellers visiting the Greenwich Centre Business Park can walk there in minutes. Whatever your plans, you'll definitely want to squeeze in a walk up to the Royal Observatory for an incredible panoramic view. All rooms feature a comfy king size bed with four plump pillows and a cosy duvet. Our on-site restaurant and bar serves breakfast and tasty evening meals. '

626261.description:
New Road Hotel is a stylish 79 bedroom boutique hotel in East London. Housed in a former textile factory in Whitechapel, this unique hotel is inspired by the New York metropolis. 


New Road Hotel features a signature restaurant by acclaimed chef Marco Pierre White, a fitness studio, free WiFi throughout the property and several social zones - enjoy live music, play pool in the games zone or relax in the library. Vs.

626302.description: Hastings Grand Central is more than a hotel. It's an ode to a city. Standing tall in Bedford Street, this impressive jewel fuses glamour and grandeur with a uniquely Belfast spirit. Perfectly placed in Belfast City. Just as Belfast is at the heart of the Grand Central, the Grand Central is at the heart of Belfast. Set in the up and coming Linen Quarter, the hotel is a spectacular hub for exploring Titanic Quarter's history or Cathedral Quarter's charming cobbled streets, pubs and eateries. Theatre buffs, shopaholics and historians alike will all be spoiled for choice, with a host of options right on their doorstep. Conveniently located for all transport access, the Grand Central is perfectly placed for every city centre endeavour – from business to leisure and everything in between.

627834.description: Mimi's Hotel Soho enjoys a central location in London, just a 2-minute walk from Oxford Street and 100 m from Prince Edward Theatre. Guests can enjoy the on-site bar. Each cosy room at this hotel is air conditioned and has a flat-screen TV with satellite channels. The rooms include a private bathroom fitted with a bath or shower. Mimi's Hotel Soho features free WiFi throughout the property. There is a 24-hour front desk at the property. A wide range of restaurants, pubs and bars can be reached within a short walk. The hotel also offers bike hire. Old Compton Street is 100 m from Mimi's Hotel Soho, while Charing Cross Road is 200 m from the property. The nearest airport is London City Airport, 13 km from the property.

name.content: Hampton by Hilton Belfast City Centre

627882.description: The following services and amenities are available, but with reduced service: Business Center, Fitness Center, Breakfast, On-site Restaurant(s). Located in central Belfast, Hampton by Hilton Belfast City Centre offers modern rooms with free WiFi and secure discounted parking adjacent to the hotel. Travelers of all types will appreciate our proximity to the main road networks and public transport hub making, Belfast City Airport (BHD) and SSE Arena within easy reach. Our hotel puts you within walking distance of the fashionable Victoria Square shopping centre and many of the city's attractions. The Grand Opera House and the Lyric Theatre are less than two miles away. Walk to Great Victoria Street railway station for easy access around the city and the surrounding areas. After a busy day, unwind in your spacious room with a clean and fresh Hampton bed. Start your day with Hampton's included hot breakfast, offered to guests staying at the hotel. Later in the day, dine at our lobby bar with plenty of drink options as well as light meals and snacks. For a quick snack, stop by the 24/7 snack hub offering soft drinks, snacks and some travel essentials.

628011.description: An upscale Heathrow airport business hotel with a fine-dining restaurant. Crowne Plaza® London Heathrow T4 hotel is directly linked to Terminal 4 by a covered pedestrian bridge. A prime location and advanced facilities make our Heathrow Terminal 4 hotel an ideal choice for business travellers. You can reach central London in half an hour on the Heathrow Express or the new Elizabeth Line. Our 4 well-equipped event spaces can cater for small meetings or major events, while international flights from Terminal 4 are a short walk away. When you’re off duty, the open spaces of Windsor Great Park and the thrills and spills of Legoland® Windsor Resort are within 30 minutes by car. At this hotel you can enjoy:- Completely Connected power access- A dedicated Crowne Plaza Meetings Director- Sleep Advantage® programme to aid restful sleepOur sophisticated dining options include fusion dishes and an Asian street-food counter in the elegant Urban Brasserie, and snacks in the Crowne Plaza Bar. The gym is open around the clock, so you can work out before breakfast or wind down after work. Our luxurious guest rooms all feature Smart TVs and free Wi-Fi to keep you entertained, while dedicated Quiet Zones and premium bedding help guarantee a good night’s rest.

628021.description:
Mirroring the 1920s glamour of its theatrical surroundings, Hotel Indigo® London – 1 Leicester Square draws you into an art deco, glass-and-marble haven. Our bespoke rooms have walls adorned with framed scripts, gently spot-lit by stage lights hanging from rigging. 

Guests love our central location, forming part of London's infamous Leicester Square. Staying with us means waking up to London's West End, with all the great shopping, theatre, museums, and more just steps away. In the morning, enjoy a hearty breakfast at the Rooftop Bar, overlooking London's iconic skyline. Step out into Leicester Square from our London hotel, and you’re in the domain of red-carpet premieres at world-famous cinemas. 

Choose a big-name show in a glittering West End theatre or dine in one of London's best restaurants. A highly convenient West End location means you are moments away from Covent Garden, Regent Street, Chinatown, Piccadilly Circus, Buckingham Palace, Trafalgar Square, and Charing Cross. 

Please note: There is no road access, parking or vehicle drop-off point directly outside the hotel. The nearest drop-off point is on Wardour Street and Coventry Street, a short walk to the hotel. The nearest parking is Q-Park Leicester Square, a short walk to the hotel. Our closest tube station is Leicester Square and Piccadilly Circus.

name.content: Holiday Inn Express London Heathrow T4

628334.description: A convenient airport hotel with excellent transport links and inclusive breakfastHoliday Inn Express® London Heathrow T4 hotel is a 5-minute stroll by covered walkway from Terminal 4 at London Heathrow (LHR) airport. A 30-minute train ride on the Heathrow Express will whisk you into central London’s London Paddington station. There’s fast access to the M4 and M25 motorways, so the Windsor Royal Shopping Centre and medieval Windsor Castle are within a 30-minute drive. Adrenaline-inducing thrill rides await at Thorpe Park Resort, and concerts or international rugby matches at Twickenham Stadium are within easy reach. At this hotel you can enjoy:- A flexible space for meetings and events- Free WiFi- Bedside USB ports for charging devices- All Day DiningWhether you’re staying for business or sightseeing with family, the best way to start your day is with the Express Start™ Breakfast, included in the room rate. At our Heathrow hotel in Terminal 4, you can meet friends or colleagues over coffee or drinks at our well-stocked bar, and tuck into light bites and hot snacks all day at the ultra-modern lounge bar in the open plan lobby. Rest assured that you’ll sleep well in comfortable guest rooms, where pillow menus, noise-reducing headboards and tea- and coffee-making facilities help guarantee a peaceful stay.

name.content: Holiday Inn Express Birmingham - City Centre

628341.description: Central Birmingham hotel with free Wi-Fi and Breakfast includedHoliday Inn Express® Birmingham - City Centre hotel is 10 minutes’ walk from Grand Central train station and Grand Central shopping mall. The hotel is 10 minutes’ drive from the M6 motorway, while Birmingham Airport (BHX) is a 15-minute train ride away. A short walk takes you to events at the International Convention Centre. You can host informal meetings in the hotel’s relaxed lobby lounge area before reaching companies like RBS and KPMG in the nearby Colmore Business District. Browse for designer fashion at the nearby Mailbox shopping centre, anchored by a Harvey Nichols department store. Selfridges, housed in a landmark futuristic building, is a quick stroll away at the Bullring mall, near the Hippodrome and New Alexandra theatres. At this hotel you can enjoy:- A hot Express Start breakfast buffet included in the room rate- Free Wi-Fi throughout the hotel- A Business CentreWelcoming rooms come with blackout blinds and pillow menus to help you get a good night’s sleep. Wake up to a power shower and enjoy the inclusive buffet breakfast in the bright Express Café and Bar. It’s just the place to chat with friends and colleagues over a coffee or a cold beer, and if you need a bite to eat, try the all-day menu of snacks and light meals.

name.content: Belvilla Ilford Station Ht, 4 min Elizabeth line

628445.description:
Belvilla Ilford Station Ht, 4 Min Elizabeth Line is located in Ilford just off the A406 and a 4min walk from Ilford Train Station, which links to popular London attractions such as Liverpool Street being only 20mins away. Access to the main bus stop is less than a minutes walk which can be used to get to destinations such as the Excel Centre very conveniently. 
Ilford Exchange Mall is a stone throw away, with local supermarkets, retail and convenient stores. The hotel is 650 yards from Redbridge Central Library and Museum. Every room is equipped with a flat-screen TV. Each room has a private bathroom fitted with a shower. For your comfort, you will find slippers and free toiletries. Hotel Alto features free WiFi throughout the property. You will find a 24-hour front desk at the property. The nearest airport is London City Airport, 3. 7 miles from Belvilla Ilford Station Ht, 4 Min Elizabeth Line. This property is also rated for the best value in Ilford! Guests are getting more for their money when compared to other properties in this city.

629451.description: Designed for travelers seeking more than just basic accommodation, Locke immerses you in a creative community where work, leisure, and comfortable living intertwine seamlessly. Located in a striking sky tower in Aldgate, East London, Leman Locke offers 168 spacious studios and suites across 22 floors. You'll be just steps from the City of London, Shoreditch, and the Tower of London, with easy access to the rest of London via the nearby Aldgate East and Aldgate tube stations. Explore the vibrant cultural scene on Commercial Street, Liverpool Street, and Columbia Road, browsing designer boutiques, galleries, and the bustling Spitafields and Brick Lane Markets. The hotel features a gym (disclaimer required for use) and provides weekly cleaning for stays of 7 nights or more (additional cleaning available for a fee). One dog up to 30 kg is welcome in our dog-friendly properties (charges apply; service animals are always welcome with prior notice). 629453.description: Located close to Cannon Street and St Paul's tube stations. Tower of London, St Paul's Cathedral and various attractions are easily commutable. 629505.description: Situated in Edinburgh's prestigious New Town on George Street, Eden Locke occupies a stunning five-story Victorian building. This aparthotel offers self-contained apartments, each equipped with a kitchen including a dishwasher, oven, and microwave. Complimentary Wi-Fi and initial breakfast essentials are provided. While on-site restaurants and social spaces are currently closed, the surrounding area boasts a vibrant array of shops and restaurants. One dog (up to 30kg) is permitted in designated dog-friendly apartments, with charges applicable (excluding registered service animals). Weekly cleaning is included for stays of 7 nights or more, with additional cleaning available for a fee. Luggage storage is complimentary until 11:59 pm on the day of arrival/departure.

629524.description: Situated in the Bloomsbury area, SACO Holborn boasts 32 award-winning serviced apartments — the perfect base for exploring all that London has to offer. You'll be a stone’s throw from the vibrant West End, theatre district and The City, making our aparthotel ideal for both work and play. Each generously-sized apartment at SACO Holborn features a fully equipped kitchen, bathroom, superfast WiFi and TV. Check-in from 4pm. Check-out until 11am. Reception hours: 8am - 7pm. If arriving later than 7pm, please let us know in advance. Early check-in (2pm) and Late check-out (1pm) available at a surcharge, on request, subject to availability. Private parking available on request for an additional fee. We provide a weekly cleaning service for stays of 7 nights or more. Additional cleaning service available on request for an additional fee. Smoking Charge - £300

629949.description:
Thistle Express London Luton is perfectly positioned for both convenience and discovery, just steps from Luton town centre and only minutes from London Luton Airport. 
Ideal for business and leisure stays alike, our modern 3‑star hotel puts you right at the heart of Bedfordshire’s most popular attractions, with fast connections to London and beyond. 
Whether you’re catching an early flight, visiting the University of Bedfordshire, or cheering on Luton Town FC at the historic Kenilworth Road Stadium, you’ll find everything within easy reach. Families and leisure travellers can enjoy memorable days out at nearby favourites such as Whipsnade Zoo or Woburn Safari Park, while film fans can step into the magic of cinema at the Warner Bros. Studio Tour London – The Making of Harry Potter, just a short drive away in Watford. 
The hotel itself is surrounded by a lively mix of high‑street shops, cafés, restaurants, and entertainment venues, all complemented by excellent transport links. Direct trains from Luton Station whisk you to London St Pancras International in just 32 minutes, opening up world‑class shopping, theatre, museums, and iconic landmarks - from Camden and Covent Garden to Soho, Oxford Street, and the West End. 
Offering contemporary comfort, stylish design, and exceptional value, Thistle Express London Luton is a smart and affordable alternative to staying in the capital - without missing out on everything it has to offer. 
Think London. Think Thistle.

630039.description: The modern Mercure Blankenberge hotel offers comfortable, stylish rooms near the train station. All rooms feature minibars, safes, flat-screen TVs, telephones, tea/coffee making facilities, and AC. Privilege rooms include luxury amenities, docking stations, and Espresso machines. Guests can meet in the lounge bar to explore the wine menu or enjoy the heated rooftop pool (closed until 01/07/2020).

name.content: Staybridge Suites London - Heathrow Bath Road

632082.description:
Situated in West Drayton, close to Heathrow Airport, the upscale Staybridge Suites London Heathrow - Bath Road offers convenient access to Stockley Park and Windsor Castle, both within a 15-minute drive. This all-suite hotel provides 190 air-conditioned accommodations, each featuring a fully equipped kitchen with a refrigerator and oven, and a 43-inch Smart TV with satellite programming. Guests can enjoy complimentary Wi-Fi, a 24-hour fitness center, and a daily complimentary continental breakfast. Additional amenities include a restaurant with room service, a bar/lounge, and a business center. Self-parking is available (subject to charges). 
The Heathrow Hoppa bus collects you right outside reception, making your trip as stress-free as possible. 
The Hoppa fare is £7. 00 per person for a single fare or £13. 00 per person for a single return.

name.content: Holiday Inn London - Heathrow Bath Road

632083.description: Welcome to Holiday Inn London - Heathrow Bath Road. Located opposite Heathrow Airport Terminals 2 and 3, and within minutes of Terminal 5, we’re in the perfect spot if you’re planning on travelling for business or leisure. We offer onsite parking, with Park, Stay and Fly packages available, and the Heathrow Hoppa bus collects you right outside reception, making your trip as stress-free as possible. The Hoppa fare is £7. 00 per person for a single fare or £13. 00 per person for a single return. Planning to visit central London? You can be there within 15 minutes from leaving the airport on the Heathrow Express. Windsor Castle is only a 20-minute drive away or why not enjoy a day with the family at LEGOLAND® Windsor Resort. When you step into our hotel, you’ll be mesmerized by our unique, open plan atrium that takes inspiration from an Italian streetscape. It's full of cosy seating areas, street lighting and an impressive theatre kitchen, so you can watch our talented chefs prepare your food! Our menu features authentic, home cooked Italian dishes, from antipasti and salads, to stone-baked pizza, pasta and grill options. Our contemporary, spacious bedrooms feature floor-to-ceiling windows, with many providing exclusive views of Heathrow Airport’s runway. Plus, room service is available 24/7!If you’re planning a meeting or conference in Heathrow, we have six flexible meeting rooms and a large breakout space, perfect for up to 80 delegates.

Catch up on emails in the coworking space, break a sweat in the gym, or grab a coffee. Tate Modern and Shakespeare's Globe are just across the River Thames, via the Millennium Bridge. Plus, it's easy to jump on the tube at nearby Bank, Cannon Street or Mansion House to access the rest of London. With a design-led co-working space on the ground floor, treat yourself to artisanal coffee by day and playful cocktails by night. London's cultural hotspots with theatres, galleries and food markets surround Broken Wharf. NCP (Vintry Car Park) is the closest car park. 

Dog Stays - We have dog friendly properties where 1 dog of up to 30 kilos is welcome. Registered service animals will be permitted in all locations where notice has been given prior to arrival. Additional charges apply for dogs (excluding registered service dogs) and a completed pet waiver upon check-in is mandatory. It is your responsibility before arrival to check that dogs are permitted at the Property. Storage of luggage after 23:59 on the day of arrival and/or departure (storage is free until 23. 59 pm on the day of arrival and/or departure). Gym Disclaimer - Guests are now all required to sign a gym disclaimer in order to be able to use the gym. Gym - The use of gym facilities is subject to guests signing a mandatory disclaimer, acknowledging and agreeing to the terms of use of the gym. This policy applies to all properties equipped with gym facilities and the form of disclaimer will be made available to guests at those properties. We provide a weekly cleaning service for stays of 7 nights or more with an additional fee. Smoking Charge and Hardkey replacement with an additional fee.

877728.description: Enjoy a stylish and convenient stay at the Radisson RED London Gatwick Airport. Ideally located just a few minutes from London's buzzing Gatwick Airport, the hotel is perfect for a fun start to your travels or a great night's sleep before your flight. The fabulous 4-star hotel features 185 stylish en suite rooms, where you can make yourself at home with a 49' Smart TV with built-in Chromecast, mini-bar, tea & coffee facilities, iron & ironing board, black-out curtains, and much more! Stay connected with free Wi-Fi throughout the hotel, work up a sweat in our fitness center, or take advantage of our 24-hour room service. Feeling peckish? Check out our Grab & Go kiosk, buffet breakfast, an onsite bar, and restaurant. If you're traveling by car, why not pre-book one of our onsite 120 parking spaces with the room (subject to availability)?

877849.description: Offering free parking and rooms with attached bathroom, this family-run hotel and restaurant is less than a kilometer from Boston Manor Underground Station. All of the rooms with attached bathroom are individually decorated, and have a shower, TV, telephone and facilities for making tea and coffee. The hotel also has a 24-hour front desk. The OYO Bostons Manor Hotel has a convenient location for those using London Heathrow Airport. London Underground services run regularly between the airport and Boston Manor Station, with a journey time of just 17 minutes. Ealing Broadway and West Ealing shopping centers are close by, and there is a regular bus service from just outside the hotel to both shopping centers and to the Underground station.

878058.description: Located in Redditch, OYO Blue Inn features a restaurant, garden and free WiFi throughout the property. Guest rooms are equipped with a flat-screen TV with satellite channels, a kettle, a shower, a hairdryer and a desk. At the hotel each room comes with a wardrobe and a private bathroom. OYO Blue Inn offers a sun terrace. Guests at the accommodations will be able to enjoy activities in and around Redditch, like cycling. Birmingham is 12 mi from OYO Blue Inn, while Stratford-upon-Avon is 11 mi away. The nearest airport is Birmingham Airport, 12 mi from the hotel.

882285.description: Recently refurbished and offering a dedicated restaurant, the Royal Square Hotel is a simple accommodation choice that is conveniently positioned less than 4 minutes drive from Birmingham Airport. All 24 rooms at the Hotel come equipped with a flat-screen Freeview television, hairdryer, direct dial telephone and tea/coffee making facilities. The rooms also include an en-suite shower room with free toiletries. A variety of beverages are served in the bar, which can be enjoyed in the dining room, lounge or landscaped garden areas of the hotel. Wi-Fi & on-site parking are free. A complimentary full English breakfast is served each morning alongside fresh fruits, cereals, yogurts and juice. In addition, the hotel's restaurant serves a diverse three-course menu for dinner. The National Exhibition Centre is a 20 minute walk from the hotel. Birmingham town centre is 15 minutes drive.

883045.description: Colourful murals, cosy cafes, bustling markets, interesting galleries*, eclectic boutiques, and lively streets. Dalston captures the essence of East London, with its mix of creative energy and multicultural heritage. Our aparthotel sits right in the centre of this uber-cool neighbourhood, just a 4 minute stroll from Ridley Road Market, where you’ll find everything from global street food to vintage treasures. Wander between independent cafés, local makers and buzzing market stalls, or explore East London by bike and discover a different side of the city. Besides its independent shops and buzzy nightlife, Dalston’s streets are full of hidden gems—from local art to rooftop bars offering unique views of the city. Dalston is home to the Hang-Up Gallery, which showcases a range of contemporary artwork including pieces by infamous street artist, Banksy. While we do not serve food and drinks in-house, breakfast bags are available for our guests. You can also pick up meals, snacks and coffees from our in-house shop at reception.

883046.description: Work. Play. Create. Welcome to Beckett Locke, your new base in the heart of Dublin's up-and-coming Docklands. Wander through the open lobby, designed to reflect a bustling market hall. Spend an hour, or an afternoon, in our co-working space. Or unwind in your very own design-led apartment, complete with kitchen and living space. Location-wise, you'll be just steps away from the 3Arena, and a short walk from Convention Centre Dublin, Bord Gáis Energy Theatre and a host of coffee shops and bars. All you need for a productive and inspiring stay. Smoking fee - €240Dog stay - Registered service dogs are now permitted free of charge, please arrange prior to arrival. 883049.description: Located in central Dublin, this riverside aparthotel, comprised of four renovated Georgian townhouses, offers spacious apartments with curated art and a courtyard. Enjoy the convenience of a fully equipped kitchen, or explore nearby Temple Bar's vibrant nightlife. Guests can enjoy on-site amenities such as a gym (disclaimer required) and free luggage storage. Smoking incurs a €240 fee, while registered service dogs are permitted free of charge (prior arrangement necessary). Lost access cards are free, but hard key replacements cost €50.

883147.description: The ibis London Sutton Point is perfectly located in the heart of Sutton, Surrey. Designed with comfort and enjoyment at its heart, guests can enjoy new Plaza concept bedrooms, which have been considerately designed by FGMF architects. With everything you need to enjoy a comfortable stay, you are sure to feel at home from the moment you arrive. Guests are also welcome to relax in Charlie s Corner, a cosy yet sophisticated spot perfect for enjoying a morning coffee or craft beer and music in the evening.

883206.description: The Adagio London Sutton Point is ideally located just a few minutes walk from Sutton station and Sutton High Street, so guests can enjoy the bustling area or travel to London in just 30 minutes. This aparthotel offers 59 beautifully furnished apartments and studios with fully equipped kitchens and laundry appliances. Reception staff are on hand 24 7 to cater for your needs, so you can enjoy the freedoms of an apartment and the warm hospitality of a hotel from the moment you arrive.

883303.description: Paddington puts London at your feet. Our aparthotel is just a seven minute walk from Paddington Station, connecting you to the Underground, national rail and the Elizabeth line, so getting around the city (and beyond) couldn’t be easier. Step outside the door and you’re moments from Merchant Square, a canalside spot with buzzy bars and a local feel. Think pedal boats on the water, pop-up events and plenty of places to sit and soak it all in. Inside, our thoughtfully designed accommodation includes studios (sleeping up to three) and one bedroom apartments (sleeping up to four), giving you space to settle in properly. Expect fully equipped kitchens (perfect for cooking up whatever you’ve gathered at Portobello Market) supremely comfortable beds and sleek bathrooms. Start your day with breakfast on the ground floor, keep up your routine in the fitness room, or ease into the evening with a drink at the bar. However you choose to stay, everything flows your way.

name.content: Wilde Aparthotels London Aldgate Tower Bridge

883304.description: Wilde Aldgate isn't a hotel in the standard sense, it's an aparthotel where every studio and apartment comes with its own kitchen, a living area, and enough space to actually settle into. Positioned where the City's glass towers meet the painted murals of East London, it works as well for a three-night city break as it does for a month-long project placement. Aldgate sits at the intersection between two sides of the same city. the financial district on one side, the vinyl shops and curry houses of Whitechapel on the other. Whitechapel Gallery is a 7-minute walk along the high street; Brick Lane is 10 minutes through some of the city's most visually dense streets; and the Tower of London anchors the area's western edge, a 15-minute walk through the old city gate it shares a name with. Aldgate East station is 6 minutes on foot, connecting you to the District and Hammersmith & City lines and putting central London well within reach. The Thames Path is a short walk south, if you want to stretch your legs without getting on a tube. After a day in the city, come back to a comfortable space that feels like home. Cook your favourite meal in your own kitchen, enjoy your drink of choice at the bar downstairs, and take your time. The longer your stay at Wilde, Aldgate, the more it starts to feel like a base and less like a booking.

883389.description: The Londoner, the world's first super boutique hotel on Leicester Square, welcomes you to an urban resort spanning 16 floors, curated to reflect the drama and elegance of West End life. This 5-star property boasts 350 air-conditioned rooms equipped with minibars, espresso makers, smart TVs, Wi-Fi 6, and private bathrooms featuring designer toiletries and hair dryers. Additional conveniences include laptop-compatible safes and desks. Discover diverse cuisines across six restaurants and bars, including Japanese, and Mediterranean options, plus a guest-only residence with complimentary drinks and snacks. Breakfast is served weekdays 6:30–10:30am and weekends 7:30–11:00am. Unwind at the stunning wellness retreat featuring a gym, a pool surrounded by private cabanas, a jacuzzi, sauna, and steam room, plus a superfood bar and hair/beauty parlours.

886739.description: Located in Solihull, The Airport Lodge - Birmingham Airport & NEC is in the city centre. name.content: Embassy Newcastle Sure Hotel Collection by BW

889115.description: Your perfect base for exploring all the North East has to offer. Just a stone's throw from Newcastle City Centre, Embassy Newcastle, Sure Hotel Collection by Best Western in Gateshead, allows you to choose between the hustle and bustle of town life and the nearby countryside. Renowned for its architecture, the town boasts striking landmarks such as the Sage Gateshead concert centre, the iconic Angel of the North sculpture, and the industrial Baltic Centre for Contemporary Art. These beautiful settings provide an ideal backdrop for a work trip – with Team Valley Trading Estate nearby – or a leisurely weekend getaway. Nestled in metropolitan Tyne and Wear, you'll find us in Gateshead's Lobley Hill, just off the A1. On-site parking ensures a smooth arrival. Use the local bus service from Central Station or the underground for the first leg of your journey – both quick and easy options. Newcastle Upon Tyne is just a 30-minute ride on public transport or a 10-minute taxi ride away, while Durham and Sunderland are also easily accessible. Choose from our 42 deluxe and accessible rooms, featuring double or king-size Hypnos beds. We offer child-friendly sleeping options and adjustable beds. Amenities include a desk and chair, tea and coffee making facilities, a hairdryer, free Wi-Fi, and a flat-screen TV in every room to ensure a comfortable stay. Enjoy a bath, power shower, or wet room before relaxing in our super-cozy bedding. Embassy Newcastle, Sure Hotel Collection by Best Western, is ready to be the perfect base for your adventures – or relaxation – in the North East.

name.content: Orchid Epsom Sure Hotel Collection by Best Western

889116.description: A great night's sleep in the heart of Surrey and on London's doorstep. Our inviting rooms are found in Epsom, the leafy Surrey Suburb famed for the Downs Racecourse and exhilarating race days. It's not all jockeys and furlongs though, the hotel's excellent location means you are moments away from the grand Hampton Court Palace and a mere 20 minutes from world class tennis action at Wimbledon. If a day at the races or the chance to explore Henry VIII's opulent abode doesn't twist your arm, there are plenty of chances to entertain the family elsewhere. Chessington World of Adventures is a 20-minute drive from the hotel and our free on-site parking makes a day on the rollercoasters even more stress-free. There's even a chance to take in some wildlife at the nearby Hobbledown Adventure Farm. For guests who prefer to leave the car behind, the hotel is situated near Ewell West railway station. Trains take a swift 35 minutes to reach London Waterloo, where visitors can enjoy the restaurants and bars of the South Bank and the buzz of the capital. After a long day exploring the nearby sights and sounds our Hypnos beds are the perfect place to kick back and relax. We cater for a wide range of guests' needs and offer deluxe and accessible rooms, we even have cots and pull-out beds on hand to keep the whole family well rested. Breakfast is available as Continental Grab & Go. This includes the following - 1 Fruit Juice, 1 Piece of Fruit, 1 Croissant, 1 Breakfast Oat Bar, 1 Yoghurt and 1 Soreen Malt Loaf.

name.content: Hampton by Hilton Dublin City Centre

893681.description: Our hotel is in the heart of Dublin, just across the street from the Four Courts complex. Dublinia Museum, Guinness Brewery, Jameson Distillery, and the iconic Temple Bar are all within two kilometers. Getting around is easy with a tram stop and bikeshare across the street, and multiple bus stops within two blocks.

894536.description:
Moments away from the greenery of Hyde Park and nestled near some of London’s most iconic landmarks, including the Royal Albert Hall, Kensington Palace, the Victoria & Albert Museum and the Serpentine Gallery, Cheval Thorney Court stands as one of Cheval Collection’s most luxurious residences, offering 59 exceptionally spacious non-smoking luxury apartments available for any length of stay. 

Against the backdrop of traditional British Georgian period décor, you will be ideally placed to discover the Royal Borough of Kensington, a district renowned for its exclusivity and undeniable appeal. And with 2 tube stations (High Street Kensington and Gloucester Road) and a bus stop only minutes away this residence is the perfect base to explore the rest of London. 

All 59 apartments at Cheval Thorney Court offer the convenience of fully equipped kitchens including washing machine and dishwasher, as well as separate space for living and dining. All bedrooms have en-suite bathrooms with either walk-in shower or shower-over-bath. Comfort cooling/AC is available as standard. Every apartment is furnished with at least one desk, and provides a separate guest cloak room, as well as high speed WiFi throughout. Additional features in some apartments include a small balcony or large terrace, and either urban or park views (see apartment type description). 

The front desk is staffed 24 hours a day and eager to help guests make the most of their stay. You can expect daily housekeeping service, and apartments stocked with luxury toiletries, fluffy towels, bathrobes and slippers, and a generous welcome hamper on arrival. 

All rates are subject to a discretionary 4% service charge.

896098.description: With a stay at The Fleece in Witney, you'll be within a 10-minute drive of Cotswolds and SOTA Gallery. This inn is 10. 1 mi (16. 2 km) from Cotswold Wildlife Park and 12. 3 mi (19. 8 km) from Blenheim Palace. Take in the views from a terrace and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless Internet access. Free self parking is available onsite. At The Fleece, enjoy a satisfying meal at the restaurant. Quench your thirst with your favorite drink at the bar/lounge. English breakfasts are available daily from 9 AM to 11:30 AM for a fee. Make yourself at home in one of the 10 guestrooms. Bathrooms have showers and complimentary toiletries. Conveniences include electric kettles and complimentary bottled water, and housekeeping is provided daily.

897301.description:
Music venues, art collectives, historic Dublin*, vintage shops, speciality coffee, gothic churches, and the occasional horse and cart. 
Our aparthotel is located in the historic Liberties, fast becoming Dublin’s hippest neighbourhood. Surrounded by a medley of antique shops, bars and cafés, this is where old Dublin meets new. Plus we’re just a 10 minute walk to Temple Bar and top attractions such as Dublin Castle and Dublinia Viking Museum. 
*Back in Medieval times, the Liberties was just outside Dublin’s city walls so was given the ‘liberty’ to create their own laws, hence ‘The Liberties’. We have a strict non-smoking policy in any of our rooms or communal areas. Events, parties or additional guests/visitors are not permitted.

899635.description: With world-class golf courses just up the road, plus the excitement of Edinburgh just a pitch and putt away, our south-east Edinburgh hotel is a great place to stay. Not least because the hotel features our new generation bedrooms, with an impressive 40" flat screen TV, freshly- updated bathroom with large shower bed, and brand new, slumber-inducing, king-size Hypnos bed. If you're here for the shopping, there's a huge range of stores within walking distance, at Fort Kinnard Retail Park. If you'd rather relax, then Musselburgh is a lovely sleepy fishing village. As for the partying, all the buzz and excitement of Edinburgh is within easy reach, including some iconic landmarks. All reservations placed at this hotel are subject to Premier Inn’s standard Terms and Conditions, which can be found at premierinn. com

899801.description: Located in Batam, Studio Apartment Nagoya Mansion Batam is within a 5-minute drive of Nagoya Hill Mall and Grand Batam Mall. This aparthotel is 4. 1 mi (6. 6 km) from Batam Centre Ferry Terminal and 2. 2 mi (3. 5 km) from Harbor Bay Ferry Terminal. Conveniences include desks and rice cookers, and housekeeping is provided once per stay.

903655.description: Located between Cardiff Bay and the city centre, Staybridge Suites Cardiff offers the comforts of home whether you're staying for a night, weekend, or an extended work project. Our suites offer living space, a fully equipped kitchen and free Wi-Fi. Just a mile from Cardiff Central Cardiff Railway and a 10 minute walk from Cardiff Bay Station. Cardiff International Airport a 30 minutes drive. Mermaid Quay home to many restaurants and bars plus Wales Millennium Centre- home of the Welsh National Opera hosts many great concerts and shows and all within a 10 minute walk. Either walk or take the bus into the city centre and explore the 'City of Arcades' with many exclusive boutique shops and the Victorian Market. Cardiff renowned for its sporting venues with the hotel perfectly situated for Glamorgan Cricket Ground, Cardiff City Stadium and the iconic Principality Stadium home to Wales National Rugby TeamThe Den, a smart space with meeting capacity for 10 comes with a screen and projector is available. If you are attending an exhibition or conference at ICC Wales; it is just 20 minutes by car. Daily breakfast buffet is included. Fitness Room for your workout and Laundry Room available day or night. The Pantry also 24/7 so you can stock up on groceries, snacks and any little things left at home.

904315.description: With a stay at The Bournbrook Inn in Birmingham (Stirchley), you'll be within a 5-minute drive of Cadbury World and University of Birmingham. This inn is 3. 9 mi (6. 3 km) from Broad Street and 4. 6 mi (7. 4 km) from Arena Birmingham. Take in the views from a garden and make use of amenities such as complimentary wireless Internet access. Complimentary wireless Internet access keeps you connected, and satellite programming is available for your entertainment. Private bathrooms with showers feature complimentary toiletries and hair dryers. Conveniences include electric kettles and free tea bags/instant coffee, and housekeeping is provided daily.

904317.description: Make use of convenient amenities such as complimentary wireless internet access, concierge services, and a communal living room. Satisfy your appetite for lunch, dinner, or brunch at the hotel's bar/lounge, The Drawing Room, or stay in and take advantage of the 24-hour room service. A roundtrip airport shuttle is provided for a surcharge (available 24 hours). 904318.description: Once Bow Street Magistrates' Court, today our Grade II-listed building is one of the World’s 50 Best Hotels. Step straight into Covent Garden or wander our 19th-century halls complete with 1, 600 original artworks, spa, and a velvet-clad library exclusively for guests. When it’s time to dine, visit our triple-height glass atrium restaurant or sip late-night drinks from your choice of low-lit midnight bars.

name.content: Premier Inn London Southwark Tate Modern

904581.description: Modern, classic, pop or surreal? Whatever your style, Premier Inn London Southwark (Tate Modern) puts you in the thick of things - with all the star attractions of central London just a picture-perfect stroll away. Wander along the buzzing Southbank, with its riverside venues, restaurants and bars. Step into Shakespeare's world at the Globe. Get close to the icons of the London skyline from St Pauls' Cathedral to Tower Bridge. And with our friendly team and extra-comfy beds to frame the whole experience, you'll find everything you need for a great night's sleep. All reservations placed at this hotel are subject to Premier Inn’s standard Terms and Conditions.

name.content: Premier Inn Liverpool City - Liverpool One

904656.description: If you want a city break, it's great to be right at the heart of things, which is exactly where Premier Inn Hotel Liverpool City Centre (Liverpool One) puts you. Whether you're here for business or pleasure, you'll find lots of places to visit on your doorstep, and the transport links are really good too. Wander through the four shopping centres brought together in Liverpool One. Then pop over to Albert Dock for lunch at one of the many lively bars and restaurants. In the afternoon you could cheer on the Blues or the Reds, or why not visit the Beatles Story. After a hard day's night, come back to the hotel for some food and a lovely, comfy bed. All reservations placed at this hotel are subject to Premier Inn’s standard Terms and Conditions, which can be found at premierinn. com

904658.description: If you're seeking a fun-packed weekend look no further. 994541.description: AMTD Dao by Dorsett Hornsey will be part of the restored Grade II* listed Town Hall complex steeped in history. These unique features have been retained, restored and paired with modern pendant lighting and terrazzo-inspired worktops, giving each room a mix of period and contemporary fittings. The listed building overlooks the Town Hall Square; alongside an Art Centre featuring co-working spaces plus a cinema, debating chamber, assembly hall, recording studios, three restaurants, a café and a rooftop bar. These unique spaces are available for a vast range of events hosting such as weddings, live music, lectures, conferences, corporate events and exhibitions. The development is located at the heart of Crouch End, adjacent to shops and restaurants on it’s vibrant high street, while having good transport links to central London. Crouch End is located at north of Finsbury Park, east of Hampstead Heath and Highgate. Being located in the heart of Crouch End is a main advantage point of Dao North London. It has the village feel combined with London lifestyle; there is a substantial range of local eateries, convenience stores and retail on our doorstep. The W7 bus to Finsbury Park is located on the doorstep of the development with buses to Finsbury Park Station (Zone 2), which leave every few minutes and run for 24-hours during the weekend. Finsbury Park Station is serviced by Victoria and Piccadilly lines, with direct access to central London within minutes.

996647.description: Superbly located in the center of Edinburgh and within walking distance of almost all the city's major attractions, Cheval The Edinburgh Grand offers uniquely decorated apartments available to book for any length of stay. Housed in a restored bank, this grand building on St Andrew Square has a range of apartment types, from studios to three-bedrooms, all with their own kitchen and space for living and dining. Edinburgh Waverley Railway Station is just three minutes' walk away, and there are endless dining and shopping opportunities in the immediate vicinity. Breakfast is served daily in The Register Club on the fourth floor, along with a superb afternoon tea and a range of cocktails and drinks available from the expansive bar.

996929.description: Welcome to Chipping Norton - or 'Chippy' to the locals - a lively little market town with a bustling vibe and busy programme of events. Indeed, the 'town of ten festivals' is known for its celebrations of fiction, food, magic and more. ChipLitFest has the likes of Fay Weldon and David Nicholls amongst its guests. Book a room at our Premier Inn Chipping Norton hotel and you'll be walking distance from the town's medieval marketplace, museum and theatre. Or hop in the car and you're three miles from the ancient Rollright Stones. When it's time to kick back, you'll find plenty of space in our new, modern rooms which feature 40" flat-screen TVs and kingsize Hypnos beds. You'll also find a tempting place to eat, with our on-site Thyme restaurant serving delicious breakfasts, dinners and drinks. name.content: hub by Premier Inn London - Soho

996937.description: You'll have the best of the West End right on your doorstep when you stay at our hub by Premier Inn London Soho. Plus - with Oxford Street only a 10-minute walk away - you could hit the shops by day and enjoy a tasty meal back at our in-house Lounge restaurant in the evening. From slick one-touch room controls, inviting double beds and high-spec en-suite bathrooms, to sleek pull-out desks and plenty of under-bed storage, our stylish, compact rooms are cleverly designed around you. Catch up with friends online or watch the latest blockbuster movies through your smart TV. Customise the lighting and the temperature with our app. Stay connected with super-fast, free Wi-Fi, and experience the city at your fingertips. All reservations placed at this hotel are subject to Premier Inn’s standard Terms and Conditions.

name.content: Premier Inn London Paddington - Paddington Basin

996938.description: Make your next trip to London easier with our convenient Premier Inn London Paddington (Paddington Basin) hotel. We’re just a 5-minute walk away from Paddington Station, ideal if you’re travelling in from Bristol, Cornwall or elsewhere in the southwest. We’re also just a five-minute walk from Edgware Road Station – both stations are great for getting Tube rides to Central London and beyond! Now we’re probably a little biased, but Paddington Basin is probably one of the best places to stay in London. Not only are you close to all the fun on the Thames and right next to the train station, you’re also only a 5-minute Tube ride (or 20-minute walk…!) from Hyde Park, one of London’s biggest and most famous parks. Perfect for picnics in the summer and home to Winter Wonderland in the winter, our hotel practically puts one of London’s best parks on your doorstep. And that’s not all, we’re also really close to Regent’s Park and the world-famous Madame Tussauds – see the stars up close in all their waxy glory only an 10-minute Tube ride away from our hotel. Wherever your trip to London takes you, make sure to stop by our Bar + Block restaurant next door to fill up on some of the finest cuts of steak and our unlimited full English Premier Inn Breakfast. Make full use of our free Wi-Fi in our rooms and across our hotel, and if you need to chill out before a long journey the communal areas in our hotel are perfect. After a brilliant day exploring Paddington Basin and the rest of London, look forward to a relaxing sleep in the middle of all the hustle and bustle of the capital on one of our super-comfy kingsize beds.

996943.description: Our Premier Inn Whitley Bay hotel is a great destination for a family beach break - right in front of a lovely stretch golden sand that's jam-packed with things to do. While you're here, relax on the beautiful Whitley Bay beach, uncover the secrets of the historic Seaton Delaval Hall or take the little ones to see the clownfish at the Blue Reef Aquarium. You could even explore nearby Newcastle and see the Angel of the North. After a day out enjoying the fresh air, head back for a tasty dinner in our Beefeater restaurant and drift off into the soundest sleep in your ultra-comfy, kingsize Hypnos bed. 1023772.description: A Warm Welcome To Your Liverpool HotelThe Perfect 4 Star Hotel In Central LiverpoolIdeally located in the heart of the city centre, Maldron Hotel Liverpool is just minutes away from the city’s star attractions. 1024283.description: Welcome to Maldron Hotel Shoreditch, an epic base for your city adventures. Positioned just a short stroll away from Shoreditch High Street, Spitalfields Market, and right in the heart of one of London’s coolest, most vibrant neighbourhoods, Maldron Hotel Shoreditch taps right into the lively pulse of London's legendary urban scene. Benefitting from excellent transport connections and nestled in the heart of Shoreditch's thriving culture, our hotel is the perfect choice for both leisure and business travellers alike. Liverpool Street Station is a mere 5 minutes' walk away, providing access to direct links out of London, a super-fast service to Stanstead Airport, and convenient connections to other major transportation hubs. Discover a wealth of attractions mere minutes from our hotel doorstep. Whether indulging in vintage fashion and culinary delights along the trendy Brick Lane, exploring the rich heritage of Shoreditch Church, or unwinding at Spitalfields Market, there's an abundance of experiences waiting to be savoured. For business travellers, getting to the renowned business hub of the City of London is a breeze, with Old Street Station a only 500 metres from our doorstep. Settle into any of our 149 modern, inviting, and generously-sized rooms, or squeeze in a workout at our well-equipped gym. Then, descend to our inviting Grain & Grill bar and restaurant, open round-the-clock to tantalise your taste buds with delectable dishes, tempting treats, and refreshing beverages.

Then enjoy the new: great restaurants and bars are popping up all over the place. Guests can enjoy thoughtful art-deco design that reflects the local theatres, an equipped gym, a sauna, a co-working area, and a stylish restaurant. The hotel provides a boutique hospitality experience, combining the privacy of an apartment with the services of a luxury hotel. Each guest apartment is uniquely designed and features a fully-equipped kitchen, a dining and living area, and high-end amenities. Rooms include high-speed WiFi, climate control, a flat-screen TV, and comfortable beds, ensuring a seamless stay. The private bathrooms offer premium touches such as a rain shower and complimentary toiletries. Beyond the comfort of your apartment, guests can work in the co-working space, relax in the sauna, or enjoy a meal at the restaurant. The gym is equipped with the latest fitness equipment, providing an exclusive wellness experience. The July - London Victoria is ideally located, with theatres, cultural hotspots, and excellent transport connections at your doorstep, making it the perfect place to explore the city like a local.

1085571.description: Six Senses London sets a different rhythm for the city. The brand’s first UK destination, set within the reborn Whiteley in Bayswater, is an icon reimagined for a new era. An urban oasis with a rhythm all its own, where each of the 109 rooms, suites, and 14 branded residences is crafted with intention. Many open onto private terraces, dissolving the line between indoors and out. The arrival sets the tone: an art deco lobby, layered with greenery and framed by soaring ceilings. At its heart, the grand cascading staircase from the original Whiteley’s department store once modelled on Milan’s La Scala is back and revived for its new home. Restoration here is bold. It’s theatre. Whiteley’s Kitchen, Bar and Café sits at the centre of it all. Executive Chef Eliano Crespi leads with instinct and flavour. Guided by William Whiteley’s pioneering spirit, the kitchen celebrates fresh, seasonal, and local ingredients, turning each plate into a generous, expressive experience. From morning to night, Whiteley’s Bar evolves with the hours: natural wines and small plates by day; cocktails with character after dark. Alchemy shapes the menu, adding playful moments of surprise to every order. Whiteley’s Café spills into the courtyard with coffee that wakes, pastries that make you linger, and ice cream built for afternoons that stretch too long. Below, the Six Senses Spa captures London’s layered energy in one continuous flow between movement and stillness. Pause in vaulted calm, explore fitness and biohacking zones, or step into the Alchemy Bar for rituals that blend nature and science. The world’s first Six Senses Place introduces a new rhythm: a space to restore, to gather, and to belong. Some moments are shared, others kept close. The atmosphere is social but never forced, shaped by those who walk through the door. The Earth Lab brings sustainability to life. Come curious. Leave inspired.

Revolver Glasgow: Where Style Meets the Street

Forget everything you know about traditional hostels. Located in the heart of Glasgow’s trendy Merchant City, Revolver is a bold, inclusive, and lifestyle-led hotel-meets-hostel designed for the modern explorer. Housed in the historic Virginia House, we’ve blended the building’s original Victorian character with neon-drenched corridors, local queer art, and a high-energy social atmosphere. 


Whether you’re a solo backpacker, a couple on a city break, or a group ready to hit the town, we have a space for you:

Solo & Social: Choose from our sleek Japanese-style pods or premium dormitory bunks—all featuring privacy curtains, personal lockers, and integrated USB charging. 

Private Retreats: Upgrade to our Signature Double or King Rooms, many featuring en-suite bathrooms, high ceilings, and unique Ab-Fab inspired murals. 

Group Stays: Traveling with the whole squad? Our Multi-room Apartments sleep up to 8 and come equipped with private kitchens and lounge areas. 

The Location
You couldn't be more central. We are situated directly above the iconic Polo Lounge and steps away from the city's best nightlife. 

Transport: A 10-minute walk from Glasgow Central and Queen Street stations. 

Culture: Minutes from George Square, the Gallery of Modern Art (GoMA), and the luxury shops of Buchanan Street. 

Food: Surrounded by the Merchant City’s legendary dining scene, from Neapolitan pizza to high-end steakhouses. 

Good to Know

Adults Only (18+): We maintain a vibrant, grown-up atmosphere. 

The Soundtrack of the City: We are located in a bustling nightlife district. We provide complimentary earplugs for those who want to sleep, but we’re the perfect choice for those who want to dance.
